rows.name: Orange You Glad i Didn't Say Banana
rows.short_description: 🍌 Orange You Glad I Didn’t Say Banana?! 🍌 Play as Banana man, a bipedal banana with a minigun in this chaotic rogue-ike platformer! Mod your gun with a flamethrower, rocket launcher, or grappling hook, battle endless enemies, and climb the global leaderboard. The further you go, the harder it gets
rows.description_html: Orange You Glad I Didn't Say Banana?! Get ready for the wackiest, most action-packed roguelike platformer you've ever seen! Orange You Glad I Didn’t Say Banana? throws you into the peel of Banana man , a bipedal banana with a thirst for destruction and a minigun that spits absolute chaos! This isn’t just any ordinary run-and-gun adventure—this is a fast-paced, high-intensity, endlessly challenging roguelike where every run is different, and every decision can mean the difference between glorious victory and getting turned into a fruit smoothie! MOD YOUR MINIGUN—UNLEASH MAYHEM! Why settle for just a minigun when you can slap on some of the wildest mods imaginable? Choose from a selection of ridiculous yet devastating weapon upgrades to turn your gun into something truly overpowered: 🔥 Flamethrower – Turn up the heat and roast your enemies into crispy snacks! 🚀 Rocket Launcher – Blast through waves of foes with explosive firepower! 🪝 Grappling Hook – Swing through the map like a banana-flavored ninja, dodging enemies and pulling off insane aerial stunts! 💥 More to Discover! – Unlock secret upgrades that completely change the way you play! Each mod completely alters the gameplay , allowing you to mix and match upgrades for maximum destruction. Experiment with different builds and see just how far you can push Banana Joe’s arsenal! THE FURTHER YOU GO, THE HARDER IT GETS! Think you’ve mastered the game? Think again. Orange You Glad I Didn’t Say Banana? ramps up the difficulty the longer you survive. Enemies get tougher, levels become deadlier, and only the most skilled players will be able to push past the chaos. Survival is key, but destruction is king! GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS – COMPETE FOR BANANA SUPREMACY! What’s the point of all this mayhem if you can’t prove you’re the best? Climb the global leaderboard and show the world that you’re the ultimate Banana! Compete for high scores, perfect your runs, and etch your name in the hall of fruit-based legends! ARE YOU READY TO GO BANANAS?! This is not just another platformer. This is an adrenaline-fueled, over-the-top, fruit-flavored explosion of chaos that will keep you coming back for more. So grab your minigun, mod it to the max, and prepare for the wildest roguelike platformer ever created!

rows.name: Hellkind
rows.short_description: You awaken to whispers of an ancient cult and their unholy rite. As the veil to the dead unravels, explore, solve puzzles, and escape - before you become part of the ritual.
rows.description_html: Trapped in the misty sanctuary of San Andrés de Teixido, you awaken to whispers of an ancient cult and their unholy rite. As the veil between worlds begins to fray, explore, solve puzzles, and escape - before you become part of the ritual. In a mist-shrouded village of Galicia, ancient shadows stir as whispers of A Irmandade da Compaña echo once more. Long thought lost to time, the cult of the dead has resurfaced, gathering in the sanctuary of San Andrés de Teixido to summon something evil. Their ritual nears completion, and with it, the boundary between the living and the dead begins to fray. The ritual remains incomplete, for only a witch can seal the final act of summoning. Until today, they had none. But that is about to change. You wake in darkness, the air thick with an eerie presence. Something stirs - something that should have remained buried. Hellkind is a short and immersive experience inspired by the folklore and atmosphere of Galicia and Spain - blends exploration, light puzzle solving, all set against a backdrop of ancient religious rituals and forbidden knowledge. As players navigate the eerie sanctuary and its shadowed corners, they will feel the weight of claustrophobic tension, with unseen horrors lurking just beyond the veil of reality. With its forgotten cults, spectral processions, and the ever-present temptation of religion, the game weaves elements of supernatural horror and mystery into a chilling experience. Every step feels like a step toward salvation, pushing them closer to unraveling the cult’s dark intentions.

rows.name: The Little Shelter Demo
rows.short_description: The Little Shelter is a narrative 2D platformer about identity, anxiety, and self-discovery. Guide Lunaaa through surreal dreamscapes and NYC streets in a beautifully hand-drawn journey shaped by emotion, exploration, and resilience.
rows.description_html: The Little Shelter The Little Shelter is a narrative-driven 2D platformer that follows Lunaaa, a young Asian woman navigating the overwhelming chaos of New York City in search of solace and self-discovery . Caught between reality and surreal dreamscapes , players will embark on a deeply emotional journey through loss, resilience, and transformation . Key Features: 🎭 Deeply Personal Story – Experience Lunaaa’s emotional struggles , shaped by the highs and lows of city life, as she seeks a place to call home. 🏙️ Surreal NYC-Inspired Environments – Journey through handcrafted 2D levels that blend gritty urban realism with dreamlike visuals, mirroring Lunaaa’s shifting emotional states. 🎮 Platforming & Puzzle Mechanics – Navigate challenging platforming sequences and environmental puzzles that reflect both external obstacles and internal struggles. 🔥 Anxiety System – A unique game mechanic that represents Lunaaa’s emotional state, affecting her movement, perception, and interactions with the world. 🎶 Atmospheric Soundtrack – A rich, immersive score that evolves with the narrative, heightening the emotional depth of Lunaaa’s journey. 🎨 Hand-Drawn Art & Animation – Vibrant, expressive visuals that bring the world to life, blending modern indie aesthetics with evocative storytelling . Whether you’ve ever felt lost in a city’s noise or found shelter in your own silence, The Little Shelter invites you into a tender, visually stunning meditation on identity, emotion, and the courage to keep moving.

rows.name: Luna and the Sea
rows.short_description: A hand-drawn-style point-and-click adventure set in 17th-century Amsterdam. Play as Luna, a young girl surviving on the streets, solving puzzles, and embarking on a journey to find her father. A touching story about kindness, resilience, and the sea.
rows.description_html: Luna and the Sea is a beautifully hand-drawn-style, story-driven point-and-click adventure set in 17th-century Amsterdam . You play as Luna , a young girl surviving alone on the streets, who embarks on a journey across the sea to find her long-lost father. With only her wits and kindness, Luna navigates a world that is both cruel and wondrous, encountering characters who are struggling just like her. Every choice matters—will you help those in need, or look out only for yourself? This first chapter introduces players to Luna’s world, where puzzles, exploration, and heartfelt storytelling blend seamlessly. Key Features: A rich narrative adventure – Experience a heartwarming yet bittersweet story about hope, loss, and resilience. Classic point-and-click gameplay – Solve puzzles, interact with unique characters, and explore a historically inspired setting. Hand-drawn art style – A visually distinctive, pencil-drawn world that feels like stepping into a child’s dream. Choices that matter – Luna’s interactions shape her journey, rewarding kindness and cleverness. A dynamic hint system – Luna’s only friend, the moon , gently guides her when she’s lost. This game was made by humans with the help of AI.

rows.name: Turn It Around
rows.short_description: Solve puzzles by turning the maze around. 'Turn It Around' is a gravity-based puzzle game where you'll need to rotate the scene left or right to slide the balls to the goal. Navigate through increasingly challenging levels with a variety of evolving mechanics.
rows.description_html: Do you remember those wooden puzzles where you have to move a ball through a maze to reach the goal? Well, this game is based on a similar premise: to reach the goal, you have to rotate the stage. Turn it Around is a gravity-based puzzle game where, in each level, you must solve a small labyrinth by rotating it left or right. As you progress, new mechanics will be introduced, refreshing the experience and gradually increasing the complexity. The game features 45 different levels , each one more challenging than the last, until they become true tests of logic and skill that will keep you entertained for hours. Solve all the intricate puzzles and help the balls return to their homeland, Bolaland !

rows.short_description: Mazer is a puzzle game where you have to find a way through a maze while following rules of every element you encounter. With 150 handcrafted puzzles of varying difficulty, each level will test your logic to its limits!
rows.description_html: Mazer is a puzzle game where you have to find a way through a maze while following rules of every element you encounter. How to Play? 🧩 Find a path through the maze while obeying the rules of stars, shapes, geometric figures, and other elements. 🌟 Each element has its own unique behavior – find out how they interact to solve the puzzle! 💡Learn the game through a dedicated in-game 'How to play?' tutorial and starter puzzles set. 🧠 Levels increase in difficulty, keeping you engaged and challenged. Try Mazer now and put your logic to the test!

rows.name: Grafika66 - The Galleries
rows.short_description: Explore Grafika66 – The Galleries, a curated virtual art space showcasing digital paintings, limited-edition skate decks, and 3D sculptures. Navigate 11 immersive galleries in first-person, built with cutting-edge Unreal Engine technology.
rows.description_html: Grafika66 – The Galleries is an interactive virtual art gallery built in Unreal Engine, designed to present a curated selection of digital art from the catalogue that acts as a complement to the Grafika66 website. The gallery offers 11 freely explorable spaces in 1st person, allowing visitors to navigate through a collection of digital paintings, limited-edition skate deck designs, and a small number of 3D sculptures. Each piece is carefully selected to reflect a blend of traditional and contemporary influences, offering a unique take on various forms and materials. Features: 11 Freely Explorable Gallery Spaces – Navigate through a series of exhibition rooms, each showcasing a mix of art in a minimalist, immersive setting. Digital Paintings & 3D Sculptures – A focused selection of artwork, including fine art canvases, digital display panels, 3D sculptures, and skate deck designs displayed throughout the space. Quick Navigation - Use the map to teleport to one of the 11 galleries, or simply take a casual browse through the first-person navigation. Grafika66 – The Galleries is more than just a virtual art space—it's an evolving exploration of digital and traditional artistry. Whether you’re an art enthusiast or someone looking to engage with creativity in an interactive environment, this gallery offers a fresh way to experience modern art.

rows.name: Battle Tokens
rows.short_description: Battle Tokens is a free-to-play, turn-based tactics RPG where up to 9 players push 2D tokens across a living grid, crush escalating monster waves, and complete dynamic quests for gold, upgrades, and items!
rows.description_html: Battle Tokens is a free-to-play, turn-based tactics RPG that squeezes the thrill of a tabletop dungeon crawl into bite-size multiplayer matches. Pick a class, slide your 2D token across a living grid, and repel wave after wave of goblins, orcs, undead—and, if you last long enough, dragons—while story quests shape the fate of the realm. Play solo, queue with strangers, or host a private lobby for up to 9 heroes. Key Features Token-Based Tactics No rulebook required: chain abilities and status ailments in lightning-fast encounters that feel like a Friday-night D&D skirmish brought to life. Choose a Class, Master a Build Launch lineup: Warrior, Archer, Mage, Healer (more on the roadmap). Each offers unique stats, abilities, and gear synergies—from glass-cannon fire mages to shield-wall bruisers. Massive Co-op Up to 9-player online co-op. Utilize your class specialties to protect your allies, kill the enemies, or heal your friends. Quest-Driven Progression Escort caravans, defend relics, purge elite foes. Every run strings dynamic objectives into a mini-story that feeds the larger campaign. Roguelite Leveling system Earn gold, unlock new skills, and shop between runs for gear. Opt into endless Survival mode to chase legendary drops. Unique-Style Art Bold outlines, flat fills, and a medieval-pub UI bring the battlefield to life, backed by lute-laden tavern tunes. Built for 10-Minute Bursts or All-Night Raids Missions run ~30 min; Survival can last as long as 100 waves, can you make it to the end? Cross-Play on the Way Planned launch on PC first, with mobile releasing soon after—party with friends on phones while you camp in your gaming chair. Controllers are supported! Free to play. Will your party’s tokens become legend—or shatter under the next boss’s crushing blow? Wishlist now! (More content to come! Still adding more classes, enemies, items, and missions!)

rows.name: Bling: Fortune Memories
rows.short_description: Explore a temple filled with traps and secrets in Bling: Fortune Memories. Use your wits, collect gems, and activate your invisibility ability to overcome challenges while searching for your missing brother. With tactical grid-based movement and a minimalist style, will you achieve fortune?
rows.description_html: Embark on a thrilling adventure of exploration and survival in Bling: Fortune Memories , a platformer and action game set in a mysterious abandoned temple. Play as a young adventurer searching for his lost brother, who vanished while trying to collect the temple’s legendary gems. KEY FEATURES Strategic exploration: Move on a 2D grid through an environment filled with traps, enemies, and hidden secrets. Invisibility power: Use the Medallion’s power to temporarily become invisible and evade deadly dangers. Puzzles and challenges: Each level introduces new mechanics and obstacles that will test your wits and reflexes. Minimalist art style: A simple, geometric visual style that enhances the strategic gameplay. Collection-based progression: Find and gather gems to unlock new levels and advance the story. Can you overcome the temple’s challenges and rescue your brother before it’s too late?

rows.name: Plenty of Fish in the Sea
rows.short_description: Plenty of Fish in the Sea is a cozy narrative-driven dating sim where you engage in heartfelt conversations with charming salmon and take them on delightful underwater dates.
rows.description_html: In Plenty of Fish in the Sea , you dive into the serene, shimmering waters of a peaceful river, where the salmon are not just fish but charming, chatty companions with unique personalities, dreams, and dating preferences. As a friendly aquatic matchmaker (and potential love interest), you’ll engage in heartwarming conversations with a diverse cast of salmon, from poetic deep-thinkers to adventurous thrill-seekers.   Swim through winding streams, moonlit waterfalls, and cozy underwater grottos as you take your fishy friends on delightful dates—whether it’s a scenic drift downriver, a romantic algae-tasting picnic, or a playful game of leaping over waterfalls.   With colorful visuals, a soothing soundtrack of bubbling brooks and gentle chiptune melodies, and branching dialogue choices that shape your relationships, Plenty of Fish in the Sea is a cozy, feel-good experience about connection, companionship, and the simple joys of swimming side by side. Will you find your perfect fishy match?

rows.description_html: You are a doll who wakes up on the day of her owner's first period. How will you navigate the unfamiliar and increasingly surreal situation? Navigate immersive psychological environments. As the girl's mental state deteriorates, how does your environment change? Solve puzzles to help your owner. Look for solutions in your environment to the problems she's facing. Discover journal pages and gain insight into your world. How did things come to be this way? Survive the horrors of growing up.

rows.name: Nyanco Channel Engine
rows.short_description: Nyanco Channel Engine is a reactive VTuber simulation app featuring easy mic and keyboard controls, custom avatars, handy creative tools, simple screen capture, and an engaging idle roguelike mini-game. No webcam needed!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Nyanco Channel Engine , a user-friendly reactive VTuber app designed for gamers, streamers, and creative enthusiasts. Enjoy becoming a VTuber by simply using your microphone (with loopback support) and keyboard inputs—no webcam is necessary. This webcam-free feature helps protect your privacy while you interact with your viewers through a virtual avatar. If you face microphone or audio output issues or require advanced management such as loopback support, installing VoiceMeeter software is recommended. Customize your streaming avatar by using the provided Nyanco character or by easily uploading your own images. Beyond virtual streaming, Nyanco Channel Engine is also a handy gaming assistant, featuring: Built-in Notepad: Conveniently note down strategies, reminders, or streaming notes without exiting your game. Creative Paint Tool: Quickly sketch ideas or annotate captured screen images, enriching your gaming and streaming interactions. Instant Screen Capture (F10): Select and embed parts of your screen into the paint tool, ideal for emphasizing important gameplay moments or explanations. Custom Avatar Setup: You can select two custom images for your avatar: an idle state image (Image A) and a reactive state image (Image B). Use the 'Select Image' button in the UI to select each image separately. Idle Roguelike Mini-Game: A mouse-controlled game where you guide Nyanco through dungeons using arrow keys. Encounter creatures such as goblins (g), skeletons (s), orcs (o), and collect potions (p). Activate automatic gameplay by clicking the 'A' button to enjoy idle gaming. Streamer-Friendly Features: Chroma-Key Mode (F8): Activate or deactivate chroma-key for smooth integration with OBS or Discord. Background Sync (F9): Allows syncing background color directly to your preference. Helpful Tips: Press Alt+F4  to quickly exit the application. Press F2  to access this helpful tutorial at any time. For advanced audio management or troubleshooting microphone and loopback issues, installing Voice Meeter is recommended. The base app is free , displaying a watermark logo. Optional paid DLC is available to remove this watermark for a cleaner streaming appearance. Nyanco Channel Engine —your streaming and gaming companion, designed with your comfort and creativity in mind!

rows.name: Garden Masters
rows.short_description: The final project for a team of high school seniors as part of their game design class, Garden Masters is a free-to-play gardening game with a fast pace.
rows.description_html: The final product for a team of high school seniors as a part of their game design class, Garden Masters is a free-to-play, fast-paced, first-person gardening game where you aim to make the most money by planting seeds to grow your plant empire. In Garden Masters, there are three unique areas where you can aim to expand your garden. The humble and rustic Breezyglade, the arid and desolate Barrenbloom, and the vividly tropical Sandyshrub. Each area has its own unique environmental hazards, such as animals, insects, crabs, scorpions, and... Sharks?! To amass your garden empire, you must do the following: Buy seeds! Grow Plants! Avoid hazards and fight off pests! Earn Money! So, how much money can you earn?

rows.name: Astrohaulers
rows.short_description: Astrohaulers is a sci-fi package management game that challenges you to build and expand your delivery network across the galaxy.
rows.description_html: Astrohaulers is a sci-fi package management game that challenges you to build and expand your delivery network across the galaxy. Your mission is to deliver color-coded packages to the correct space stations. As you successfully deliver packages, you’ll unlock new stations and boost your score. Strategize your routes and optimize your deliveries to become the ultimate interstellar hauler! DELIVER PACKAGES You are in charge of coordinating deliveries across different sectors of space. Place packages on ships and send them to their destinations! STRATEGIZE YOUR ROUTES Support efficient deliveries everywhere in your sector by strategically connecting stations. Be wary though, as routes can’t cross each other. Will you better connect important stations or will you be sure packages can get anywhere in your network in reasonable times? ACHIEVE HIGH SCORES Each sector has its own challenges for you to master. Can you beat your high score? Can you beat ours? … OR WATCH YOUR NETWORK DESCEND INTO CHAOS

rows.name: Awkward Valley
rows.short_description: Welcome to Awkward Valley! Plan your day, tackle strange activities, and unlock bizarre new options as you go. Gym? Therapy? Vending machine snacks? It’s up to you! Featuring Awkward Yeti’s weird and wonderful characters in a totally normal town.
rows.description_html: Awkward Valley is a totally normal, definitely-not-a-time-loop daily planner sim! Each morning, drag activities from your trusty notebook into your schedule and hit 'Start' to watch your perfectly (or terribly) planned day unfold. Will you be productive, exhausted, or just spiral into existential dread?  Featuring a micro deck-building mechanic, every choice shapes your routine. Convert fatigue into gains at the gym, fuel your soul (or just your stomach) with vending machine snacks, or attend therapy to process your life choices. As you progress, unlock new activities, modifiers, and Rue Valley-inspired oddities—because nothing here is ever truly normal. With illustrations by Awkward Yeti and a healthy dose of absurdity, Awkward Valley! is your chance to micromanage a surreal life - one scheduled breakdown at a time!

rows.name: Project Freefall
rows.short_description: Grab your squad and dive into a frantic chase for the lone parachute as you play the ultimate game of tag at 10,000 feet! Toss a grenade, spray a fire extinguisher, or dodge the shark as you skydive with your friends. Will you go on to victory or go splat? Free to play in Alpha.
rows.description_html: Dive into Project Freefall,  free to play in Alpha, where the stakes are as high as the altitude. You and up to seven friends are plummeting towards the earth in this adrenaline-pumping game of tag... but there’s only ONE parachute. The rules are simple: survive. The parachute drops from the plane. Your job? Skydive out of the plane and grab it for yourself. Toss a grenade, spray a fire extinguisher, or dodge the shark as you weave through the clouds in a high-speed aerial chase where alliances are temporary and gravity is permanent. As the ground rushes up to meet you, the intensity skyrockets. It's a hilarious, high-skill dance of chaos where only one can claim the ultimate victory, leaving the rest to an… explosive landing. FEATURES: 8-Player Mayhem: Invite your squad for the ultimate test of friendship and reflexes. More players mean more chaos! Cross-Platform Play: Dive in from either PC or VR. Everyone plays together in the same sky. In-game Voice Chat: Talk with your friends as you plummet through the air. High-Stakes, Simple Rules: Easy to learn, but mastering aerial maneuvers to secure the win at the last second takes true skill. Flex Your Style: Look good while you fall! Project Freefall lets you shop for unique characters and Diver suits to customize your look. What are you waiting for? Download for free and join our Discord to help shape the experience. It’s a race to the bottom - will you land with a prize or a splat?

rows.description_html: Sisyphi is a casual strategy game about two players (Sisyphus) competing against each other to push their boulder towards the finish line. But there is a twist. The map that you play on is generated from text-to-AI, so you play what you type! With short 15-minute matches, have a fun time with your friends trying to race to the finish. Use skill moves to get a better chance to win! Dev Note : This was a solo project, and offers gameplay the scope of which is restricted by the capabilities of AI. Hence, it's not as expansive as it can be, so go easy on me!

rows.name: Time Gamers: 12000 Years in One Square Mile
rows.short_description: You have just been trained and certified as a 'Time Gamer'. Your first task is to travel back in time to the area of the longest running period of continuous human history in the United States. There, you must collect the DNA of extinct animals and important people of the past.
rows.description_html: In a one-square-mile area in the United States, evidence has shown that there have been 12,000 years of continuous human habitation. From Native American, to the first European expedition (de Soto), and first backcountry fort and settlement. In this same area, there were battles of both the American Revolution and the American Civil War. This game/simulation recreates the objects and terrain of this history. You are a time gamer. Until now, time gamers were just explorers. The only thing they could bring back from a parallel universe were the memories of their experience. But new methods and technology will allow you to bring back specially designed devices from the future. Your combined universes have been selected so that such a future device may be found. Specifically, you will need to find a DNA sniffer which will allow you to sample and bring back the DNA of extinct life forms. If successful in your mission, these samples will be used to map the DNA history of Earth. This mapping will allow scientists to build and clone the animals of the future.. animals that will be able to survive the growing challenges of our planet.  Features: Immersive World: From pure native cultures to the first European settlers, you will move through prehistory and through the American Revolution and Civil War, and into the 20th century. But it is an item from the future that is key to mission success. Soundtrack: Original music written by award winning songwriters for this game. It sets the tone and mood for important scenes and leaves you with memorable melodies. 3D Anaglyph Mode: With the press of a key, you can turn the game into 3D. Red/Cyan 3D glasses are required. Historical Narration: As you move around, a narrator will educate you on the true history of each location you enter. You will interact with people of that time. The buildings you encounter have been recreated based on historical documentation and local archaeology work. Critical Decisions: You must find, identify, and sample, key DNA targets. Some of these may be 'hidden'. You must always be looking for clues. Achievements: In addition to DNA targets, you will also have the opportunity to explore and earn many achievements.

rows.name: Days Without Incident
rows.short_description: It has been -̷̯͙̔̈́-̴̱̽̓͝-̷̍̊̕͠  days without incident. Your investigation has brought you to an old metalworks factory, abandoned after a series of mysterious deaths. But something’s been growing in the quiet. A short first-person survival horror experience.
rows.description_html: VINTAGE SURVIVAL HORROR Days Without Incident is a short, never-before-seen horror experience from We Create Stuff. This lost prototype from 2017 reveals the creative roots of In Sound Mind. Take a nostalgia trip back to the 2010s: keep an eye on your health, make every bullet count, and solve intriguing puzzles as you navigate a haunted factory. DON'T DRINK THE WATER Working off no more than an old newspaper clipping, you've come to the town of Ebenflow to find the answers you've been hunting for. Its people live in the shadow of an awful tragedy; they may want to forget, but you've come to find the truth of what happened to the factory and its workers. Why doesn't anyone drink the water? Features: A Lost Prototype: Experience a previously-unreleased piece of horror history. Noir-Drenched Mystery: Investigate an abandoned metalworks factory that’s plagued by sickness, whispers, and silence. Piece together the hidden truth, and what’s been left to fester… The DNA of Indie Horror: An evolutionary milestone between Nightmare House: The Original Mod and In Sound Mind. Designed to Linger: This survival horror experience is a short 45-60 minutes, sharp and unsettling.

rows.name: Study Arcade
rows.short_description: Study > Play > Repeat
rows.description_html: When you open Study Arcade, you're presented with an extremely simple interface to set a timer and get going. Hit Start, leave it open in the background, and get to work. It'll alert you  automatically when it's time to take a break. Come back after studying, hit Play, and it'll give you a list of arcade minigame for you to play, giving you a break when you need one! I've made 3 minigames so far, from block-breaking to retro shooter (okay, there may or may not be a 4th bonus game). Crucially, though, it only lets you play after you've already been productive, and all of the games are designed to give you a quick brain break and then help you get back to work. Study more to get a chance to play all of them and try to beat the highscore. Escape the doomscrolling, get stuff done, and most importantly, have fun while doing it. Simple as that! The Pomodoro Technique (25 minutes of intense focus followed by 5 minutes of rest) is extremely helpful for more productive studying and working, but let's be honest, we all get distracted pretty easily. My attempts to use the technique looked something like this: set a timer, timer goes off, start scrolling social media or playing a game designed to keep me on for as long as possible, get distracted, and never get back to work. The problem is that most entertainment is designed to monetize your time, the most important resource you have! This free tool helps you solve that problem. It's what I wish I had when I was in school (especially during college), and so I'm putting it out there for free.

rows.name: Obscula
rows.short_description: Face the fears lurking in the dark. Obscula is a psychological horror experience that tells the story of someone seeking the truth but finding themselves trapped in a nightmare. There's no escape, only answers… but are you ready for the truth?
rows.description_html: Obscula is a first-person psychological horror game that drags players into the depths of the mind, blending psychological terror with an oppressive atmosphere. Forgotten memories, distorted realities, and an overwhelming sense of dread lurk in every shadow. As you search for the truth, you must face the horrors that hide within the walls of this forsaken place. Story: You were once a servant in this house, but your past is nothing but a blur. Trapped within its decaying halls, you are haunted by eerie whispers, shadowy figures, and fragmented memories. Someone doesn’t want you to remember. But before you can uncover the truth, you must confront the illusions that cloud your mind. This house is not what it seems. Behind each door lies more than just a room—it holds echoes of the past, watching, waiting. You must question everything you see, for every step forward may lead you closer to the truth… or deeper into madness. Gameplay: Atmospheric Horror: A slow-burning fear that lingers in every corner—Obscula builds tension through psychological dread rather than cheap jump scares. Bone-Chilling Sound Design: Every whisper, every creak, and every distant footstep reminds you that you are never truly alone. Story-Driven Exploration: Gather fragments of the past through environmental storytelling and unravel the dark truth hidden within the house.

rows.name: Knight Brawler
rows.short_description: Inspired by the masterpieces of the past, Knight Brawler is a nostalgic 2D platformer that combines thrilling action with vintage game play.
rows.description_html: Knight Brawler Inspired by the masterpieces of the past, Knight Brawler is a nostalgic 2D platformer that combines thrilling action with vintage game play. In order to save the girl and vanquish the evil that stands in your way, you must bravely navigate a number of difficult levels that are full with fierce foes, fearsome platforming scenes, and a formidable boss. Inspired by Retro Legends Every level pays special tribute to the heyday of video games. You'll encounter a wide variety of obstacles that will put your abilities and reflexes to the test, whether you're fighting your way through platforming parts or slashing in intense action. Epic Adventure Awaits Navigate through a variety of lively settings while you slash and jump your way through every level. Before you battle the ultimate villain in the final showdown, you must defeat a unique collection of foes and challenges in each stage. Features Classic 2D Platforming: Slash, jump, and fight your way through dangerous, retro-inspired levels. Nostalgic Sound & Visuals: With pixel art, nostalgic music, and an exhilarating arcade setting, relive the enchantment of classic games. Save the Girl: In this timeless story of bravery, save the girl and vanquish the evil forces that are endangering the land. Prepare to fight your way in Knight Brawler, the ultimate homage to classic video games!

rows.short_description: Gamble, survive, and outplay your debt! In Bling Bling Bankruptcy, you’re deep in the red, and the only way out is through high-stakes gambling. Play Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Plinko, and more, buy items for bonuses, and survive as many days as possible!
rows.description_html: 💰 Gamble, Survive, Repeat! 💰 Welcome to Bling Bling Bankruptcy , a high-stakes gambling adventure where every decision could be your last. Drowning in debt, you have only one way out—bet big, win bigger, and stay ahead of the collectors. But be careful… one bad day, and it’s game over! 🃏 Play Your Way to Fortune (or Ruin) 🃏 Test your luck and skills across a variety of classic and chaotic gambling games: 🎲 Poker – Outplay your opponents and go all-in. 🃏 Blackjack – Count cards or trust your gut. 🎡 Roulette – Red or black? Your fate spins in an instant. 🎯 Plinko – Drop and pray for the jackpot. 🐄 Bet Your Booze – Bet on the cow booze.. That's it. 🪙 Flip the Coin – 50/50, all or nothing. 💣 Mines – Avoid disaster and cash out before it’s too late. 📈 Stock Market – Buy low, sell high, or lose it all. 🛒 Upgrade Your Odds at the Local Store Stop by the convenience store to buy items that boost your chances—lucky charms, energy drinks, or even shady insider tips. Every edge counts when your life is on the line. 📆 Can You Survive Another Day? The clock is ticking. Each day, your debt grows. If you can’t pay up, it’s game over. Manage your time, take calculated risks, and climb your way out of financial hell—before the collectors find you. 🏆 How Far Can You Go? • Rogue-like gambling mechanics: every run is different. • Buy items to enhance your gambling skills and odds. • A dark yet humorous take on the high-risk world of betting. • Stylish pixel art aesthetic with a gritty casino vibe. Are you ready to risk it all? Play Bling Bling Bankruptcy and roll the dice on your future! 🎰🔥

rows.name: Serious Survivors
rows.short_description: The most EXPLOSIVE roguelike boomer shooter. Fully packed with serious action, wicked humor, and good old bloody fun. Blast hordes of bastards, stack insane perks, and unlock new stuff. Survive…or get shredded trying!.. And try again.
rows.description_html: GIT GUD! GIT BETTER! GIT SERIOUS! SERIOUS SURVIVORS is a brutally intense roguelike FPS where over-the-top carnage meets ridiculous power-ups. Circle-strafe, jump, dodge backpedal, and blast your way through endless hordes of enemies while collecting absurd perks that transform you from 'zero' to 'super-bad-ass-hero'. Hell is empty, and all the monsters are here – waiting for you to fill them with lead. MONSTERS GO 'RAWR' Clash with waves and waves of bloodthirsty enemies. From mildly annoying bastards to semi-deities eating heroes like you for breakfast. Every run throws hundreds of foes at you simultaneously. The only escape is through a mountain of corpses. GUNS GO 'PEW-PEW-PEW' Start with a trusty pistol, end with a walking arsenal of destruction. Dual-wield shotguns, unleash minigun mayhem, or reduce enemies to bloody mist with the particle disintegrator. Unlock new weapons between runs to expand your options for the next slaughter. UPGRADES GO 'BRRR' Combine during a single run for earth-shattering builds. Double your rate of fire! Triple your movement speed! Bullets that explode into more bullets! Create combos so powerful they should be illegal (and probably are in some dimensions). UNLOCKS GO  ' OH YEAH' Death is just the beginning. Use resources collected during runs to permanently unlock new starting weapons, perk options, and chaotic environments. Every failure brings you one step closer to becoming an unstoppable killing machine. ONE MORE RUN! Just died after a 20-minute rampage? Don't worry, the next run is just seconds away. Quick restarts and addictive gameplay loops will keep you saying 'just one more' until the sun comes up. Your sleep schedule never stood a chance.

rows.short_description: Cursed into a tadpole, you’ll swap between frog and tadpole forms in this puzzle-platformer to explore a magical pond, solve puzzles, and become human again
rows.description_html: In Lillapad , you play as Lilla, a young girl cursed into a tadpole by the mysterious King Frog. But when she discovers she can shift between tadpole and frog forms by hopping onto lilypads, a magical adventure begins. Explore a magical pond hidden in her backyard, solve puzzles using your dual forms, and search for two missing petals needed to restore the Golden Lilypad, the most powerful lilypad in the pond, and break the curse to become human again. The magic of Lilypads Lilypads aren’t just decoration, they let you swap between frog and tadpole anytime. Each form has its own strengths, so you’ll need to use both to make it through the pond. As a tadpole... Swim through the deepest parts of the pond, squeeze into hidden spots, and move lilypads into place to shape your own path. You may be small, but that has its advantages. As a frog... Climb over rocks, break weak walls, and swing across gaps using your tongue. You can even swallow seeds to spit them out to solve puzzles. On land, your frog skills truly shine. Meet Ruggero Ruggero is a mysterious Italian frog who helps you uncover your transformation abilities. He’s your guide through the pond and the key to understanding your destiny. Missing petals The Golden Lilypad is the only thing powerful enough to break your curse—but it’s missing two petals. You’ll need to use all your frog and tadpole tricks to find them, solve environmental puzzles, and get your human self back.

rows.name: Banshee
rows.short_description: The game is about escaping from a house where “Banshee”, a frightening looking fairy, wanders around, exploring the surroundings and using the items found to escape.
rows.description_html: story You wake up in a strange house and look for a way out to escape as quickly as possible. However, you cannot escape from the house because the doors are locked by numerous locks. Still, you try to find a way out of the house and look for something you can use inside. Then, Banshee, a frightening looking fairy, attacked you. Can you escape from the house of horror by using the items you picked up along the way, while running away from Banshee? About the game This is an exploration type horror game. The objective of the game is to find items while exploring the dimly lit house, and sometimes combine items to escape. Banshee, a frightening looking fairy, will chase you while you are exploring. If you are caught, you will be beaten and forced to return to your initial location. If you are caught by “Banshee,” one day will pass, and if you exceed the fifth day, you will be Game Over, so try not to get caught. There are also traps and surprises along the way to lure “Banshee. rows.name: Adult Life Yuri Bundle by Team ANPIM
rows.short_description: Collection of 4 yuri stories by Team ANPIM, featuring women who are 23 years and older! No longer students, they are finding romance while balancing the responsibilities of working, rent, and adulting.
rows.description_html: Four couples, four yuri stories Want to read yuri? Here's not only 1, but 4 yuri stories featuring women who are 23 years and older! No longer students, they are finding romance while balancing the responsibilities of working, rent, and adulting. Developed by Team ANPIM: Your quick fix for short, cheesy, and fluffy yuri kinetic novels. Total length: ~112,000 words My Dream Is To Be a Model, Not a Maid! Tanaka Akane is a stubborn and hot-headed 24 year old still chasing her lifetime dream of being a model, but after countless amounts of interviews, she still hasn't landed a permanent modeling job at an agency yet. To make matters worse, she accidentally spills coffee on a rich CEO's daughter and now this stranger demands Akane to be her maid to pay off the damages. How will Akane fare as a maid for this snobby and impossible rich girl? Will she even be able to last a day? Length: ~28,000 words There’s No Way I’d Fall in Love With a Womanizer, Right? Being the type that cares too much to a fault, Asahina Umeko helps out a supposedly drunk girl one night, and she soon finds out that this girl is the hot new celebrity worker at the mall she works at. She's instantly attracted despite their weird first meeting, but all that goes down the drain when Umeko finds out that this girl is a serial womanizer that breaks one too many hearts and with everything pointing to red flags. Umeko swears off falling for her, but can she really resist getting swept up by this womanizer's charisma, or will she end up getting drunk off her? Length: ~30,000 words The Moon That Fell for the Star Tsukimiya Minami is just an ordinary convenience store worker trying to make ends meet—another day, another dollar. But things takes an unexpected turn during a late-night shift when she encounters a mysterious stranger in need of help. Against her better judgment, Minami offers her a place to stay. Little does she know, her new and annoying (yet surprisingly captivating) roommate is more than meets the eye (and ear) with a plate full of troubles. Yet, Minami can’t seem to resist lending a hand. As Minami gains a new temporary roommate, she soon also ends up gaining something else unexpectedly… Length: ~28,000 words Love Goes Toward Love When a new cafe opens right in front of the one Chiyoda Juri works at, tensions begin to rise between the two competing owners. After a fateful encounter, Juri falls in love at first sight with the beautiful and charismatic stranger that saved her life—who just so happens to be the new worker at the rivalling cafe. To make matters worse, her savior already has eyes on someone else! How will Juri deal with these overflowing feelings for someone she shouldn’t have feelings for? Length: ~26,000 words Content warning: Some characters consume alcohol in the story. There is no sexual content in the stories. One character has slightly revealing outfit but no nudity is mentioned or depicted in-game.

rows.name: The Easter Bunny Game
rows.short_description: Grab eggs, bombs and anything else that falls to hand in this frantically stupid multiplayer party game. Perfect for ending quiet nights on the sofa, friendships, or marriages! Absolutely no animals remained intact during the creation of this product.
rows.description_html: An Epic almost thirty years in the making... Born in 16-bit in 1996 Played by literally some people from every corner of the room we were in Finally perfected for Steam in 2025, making full use of almost all the extra 48 bits The Easter Bunny Game is an hilarious pick up and play 2-8 player party game packed with bunnies, eggs, bombs, bits of bunnies, shotguns, more bits of bunnies, corks, buckets and carrots! Grab The Eggs! Race to gather eggs that rain from the sky and return them to your burrow. Grab a whole stack at once for bonus multipliers! Play in teams or every bunny for themselves. Play Dirty! Eggs aren't the only things falling from above. Stuff a bomb down a rival's burrow to halve their score, or cork it to trap them inside - or out. Drown 'em if they're hiding, or blow their head off and steal their load - just watch out; that shotgun has quite a kick! And, of course, ganging up on someone who's doing a little too well is only to be encouraged. Local Multiplayer and Remote Play Together Gather round! Two players can share a single controller with up to two more on keyboard, so a full party of eight can play with just three controllers. (FunLittleGames accepts no responsibility for loss or damage to hardware, software, firmware, thumbs, furniture, or relationships as a result of playing this game) Configure Everything! Adjust drop rates, round lengths, teams, and victory conditions to suit yourself. The sky is the limit - especially if you're in a burrow when a bomb goes off...

(FunLittleGames accepts no responsibility for loss or damage to hardware, software, firmware, thumbs, furniture, or relationships as a result of playing this game) Configure Everything! Adjust drop rates, round lengths, teams, and victory conditions to suit yourself. The sky is the limit - especially if you're in a burrow when a bomb goes off...

Step into the dojo and unleash your skills in a fast-paced, action-packed karate video game that brings the thrill of combat to your fingertips. Train, fight, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate karate champion. Are you ready to test your strength and strategy? The battle begins now! Special thanks to the Godot Engine.

rows.name: The Ghost of Alcantra
rows.short_description: The Ghost of Alcantra is a free kinetic romance/mystery vn that alternates between two perspectives, one focusing on a blossoming romantic relationship, and another focused on unraveling a murder mystery.
rows.description_html: Features:  Free Around 175,000 words Sprites and CGs done by YuukiPudding + Rhealess (14 Sets of Character sprites, plus 26 CGs) Classical music soundtrack Edited photo backgrounds of the Upper Peninsula of Michigan (the setting for the visual novel) Kinetic with a complete ending Takes place in the Midwest The Ghost of Alcantra is a passion project made by four people. It is a free kinetic romance/mystery vn that alternates between two perspectives, one taking place in 1987 and one taking place in 1997. In 1987, Nick Fox meets the mysterious Alexandria (who seems to know more than she lets on) at the Summer Festival of Alcantra. They become closer, but at the same time, Alcantra finds itself the center for a series of murders. In 1997, an unknown narrator gets hit by a motorcycle and ends up in the hospital with amnesia. A detective, Scarlet Storm, informs him that a murder has just occurred and gives him a note found with his belongings that says: “Her blood is on your hands.” He joins Detective Storm to assist in the case in hopes that doing so will help him recover his memories. She tells him that the townspeople think the murder was done for The Ghost of Alcantra. As the events progress, it becomes clear that the events of 1997 are connected to those of 1987. If you’re looking for a fairly lengthy visual novel focused around a central romance and mystery, consider The Ghost of Alcantra. There are many great visual novels that involve different routes or dating sim elements, but if you’re wanting to experience a narrative that emphasizes a singular, fleshed-out story, consider checking out The Ghost of Alcantra. Content Advisory: Profanity, Violence, Gore, Suicide

rows.name: Zui's Witch Academy
rows.short_description: Welcome to Zui's Witch Academy, a boss rush roguelike-styled game that encourages creativity by building decks to face off against skilled bosses in a row to beat the game. Choose your selection of magical cards to take down 8 uniquely designed bosses!
rows.description_html: Zui's Witch Academy is a boss rush roguelike-styled action game. You build a deck of 3 magical cards to take down one of many bosses. Each boss has an arena specifically tailored to them. Can you help Rysa graduate from Zui's Witch Academy with flying colors? This game was originally made for the Boss Rush 2025 Game Jam! Features 18 unique cards to collect and build your deck with! 3 difficulties to attempt and conquer, I doubt you can beat impossible mode (no like seriously, give up). Practice and master against every boss in training mode. 8 bosses each with their own arena specifically designed around them. An energetic and fun soundtrack! Complemented by a charming modern pixel-art aesthetic. What are you waiting for? The game is free! Download it and play it now! Rysa is waitin' for you to wake her up, how else is she going to graduate from Zui's Witch Academy?

rows.name: Kwyjibo Adventure
rows.short_description: Kwyjibo Adventure is a 3D turn-based combat game where fight against bullies using a magic yo-yo. Play as Emily, a new kid at school, where you fend for yourself by doing awesome tricks and casting mystic spells with your yo-yo
rows.description_html: Kwyjibo Adventure Step into the shoes of Emily, a kid navigating the trials of bullying, in Kwyjibo Adventure! Discover a magical yo-yo that grants incredible powers and embark on a journey to stand up to your bullies. Engage in strategic turn-based combat, master unique yo-yo tricks and spells, and become the hero of your own story in this charming rogue-like adventure. The Story In a world where school hallways can feel like battlegrounds, Emily is just trying to get by. But when she stumbles upon a mysterious yo-yo, her life takes an extraordinary turn. This isn't just any toy; it's an item of incredible magic, offering Emily the power to finally confront the bullies who have made her life difficult. Witness Emily's transformation through vibrant 2D comic-style art and 3D combat that unfolds at key moments in her journey. From a timid target to a confident protagonist, experience her growth as she learns to wield her newfound abilities and discover the true meaning of inner strength. Turn-based Yo-yo Combat Prepare for a unique and engaging combat system! Kwyjibo Adventure features turn-based battles where you'll use your magical yo-yo to perform a variety of tricks and spells. Utilizing your joystick, you'll execute precise movements to unleash powerful attacks and strategic maneuvers against waves of bullies. Discover and master a diverse range of yo-yo techniques, combining them to create devastating combos and outsmart your opponents in tactical showdowns. Rogue-like Progression Each journey in Kwyjibo Adventure is a fresh challenge! Face relentless waves of bullies in procedurally generated encounters. Defeat your adversaries to earn valuable buffs and upgrades that will enhance Emily's abilities and yo-yo skills. With each successful run, you'll grow stronger and unlock new possibilities, encouraging you to experiment with different strategies and builds as you strive to overcome the ever-increasing difficulty.

rows.name: Mang Ojek: Driving Test
rows.short_description: Ojek Online Simulation Game
rows.description_html: Mang Ojek: Driving Test Get ready to prove your skills as a professional motorcycle rider! Step into the world of Mang Ojek , where precision, speed, and control are everything. In Mang Ojek: Driving Test , you'll tackle two core challenges: the Motorcycle Driving Test , where you must conquer obstacle-filled tracks, and the Ojek Test , a high-pressure delivery challenge where you transport passengers, food, and packages under tight time limits. Compete for the best times, master your two-wheeled vehicle, and rise through the global ranks. Key Features 🏍️ Driving Test Mode – Complete technical riding challenges to earn your spot on the road. 🛵 Ojek Test Mode – Simulate real-world delivery tasks with strict timing and precision. ⏱️ Time-Limited Levels – Push yourself to finish each stage with speed and accuracy. 📊 Global Leaderboards – Show off your best runs and compete with players worldwide. 🎮 Realistic Motorcycle Gameplay – Ride with responsive two-wheeled control physics. Mang Ojek: Driving Test is part of the broader Mang Ojek experience—an expanding series of games inspired by the fast-paced life of motorcycle delivery drivers. Whether you're chasing the leaderboard or perfecting your ride, this is your chance to rev up and show your skills. 🛠️ Your feedback and support mean a lot! Every suggestion, review, and word of encouragement helps shape the future of Mang Ojek . Thank you for riding with us! 🏍️💬

rows.name: Whimsical Artefacts
rows.short_description: A co-op friendslop game with a heavy focus on customization via drawing. Scavenge liminal bunkers and obtain artefacts that may or may not aid you and your friends.
rows.description_html: Explore with friends the depths of liminal bunkers and take any artefact that you come across. Identify forgotten artefacts to deduce their effects on you or on your friends. Draw descriptive pictures to not forget what they do or sacrifice them to go deeper into the bunkers. While delving deeper and deeper into the bunkers, rooms will get more dangerous, traps that keep scavenger at bay will be more frequent and artefacts will be more and more lethal. Draw anything you want to represent yourself. Draw your face, accessories, your own cursor... You may also draw something for artefacts that could be helpful for yourself or for your friends that collect them from your remains. They could also deceive them into chaotic situations.  Use the proximity voice chat to communicate with friends and play with many sound altering artefacts.

rows.name: Ball Roller
rows.short_description: Roll your ball up a steep mountain either alone or with fellow ballers!
rows.description_html: Ball Roller is a short game about rolling your ball up a steep and unforgiving mountain either alone or with fellow ballers! Roll your Ball up a steep rockface or perilously perch on the edge of a sheer drop. Make a daring jump and maybe nail the landing. Help fellow ballers climb, or snooker them off the edge. Discover an alternate path or build up enough speed to make your own. The climb is difficult, but fair.

rows.name: Traveler Lost
rows.short_description: An adventure game where you work with a creature companion to solve puzzles and navigate various environments.
rows.description_html: On a journey of self-discovery, a young traveler crosses paths with a majestic-yet-frightened beast. The trek to guide it home shall be one of cooperation and understanding. Traveler Lost is an adventure puzzle game about learning the ways of a mysterious animal companion and working alongside it to guide it home. This odyssey will take you through various biomes, each with their own scenery and mysteries to unravel. Guide your companion forward, explore your environment, and ward off evils as you journey to help a new friend. Your voyage will take you through four locales, including a village, forest, and more. Use your wits to find your way through each one of them, taking into account how your partner interacts with their environment. Pick up objects, rotate statues, and even platform to overcome obstacles in your way and get the creature to travel alongside you. Remember, both you and your companion have your own strengths and weaknesses, so think carefully and use them accordingly! Grab and rotate objects like fruits, crystals, and statues to clear a path forward. Jump across abandoned buildings, rocky platforms, and even your new friend to solve puzzles. Learn to whistle to command and guide your creature confidant directly. Ward away enemies by sending your companion to scare them off. Open gates, redirect light beams, and even help other creatures to make your way atop a great mountain. This is a student project created by undergraduate students at the University of Central Florida.

rows.name: Frostbite Frenzy
rows.short_description: Slide, smash, and splash in this chaotic multiplayer penguin brawl! Battle your friends on crumbling ice platforms, using quick wits and playful tactics to knock them into the freezing water. The last penguin standing wins!
rows.description_html: Slide, smash, and splash in this chaotic multiplayer penguin brawl! Battle your friends on crumbling ice platforms, using quick wits and playful tactics to knock them into the freezing water. The last penguin standing wins! As a penguin, stay on the icy surface for the longest duration possible. Knock each other down with snowballs, and swiftly reposition yourselves. However, know that the ice you're on is gradually cracking. A block of ice weakens and breaks under sustained weight. You lose if an Orca eats you after you fall in the ocean. The final penguin remaining wins. Game Features Multiplayer focused gameplay with up to 5 players competing to survive. Wear hats to showcase your status as an elite penguin with appearance customization. Throw snowballs and dash to always change your positioning and to break more ice at a time.

rows.name: Cosmic Concealed
rows.short_description: In Cosmic Concealed, players are launched into space themed settings, one team hides in plain sight—disguised as everyday sci-fi props—while the other team hunts them down. The clock is ticking to find them, and eliminate them.
rows.description_html: Cosmic Concealed: A Galactic Hide & Seek   Welcome to the wackiest game of hide-and-seek this side of the universe! In Cosmic Concealed, players are launched into space-themed settings, which includes Earth, the Starship, or Space! One team hides in plain sight—disguised as everyday sci-fi props—while the other team hunts them down. The clock is ticking to find them and eliminate them. Will you blend in as a bottle on the bridge of a spaceship or a suspicious space cactus. Will you suit up and shoot every suspicious object to uncover your hidden aliens? Features: Hilarious prop transformations: crates, chairs, and more! 3 epic maps: Earth, The Starship or Space Maps include low-gravity as well as normal gravity. Hiders can use voice taunts! It’s hide-and-seek—but in SPACE. Are you prepared to vanish? How to Play In this game, it’s a round-based game; players will be randomly assigned to Hiders or Hunters. The game will conclude by either time running out or the Hunters finding all of the Hiders, and then it will start a new round. Hunters: The players assigned to Hunters will be released at a delay. They are tasked to find and shoot any objects out of place. If they hit a Hider, the prop will disappear, leaving a cloud of smoke. Shoot all the Hiders to win the round. Happy Hunting! Hiders: The players assigned to Hiders will have time to hide and transform into a prop. Hide or move around as the prop to keep hidden from the Hunter. Once time runs out, you win the round. Good luck staying hidden!

rows.name: Dr. Suun
rows.short_description: Dr. Suun is a thrilling horror experience that combines intense chases with mind-bending puzzles. Players step into the shoes of James, a man drawn into the mystery of an abandoned hospital with a haunting past. As he uncovers its secrets, the lines between reality and nightmare begin to blur.
rows.description_html: *DISCLAIMER: When launching the game for the first time, it WILL ask you for access to your network connection. It is used so it can access Steam achievements. It cannot be used for anything else. General Credits not included because of being added later: Paxxton Rehman - James’s Daughter Dr. Suun is a relentless horror experience where every step pulls you deeper into a nightmare. Playing as James , you explore an abandoned hospital with a dark past, uncovering unsettling truths as reality blurs into terror. The deeper you go, the greater the danger. Shadows hide more than just secrets, and when fear takes shape, running may be your only option. Will you escape, or will the hospital claim you like the rest? Solve: Use your wits to solve puzzles by finding keys and unlocking doors. Each door grants access to new rooms, uncovering secrets and pushing you further into the depths of the game. Run: Evade a relentless pursuer as you explore the hospital. Stay on the move, but be cautious—your enemy’s behavior is unpredictable, keeping you on edge at all times.

rows.name: Somniphobia
rows.short_description: Escape the reoccurring nightmare and stop the cycle by fighting through strange enemies and collecting items and information to get out. Somniphobia combines traditional survival horror and rogue-like elements. Can you find a way out of your ever-changing nightmare?
rows.description_html: Escape the reoccurring nightmare and stop the cycle by fighting through strange enemies and collecting items and information to get out before you wake up, otherwise the dream resets, but changes slightly. Somniphobia combines traditional survival horror elements such as combat, fixed camera angles, and item collection, with rogue-like elements where the item, enemy, and room placement will be different every night. Tank control movement Fixed cameras Procedural item and enemy placement Resource management Randomized map layout This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: The Bloody Cross
rows.short_description: Fight through a haunting journey of sin and suffering in this short top-down story game inspired by Christian themes and the crucifixion.
rows.description_html: The Bloody Cross is a short, narrative-driven top-down game with horror elements, exploring the weight of sin, guilt, and redemption through a Christian lens. You play as a wanderer climbing a mountain that represents moral achievement—only to be met with temptation, failure, and spiritual struggle at every turn. Along the way, you encounter others like you, including Jesus himself, who offers forgiveness and calls you to follow him… even unto the cross. This is not a sanitized or child-friendly Christian game. The Bloody Cross is raw, emotional, and unafraid to deal with disturbing and mature themes—addiction, shame, pride, suicide, and the trauma of trying to be good in a broken world. Through powerful allegory and stark imagery, the game pulls players into an intimate and unsettling reflection on the human condition and the costly grace offered at Calvary. Whether you’re a believer or not, The Bloody Cross offers a bold narrative experience built to challenge, provoke, and stay with you long after the credits roll.

rows.name: Upload Labs
rows.short_description: A sci-fi management game where you build and optimize your computer's system from the ground up. Connect and configure interconnected nodes to efficiently download, process, and upload files. Manage your setup, solve system challenges, and become the ultimate system architect
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Labs! In Upload Labs you are tasked to  save the universe from the inevitable heat death. Use your ingenuity and power to build optimized systems using a node-based system. These nodes are window-like interfaces representing components and processes within your computer. You will connect nodes from output to input to control resource flow and data pipelines Research : Scan files to unlock powerful new technologies via the research tree. There you will find game-changing nodes, innovative systems, and scientific milestones, all critical for achieving your ultimate goal. Hack : Strategically engage in breaches of organizations through hacking. This provides access to critical intel, enables the disruption of opposing systems, and secures resources vital for your mission. Code : Get contributors by committing important code, Implement custom solutions for your system by crafting code optimizations, developing custom applications, and programming essential drivers. These tools allow for precise tuning and automation, ensuring optimal performance. AI Development: Cultivate and evolve an Artificial Intelligence by feeding it downloaded files for processing and learning. As the AI progresses, it will generate improved files, greatly boosting your income. Guide its development to ultimately achieve Artificial General Intelligence, a pivotal step in overcoming the universal crisis.

rows.name: Ultima Nex
rows.short_description: Become the master of the galaxy! Battle solo or team up with others in intense multiplayer fights. Conquer the galaxy across diverse modes and maps!
rows.description_html: Campaign Mode Complete many different missions in Campaign Mode and save the space city from the pirates! Choose your class - Dominate the battlefield In Ultima Nex, you duel with other players in action-packed space battles. Choose from five unique spaceship classes, each designed for different play styles 🔺 Fighter - The perfect all-rounder, relatively fast, good damage and good defence! 🔺 Fighter Jet - The fastest ship in the galaxy! Particularly annoying against any kind of ship, except... 🔺 Interceptor - Particularly good against small, fast spaceships, with lots of small projectiles being fired at the same time! 🔺 Battery - Nerve your opponents with large EMP waves that paralyse all players in the vicinity! 🔺 Heavy Cannon - This spaceship has an extremely large cannon with it, which does immense damage and is therefore particularly good against tanks 🔺 Shadow Hunter - A fast, annoying assassin, he is designed to surprise his opponents and eliminate them quickly Different special abilities for each spaceship Each spaceship has special abilities that offer different strategic possibilities to conquer the galaxy! Game modes - Your path to galaxy domination Ultima Nex offers various exciting game modes that provide excitement and variety: 🔺 Deathmatch - Fight against the other team, but beware! There is no respawning! 🔺 Space War - Fight against the other team, the team that defeats more opponents wins 🔺 Core Defence - Protect your energy core, only it will allow you to respawn. Destroy the enemy team's core and then eliminate it completely, and victory is yours... 🔺 Space Conquerors - Capture all of your opponent's space zones and defend your own! A vast galaxy awaits you From dense asteroid fields to abandoned space stations and huge planetary rings - every map in Ultima Nex brings new challenges and strategic opportunities. Use the terrain to your advantage, lay ambushes or flee into dangerous nebula clouds to escape your opponents.

rows.name: Make Your Country Dominate Again
rows.short_description: Welcome to a global multiplayer meat grinder. This is a strategy game where you don’t just win — you collectively erase countries from a single, shared world map. Only one nation is allowed to survive!
rows.description_html: Make Your Country Dominate Again is a minimalist PvP Super MMO idle strategy game about the collective conquest of territory and the absorption of real-world countries. Why 'Super MMO'? Because players from all over the world — in unlimited numbers — exist on one single, monolithic map at the same time. The player, an immaterial entity, uses their share of influence to help some nations consume others. Player actions are expressed through Arrows — to invade neighboring countries — and Flags — to defend their own. The entire world becomes a superposition of every player's input across the planet. The main goal is to help your country conquer the entire world. That’s the victory condition. Tactically, you focus on generating Energy through a system of Devices. The energy you produce represents your influence as a player in the world. You monitor the charge level of your main Dynamo Machine — the core of your energy production — and strategically activate temporary boosters throughout the day. The Dynamo Machine and other Devices can be upgraded to match your playstyle: Stay active longer in offline mode Generate more Energy during active play Provide temporary boosters for sudden attacks You can always reset the device upgrade tree and experiment with different configurations.

rows.name: XETTER 2020
rows.short_description: Collect all the dots to clear each of the 30 action-puzzle scenes. Dodge two types of enemies, drop blocks to crush them, and avoid being crushed yourself. Use limited lives wisely, restart levels when needed, and unlock cleared scenes for replay. Can you beat them all?
rows.description_html: In this action-puzzle game, your goal is to clear each scene by collecting all the dots. There are 30 unique scenes to conquer. You control the main character using either a keyboard, controller, or on-screen joystick. Navigate the stage, avoid enemies, and use blocks strategically to survive. Two types of enemies chase you relentlessly. If they catch you, you lose a life. However, you're not defenseless—by pushing blocks and dropping them from above, you can crush enemies. Be careful though: if you're crushed by a block yourself, you'll also lose a life. Each scene has a time limit. If time runs out, you lose a life. Lose all your lives, and it’s game over. You can restart the current scene at the cost of one life using the [RESTART] button, or return to the title screen using the [QUIT] button. Once you clear a scene, it becomes available for selection from the title screen. Use the [UP] and [DOWN] buttons to choose a previously cleared scene, and use [TO LEFT] or [TO RIGHT] to move the position of the on-screen buttons for comfort. Can you clear all 30 scenes and master every challenge? Additional Controller and Keyboard Functions In the game screen, the [RESTART] button can also be triggered by pressing the controller's [START] button or the keyboard's [Delete] key. In the game screen, the [QUIT] button can also be triggered by pressing the controller's [BACK] button or the keyboard's [Esc] key. In the title screen, the [UP] and [DOWN] buttons can also be triggered by using the controller's D-pad or analog stick (up/down/left/right) or L/R buttons, or by using the keyboard's arrow keys. In the title screen, the [START] button can also be triggered by pressing the controller's [START] button or the keyboard's Space or Enter key. In the game screen, the [TO LEFT] and [TO RIGHT] buttons can also be triggered by pressing the controller's L/R buttons or the keyboard's L/R keys.

rows.name: Gunbot Diplomacy: Blast Off
rows.short_description: Splatter slimes, massacre mutants, and assemble your perfect Gunbot! Survive the wasteland in this top-down shooter roguelite by customizing your weapons on the unique upgrade grid, and pick from tons of build-defining modules and wacky bots for a new experience every run. Prologue teaser build.
rows.description_html: Gunbot Diplomacy: Blast Off is a prologue teaser to Gunbot Diplomacy.  You'll have the opportunity to experiment with multiple Bot builds, providing plenty of replayability and a few hours of potential gameplay. Content available in Blast Off: Two gunbots, eight starting Weapons with plenty of augments and ammo to customize them, 50 Modules + the first ten maps of the game on the base difficulty, featuring 20 unique enemies. Assemble the perfect arsenal of weapons, from nuclear footballs to fire extinguishers that spray electrified flames. Rewire your Gunbot - frame and (artificial) brain - whether it's for speed, durability, or straight up firepower. Welcome to the wasteland; now pick your flavor of carnage! Features: - Infinite replayability! No two bots are the same, so no two runs are the same! -Mix and match from over 20 base weapons and customize them to suit your build on a unique hexagonal upgrade grid -Choose from more than 80 build-defining modules - it's not like messing with Gunbot AI lead to the downfall of all human civilization or anything! -Fast-paced gameplay: let your weapons do the talking and splatter your enemies across the desert, while you dodge out of harm's way! - 10 base Gunbots to choose from, from the gallant LanceBot to the Freezer , the best armed fridge the world has ever seen! -Discover hidden combinations for special evolved weapons to kick your build into overdrive! -Fun and varied enemies: oozified office workers still on their 9-to-5 grind, brawl boys who just want to fight everything that moves, skittering spine-slinging crab/cactus hybrids, and so much more! -Special Hazard and Boss levels to test your build - and skills - in unique conditions! -Let your gunbot's automated targeting systems handle the firing - or select which weapons you want to manually aim for optimal control!

rows.name: Touhou Chouhatsuyou ~ Burgeoning Tresses of Longevity
rows.short_description: A mysterious scent has caused everyone's hair to grow haywire...
rows.description_html: An experiment in Gensokyo went disastrously wrong for a few individuals. A mysterious scent has caused every woman's hair to grow to the height of their body. Some of the victims who are fine with their old hair now look unpleasant to themselves. Based on an original screenplay and featuring an original score written by Susumu Takajima, you take control of one of the victims out of a selection of four to find the person who conducted the experiment. You will have to take your super long hair across six stages to find the scent's origin so you can restore it to normal. You can tackle it alone or with a friend.* The weight of your hair will make it challenging to defeat your enemies' danmaku and their spell cards. *Additional accessories may be required for local multiplayer modes. Features: Four playable characters spanning different backgrounds Four difficulty modes with different spell cards A six-stage main game plus a post-game extra stage A series of original characters created by Susumu Takajima to fight against 1990s-style musical score by Susumu Takajima Controller support

Build Your Legend - Endless Heroes, Infinite Possibilities Customize your stickman warrior with unique weapons, armor, and abilities. Unlock rare heroes, each with distinct fighting styles and special moves, to create your ultimate combat team. Every choice shapes your legend! From ancient temples to futuristic battlefields, each playthrough offers new secrets to uncover and bosses to conquer!

Only you can hold them back, as you are still the strongest greatsword user in the world! Though you are pretty old right now. rows.name: Double Down
rows.short_description: Double Down is a roguelike FPS for high-octane high rollers. Smash robots and spin slots to win powerful upgrades, and make your way through growing waves of enemies to face The House and take back the casino.
rows.description_html: Double Down is a rogue-like FPS for high-octane high rollers. You are The Dealer, one of the card dealers for the Triple 0 Casino. Well… former card dealer. You and your fellow employees have been replaced with an advanced AI called The House. It can supposedly do everything the humans can, but better. No pay required. You only manage to take a few steps out the door before the AI takes over the casino. Now it’s up to you to defeat your enemies, get chips, and tip the odds in your favor as you descend through the Casino to get your job back. Spin slots, risk it all on roulette, and go all in on ante to power your way through endless waves of enemies. Mix and match dozens of unique upgrades to tear through the robot horde. Save up your chips and cash them in to venture deeper into the Triple 0 Casino, and face the AI overlord behind it all. You aren’t the only one getting upgrades. Look out for elite robots with big buffs and dangerous special abilities. Bet on the roulette to get special challenges, but don’t slow down, or you might lose it all. Learn more about The House and the Triple 0 Casino as you make your way through the hand-crafted levels. Double Down was developed over 1 academic year as a part of Champlain College's Game Studio Capstone program.

rows.name: Prism of You
rows.short_description: Experiment with emotions in this emergent sandbox simulation by identifying, engaging, and expressing dynamic creatures known as Emoes -- all while trying to maintain balance and uncover the secrets of this mysterious alien world.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Prism , a unique emotional sandbox simulation where the player's goal is balance. Identify, engage, and express eccentric alien creatures that represent human emotions. What’s hiding in the dark fog? Using sounds, movement patterns, and thoughts as hints, learn how to identify your emotions before you can start engaging with them. It gets easier as you go! It’s important to engage with your emotions in a healthy way instead of bottling them up. Give your Emoes attention to maintain them, and build structures to help manage your Emoes more effectively. Your Emoes also have unique properties. Emoes of the same type can merge to create higher intensity emotions, and Emoes holding too much charge will split into more Emoes. Learn how to manage your population of Emoes and keep your Prism in a steady equilibrium. Expressing your emotions can be relieving and cathartic. Express your Emoes to release charge from the system and help keep your Prism in balance. Obtain unique collectibles through experimentation and play to shed light on the mysterious origins of the Prism.

rows.name: Spaceship Man 2
rows.short_description: It's time to go fight in space. Good thing I can't die.
rows.description_html: It's time to go fight in space.  Spaceship Man 2 answers the questions, 'What would it be like if I went to go fight in outer space? What would I fight? Who would I meet? What lies beyond the distant limits of the human perception of our own existence? What if I couldn't die?' The casual gameplay of an arcade space-shooter meets the rogue-like element of random boons that reward adaptive playstyles. Spam the spacebar to deal damage as fast as you can, learn the best way to utilize the gifts that random NPCs give you, how to obtain potions that allow you to activate your accumulating powers and when to use them, all to a killer, entrancing soundtrack composed and produced by Placeless. The skilled will be tested, the curious will be rewarded, and you can't die.   Music by Placeless.  Sounds by Zapsplat.  Font engine by Scribble.
