rows.name: Dread Not
rows.short_description: Avoid your watery grave in this asymmetrical co-op horror game where you and a friend take the roles of a submarine Pilot and Mechanic. Work together to repair the ship, solve puzzles, avoid a deadly creature, and make it back to the surface before time runs out! It's time to Sync or Swim
rows.description_html: The water is dark and incredibly cold. The pressure is intense, and the stakes couldn’t be higher... After being attacked by a colossal sea creature, a small nuclear submarine is thrown into a high-stakes battle and must reach the surface before air runs out. Players take on the role of either Pilot or Mechanic and must work together to keep the submarine stable by communicating with each other, fixing failing systems, and navigating through perilous waters. Survival depends on the pair’s ability to work together under immense pressure. Failure is not an option.   Dread Not is an asymmetric co-op game created by Leviathan Interactive, a studio comprised of 15 UW-Stout students, that will leave players wanting more! Play as a pair of marine researchers aboard a doomed vessel that has suffered severe damage and only has 10 minutes before running out of oxygen. The only chance of reaching the surface is by making repairs, which are completed through cooperative and individual puzzles scattered throughout the system rooms of the submarine. The Pilot is constrained to a single room and is in charge of navigation while simultaneously communicating with the Mechanic in order to keep necessary systems up and running. The Mechanic is able to move between all other rooms and must repair systems under the Pilot's guidance. With inspirations taken from real 1960’s Navy Nuclear Ballistic Missile submarines of the George Washington Class combined with the 80's vibes found in cinematic classics such as The Hunt for Red October and Jaws , Dread Not is sure to be an absolute blast. Will you sync or swim?

rows.name: Buck Trucker in Rowdy Business
rows.short_description: Buck Trucker must gamble and sweet-talk his way through The Golden Palm Casino, Las Vegas, to save an orphanage back home—or succumb to Sin City's many temptations in this choice-driven story featuring mini-games, multiple endings, and a cast of outlandish characters.
rows.description_html: BUCK TRUCKER'S ADVENTURE BEGINS YEEE HAW! Buckle up for the first installment of the Buck Trucker adventures! Follow the outrageous exploits of Buck Trucker as he heads to the Golden Palm Casino - Las Vegas, Nevada with one mission: save the orphanage back home in Clay County, West Virginia.  Buck Trucker in Rowdy Business delivers a quick-hittin' replayable romp, perfect for anyone who wants the text adventure experience, without the complexity and length. 'GAMES. GAMES. GAMES. WINNERS AND LOSERS' Put Buck's gambling skills to the test with realistic casino games! Try your luck at the blackjack table, pull the lever on the Lucky Tug Slot Machine, or place your bets at the horse racing track. Every dollar counts when you're savin’ them orphans... or does Buck have other plans? The choice is yours, cowboy. MEET CRAZY CHARACTERS ALONG THE WAY Cross paths with a cast of Vegas lowlifes, high rollers, and everyone in between. Help Buck make decisions that will lead to wildly different outcomes - will Buck save them orphans, find true love, or end up in a dumpster behind the Golden Palm Casino? Experience the story through hand-crafted character portraits and scenes that bring Buck's rowdy adventures to life. ACHIEVEMENTS Have you got what it takes to be a real Trucker? Unlock 20 achievements that'll have you exploring every seedy corner of the Golden Palm Casino.  Will you discover all possible endings? Can you maintain a clean conscience in a city of sin?  The only question is, which path will you choose?

rows.name: Fire in the Hole
rows.short_description: Play as one of four animal company leaders looking to dominate the competition through an intense game of golf in this top-down twin-stick shooter for local play (2-4 players)!
rows.description_html: With the upcoming merger approaching, play as one of four animal company leaders looking to dominate the competition through an intense game of golf. But for stakes so high, they've agreed to mix things up a little. And thus, the hunt is on! Fire in the Hole is a top-down twin-stick shooter featuring four animals all duking it out on the golf course. It is a local PVP and controllers are recommended (although one player can use Mouse and Keyboard) and the game is intended for 2-4 players . Shoot down competition to prevent them from scoring their golf balls into holes! The player with the highest score wins the match! But we didn't leave out rewards for the losers. Every player, even losers, can earn themselves accolades; from getting the most golf ball KOs to missing the most golf ball holes, there's bound to be something for everyone on the course. While Fire in the Hole can be played with one player on a mouse and keyboard, we fully recommend players to use a controller in order to best experience the game! The game teaches the player how to play before entering combat, but we've provided a manual as well that outlines both controller and keyboard controls, as well as potential upgrades and dangers you may encounter on the golf course. Fire in the Hole offers : 5 Unique Gun-Clubs! 5 Different Golf Balls! 4 Specialized Power-Ups! And 4 Arenas each with their Own Hazards! We don't teach you everything though. Experimental players might be rewarded with a fun discovery! This game is being developed for our 2025 Capstone Project in the Honours Bachelor of Game Design Program at Sheridan College, Oakville, Ontario, Canada. Fire in the Hole was made by 6 game designers and 1 composer over 28 weeks of development! If you like what you see, please consider checking out the other works of the individuals listed in the credits! Shoot us a message - we don't bite!

rows.name: PyramidValley: Reborn
rows.short_description: ​Immerse yourself in ancient Egypt with PyramidValley, a management game where you develop your pharaonic city by constructing iconic monuments and gathering various resources to ensure prosperity.
rows.description_html: ​Immerse yourself in the captivating world of ancient Egypt with PyramidValley: Reborn , a compelling management game that invites you to build and develop your own pharaonic city. Play as iconic figures such as Cleopatra, and construct legendary monuments like majestic pyramids, the Lighthouse of Alexandria, and the Great Sphinx.​ Collect and manage various resources to ensure your city's prosperity, while taking on strategic challenges that will test your managerial skills. With meticulous graphics and an immersive atmosphere, PyramidValley: Reborn offers a rewarding gaming experience for all history enthusiasts and management game fans.​ Furthermore, the Reborn project aims to revive the game by allowing players to relive the PyramidValley experience independently, thus ensuring the continuity of this Egyptian adventure.​ Sources

rows.name: Midnight Arcade
rows.short_description: A compilation of two Arcade-Styled VR games, featuring both Mini Golf and Laser Tag. Play in an abandoned entertainment center, wander the premises, discover silly secrets, hit the golf balls into holes and defeat waves of robots in laser tag!
rows.description_html: Ready to add some excitement to your night owl life? Look no further than the Midnight Arcade! Open exclusively overnight, as long as you're open to breaking in, this VR experience lets you have fun with some fun Laser tag and Mini golf in a long abandoned arcade building, all in one package! In Mini golf, you'll be on the outside of the premises, exploring the holes, checking out the old gift shop, and playing the game as you go. Within Laser tag, you'll fight off long dormant robots as waves of enemies in a small arena.

rows.name: bagelball
rows.short_description: bagelball is a physics & movement-based multiplayer sports-ish game, similar to the game with cars and footballs, except instead of driving a car you wield a bagel. you can ride the bagel to fly, throw bagels at high velocity, and wall jump, all to score the most goals within 5 minutes.
rows.description_html: only bagels can move the ball properly. whoever scores the most goals within 5 minutes wins the match. play 1v1 or 2v2, on a variety of maps (currently 4, i plan for more) utilise the unique physics properties of the bagels to propel yourself across the map, as well as the ball. use the practice mode to get to grips with the unique movement system within the game. lobby browser makes it easy to set up a match with your friends, or find a match with another player. join a game before it starts to spectate. peer-to-peer netcode. bagelball. controls left click to pick up bagel/drop bagel wasd to move shift to sprint scroll wheel to make bagel close and far ctrl to fastfall right click to quantum switch space to jump, space while in the air to double jump, space while on a wall to wall jump jump onto a bagel underneath you while in close mode to start flying

rows.name: Gunman Drift
rows.short_description: The driving and shooting game. Gunman Drift is an incredible and satisfying drifting TPS where you drive, shoot, get shot at and get rewarded for it all in the meantime. Keep climbing the ranks until you become the Ultimate Gunman!
rows.description_html: Gunman Drift is an immersive experience where the player must focus on drifting and shooting at the same time. In this game, the player can customise their weapon and car of choice, and the paint of the car. There are some obstacles and opportunities for the player to score some points and in turn level up. Everything the player does results in experience, and experience rewards the player with money and crates. As the player makes progress, they gain enough money to unlock faster cars and better weapons. This game has been developed in such a way that players can enjoy the same experience both on a computer and in virtual reality.

rows.name: One-Hit Slayer! Swordog
rows.short_description: Decide the battle with a single deadly strike! If you take a hit, both you and your enemy will fall in one blow— a simple yet challenging high-difficulty action game. Within a limited 10-second window, read your opponent's movements, find an opening, and strike them down instantly!
rows.description_html: Decide the battle with a single deadly strike! One hit, and both you and your enemy will fall—this is a simple yet challenging high-difficulty action game. [Game Features] A moment of hesitation can be fatal. Stay on edge until the final blow and experience intense, nerve-wracking combat. The key to victory is finding an opening. However, you only have 10 seconds to defeat each enemy. There’s no time to sit back and observe—read their movements and strike with precision! Don’t give up if you fall! Learn enemy patterns little by little and keep challenging yourself. Face off against 20 formidable enemies—defeat them all and aim for the highest rating!

rows.name: Jackroid
rows.short_description: Originally developed as a birthday gift for my nephew, Jackroid is a heartfelt indie game that blends classic action-platforming with Metroid-style exploration. After several requests and growing interest, I’ve decided to bring Jackroid to Steam. Free—as a thank you to everyone who’s supported me.
rows.description_html: Jackroid A Retro-Inspired Sci-Fi Platformer Adventure — Now Free on Steam Originally developed as a birthday gift for my nephew, Jackroid is a heartfelt indie game that blends classic action-platforming with Metroid-style exploration. After several requests and growing interest, I’ve decided to bring Jackroid to Steam—for free—as a thank you to everyone who’s supported my game dev journey. This is the first game that I built after quitting PCL work (aka automation) seven years ago.  About the Game Play as Jackroid —the first machine-human hybrid built for deep space exploration. Journey across mysterious galaxies and uncharted planets in search of your identity and purpose. rows.name: Sea Blindness
rows.short_description: Sea Blindness is a 2D pixel-art narrative RPG Game. In the year 2064, players assume the role of Jimmy, a deep-sea researcher who becomes entangled in a mysterious incident only to discover he's trapped inside a video game.
rows.description_html: Jimmy, captain of the deep-sea research vessel Trilobite, leads his crew—including his younger brother, Jack—to investigate an unidentified signal. But unlike previous missions, the newly assigned, enigmatic commander appears to have ulterior motives… Sea Blindness  is a 2D pixel-art narrative RPG Game. In the year 2064, players assume the role of Jimmy, a deep-sea researcher who becomes entangled in a mysterious incident only to discover he's trapped inside a video game. Together with the player, Jimmy must navigate this digital realm to rescue his crewmates and ultimately restore balance to the game world. Game Features: Self-Aware NPCs Characters gain consciousness and collaborate with players to complete problems. Fourth-Wall-Breaking Gameplay The game dynamically generates special files on your local PC as part of the narrative experience. Intuitive Controls  Simple keyboard and mouse interactions drive progression. Immersive Audio Headphones recommended for full atmospheric impact. Controls: WASD:  Character movement E:  Interact with objects Mouse:  Click/Drag to interact with files and UI elements Z: Quit game Detailed Instructions for Game File Panel Operations： Click the  Game File  icon with your mouse to open/close the Panel. Click the  File  icon with your mouse to open the File. Hold and drag the  File  icon to the desired folder to move its location. When the game notifies you of a new email message, why not check your computer desktop? ;)

rows.name: Booklet's Big Story
rows.short_description: Booklet is the only empty storybook in all of the Grand Library! Journey alongside them as they wrestle with feelings of unbelonging while striving to find their own story in this 3D puzzle platformer.
rows.description_html: Booklet is the only empty storybook in all of the Grand Library! Journey alongside them as they wrestle with feelings of unbelonging while striving to find their own story in this 3D puzzle platformer. Emotional Narrative Booklet’s dealing with some big feelings! Being the only storybook in the Grand Library without a story is pretty isolating, and it would be terribly lonely too if not for the Narrator, Booklet’s first and endlessly inspiriting friend. But the Narrator isn’t the only influential figure you’ll encounter–each one will shape the trajectory of Booklet’s self-discovery, for better or for worse. Puzzling Gameplay Every section of the Grand Library you explore will empower Booklet with an ability they can use to overcome thematic puzzles and conflicts. With your help, they’ll uncover the secrets of classic genres like Fantasy, Science Fiction, and Noir by platforming through intricate, multi-leveled set pieces brought to life by the library’s magic.

rows.short_description: 'This is a single-player RPG based on the 'Tower of the Sorcerer' gameplay. Control the hero to collect resources on the map, defeat monsters, obtain gold coins, and continuously improve your attributes until you defeat the final Demon Dragon King！
rows.description_html: This is a super retro and super 'simple' RPG, inspired by 'Tower of the Sorcerer ', but using a vast RPG map. Control the hero to collect items, defeat monsters to get gold coins, talk to different NPC, increase each attributes and eventually chanllege the demon dragon king!  You can invite the princess to travel with you and benefit from her healing magic, or you can changllege yourself by sovling the complex map puzzle all by the hero alone! In the game, use WASD or Arrow Key to move, use Space,Enter or F key to interact with the scene, The map contains 4 different areas representing for levels. And can be treated as a huge puzzle game, hope you enjoy it! The level editor is also included, so you can modify the game whatever you like freely!

rows.name: REGION55
rows.short_description: REGION55 is a fast-paced first-person shooter where players engage in brutal combat across tightly designed arenas. Weapon customization, unique tactical options, and diverse maps ensure no two matches play the same!
rows.description_html: REGION55 is a fast-paced first-person shooter where players engage in brutal combat across tightly designed arenas. In Free-For-All (FFA) mode, it’s every player for themselves, only the one with the most frags before time runs out will emerge victorious. Weapon customization, unique tactical options, and diverse maps ensure no two matches play the same! KEY FEATURES: ✔ Brutal FFA Mode – Fight against everyone, using the environment and tactics to survive. ✔ Weapon Customization – Modify barrels, stocks, scopes, attachments, and skins to suit your playstyle. ✔ 4 Unique Maps: - 'Abandoned Factory' – Tight corridors and open spaces for intense combat. - 'Panelki' – Plenty of cover and urban advantages. - 'Brick Buildings' – Destroyed buildings and dynamic firefights. - 'Village' – Balanced for close and long range combat. ✔ Fast & Responsive Gameplay – Smooth movement, realistic ballistics. ADVANTAGES: - Intense 5-Minute Matches – No long waits, just pure adrenaline. - Balanced Weapons – No pay-to-win, victory depends on skill. - Regular Updates – New maps, modes, weapons and cosmetics. Are you ready to become the arena king? Jump in, pick your weapon, and prove you’re the best in chaotic FFA battles!

rows.name: Zombie Graveyard Simulator - Prologue
rows.short_description: Manage your Graveyard by day as you bury and cremate bodies, maintain graves, fulfill visitor requests, grow crops, and unlock upgrades. When night falls, face relentless zombie hordes as you build defenses to protect your work and fight to survive in Zombie Graveyard Simulator - Prologue!
rows.description_html: THIS PROLOGUE FEATURES Limited play up to 6 days Limited progress on upgrades Limited number of store items (defenses, decoration objects etc.) Locked features such as employees and bank/loan system Limited weapon variety Limited zombie types No endgame content Progress will not carry over to the full release About the Game In a world where the dead turn into zombies, your job is to manage your very own Graveyard! Perform burials and cremations, and fulfill visitor requests with special flowers and gravestones by day. But when night falls, everything changes. The dead may rest, but the zombies don’t. They are coming for your precious work. Will you be able to protect them? Visitor Satisfaction is Key After processing the bodies, visitors will regularly return to check on their loved ones. Your duty is to keep graves clean and intact while providing fresh flowers to ensure their satisfaction. Every visit rewards you with valuable bonuses to help keep your business running smoothly. Build your Defenses Each night, waves of zombies will come with their numbers growing and special zombie types emerging, hungry for freshly buried bodies and the freshest of all, you. From basic defenses like barbed wires and fences to advanced machines like automatic turrets, keep your defenses upgraded, repaired, and fully stocked with ammo to withstand the night. Trust your Arsenal With a variety of weapons, including pistols, rifles, shotguns, and your trusty shovel, you are the ultimate force against the Zombies. As you level up, unlock and purchase new weapons while upgrading your skills to become even stronger. Just make sure to stock up on enough ammo! Even a Graveyard Can Be Cozy Sometimes! Use your Farming Area to grow different flowers for profit and vegetables to simply eat and restore your energy and health. With Upgrades, you can even unlock a Grinder to turn zombie parts into Fertilizer. Decorate your Graveyard with statues, lights, and other ornaments to make it truly your own. Expand and Upgrade Your Facilities Your graveyard isn’t just a resting place, it's a business, and every upgrade matters. Expand your burial area to accommodate more bodies and improve your crematorium with additional furnaces, automated cleaning systems, and faster processing times. Upgrade your farming area for better resource production, and enhance your water supply from a simple well to a motorized pump and water tank to keep everything running efficiently. Every improvement helps you stay one step ahead of both business demands and the undead threat. Key Features Manage and expand your own graveyard while balancing business and survival. Build defenses and fight off nightly zombie attacks. Perform burials, cremations, and keep visitors satisfied. Upgrade facilities like the crematorium, farming area, and water supply. Unlock new weapons and improve your skills. Customize and decorate your graveyard. Experience a mix of management, strategy, and first-person action.

rows.name: I See Me
rows.short_description: Overcome the trials by relying on your partner's sights! A 3D co-op game that goes beyond common sense. Enjoy unique gameplay based on sights in I See Me.
rows.description_html: Seeing the World Through Each Other's Eyes – I See Me Little Hojin sets out to rescue Mimi, who has beyond the Rainbow Bridge. This isn't a simple rescue story. A very special ordeal awaits them. A Unique Co-op Twist I See Me is a game where Hojin and Mimi, with your screen shows your partner’s character, and their screen shows yours, travel back beyond the Rainbow Bridge. They must see the world through each other's eyes. That's why cooperation is essential. Without true teamwork between the two, they can't advance to the next stage. Trust each other, have the occasional mental breakdown, and overcome obstacles! Brain, Voice, and Hands are Fully Operational! Beating a level without communication? Impossible. 'Left! No, right! Jump, jump!' Control your movements through conversation with your partner. A Small Glimmer of Hope Amidst Trials: Item. Using a special item will briefly restore your vision to normal. It's only for a brief moment, so stay alert and overcome the difficult sections! Memory Fragments and Hidden Stories! As you discover 'memory fragments' during your adventure, Mimi and Hojin's pasts will be revealed, piece by piece. Aren't you curious about the story behind Hojin and Mimi? Here, on the Rainbow Bridge, your view keeps swapping—and the path is full of traps and tricks. Now, are you ready for the extraordinary adventure of traveling back across the Rainbow Bridge? It won’t be easy—but together, you can make it to the end. Hojin and Mimi! Let's work together to create a miracle. Because together, there's nothing we can't do.

rows.short_description: Bullet Yeeters - jetpack chaos in your own home! A third-person shooter where tiny agents with big guns battle it out in giant household arenas. Fly with a jetpack, fight crazy bosses, customize your hero, and unleash explosive mayhem in kitchens, garages, and living rooms!
rows.description_html: Bullet Yeeters - Jetpack Chaos in Your Own Backyard Get ready for high-flying mayhem where tiny agents with big guns turn your home into a battlefield! Bullet Yeeters is a chaotic third-person shooter with jetpack-powered movement,  over-the-top physics, and explosive action in giant household environments. ✈️ JETPACK COMBAT Master aerial movement and outmaneuver your enemies mid-air. Use your jetpack to dodge, strafe, and surprise from above. 🏠 HOUSEHOLD WARZONES Fight in oversized kitchens, garages, living rooms, and more. Everyday objects become tactical cover, traps, or high ground. 🔫 CUSTOM AGENTS & WILD WEAPONS Unlock and personalize agents with unique abilities. Customize jetpacks, gear, and outfits. Choose from a huge arsenal of upgradable guns. 💥 GIANT BOSS FIGHTS Take down ridiculous oversized bosses solo or in co-op. Every battle is a spectacle. 🎮 PURE MAYHEM, YOUR WAY Free-for-All is already available in the game, and other modes — including Battle Royale, Control Point, and The Floor is Lava — are coming soon! Fly fast. Shoot hard. Yeet or be yeeted.

An action-packed, third-person, single-player game that blends treasure hunting and enemy evasion in a vibrant, fantastical world. Step into the shoes of the intrepid Candle Boy, an adventurer determined to steal an enchanted ring of immense power, hidden deep within the heart of a Giant's castle. rows.short_description: 'Kuafu Chases the sun' is an exhilarating adventure parkour game deeply rooted in the rich tapestry of ancient Chinese mythology. In this immersive gaming experience, players are instantly transported to a bygone era, assuming the role of the mighty and legendary giant, Kuafu.
rows.description_html: Kuafu Chases the Sun ' is a 2D side-scrolling parkour game inspired by Chinese mythology, where players embody the legendary giant Kuafu in a visually striking hand-painted world. Race across ancient landscapes—misty mountains, blooming valleys—while executing parkour moves like jumping and sliding to overcome obstacles, and unravel Kuafu's fate in the endings. The game blends mythic storytelling with cultural artistry, featuring unlockable lore from Shanhai Jing (Classic of Mountains and Seas).

rows.name: Shellborne
rows.short_description: Shellborne is a chaotic co-op game, where you guide a giant mystical turtle, over a dangerous mountain path. Collect resources and flee from the evil fog.
rows.description_html: Note: Shellborne is currently in the beta phase . Shellborne is a student‑made, completely free to play , co‑op adventure—no paywalls, just pure turtle‑powered fun. If you want to support us, join our community discord and give us feedback. Collect Resources and Remove Obstacles Harvest wood, mine stone, and gather berries, then load them onto your trusty turtle to carry for you. Smash through debris and rebuild bridges to carve out a safe route for your turtle. The evil fog hunts your turtle A living wall of mist moves toward you, hungry for your magical turtle. It sends Spirits to slow you down - keep them away and keep running. Buy upgrades. When you reach a safe camp, spend leftover resources to upgrade your turtle. Make your turtle run faster, carry more, and stay stronger for the next stage. Coming Soon Work together and communicate. Coordination is key as you can only carry one tool at a time. Discuss roles and swap gear at the right moment to clear the way. Note: The Game is about playing with friends, use the Steam friend list for invites. Use the Steam voice chat or an external tool for communication.

Collect Resources and Remove Obstacles Harvest wood, mine stone, and gather berries, then load them onto your trusty turtle to carry for you. Smash through debris and rebuild bridges to carve out a safe route for your turtle. The evil fog hunts your turtle A living wall of mist moves toward you, hungry for your magical turtle. It sends Spirits to slow you down - keep them away and keep running. Buy upgrades. When you reach a safe camp, spend leftover resources to upgrade your turtle. rows.name: Ergosphere
rows.short_description: You're the newest steward of Thoth Observatory, tasked with researching the strange Kerr black hole SJ-1765—the Sejanus Singularity. The data gathered here is invaluable, so maintain the installation and preserve your sanity until your rotation ends in this deteriorating station.
rows.description_html: Intro You're the steward of Thoth Observatory, a failing research station studying the Sejanus Singularity—humanity's key to FTL communication. Keep the station operational while managing cascading system failures, performing emergency repairs, and gathering critical data. The station's AI actively abstains from sharing information it thinks you don't need, leaving you to piece together the truth yourself, if you desire that is, after-all priority number one is simply getting through your shift. Balance routine maintenance against crisis management as equipment degrades faster each day. Every decision matters when you're alone in deep space with deteriorating life support, unstable power systems, and an anomaly that warps reality itself. Gameplay The machine intelligence known as HERMES will provide you with a list of tasks to complete each day. These tasks can vary in number and complexity, but some examples of them include but are not limited to. Interacting with a station terminal and either following the instructions or solving a puzzle depending on the task. Utilizing portable tools to scan the station for anomalies. Taking emergency action when a system fails or there is imminent danger of the Black Hole leaking harmful amounts of radiation inside the station. Avoiding potentially hazardous apparitions onboard the station. Maintaining your sanity as the days progress, you are completely alone here after all. You are essentially a fusion between a research scientist, mechanic, and janitor as the people who build this station could not afford to hire more than one crew member at a time, as such you will be wearing many hats. Features Dynamic event system : Events will happen, the order in which they do so and which you will even experience are never the same. Atmospheric Horror elements : The station creaks and groans under the pull of the singularity; systems fail randomly, reality itself seems to decay around you. Is this a sign of your own madness, or is there something more to it. Hidden Story : There is a reason why you are here, there is a reason why all these things are happening, few involved in this deep space research endeavor know it and even fewer wish to share it with you. Object Physics: Play with some of the objects scattered around the station; if you want to. Short Playtime: You can easily finish this game on a lunch break, it is a short but concise experience. Free game: This product is and will remain free to play.

rows.name: Amaz'd
rows.short_description: 2D fast-paced, pixel-art roguelike dungeon crawler. Battle through procedurally generated mazes, slay monsters and bosses, Your score passively ticks down, so clear the maze as quickly as possible! Can you win and a-maze me?
rows.description_html: Amazd is a 2D fast-paced, pixel-art roguelike dungeon crawler where every second counts! Battle through procedurally generated mazes , slay monsters and powerful bosses , and collect loot to power up and increase your score. Tutorial There is a short tutorial that can be accessed from the main menu, which teaches players the ropes of Amazd. You will learn how to fight, move through mazes and beat the game! Main Game - 8 Levels There is a series of 8 levels in Amazd, each one contains a procedurally generated maze, with the 8th level being a boss fight! The mazes get increasingly more difficult as you progress. Each maze contains: -Coins to collect -Monster to slay -Powerups and Potions to use -A portal to the next level Your score goes down every second! so slay monsters and collect coins to increase your score. Don't Die! -You only have 7 hearts, so careful not to die in combat, otherwise game over! -You have a stamina bar, so careful when sprinting so save stamina! The aim is to beat all 8 levels as fast as possible, and get a highest score!

rows.name: Sync Or Sink
rows.short_description: Trapped in a sinking submarine, two players must communicate through walkie-talkies to solve puzzles, complete tasks, navigate the depths, and escape before time runs out.
rows.description_html: You're trapped in an old Cold War submarine. Your only goal: survive. Complete urgent repairs, manage limited resources, and keep the systems running. You can’t see each other. One misstep, one wrong call, and it’s all over.  Use your voice. Trust your partner. And don't run out of time. You’ll never make it alone. Communicate through a crackling walkie-talkie. One speaks, the other listens - no exceptions. Relay codes, fix malfunctions, and guide each other through a maze of rust, steam, and shadows.   Forget clear sight. All you’ve got is each other’s voice. Keep it steady. Time is not your friend. Each second wasted brings your doom closer - flooding compartments, failing engines, failing minds. Complete your tasks quickly. Stay calm under pressure. And if you mess up? You’ll hear it. Feel it. Maybe even see it... before the ocean swallows you whole.

rows.name: SAYONALAIKA
rows.short_description: My grandmother went to space—and came back.After that, the world began to spin, round and round...What was this country, this society, meant to be?We simply process the things that come our way.What was the world supposed to be like?I don’t know.SAYONALAIKA is an adventure game.
rows.description_html: SAYONALAIKA is an adventure game where you walk through landscapes filled with memories. Story My grandmother went to space—and came back. After that, the world began to spin, round and round... What was this country, this society, meant to be? We simply process the things that come our way, one after another. What was the world supposed to be like? I don’t know. Time passes without knowing. Someday, let’s talk about the 'light' that lies beyond resignation. Game Features A walking simulator where various events unfold as you explore. Progress the story by examining objects. No quest markers or time limits—enjoy a relaxed gameplay experience. I don’t know the names of the stars, yet I still gazed at the universe. Playtime: 10–25 minutes Streaming Guidelines Streaming is allowed without prior permission, both for individuals and businesses.

rows.name: Strike Back
rows.short_description: Spacing, tempo, and whiff punishing are keys to victory in this simple 2D ground-based fighting game. With simple controls paired with a high skill ceiling, Strike Back is designed to be Inviting to new players while allowing high-level play for those experienced in the genre.
rows.description_html: Strike Back is a simple 2D ground-based fighting game geared for both new and experienced players. No jumping, no throws, and no crouching - just striking. While the game controls and mechanics are simple, Strike Back is designed around distilling the fun of the fighting game genre where spacing, tempo, and whiff punishing are keys to victory! Featuring the G.R.I.T system, players must balance defensive resources or face burnout! Players in burnout are unable to defend themselves - leaving them in a vulnerable position. Strike Back blends the complexities of fighting game system mechanics into a neat, simple package for everyone! Offline Versus Strike Back's core game mode. Play against your friends and family in an offline 1v1 setting. Use Steam Remote Play to play with friends around the globe! Training Mode Hone your Strike Back skills and tactics in training mode. Complete with a frame data viewer and dummy settings. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Battleboat
rows.short_description: Battleboat is a strategic, turn-based naval combat simulator where you command a fleet on a grid and execute tactical strikes against a CPU opponent. Anticipate enemy moves, and fire precise payloads as you navigate the world of naval warfare.
rows.description_html: Battleboat – Prepare to test your strategic skills in a single-player showdown against a cunning(little bit) CPU opponent. Battleboat offers an interactive experience where every move counts. Features: • Single-Player combat: Engage in tactical battles against the CPU which adapts its strategy after every hit. • Diverse Fleet: Command a variety of ship types – from sleek boat and robust cruiser to formidable destroyer – each with its own unique placement. • Interactive Graphical Interface: Enjoy a visually simple and non-bloated interface. • Smart CPU Logic: Watch as the AI analyzes your ship placements and makes calculated moves to try and outsmart you. Step into the battle and master the art of tactical warfare.

rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in a grim post-apocalyptic world where survival depends on your skills, ingenuity, and determination. Explore abandoned streets, battle hordes of zombies, solve puzzles, and forge a path to the Central Hospital — your ultimate goal.
rows.description_html: Survive the Chaos – Can You Make It to the Central Hospital? Step into a shattered world where every decision matters, every step is a risk, and survival is your only goal. Navigate a relentless apocalypse, scavenge for resources, and fight to stay alive. What Awaits You: 🔎 Explore and Discover: Search abandoned buildings, vehicles, and hidden caches for food, water, and medical supplies. Treasures and dangers lurk in every corner. ⚔️ Fight for Your Life: Engage in intense battles against relentless zombie hordes. Conserve ammunition, outsmart your enemies, and use every weapon you can find. 🛠️ Trade and Craft to Survive: Gather rare materials, scrap metal, and fabric to craft essential tools. Trade with merchants—will you invest in powerful weapons or stock up on vital supplies? Key Features: 🗝️ Solve, Unlock, Progress: Complete quests, activate mechanisms, and uncover keys, passwords, and blueprints to navigate through blocked roads and ruined tunnels. 💡 Outthink the Apocalypse: Survival isn’t just about strength—it’s about strategy. Use logic and creativity to overcome challenges. 🎯 Every Choice Counts: Inspect every corner of the world—hidden dangers and invaluable resources may be closer than you think. A Living World Shaped by You This game is continuously evolving, and your feedback helps refine the experience. We welcome discussions, ideas, and community engagement on our Discord. By playing, you're supporting the development of our flagship project, All in Vain . Thank you for being part of this journey. 🚨 The apocalypse won’t wait—are you ready to face the challenge? 🚨

rows.name: Miscrits: World of Creatures
rows.short_description: After years of absence, Miscrits is back and better than ever! Return to the world of Miscria and capture hundreds of iconic Miscrits. Train your Miscrits to their strongest forms and put a stop to the Magicites, who threaten to eliminate all Miscrit life from the world!
rows.description_html: Start your journey in Sunfall Kingdom and explore the vast and vibrant surroundings! Find and capture hundreds of unique and iconic Miscrits of various types, strength and rarity. Train and evolve your Miscrits into increasingly powerful forms and watch your Miscripedia fill up! A mysterious group called the Magicites have vowed to destroy all Miscrits to keep magic under control of the humans. You're Miscria's only hope at stopping them! Their leader, Apollo Nox, has summoned six Elementums that are draining the magic from Miscrits. Deal with the Magicites and defeat all six Elementums to enter his domain and take him down! Take on other players in strategic combat at the arena! Take part in various different Arena formats, each with their own rules and rewards. Conquer the leaderboards and become the best player you can be! Join our Discord of over 50,000 members to showcase your Miscrits, ask questions, discuss strategies and see update details as soon as they're announced! Miscrits is still a work in progress, and there are many updates and expansions planned for the foreseeable future, as well as consistent balance patches to keep the meta fresh and evolving! Miscrits is a game built by the players, for the players. While there are in-game purchases, all in-game content can be accessed completely for free. No matter how you choose to play, you'll have access to the same tools and content as everyone else!

She immediately teases you with her alluring charm, daring you to keep up with her seductive games. Your choices will determine how far this steamy evening goes. rows.name: Vibrant Dash
rows.short_description: Capture other player's pixels by running, jumping, dashing through procedural levels ! Vibrant Dash is a first-person platformer. The twist ? Every level is placed on a huge pixel grid. Capture a pixel by beating other's time on the associated level !
rows.description_html: Vibrant Dash is a first-person plaformer with a twist : The world map is a pixel grid. In this grid, EVERY pixel is a new procedural level . Capture a pixel by completing it quicker than other players, and color it as you like for the world to see ! Capturing pixels gives you in-game currency . Customize your character with the skins you can acquire in free  lootboxes. Use a wide moveset to progress through levels. Jump, dash, wallride, ledge climb... The timing is key ! Use the in-game chat to gather players and make art together. View past seasons leaderboards via the control panel. The best players will be remembered. Beat other runners in a high stake daily level !

rows.name: RockStars!
rows.short_description: 'RockStars!' is a third-person action adventure game set in an alien planet with a 70's retro psychedelic style. When Aero's rocket minivan crash lands on a hostile alien planet, they must use the abilities of different instruments to find their band members and escape.
rows.description_html: Aero is the lead electric guitarist in a band of hippie astronauts. While on their way to an intergalactic music festival known as the Protostar Palooza, Aero and their band members crash land on the planet Ergosporrus. After becoming scattered during the crash, Aero must use the abilities of different instruments to locate each missing band member while traversing through harsh and hostile environments. Unique Instruments and Abilities  New instruments are introduced gradually, each containing unique attacks and abilities essential to overcoming specific challenges and progressing through the story.  Diverse Platforming Challenges  Players navigate diverse terrains such as canyons, caves, and psychedelic levels. the use of traditional moving and jumping in combination with a variety of special abilities. Platforming utilizes the player’s base movement and jump abilities in combination with the special abilities of different instruments.  Narrative Cutscenes and Dialogue  Players engage in a story told through cutscenes, gameplay dialogue, and NPC interactions. All narrative elements are voice acted.  Rhythmic Combat  While executing instrument attacks, players can time their strikes to a rhythm for enhanced damage values.  Interactive Environment  Environments have multiple opportunities for player interaction, such as destructible crystals bounce mushrooms, health and ability collectibles, as well other pieces of destructible environment which trigger narrative and gameplay events.  Enemy Variety  Each area has a new enemy to encounter. Enemies have unique designs and introduce new gameplay mechanics.

rows.name: ElfMiner
rows.short_description: In this mini-metroidvania festive adventure, help discover Elf's calling and learn to follow their dreams. Unlock Christmas decorations an keep nightly visitors entertained. Collect gems, complete time trials and discover friends along the way.
rows.description_html: Elf lives at the North Pole and simply wants to be a miner. Help discover the calling and learn to follow their dreams. Currently in charge of toy production, they might have slept a little too long today. The house is preparing for the annual Christmas street lights and needs to get ready. Once decorations are setup and Christmas rolls around the visitors will come in waves each night to take a look at all the hard work you've done. The underground is rich with geode crystal caves to explore, friends to meet and obstacles just trying to slow you down at every twist and turn. Features Explore the underground while completing Geodes time trials. Complete geodes to obtain gems to decorate the Christmas street lights. Entertain nighttime visitors that come in waves of increasing volumes with Christmas decorations and friendly Gingerbread that can wave at the passers by. Several distinct Geodes with time trial challenges to beat your quickest times. Mineshaft challenge to experience and level up. ElfMiner is an indie game based on the real life events of Christmas street neighbourhood lights. Although the mining is an added gameplay element to encourage exploration and storytelling within the game, the only real life equivalent would be the holes dug for new plants.

Once decorations are setup and Christmas rolls around the visitors will come in waves each night to take a look at all the hard work you've done. The underground is rich with geode crystal caves to explore, friends to meet and obstacles just trying to slow you down at every twist and turn. Features Explore the underground while completing Geodes time trials. Complete geodes to obtain gems to decorate the Christmas street lights. Entertain nighttime visitors that come in waves of increasing volumes with Christmas decorations and friendly Gingerbread that can wave at the passers by. Several distinct Geodes with time trial challenges to beat your quickest times. Mineshaft challenge to experience and level up. ElfMiner is an indie game based on the real life events of Christmas street neighbourhood lights. Although the mining is an added gameplay element to encourage exploration and storytelling within the game, the only real life equivalent would be the holes dug for new plants.

rows.name: Nightlings
rows.short_description: Nightlings is a First Person survival horror game, set in the mind of a child's worst nightmares come true. Prevent the Nightlings from breaking in, and survive until morning. You have 3 nights to survive...could these be your last?
rows.description_html: Nightlings is a first person, fast-paced survival horror game, where you play as a 10 year old child, left home alone for the weekend while your parents handle a family emergency out of town. Initially thrilled by the freedom, your excitement fades quickly as midnight approaches. Strange, goblin-like creatures from forgotten neighborhood folklore appear outside, intent on breaking into your home to slaughter you. Your goal? Run, Secure, and Survive. Run around your house, blocking off all entries to secure your home from the Nightlings, and survive the nights until 7 AM. Each night will get progressively more intense, with more entrances opening up. You'll have to strategize your movements to get to each entrance and block off the Nightlings before it's too late.  Note from the devs. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This game was made by a group of game dev college students in the span of only 4 months! This is our first game we've ever released, so we'd love to hear your feedback!  Credits: ------------------ Project Manager: NitroWolf902 Lead Game Designer: Armanlot Lead Programmer: timefallc Lead Sound Designer: Dylan Ryan Lead Artist: TheLittleBear

rows.name: Killer Karnival
rows.short_description: Killer Karnival is a first-person survival horror stealth game ​where players are trapped in an abandoned carnival ​and hunted by killer clowns, each with unique senses. The player must escape by solving puzzles while remaining hidden to avoid becoming the carnival's next victim.
rows.description_html: In Killer Karnival , players find themselves trapped in an abandoned amusement park at the mercy of three killer clowns who engage in a nonstop hunt to track down the player. Using their wit, determination, and problem-solving abilities, players must traverse the hazardous nightfallen carnival while avoiding these clowns at all costs. Running, hiding, and distracting the clowns are all essential for players to keep themselves from being the carnival’s next victim.

rows.name: Super Crash
rows.short_description: How much damage can you create? Drive fast and wreck as many cars as possible before time runs out. Carefully plan your wreck to maximize chaos and destruction. Get a high damage score to win a gold medal on every level.
rows.description_html: Drive fast, weave through traffic, and slam into busy intersections to create a chain reaction of chaos and destruction.  Create as much damage as possible before time runs out. Unlock the next level by scoring enough to achieve a bronze medal. Grab pickups for a score multiplier, boost, or to explode your vehicle and cause maximum damage.

rows.name: Invention 8
rows.short_description: Invasion 8 is a continuation of a small indie shooter about the adventures of a group of cyborgs in the world of post-apocalypse and monsters.
rows.description_html: Several years have passed since the cyborgs from Invasion Corp gained freedom and regained their minds. The name of the protagonist of this part of the game is Marcel. He is one of the former slaves whose mind was subjugated by Casey Jefferson. Marcel receives a signal about the location of the legendary microchip, with which Casey's empire began. What? Maybe if you find this microchip, you can find Casey herself and take revenge on her? Invasion 8 is a continuation of a small indie shooter about the adventures of a group of cyborgs in the world of post-apocalypse and monsters. The main genre of the game is a 3D first-person shooter, but in this part of the game the emphasis is also shifted to solving various puzzles and boss battles. Demonstrate mastery of firearms, as well as ingenuity in solving puzzles! The game contains 5 different levels, in different scenery and a wide variety of monsters. You will have to go through a meaty shootout, and then solve a puzzle to get to the boss. - Control the cyborg Marcel and use his firepower and agility to defeat crowds of monsters! Control energy consumption and use the dash wisely to dodge enemy attacks! - Various weapons: shotgun, grenade launcher, laser, minigun! - Various puzzles. This time, not the easiest ones! You will need attentiveness, memory and logic! - Various levels: Ice Lake, caves, laboratory, etc. - Various monsters and quite tough bosses!

rows.name: Endless Forest
rows.short_description: You find yourself in an unending forest, trees as far as the imagination can reach. How did you get here? Where even are you? At this point you are really only left with one option, chop trees and hone your senses as you venture through the mysterious forest.
rows.description_html: You find yourself in an unending forest, trees as far as the imagination can reach. How did you get here? Where even are you? At this point you are really only left with one option, chop trees and hone your senses as you venture through the mysterious forest. However strutting through the lush grass you can't help but feel a forbidding presence. Perhaps just the wind... Game Mechanics: Chop trees with your trusty axe and gather wood. The wood can then be used to upgrade certain stats such as your power, so it will be less cumbersome to chop more trees. Explore the world as there are secrets scattered throughout the forest. Find new equipment to make your journey easier. Try and delve into the mysteries of the forest or simply find joy in gathering wood.

rows.name: When the Crow Sings
rows.short_description: WHEN THE CROW SINGS is an adventure mystery game with a focus on exploration, characters, and world building, featuring a cast of diverse survivors trying to keep the status quo as their compound life grows more complicated and dangerous.
rows.description_html: In the 22nd century, America has been ravaged at the hands of human colonization. Over the past few hundred years, the American fauna has evolved to survive the rapidly decaying environment. Tensions between intelligent animals called EVOs and humans are strained, and there are not many places where the two factions live in tandem. Westend Falls is one of the few compounds still fostering cooperative action, and it is highly exclusive. Chance has been accepted into this compound as their home has finally slipped into unlivable conditions, but once they’re in there's no coming or going. As Chance settles in, things are not as peaceful as they seem. They realize that while they may have come here willingly, there's no leaving. WHEN THE CROW SINGS is an adventure mystery game with a focus on exploration, characters, and world building, featuring a cast of diverse survivors trying to keep the status quo as their compound life grows more complicated and dangerous. It was created by a 15 person team over the course of 8 months. WHEN THE CROW SINGS is currently in development.

rows.name: Gut Eater
rows.short_description: Gut Eater is a psychological horror game where you must survive under the threat of a hungry cat 🍖. Take care of him… or he’ll play with your stomach 🫀🔪. Oppressive management, constant unease. 😵‍💫🤮😨
rows.description_html: 'Wishlist & follow if you're curious 👁️ — it helps a lot to spread the word!' 🐾 Gut Eater – A psychological horror experience where your only mission is to take care of a cat... unlike any other. 📦 A mysterious package. Inside, a creature that stares at you, tests you… and waits. It’s no ordinary pet — it’s a threat. 🍖 Feed him. Entertain him. Touch him. Survive. But the more you play, the deeper he slips into your mind… and your reality. 🔹 😨 An oppressive game: he knows when you hesitate, he knows when you're afraid. 🔹 🧠 Horror that breaks the screen: what if your nightmare became real? 🔹 👁️ A constant sense of unease: are you playing… or being played? 🚪 You’re locked in with him. And he’s hungry. 🤮🍽️🫀

rows.name: HeXpunk
rows.short_description: HexPunk is a co-op, third-person shooter with an emphasis on stylish and fast-paced combat.
rows.description_html: In a town devastated by ManaCore, there’s a reactor left running out of control, summoning creatures from worlds beyond. You play as one of two punks on a mission to shut down the reactor, bringing peace to the area and sticking it to ManaCore. Characters Hemlock: Basic Magic Attack: Rapid Fire: Shots that deal poison damage in quick succession. Special Abilities: Vortex: Summon a sphere that clumps enemies together. Acid Bomb: Rain down acid from above with a massive bomb. Faraday: Basic Magic Attack: Spread Fire: Shots that cover a wide range and deal massive damage up close. Special Abilities: Thunder Strike: Paralyzes enemies by striking them with electricity. Lightning Strike: Fly up into the air and come crashing down with lightning. Multiplayer: You can play with a friend by going to the multiplayer menu and either creating a lobby or joining an existing lobby.

rows.name: Shards Reunited: Kintsugi
rows.short_description: If you love puzzles and crave a straightforward, relaxing experience, Shards Reunited: Kintsugi is for you. There’s no fluff, just pure puzzle-solving joy with beautiful Japanese porcelain to keep your eyes delighted and your mind at ease.
rows.description_html: Endless Puzzles, Timeless Beauty Dive into the calming world of Shards Reunited: Kintsugi, a 2D jigsaw puzzle game where you piece together beautiful Japanese porcelain objects, one shard at a time. In this first chapter of the Shards Reunited series, immerse yourself in a serene experience as you restore vibrant porcelain treasures, each showcasing intricate Japanese designs like cherry blossoms, temples, and tranquil landscapes. Gameplay It’s simple yet satisfying: each level presents a new porcelain object broken into shards. Drag, rotate, and snap the pieces into place to complete the puzzle, then move on to the next. With puzzles ranging from easy to challenging, there’s always another piece to fit, offering endless hours of quiet focus and relaxation. A Feast for the Eyes Every porcelain object bursts with color, featuring hand-drawn Japanese designs in vivid hues—pink cherry blossoms, red-roofed temples, and misty blue mountains. Set against a minimalist backdrop with soothing music, the game creates a peaceful atmosphere perfect for unwinding. Key Features Puzzle After Puzzle: A continuous stream of jigsaw challenges, from simple to intricate, keeping you engaged. Vibrant Porcelain Art: Enjoy colorful Japanese designs that bring each object to life. Serene Atmosphere: Relax with calming music featuring traditional Japanese instruments like the koto.

rows.name: STRIKER HERO
rows.short_description: STRIKER HERO is an action arcade input game with an epic metal soundtrack! Master your skills, unlock new weapons, defeat the enemies, and become a true STRIKER HERO!
rows.description_html: STRIKER HERO is an arcade action input game! Strike the inputs  FAST , or be defeated! - STRIKER HERO is a difficult, fast-paced action game, with arcade-style gameplay, designed for gamers who enjoy pushing their limits and mastering their skills! You, the player, will have your reflexes tested in this intense action game! STRIKER HERO is notable for its epic metal soundtrack and highly addicting mechanical skill gameplay. Players who enjoy epic action and skill mastery will enjoy this game! Master your skills! Complete the levels! Unlock new weapons! And become the true STRIKER HERO ! - INFORMATION STRIKER HERO is controlled with a computer mouse and keyboard. The player uses the mouse to interact with the user interface elements, and the core gameplay actions are handled with keyboard inputs. The player uses the keyboard's arrow keys, or the IJKL keys to handle the directional inputs, and the ZXC or QWE keys to handle the square, circle, and triangle inputs. The escape key is used to navigate menus and toggle the in-game pause menu. The space bar is used to begin or end specific gameplay sessions. The duration of the game depends upon the player's individual skill level. On average, one can expect to complete the game within 45-90 minutes. The Learning Mode feature allows for players to improve their skills at their own pace. For an affordable price, you can enjoy an intense, addicting, and highly memorable gaming experience. Thank you for looking at my game. I hope you have fun playing it.

rows.name: Void Stalkers
rows.short_description: As the pilot of a Void Rig, it's your job to transport dangerous creatures to various research facilities across the system. Use your ship's security cameras, drone, and other systems to solve problems and stay alive as you travel through The Void.
rows.description_html: Void Stalkers is a cosmic horror game set in a dystopian future where you are a Void Runner - the pilot of a cargo space ship, under the employ of the WASP corporation. Your job? Transport dangerous creatures known as Void Stalkers to WASP's various research stations. Sounds easy - except your ship is falling apart, traveling The Void is never safe, and the Void Stalkers aren't dormant. Use your ship's security cameras, drone, and other systems to find and deal with anomalies, fires, reactor malfunctions, and other strange things in The Void. Use your ship's security cameras to monitor your ship and your cargo to ensure everything is as it should be. The Void Stalkers you are transporting begin in stasis, but can awaken during travel through The Void, causing reality-warping anomalies. Spot these anomalies and zap the creatures back into stasis before they fully wake. Fail, and you'll need to act quickly to lure them to an airlock and blast them into space before they get to you. Your ship configuration changes with every jump. Create paths for your drone to connect to different terminals or deal with threats directly! A lot can go wrong in The Void. Fires, biomass, trajectory misalignment, infestations, reactor problems, and more! Meet other Void Runners, deal with WASP's management and scientists, and communicate with other factions such as the Lunar Resistance. Each of them will want something from you and most of them have their own agenda. It's up to you how you play - keep your head down and follow orders, side with the resistance, or just look out for yourself. The choices you make impact what you learn and how you survive. It is the year 2972. After centuries of automation, AI, downsizing, and corporate mergers, 99% of Earth’s population is jobless. The unemployed live idle, pointless lives, subsisting on government provided food and living quarters. You were meant for more than that. But jobs aren’t earned. They’re won in a lottery, sponsored by the mega-corps. And against all odds, you’ve been selected. Congratulations! You’re a Void Runner now. Your prize? Minimal training, a barely functioning cargo starship, and 1,000,000,000 credits in debt. What? You didn’t think they’d give you a free ship, did you? And then there’s the cargo. Dangerous Void Stalkers that your new employer, Whitestone Agriculture Transport and Pharmaceuticals (WASP), say they want to study to create new medicines and technology to benefit all of mankind. The Lunar Resistance says otherwise, but they have their own agenda too. The other Void Runners seem to be on the level, but can you fully trust them? The Void is cold and uncaring. The corporations and factions are even worse. Every void jump pushes you deeper into a system designed to exploit you - or worse. But this is what you’ve always wanted. You’ve got your ship, your freedom (sort of), and a purpose. Make the most of it!

rows.name: Mountain's Memory
rows.short_description: Mountain's Memory is a walking simulator horror game where players explore a mountain at night, armed only with a lamp. Inspired by the chilling style of Japanese horror, this game delivers an atmosphere of fear and mystery. Feel the terror unfold in the quiet, desolate mountain.
rows.description_html: You were enjoying a peaceful camping night in a mountain shrouded in silence and darkness. The warm glow of the campfire cast flickering shadows when, suddenly, your eyes caught sight of something unnatural. The only thing I have at hand is an unreliable lamp. To reveal its identity, you step deep into the mountain. This game is a walking simulator horror game where you explore a dark mountain. Provisions for Streaming Users are permitted to stream videos or live content using this game. Monetization is also allowed. Disclaimer We are not responsible for any issues arising from streaming or gameplay related to this game. Warning Regarding Psychological Effects This game contains horror elements that may induce feelings of fear or anxiety. Play at your own risk. ───────────────── ◯Game Content Main story + bonus content (unlocked upon completing the main story) Estimated completion time: 5 minutes ─────────────────

rows.name: NYIP (Demo)
rows.short_description: Claim the Prizren Tower in the first action RPG set in medieval Serbia! Battle demonic navs, uncover forgotten legends, and survive a brutal world where Slavic myth and dark history collide. Your choices will shape the fate of all realms.
rows.description_html: The year is 1389. The Serbian army, led by Tzar Lazar, clashed with the vast forces of the Ottoman Empire in their ruthless conquest. Thousands have fallen, rivers run red with blood — but far greater evils still lie in wait. With the knights slain, the ancient protector has also fallen, leaving the mythical Tower of Prizren unguarded... NYIP is a top-down action RPG with souls-like combat, set in a grim fantasy world shaped by the forgotten myths and brutal history of medieval Serbia. As the smoke still rises over the battlefield of Kosovo, something ancient stirs — navs , the death-spirits of Slavic folklore, now walk among the corpses. Drawn by visions of the Prizren Tower — a mystical structure said to bridge realms — you, the player, are called to step into a world where dynasties crumble and forgotten gods stir in the shadows. Face legendary figures reimagined through a mythic lens, battle twisted creatures born from authentic Slavic lore, and ultimately decide the fate of Kosovo by claiming the Tower itself. Will you rise to shape destiny — or will you be consumed by it? Step into a bold, historically sensitive interpretation of one of Balkan history's most impactful and symbolically charged battles. We don’t recreate history — we reimagine its echoes through the lens of dark fantasy. The Battle of Kosovo has lived on for centuries — not only in chronicles, but in poetry, epic songs, and the collective memory of an entire region. Yet, no game until now has dared to approach its mythic weight. NYIP bridges historical reverence with immersive storytelling, treating the past not as a fixed set of facts, but as fertile ground for emotional and symbolic exploration. NYIP invites players into a setting unlike any other — a world where history, legend, and folklore intertwine across the haunted remnants of medieval Serbia. This is a land shaped by real locations, real names, and real echoes of a cultural past rarely explored in games. From the mist-veiled ruins of Samodreža Church to the cursed fields of Kosovo Polje, every environment is rooted in authentic geography and lore. Here, myth walks hand in hand with history: encounter reimagined figures such as Vila Ravijojla , the ethereal guardian of warriors; Tzarizza  Milica , torn between duty and prophecy; Vuk Branković , shrouded in betrayal and shadow; Miloš Obilić , elevated to near-mythic vengeance; and even Sultan Murat , caught in a fate that defies time... Thousands have fallen, rivers run red with blood — but far greater evils still lie in wait. Face legendary figures reimagined through a mythic lens, battle twisted creatures born from authentic Slavic lore, and ultimately decide the fate of Kosovo by claiming the Tower itself. Will you rise to shape destiny — or will you be consumed by it? Step into a bold, historically sensitive interpretation of one of Balkan history's most impactful and symbolically charged battles. We don’t recreate history — we reimagine its echoes through the lens of dark fantasy. rows.name: Spatial Ops Manager
rows.short_description: The Spatial Ops Manager App is designed for arcades, VR arenas, and other entertainment venues to manage event-style play of Spatial Ops.
rows.description_html: Step into the future of immersive multiplayer entertainment! Designed specifically for arcades, VR arenas, Family Entertainment Centers, and other entertainment venues, the Spatial Ops Manager App transforms the popular Spatial Ops experience into a scalable and operator-friendly attraction. The Spatial Ops Manager App is a desktop application for PC and Mac that provides centralized control and coordination of the game experience for group play in Arena mode. With just a few clicks, operators can manage multiple Meta Quest headsets, launch sessions, and monitor gameplay—all from a single interface. Key Features: Centralized Management: Simplify operations with a desktop-based Manager app that lets you control and coordinate sessions without needing players to navigate headset menus. Seamless Integration: Guests use the standard Spatial Ops game available on the Meta Quest Store—no custom builds or sideloading required. This ensures consistent performance and effortless updates. Scalable for Operators: Whether you're running a small arcade or a large-scale entertainment venue, the Spatial Ops Manager App adapts to your needs, delivering high-octane multiplayer VR action with minimal setup hassle.

rows.name: Coloring Voxels
rows.short_description: Bring vibrant worlds to life block by block! Our revolutionary blend of Voxel Art and Color-by-Numbers lets you build stunning 3D dioramas from the ground up. As the second entry in our hit Coloring genre, this game evolves the relaxing joy of 2D coloring into an immersive 3D experience!
rows.description_html: Coloring Voxels! Taking Coloring Pixels to a whole new level in the highly anticipated 3D sequel! Don't just colour the outside of a 3D object; build it yourself, block by block! Build up your creations layer by layer, level by level, to create a whole diorama tens of thousands of voxels big. Relive the calming and creative atmosphere of Coloring Pixels in our new 3D-based coloring game! From the music and art style to the gameplay and satisfying progression, relax and get creative with every level you build, in a format you already know and love. Create Unique Worlds! Every world in this game is made up of several individual levels that fit together in a larger themed 3D scene! Typically, each world is broken down into 16 individual levels that, when completed, fit together seamlessly to create a finished masterpiece. Create structures, vehicles, rivers, and more from the inside out, and in whichever order you like! Relaxing, Refreshing, and Reimagined! Making the game 3D has allowed us to enhance the experience even further: from satisfying coloring effects to adding new shader-based blocks, immersive particle effects, and lighting, altogether taking the genre to a whole new level. You will discover hidden easter eggs inside objects as you progress, even if you can't see them in the finished piece! Free! Starting with 7 worlds of 16 levels each, that's over 100 levels for you to play for free! Hours of relaxing fun, and we are only just getting started. Check out our Steam posts for the latest news on upcoming content!

rows.name: Caverns And Dryads
rows.short_description: Guide Tamzyn, the dryad warrioress —deadly and beautiful— and Sioul, the wizard —tenacious and powerful— to explore together forgotten cities of mysterious beauty and dungeons filled with dangerous monsters. Action, magic, and romance!
rows.description_html: Game Languages:   English,    Spanish. 'Caverns & Dryads'  takes you to a world of fantasy, where you will guide Tamzyn, the dryad warrioress  — deadly  and beautiful — and Sioul, the wizard  — tenacious  and powerful . Together, they will explore forgotten cities of mysterious beauty and dungeons filled with dangerous monsters.  Prepare for an adventure full of action, magic, and romance!   Caverns and Dryads includes features from RPGs, roguelikes, and visual novels. But it was created with total creative freedom , without following formulas or conventions. As a solo developer , I summoned its fantasy world without adhering to any trends. In this underground universe, dryads and the Magic Council play a central role. The story is an affirmation of heroic will and love , facing dangers, enemies, and limits. ¡That’s why it’s unlike anything you’ve played before! Some features : You can freely explore and move through the different locations in the game world. Each visit brings new  and different  situations. Every playthrough is unique, but everything is designed to make sense. Your  actions will advance the story and the relationship between the warrioress and the wizard. They are heroes : they don't fall easily. The wizard can resurrect  the warrioress, but at a cost  that you can recover if you play wisely . Turn-based 2D action that's immersive and relaxing, yet thrilling  during battles . Play in short sessions or for hours , immersing yourself in this fantasy universe. THE COMMUNITY: And that’s not all! The game is already packed with content , and I’ll be adding many new features regularly . Join the community and share your thoughts! Visit the Steam discussions , read the blog , or drop me a message on Discord ! (links here or from the game menu)

rows.name: Shadow Sprinter
rows.short_description: A fast-paced 2D endless runner. Dash, jump, and outpace deadly traps in a world that gets faster the longer you survive. One mistake and it’s game over. Can you outrun the system?
rows.description_html: 🕶️ Shadow Sprinter Run. Dash. Survive. Step into the shadows of a neon-drenched world in Shadow Sprinter , a fast-paced 2D endless runner where precision and instinct are your only allies. Play as a daring sprinter escaping high-tech surveillance in a dynamic side-scrolling gauntlet. Vault over shifting platforms, time your double jumps, and unleash rapid-fire dashes to dodge security drones and collapsing paths. Master your momentum— the world speeds up the longer you survive . And lastly - Square go brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr 🔥 Features: 🎮 Responsive Controls – Easy to pick up, hard to master. ⚡ Dash Mechanic – Zip forward with a satisfying boost, but time it right—there's a cooldown. 🧠 Adaptive Difficulty – The game gets faster and harder as you go. 🎵 Slick Audio Design – Jump, land, dash, and die with satisfying sound cues. 💎 Gems & Upgrades – Earn or purchase gems to unlock character upgrades and cosmetics. 🛑 One Mistake and It’s Over Touch a wall. Miss a jump. Hesitate. And it’s game over. Can you outrun the system?

rows.name: 2,4D Game
rows.short_description: Take up your sword and seek vengeance in 2,4D! As a knight whose village was destroyed, you embark on a journey of retribution. Battle through intense platforming challenges, deadly enemies and uncover the truth behind the attack. Will you reclaim your honor and bring justice to your fallen home?
rows.description_html: In 2,4D , you take on the role of a knight whose village was burned to the ground by a ruthless warlord. With nothing left but the memories of your fallen people, you embark on a relentless quest for justice—determined to track down the one responsible and make them pay. Your journey leads you through treacherous landscapes. Along the way, you will face deadly enemies: evil goblins under the warlord’s command. Every battle is a test of skill, demanding precise movement, perfectly timed attacks, and complete mastery of your weapons. But vengeance is rarely so simple. As you venture deeper into the world, you'll need to leap with precision from one platform to the next—careful not to fall, or your mission may take longer then you want it to. Will you let rage consume you, or will you forge a new path?  The warlord awaits. The path of vengeance begins now—will you be strong enough to see it through?

rows.short_description: In a desolate and ominous world, a young girl faces dark creatures that lurk in every shadow. With each step, the danger grows. But there is only one rule: stay awake.

rows.name: Operation : Escape
rows.short_description: A sci-fi top-down shooter game. 2D top-downYou shooting game. You get kidnapped by alien from far away and infested by their blood, which makes you able to use their weapon. You have to get out there before they catch you and do some weird thing with your body
rows.description_html: 2D Top-Down game with pixel graphics in Operation : Escape, will let you survive and fight with enemy by using Melee and Range combat style to escape from this place. STORY You are the criminals that trying to escape the police. While escaping, something took you out of the world from far away, and that's thing didn't help you. They want something from you. BATTLE AGAINST 'THEM' Fighting enemy by using weapons in total of 5 different styles to play with, and use some Melee combat to regain some resources to survive from this place OBJECTIVE Your goal is simple— escape . But it won’t be easy. Each room is filled with enemies and powerful bosses, all eager to welcome you with open arms ... and deadly force. Show off your skills and fight your way out! ENERGY MANAGEMENT Your energy is limited and is used for healing and reloading weapons . The only way to regain energy is through melee attacks (Right Click) on enemies —so choose your fights wisely. WEAPONS There are five different weapon types , each with its own unique function, ammo type, and ultimate ability . However, each weapon also consumes a different amount of energy when reloading , so manage your resources carefully. ENEMIES Enemies come in three distinct types , each with its own attack patterns and behaviors . Stay alert and adapt to their tactics as you fight to escape.

rows.name: Midnight Date Unleashed
rows.short_description: Midnight Date Unleashed is a Racing Dating Sim where stylish driving wins hearts. Impress your date with drifts and stunts on neon-lit, Thai-inspired streets. Earn Heart Points, and enjoy a Hyper Pop, Hard style, and City Pop soundtrack. Can you master the art of love on the road?
rows.description_html: Midnight Date Unleashed is a Racing Dating Sim that reimagines the thrill of the road. In this game, it's not about crossing the finish line first—it's about driving with style to impress your beautiful passenger. Perform breathtaking maneuvers, drift through neon-lit streets, and take control of the night as you build the perfect Heart Score to win her affection. 🔥 Key Features 🔥 🚗 Drive to Impress Master the art of smooth drifting, precise acceleration, and bold maneuvers to make your date's heart race—both figuratively and literally! But beware—reckless driving and crashing will ruin the mood. Find the perfect balance of thrill and control to create an unforgettable ride. 💖 Real-Time Character Reactions Your passenger will respond dynamically to your driving skills. Show off the right moves, and you’ll see her excitement grow through facial expressions and body language. However, push things too far, and she might get nervous or even frustrated! There are four levels of excitement, so pay close attention to her reactions. 🌆 Explore Thai-Inspired Roads Race through beautifully designed environments based on real locations in Thailand, including: 🏙️ Bangkok’s Neon Streets – A dazzling cityscape full of vibrant nightlife. 🌊 Pattaya Beachside Drive – A romantic coastal route with stunning ocean views. 📸 Unlock Exclusive Date Memories The better you drive, the more special moments you unlock! Reach the highest Heart Score to collect unique date photos, proving you’ve mastered the art of romantic driving. 🎶 Electrifying Soundtrack Set the mood for your midnight ride with a pulse-pounding soundtrack featuring a fusion of Hyper Pop, Hard style, and City Pop . Whether you're gliding through neon streets or pushing the limits on a winding mountain road, the music will keep your adrenaline high and your heart racing. 🏁 Are You Ready for the Ultimate Midnight Date? Take the wheel and experience a thrilling mix of high-speed romance, stylish driving, and unforgettable nights . In Midnight Date Unleashed , every turn is a chance to impress, and every ride is a date to remember! Choose your girls, and don’t forget to pick your perfect ride! You can drift to impress! Enjoy seeing the girls' reactions in real time!
