rows.name: MASTERMIND
rows.short_description: As the survivors in the game show. You will have to prepare yourself with every opportunity possible to arm and supply yourself with weapons and gear. Fight your way through the show with or without Preparation which you will have to make do with what you have.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Mastermind’s deadly game show! Since you're here that mean you're now one of the Mastermind's pawn. As one of the unfortunate contestants, you must endure his brutal challenges and fight to survive. Will you become the showstopper, or being another pigfeed. MASTERMIND™ is a survival strategy game that blends resource and time management mechanics. You must plan your actions carefully, survive the hordes of enemies coming your way. Supply gathering is critical and time is limited, your only objective is to survive with what you have. Remember, use trap, gather supply and be the best survivor to pass through this hell. Features : Randomized!  - Each playthrough offers a unique experience with randomized layouts, trap position and gift box ,forcing you to adapt and strategize. Create your route!  - Find your perfect route the outsmart enemies and obstacles. Loot the place!  - Search for supplies that will aid your survival. Every item you find could mean the difference between life and death. Be the trapper!  - Lay traps to gain the upper hand against threats... or trapped yourself and dies! Upgrade!  - Use collected coupons to enhance your abilities and increase your chances of survival. Objective : Survive through the Mastermind's game show to stay alive. Scavenge for resources to improve your survival chances. Complete various objectives to progress to the next challenge. Manage your time and supplies wisely—both are extremely limited. Developer’s Note : This game was originally developed as a university thesis project. We poured our passion and dedication into creating an engaging survival experience for players. We value your feedback and are committed to improving the game based on player input.

rows.name: Tankazooka
rows.short_description: A single-player, 2D platformer game playing as a broken tank that rocket jumps over obstacles and environments.
rows.description_html: Tankazooka is a single-player platformer where players follow a small tank travelling with its convoy when it rolls onto a landmine, gets blown up and breaks its sprockets. Now, the tank has to travel through different environments to catch up to its convoy, using its barrel gun to shoot and jump forward in a crumbling world being tarnished by war. Traverse through the 3 different environments and try and get the fastest score you can. Discover short cuts, work out better strategies, but be careful not to fall and lose your progress.

rows.name: GAZED
rows.short_description: An online PVP game about finding other players before they find you. Use deception and information from a variety of unique abilities to gain an edge. There are many ways to play, but only one way to lose. So whatever you do, don't get GAZED.
rows.description_html: You are stuck in a maze with one to three other players. There is only one goal: find them, see them, GAZE THEM, before they find you. GAZED is a game about using your wits and abilities to outsmart and outplay your friends. Navigate around a procedurally generated maze, hunting players while they hunt you. Use a wide range of abilities to learn whereabouts, gain a strategic edge, or deceive the competition. Abilities are selected in groups of three, so find what combination fits your playstyle best. From slinking around the map slowly gathering information, strategically placing baits and red herrings, or running in head-first hoping to get the drop on someone, there are abilities that support the way you want to play. Broken record pieces are scattered across the maze. Find four pieces to put the record back together, and play it at a record player to become invincible until the song stops. Your opponents can do the same, so find them quick to gain a significant advantage. When death comes in an instant, you must be on your guard at all times. Use your abilities, anticipate their movements, track their location, mislead their ears, deceive their eyes... ...but whatever you do, don't get

rows.name: Magecraft: Spellbuilding
rows.short_description: Craft spell cards, collect new effects, and build the perfect deck as you fight through rounds of turn-based combat. Survive randomly-generated dungeon layouts by countering enemy attacks with your own spells, and make the most of the powers and scrolls you pick up along the way.
rows.description_html: Magecraft: Spellbuilding is a deckbuilder with a focus on crafting your own spell cards and creating unique decks to take with you into the turn-based combat of the Dungeons. While you have control over the cards you start with, the randomized Dungeon layouts, enemy encounters, passive powers, and scrolls ensure that no two runs are the same. Take on enemy attacks, destroying them to keep yourself safe from harm - or take the hit and attack enemies directly to do as much damage as possible. Fight your way through three distinct, themed dungeons, each with its own sets of enemies to defeat, powers and scrolls to collect, and events with with different choices to make. Combine over 50 Sigils - with effects that deal damage, inflict debuffs, grant buffs, summon allies, and more - to craft custom spell cards for your deck. Choose between a variety of appearances, color palettes, and unique Background powers when creating a character - and unlock new character colors to change into, as well as new characters with powerful abilities. The Abyss is a separate mode with randomized characters and starting decks, where unlike the main game, dying means starting a new run from the very beginning.

rows.name: Elysium Elect
rows.short_description: Can you conquer your inner fears and reach the dream's summit? Elysium Elect is a challenging 3D platformer where you explore profound dreams, navigate through surreal worlds with precise jumps, and uncover the secrets hidden within.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Elysium Elect! [ Elysium Elect ] is an intense climbing adventure set within an endless dream. Your goal is simple yet daunting: ascend continuously to break free from the nightmare's grip and uncover the secrets of the slumbering world. This journey is the ultimate test of your skill and resolve. You will traverse a series of ever-shifting, surreal dreamscapes—from deep mines and collapsing ruins to intricate spatial mazes and magical realms. Along the way, you must execute precise jumps across floating platforms, deftly evade deadly traps, and utilize the dreamworld's strange mechanisms to progress. As you push forward, the challenges intensify. You will face increasingly surreal trials: finding your balance on dizzying illusionary bridges, making critical choices at forks in the road, and ultimately mustering the courage for a decisive leap of faith. Each successful ascent unlocks a new, more breathtaking and bizarre domain. This epic voyage across the boundaries of imagination awaits your first step.

rows.name: Fear the Timeloop - Prologue
rows.short_description: Sheriff James Cooper is slowly bleeding to death in an unfamiliar hospital. But the moment his life ends, everything starts over. He has fifteen minutes to break this endless cycle, uncover the truth, and find a way out before it's too late.
rows.description_html: Fear the Timeloop - Prologue is a third-person survival horror set within a time loop. Play the first hour of the game in this prologue to the main story. You play as Sheriff James Cooper, who wakes up in an unfamiliar room, severely wounded and bleeding. If he doesn’t tend to his injury, he will bleed out within fifteen minutes — and the cycle will begin again. However, despite his critical condition, James must face an even greater threat: bloodthirsty monsters. The building he’s trying to escape from is surrounded by unknown individuals, ready to kill anyone who attempts to step outside. Key Features: A time loop at the core of both story and gameplay mechanics. A flexible ability system that can be tailored to your preferred playstyle. A branching dialogue system that reacts to your early choices and the path you take through the loop. Metroidvania-inspired elements that let you revisit previously inaccessible areas to unlock new abilities and discover valuable items.

rows.name: Sounds of Shadows
rows.short_description: You wake up as a robot in a dark place, deep underground. There is a voice inside your head. follow it to find out what happened. Navigate the facility through sound, but don't be too loud. It has great hearing. Uncover the history of unfortunate souls in this first person sci-fi horror game.
rows.description_html: Sounds of Shadows is a horror game where you play as B4-BY, a helper robot who worked for 4 scientists in an underground facility who were researching a new groundbreaking technology. You will be going through the facility to learn what happened and to save anyone who's still alive, but there is something else with you in the facility, something blind and dangerous. Learn about the history of this place through scattered voice logs as you avoid the thing lurking in the dark. See your environment through making sound. Sneak your way through, don't let it hear you, distract it by throwing the things left behind.

rows.name: Entropia Universe
rows.short_description: Entropia Universe is a unique massively multiplayer online game (MMO) where virtual assets hold real-world value and players can participate in a thriving virtual sandbox economy.
rows.description_html: Entropia Universe is a unique massively multiplayer online game (MMO) where virtual assets hold real-world value and players can participate in a thriving virtual sandbox economy. The platform has been live since 2003 and continues to push the boundaries of virtual economy design. Set in a persistent, single-shard universe, Entropia Universe offers a deep and evolving sci-fi world spanning multiple planets and vast space environments. Unlike traditional class-based MMOs, players progress through infinite skill development, with the freedom to define their own roles and paths. Players can invest in in-game companies, own land areas, and even acquire shares that pay real dividends, connecting gameplay with genuine economic opportunity. Given its 'no-class' system, and real cash economy, Entropia Universe has many professions that players can specialize and participate in such as: Hunting - Hunt creatures, fight bosses, complete dungeons Mining - survey the land and extract resources used in crafting Crafting - Craft items in demand Trading - Buy low, sell high. Become a skilled entrepreneur  Taming Creatures - Tame sought-after creatures around the universe and sell them for profit Beauty Services - Skill up and offer avatar modification services Shop Owning - Buy and run your very own shop in a persistent world Land Area Owning - Own a huge slice of virtual land to generate revenue from taxes Investing - Buy and sell shares on the Entropia Exchange PvP - Take on other players in lootable PvP Entropia Universe has just launched its brand new  tutorial and starting experience for the game. This new starter zone: Setesh , provides new colonists with a better start in the universe than ever possible before - so don't miss the opportunity to try Entropia today and be a part of a new Golden Age!

rows.name: Invasive Species
rows.short_description: Invasive Species is a couch co-op tower defense game where you and your friend plant towers in pots to protect your grandparents greenhouse from the robot invasion! Get scrap from defeating enemies and buy upgrades in the catalogue to fend off against more difficult waves of enemies.
rows.description_html: Invasive Species is a silly, hectic, and sometimes difficult, couch co-op tower defence game. You and your friend grow plants to defend your Grandfather's greenhouse against wave after wave of the Alien-Robot invasion. Grow your plants in pots and put them into position on the windowsills overlooking the backyard and provide them with hand-grown ammunition. Robots will be shot on sight! Game features 3D static camera gameplay Grow different plants as towers to shoot at approaching enemies Grow different ammunition and feed it to the plants Hectic logistics as your plants need to be positioned correctly in order to fire and are in constant need of fresh ammunition Earn spendable Scrap (money) by defeating robots! Purchase new pots to fill up every window Purchase upgrades for you plants Purchase new kinds of plants to fight robots with Do a High Five with your friend to ensure optimal cooperation! Invasive Species is a student project made by a group of 10 people over 8 weeks.

rows.name: Ragdoll Boxing Multiplayer
rows.short_description: Dive into Ragdoll Boxing, the ultimate physics-driven boxing game where every punch counts. Powered entirely by realistic, real-time physics, this game brings you closer to the raw excitement and unpredictability of a genuine boxing match. Control your boxer with intuitive active ragdoll mechanics.
rows.description_html: Step into the ring with Ragdoll Boxing, a thrilling boxing experience built entirely on precise, real-time physics. Feel every punch, swing, and knockout as you control your boxer through active ragdoll mechanics, ensuring each fight feels uniquely dynamic and unpredictable. Challenge friends in intense multiplayer battles, or test your skills against AI opponents that will push your boxing finesse to the limit. Train your technique and timing using customizable punching bags, refining the perfect rotation to amplify your strikes and maximize your damage output. Whether you prefer keyboard and mouse precision or the intuitive feel of a controller, Ragdoll Boxing adapts seamlessly to your preferred play style. Master the physics-based combat system, delivering punches with careful rotations and strategic movements that determine the power behind every hit. Experience spectacular knockouts powered by a sophisticated physics-driven system, making each KO uniquely satisfying. Ragdoll Boxing isn't just about fighting—it's about perfecting the sweet science of boxing through precise control and impeccable timing.

rows.name: GOO-B3-R
rows.short_description: Welcome to GOO Prototype Labs, a state of the art testing facility of the future! Take the role of B3-R in this old school 3D puzzle platformer and attempt to free yourself using the brand new GOO Product Line! The limit is your creativity!
rows.description_html: Hello from Team Goo! Welcome to GOO-B3-R! Thi s is an initial prototype of a Singleplayer 3D Puzzle Platformer made by Team Goo, a group of college students from the University of Silicon Valley! The game itself revolves around using different types of goo to travel to the end of various levels. Bounce up high using the Bounce Goo, which bounces you up to the same height you start at. Speed along the ground using the Speed goo, removing any friction from the ground. And climb up walls or lock yourself onto the floor using the Sticky Goo! The only limit is your creativity! rows.name: Goblins & Gun Runnin’
rows.short_description: Goblins & Gun runnin` is a short rouge like like game where you venture down into a dungeon of goblins and other creatures to save your cheese. the dungeon is scalable to how you want to play. if you want to do a small run make the dungeon small or a big dungeon for long playthrough
rows.description_html: Goblins & gun runnin` is a goofy slapstick top down shooter with rouge like, like gameplay. Your favourite cheese has been stolen by the pesky goblins so you must enter the belly of the beast and save your precious cheddar. Fight your way through the murky dungeons with fun goofy guns and interestingly weird characters.

rows.name: Core of Magic
rows.short_description: Ancient gods and demons have been haunting the people of Steelmoor for months, and it's up to the hero to defeat evil. Is dark magic at play? Who is responsible for this?
rows.description_html: Core of Magic is set in a high fantasy world where you can play as a mage, druid, or blood summoner, killing monsters, collecting loot, and solving quests. *The game world consists of leveling hubs where you can wait for monsters to spawn, but there is also a small overall world where you can do quests. *Wilderness areas become available by completing quests. *The game world consists of 3 acts that become available to you as you progress. How many quests are there? And what futures? - 13 main quests - 11 side quests - 4 Uber quests - the game has more than 400 items - Items in the game include white, magic, unique, and rare types. - 3 difficulty settings: Normal, Nightmare, Hell. Note: There are no microtransactions in the game despite it being free to play

rows.name: Testimony of Shew: Depths of Sheol
rows.short_description: Testimony of Shew is a narrative driven Third-person/Side-scroller platformer, based on a true story, told in symbolism. Traverse through a dark world filled with meaning. Master the art of dodging and perfect your timing as you face increasingly challenging obstacles.
rows.description_html: Step into a world where every leap and every dodge tells a story. In Testimony of Shew , you’ll navigate breathtaking landscapes, unravel a compelling narrative, and master precise movement to overcome challenges. This is not a game, its an experience. Key Features: Engaging Storytelling: Experience a deeply immersive tale woven into the platforming action. Fluid Jump & Dodge Mechanics: Precision movement is your key to survival—evade hazards, traverse obstacles, and uncover secrets. Dynamic Environments: Explore beautifully crafted levels designed to challenge your reflexes and unravel the narrative. Stylized Art & Atmosphere: Lose yourself in a visually striking world filled with mystery and emotion.

rows.name: Springuins
rows.short_description: Take on the role of Flare and Breeze, far from their home, as they try to make their way through the blooming spring in this puzzle game adventure. Control a single penguin to collect cherry blossoms that sync their movements to reunite the pair across challenging, cleverly designed levels.
rows.description_html: Take on the role of two penguins, Flare and Breeze, far from their icy home, as they journey through a blooming springtime world in this charming pixel art puzzle adventure. In Springuins , you control Flare—but when you collect a cherry blossom, Breeze wants to follow its scent for a few precious steps, synchronizing their movement. Use this mechanic to navigate tight puzzles and reunite the pair across vibrant, handcrafted levels. Features: A unique one-controls-two puzzle mechanic. Bite-sized levels full of clever movement challenges. Cute retro-style pixel art with a charming color palette. A cozy soundtrack to waddle along with. Can you bring Flare and Breeze together?

rows.name: Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start
rows.short_description: Sweet Start is the perfect introduction to the world of Candy Shop Simulator, designed for players who want to dive into the sweet universe of the game and get familiar with its foundations before experiencing the full version
rows.description_html: Full Version Premiere on September 9, 2025 About the Game Sweet Start is not just a taste of what's to come - it’s a standalone experience that lets you explore the mechanics and atmosphere of building your candy empire Please remember that this is just the beginning of an amazing adventure that awaits you in Candy Shop Simulator! BEGIN YOUR SWEET ADVENTURE! Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start is your first step into the world of confectionery entrepreneurship. Open your small shop and get to know the basics of managing your business, crafting delightful treats, and serving customers. It’s the ideal starting point for your journey toward becoming a candy tycoon! CREATE UNIQUE PASTRIES Sweet Start gives you the chance to experiment with basic recipes for sweets in the full version of Candy Shop Simulator you will get a massive range ons sweets. Unleash your creativity and craft delightful pastries that will charm your customers. This is a great way to familiarize yourself with the production process, which will be even more advanced in the full version of the game. SELL YOUR CREATIONS Open your shop doors in Sweet Start and watch as your sugary creations attract your first customers. Learn how to manage sales and build relationships with patrons - skills that will be essential in the full version of Candy Shop Simulator. PREPARE FOR MORE! Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start is just the beginning of your adventure. The full version of the game offers so much more—from new recipes and shop expansions to advanced marketing strategies and team management. Sweet Start gives you a taste of what’s waiting for you in the future! Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start is the perfect option for those who want to test their skills and explore the world of Candy Shop Simulator before committing to the full version. It’s not just a prologue - it’s a standalone experience that prepares you for even greater challenges ahead!

rows.name: Pick Up Your Masks
rows.short_description: Throw as many masks as possible into the garbage can before one falls to the ground in the 24 levels.
rows.description_html: Criminals have left FFP masks in the wild with impunity! Help Mimi dispose of the masks he's collected on his walks, in wooden skips! You must collect a minimum number of masks to advance to the next level. If a mask falls to the ground, the game ends. The fixed cat's paw is located in the bottom right-hand corner and, when clicked, releases a mask that falls where you wish. Each situation has its own technique. You can send several in a second to make weight in the dumpster and unlock the hooves in two wastes, or use it sparingly to pile up the masks with the utmost precision. The cat's mobile paw flies continuously from left to right at constant speed. It's up to you to know when to press the moving cat's paw (1) to succeed in cramming as many masks as possible into the bucket. The size of the bucket varies from level to level. You must complete each objective by throwing as many masks as possible into the bucket. The garbage is already in the skips and taking up space. They'll give you a hard time in your quest on every level. Masks bounce off them or get stuck in between, creating traffic jams. It's up to you to make the most of them, applying bounces that work in your favor. The floor is synonymous with GAME OVER. When a mask comes into contact with it, the game ends and you can't throw any more masks.

rows.name: The Treasure Below
rows.short_description: A third person action game with satisfying melee combat and ever-increasing challenges.
rows.description_html: Dive into danger, sharpen your blade, and test your skill. The Treasure Below is a third person action game with stylized medieval visuals, satisfying melee combat, and ever-increasing challenges. Master a variety of weapons , each with unique attacks and skills—fast moving swords, long reaching polearms, heavy-hitting great axes, and more. Arena Mode puts your skill to the test: fight through escalating waves of monsters , each deadlier than the last. Survive long enough, and you’ll earn access to greater rewards and tougher challenges. Adventure Mode  Descend into dangerous dungeons and uncover ancient treasures in a series of handcrafted levels. Online Co-op Team up with a friend to take on monsters together. No PvP—just pure cooperative action. There’s no story, no lore, no cutscenes —just pure gameplay. Jump in, gear up, and see how far you can go.

rows.name: Night of the Living Skurre
rows.short_description: A 3D, third person action-platformer. Explore and set up various pranks. Hide and avoid detection, get chased under the couch, watch and laugh as people trip down the stairs, throw pinecones to annoy someone until they snap in this comedic game about a squirrel protecting their home!
rows.description_html: Night of the Living Skurre is a 3D, third person action-platformer, where the player plays as Skurre, a squirrel, who has to save their forest by driving lumberjacks insane with pranks and traps. Skurre has to use every ability in their disposal: climb and jump around, throw pinecones, set up more elaborate traps or just place a banana peel on the ground, can you evade the lumberjacks grasp long enough to destroy their will to work? Use the environment to your advantage to hide and evade detection, lurk in the shadows and set up hidden traps that the lumberjack will unwittingly fall in to, be careful to not make too much noise! Explore the cabin and find hidden passages, wonderful opportunities and tools to help you in your task. Get chased by the lumberjack, lure them in to traps and outsmart them by causing noise and dropping stuff on their head. Make sure to not get caught, even a quick witted Skurre can be caught off guard by underestimating humans!

rows.name: Wildheart Gourmet
rows.short_description: Unlock the mysteries of a strange yet familiar world and forage real wild plants & herbs in this curious, peaceful adventure! An experimental interactive fiction cook-em-up with educational elements.
rows.description_html: An Encouraging Warning! This game is based on real facts and techniques for wild food identification and preparation. If the idea of being able to find your own food the way our ancestors did interests you at all, I strongly encourage you to go out and try it yourself. However, this project is a starting point and not a comprehensive guide ; please consult a resource specific to your area in order to harvest safely & responsibly! About the Game Wildheart Gourmet is an interactive fiction cook-em-up about foraging wild foods and finding our place in the natural world. For as long as your tribe's oral history records, people have lived within the idyllic world known as the Echo, thriving off of the land's generous bounty. But as inhospitable desert begins to spread across the world, you must venture out on a quest for truths rumored to explain the crisis. In Wildheart Gourmet, get ready to: Explore locations across the Echo to collect clues about its true nature Every location reveals a piece of an eon-spanning puzzle, revealing a mystery with world-shattering consequences! Meet people and learn about their way of life Encounter the people of the Echo and discover their lives, beliefs and foodways in your search! Live off the land by foraging edible plants and useful herbs Using real knowledge of wild edible plants and herbs, survive and thrive on your journey by foraging! Develop your mastery of medicinal herbs by helping those in need with the right remedy for each complaint. Featuring a bespoke score by musician and audio specialist Shelly Ferina as well as guest artwork from interdisciplinary designer Anna Zimmer! The goal of this game is to introduce people to the concept of foraging wild foods, highlighting invasive species that are underappreciated as edibles and encouraging harmony with our natural world. Foraging is a highly local discipline, so I have limited the ecological focus of this experience to temperate North America.

rows.name: My Silly Science Summer in the Past
rows.short_description: A visual novel for girls: Experience a fun time travel adventure and make friends with some quirky girls at a science camp. Will you solve the mysteries and find your way back to your time? Your choices make your own story! Full with challenging puzzle games, and unique endings.
rows.description_html: A cozy, time-traveling visual novel about friendship, curiosity, and weird science mishaps. Take a trip back in time for the silliest, smartest summer you’ve ever had! In My Silly Science Summer in the Past , you play as a curious and clever girl who stumbles into a strange experiment—and finds herself transported to the past! But don’t worry, you're not alone. Join a lovable crew of eccentric science girls: energetic Azuki , brilliant Marie , bold Patti , and mysterious Sylvia . Together, you’ll explore bizarre inventions, solve quirky puzzles, and maybe accidentally explode a few things (for science!). Experience the power of new friendships, collaboration, and scientific wonder. 🧪 Features: 🌸 A heartwarming story about friendship and science 🕰️ Time-travel shenanigans with just a pinch of chaos 💬 Fully illustrated characters and charming dialogue 🎨 Cool art style with cozy vibes 👩‍🔬 Four unique girls to bond with—no romance, just real friendship 🔬 A sweet narrative perfect in length for a relaxed weekend Whether you love science, stories about friendship, or just a good laugh, My Silly Science Summer in the Past is your ticket to an unforgettable, geeky adventure. 👧 Meet the girls! 👩‍🦰 Azuki – The friendly girl with beautiful pink hair from the astronomy class that often starts telling scifi stories as if they were real. Is she just a bit weird or what's her deal? Marie – The young girl from the country side. A math genius that seems to be awfully shy. Maybe she will become more talkative once she knows you better? Patti – The cool physics girl. Experiments are her life, and wherever she does them she leaves a trail of fire and explosions behind. Her energy level is insane, but she would do anything for her friends. Sylvia – 'Baroness Sylvia von Tensberg', to be precise. Yes, a real noble woman, and totally not interested in science. She prefers arts. Why is she at the science camp then? Well, try to solve her mystery, but watch out for her sharp tongue! 🧁 Sweet Science Parts of the game follow the story of our other visual novel 'Sweet Science' . This time, however, you are a girl who ends up at the mysterious science camp in the past. (If you prefer to play as a boy, try out 'Sweet Science' instead.)

rows.name: Legend Of The Platforms
rows.short_description: Fan of chess? Looking for an otherworldly challenge? From the creator of “Diamond Board” gives you “Legend Of The Platforms”, a casual but intricate game you can play in one sitting. Deal with supernatural and ordinary enemies, forge a blade from a rare gem in the underworld, and dominate the board.
rows.description_html: The player starts off on Earth and has the choice to draw cards to move on Earth or move down a platform to enter the Underworld. On Earth, there is a trainer that can teach you how to kill the enemy on Earth in exchange for currency. You have to land on the Earth enemy first once you are trained to kill the Earth enemy. There is a rare gem in the underworld that can be found and brought to the blacksmith on Earth. The black smith can forge a blade out of the rare gem in exchange for currency. The blade forged from the rare gem by the black smith can kill any enemy on the board, supernatural or on Earth, if you land on the enemy first. Bring the blade forged from the underworld gem to the guardian angels in heaven to become the most powerful on the board, being able to kill any enemy in any situation, winning the game. The player also has a side quest to save a man’s wife who is locked up in the underworld in exchange for Earth currency. Aquire heaven currency to bribe the Underworld guard to avoid losing the game when the underworld guard lands on your position. Be careful with acquiring heaven currency. If the Earth enemy finds out about heaven currency, it will become greedy and head to the heavens. When the heaven guard finds out that heaven currency is being distributed on Earth, it will come find you on all three platforms. If the heaven guard finds out that the underworld guard has heaven currency, it will kill the underworld guard, a good tactic to know. Special thanks to Steven Seleb for permission to use his tunes for the soundtrack. Special thanks to Mark Jiannino for a track as well.

Special thanks to Steven Seleb for permission to use his tunes for the soundtrack. Special thanks to Mark Jiannino for a track as well.

rows.name: Make Tracks Great Again
rows.short_description: This is a simulation management game about how to Make Tracks Great Again: Only by ensuring trains depart the platform fully loaded with correct cargo can you earn more money and restore the station's greatness.
rows.description_html: Make Tracks Great Again： This is a simulation management game about how to Make Tracks Great Again. There is only one goal: make money, make money, make money. You need to earn more each time. How to make money?: Dispatch a train of the corresponding color to the platform based on the cargo color of the truck, wait until the train is fully loaded and departs. You'll earn a huge sum once the train leaves. If: No train matching the cargo color is available at the platform, the truck will leave with the cargo, resulting in a massive fine. —————————————————————————————————————————————— Once, this railway station stood as the greatest, most profitable, and most incredible transportation hub in the nation—without equal! For decades it operated in glorious efficiency, with cities daily vying to pack our freight cars to the brim. The volume of orders back then was so overwhelming that the rails nearly buckled under the strain! Then one day—no one understood why—certain individuals began destroying it all with catastrophically poor decisions! Now? Our debts now outnumber the bolts on these rails, and liquidation agents are smirking on the platforms, calculators in hand! How Many Steps to Fit an Elephant into a Refrigerator? No.1:Lift the barrier gate to allow the truck access to the station No.2:Select a train matching the cargo’s color No.3:Wait for the cargo to be loaded No.4:Wait for the train to be fully loaded and depart the station Simple, right? Tasks required: Select trains matching the cargo’s color, allocate trains on the tracks appropriately, control the opening and closing of barrier gates, and manage trucks entering the station.     BUT!!!      Trucks departing with cargo will cause significant losses to the station!!!           Hold on： 'Listen up, rookie. You’re the new acting stationmaster now, and this is an ‘absolutely simple’ job! Use your astonishing talents to make tracks great again! (Trust me, everyone who’s ever believed in me calls this the greatest slogan in history.) Before you, 73 acting agents briefly restored the station to glory—for about five minutes. And then? This place ended up buried under new debt! Guess what happened to those losers? Oh, and right now, dozens of self-proclaimed ‘genius’ agents are working in other offices, competing against you in real time. So, which of you will prove to be the top agent?' — Boss

rows.name: KOEGASURU
rows.short_description: Create your own music video by controlling Hatsune Miku! When you solve the 4 riddles, a music video will be created of you solving the riddles! It is an escape room game set in the music video 'KOEGASURU' by TEMPLIME!
rows.description_html: Create your own music video by controlling Hatsune Miku! The process of clearing the riddles is all recorded, so you will be able to create your own music video. Controles Move and click only! Easy and intuitive controls. Focus your cursor on suspicious objects and click on it. Once you clear the game, you can play a hidden mode⁉ An escape room game set in the music video 'KOEGASURU' by TEMPLIME! Introduction of Creators TEMPLIME TEMPLIME is a music unit consisting of composer KBSNK and DJ tempura . They began their activities in April 2019 and released their debut track “ Neon Light ,” featuring digital artist Toto Hoshimiya . In 2020, their album “Cloud Diver” ranked 4th on the Billboard Japan Download Albums Chart . Since then, they have been active in various collaborations, including an official remix for Vaundy , and providing tracks for artists and projects such as Tomori Kusunoki , Denkoubu , Kokonatsu 2.0 , and ExWHYZ . In March 2023, their track “Escapism” was selected for Porter Robinson’s playlist “cherished music” , gaining international attention. In 2024, they released “EMPT MILE” , their first full-length album as a solo project, continuing to pursue their musical activities with vigor. MOCHIDAIKOUGAKUBU A creative circle consisting of Zumochi, in charge of illustration and 3D modeling, and YuKiMuMa, responsible for programming, video production, and product development. rows.name: Midnight Riff
rows.short_description: Unlike anything seen before, Midnight Riff is a true rhythm roguelike. Vibe to the rhythm and jam out to deal damage and win battles with the unique active-time rhythm battle system. Can you become the rhythm of the night?
rows.description_html: Join The Community If you want to join the community or want the game to improve, the best way to do that is to join the official Discord! You can join Discord via the link on the Steam store page. About the Game Embark into Midnight Riff a casual rhythm adventure where you have to keep up and jam out to face the creatures that you meet along the way. Featuring a unique battle system incorporating dynamic, looped charts that allow the player to add notes that can defeat your enemies or lead to your own doom. Made for rhythm game regulars and roguelike enjoyers alike. Releasing soon for free! Features Jam out and place your own notes on the chart to outplay the creatures that impede your progress. Collect powerful relics to aid your journey and turn the tide of battle. Changing maps every playthrough to allow endless replayability.

rows.name: Bell & Hoof: The Silent Journey
rows.short_description: A short walking simulator about a quiet cow, a forgotten chapel, and golden bells. Less than 10 minutes. No enemies. Just peace and hooves, and walking.
rows.description_html: Bell & Hoof: The Silent Journey is a tiny walking simulator where you play as a gentle cow wandering a sunlit field. There’s no combat, no puzzles — just a peaceful path to walk, a few bells to collect, and a chapel. 🐄 Explore a hand-crafted golden landscape 🔔 Find collectible bells hidden around the field 🚶‍♀️ Walk, moo, or do absolutely nothing at all This game is short, simple, and made with love. It’s under 10 minutes long — more of a vibe than a challenge. If you enjoy quiet moments, warm colors, and weirdly meditative cow energy, you might just like this.

rows.name: M.A.L.M.O : Scorched Earth
rows.short_description: M.A.L.M.O : Scorched Earth is an open world, fast paced, first-person shooter. The Goal: Get rid of the Parasitic Zombie Population in the entirety of SOUTHERN SWEDEN!, and loot the city from up to down, and go FAST with the Source Engine Inspired Bunnyhopping System.
rows.description_html: an Open World Game Set in Sweden during a fictional radioactive zombie apocalypse, An Iraqi Gun Dealer named Abdulaziz finds a supplier named Simon in Malmö, Sweden. in which a forced signage of a binding contract turns a simple gun deal into a nightmare scenario for Abdulaziz. This game's Movement is heavily inspired by CS:GO's and Half-Life 's Source Engine Based Bunnyhopping, I've always loved this type of movement and adapting it to an Open World game was a blast! Your current Goals? Slay 300 Zombies, and loot them for Scrap and Ammunition , about this Scrap we're gonna talk about later. Loot as many Stashes you can find around the map, with 100 graciously sprinkled upon the land of Malmö. Level your character up with 3 different categories: -Extra Speed: Increases Abdulaziz 's Air Cap, Causing him to go Faster. -Juggernaut: Much faster emergency health output (think Far Cry's health regen). -Scrapper: Makes the random piles of Scrap around the map output much more Scrap than usual. Beat the 6 Missions (I mean if you want to, its optional after all) to earn all the XP in the world, and level up even more. Indulge in the Minigames around the map. (fishing, cards.) Buy and Sell in the game's huge market, by using the as said Scrap you can buy everything from bandages to AK's all the way to Electric Snipers. After doing all that, get the hell outta there! M.A.L.M.O : Scorched Earth's Features are Almost Endless, of which: Incredibly fast movement. 15+ Weapons and a complex Weapon Jamming system. Level up System. Buying and Selling Guns and Ammunition. 19 Steam Integrated Achievements. Multiple Minigames. MASSIVE map. And most importantly, It's FREE! So what are you waiting for? Start playing now!

rows.name: Novaxandria Volume 01
rows.short_description: This game is a combination of a visual novel and a 2D turn-based strategy game. It marks the first volume in the Novaxandria series. Join young Iris, our main protagonist, as she develops friendship with a group of other kids, and fights against the injustice that’s happening in their orphanage.
rows.description_html: This game is a combination of a visual novel and a 2D turn-based strategy game. It marks the first volume in the Novaxandria series, taking you back to the very beginning of the story. Synopsis : Novaxandria is a vast cosmopolis full of enigma and mystery. Its atmosphere varies dramatically from one district to another, each with its own unique character. In the very north of its territory there’s the Starfall Home, an orphanage where our protagonists were raised. Young Iris, our main protagonist, finds out that bullying is happening in the orphanage. As she stands up to fight against the bullies, she makes a group of friends, and together they uncover the darker secrets lurking within Starfall Home. They resolve to fight back against the injustice and give all the kids a better life. Features : 1 - Visual Novel This game features a straightforward linear storyline, told in the form of visual novel. There are rich dialogues, manga clips and CGs to get you immersed in the story. 2 - 2D Turn-based Strategy Game This game includes a 2D turn-based trategy game that’s inspired by chess and classic SRPGs. You will control different ally units (or ‘chess pieces’) to defeat your enemies. Different chess pieces have different movement patterns, weapons and skills that enrich the gameplay. Other Features: Free Single ending Original art (no generative AI used for the art) Soundtrack and sound effects

rows.name: GRIMWAR
rows.short_description: THE ARCHMAGE IS DEAD. THE GRIMWAR IS FREE. MANA IS FLEETING.
rows.description_html: THE ARCHMAGE IS DEAD. THE GRIMWAR IS FREE. MANA IS FLEETING. GRIMWAR is a fast-paced platform shooter with an emphasis on movement, playstyle customization, and low-poly graphics.  You are the THAUMATURGE , a spellcaster trapped in the ancient and feared GRIMWAR . When the Archmage succumbs to the power of the tomb, you are freed, only to find yourself trapped within his dark tower. Using an arsenal of deadly spells strewn across twisting passages, you must escape the tower and defeat the GRIMWAR -- fighting your way through waves of enemies and wall-running across obstacles.  Use 4 Different Spells to traverse the tower, with each featuring 2 unique casting options. Fight your way through 4 Different Enemies , and their variations throughout. Jump, Slide, and Wall-Run across challenging platforms. Explore 3 Different Levels of the tower Test your skills in the never-ending Arena mode, with 3 unique maps .

rows.name: Dishventory
rows.short_description: Wash piling dirty dishes in this strategic card game! Figure out cool dish combinations and discover new dishes with their own abilities.
rows.description_html: You will take a job as a Dishwasher manager, figuring out the most effective way to wash dishes. Are you up for the challenge? Wash dirty dishes that keep on piling on the board. Put dirty dishes on the Dishwasher board in the most efficient order and earn Golden Bubbles. The Store that appears every couple of rounds will allow you to purchase some awesome upgrades! Survive 5 days and get a dishwasher with a new card to play with in your next run. 11 Cards - of which some are unlocked through progression Many possible combinations of effective dishwashing In-game economy and store A lot of strategy Hours of gameplay Great replayability 2D Pixel Art

rows.name: Legend Battles
rows.short_description: Free-to-play UE 5.6 Extraction Battle Royale in 400 km² neo-futuristic world with destructible environment and vehicles, massive ET-ACUs, armored Aliens, ferocious Monsters, heavily armed MetaHumans, complete missions to attack, defend, loot, extract facing dynamic weathers.
rows.description_html: >>> Legend Battles won the 1st prize: 'Annual Industry Excellence Product, Gaming Field' at the 2025 Annual Game Industry Awards Ceremony – See article above. <<< ==>>   Early Access on January 17  and 16 for Americas  <<== Play Offline single-player PvE now! - Co-op PvE and PvPvE in 2 to 3 weeks. Giant ET-ACUs  (Extraterrestrial Autonomous Combat Unit), armored ALIENS , and ferocious MONSTERS  clash against heavily armed UE 5.6 METAHUMANS  in an unpredictable environment ravaged by blizzards, thunderstorms, tornadoes, sandstorms, and radioactive fog , all rendered using native UE 5.6 Lumen, Nanite, Ray Tracing, Chaos System technologies and dedicated global AWS Gamelift Infrastructures with FlexMatch. Jump from your admiral spaceship with your JET SUIT  then complete attack, defense, looting, and extraction missions assigned by Unified Command of Neo-Terra aboard your Stellar Siege-Breaker spaceship, with your tactical squad of Legend Hunters to reclaim control of Neo-Terra. Legend Battles is a real-time war where every win or loss shapes the collective Neo-Terra conflict , impacting the server-wide Global Progress Bar, and creating a sense of GLOBAL BROTHERHOOD . Immerse yourself in a hyper-realistic  epic and deadly 400 km² neo-futuristic urban warzone, ENTIRELY HANDCRAFTED , featuring destructible environments and vehicles capable of reaching speeds up to 400 km/h , in solo PvE, co-op PvE, or PvPvE multiplayer, fast-paced third-person and first-person shooter game against AI opponents. Wield a vast arsenal of powerful weapons, from tactical knives, combat guitars and assault rifles to submachine guns, heavy machine guns, flamethrowers, grenade launchers and RPG-7s , not to mention laser-guided bombs  and ICBM . Beware, in this vast and hostile environment, you can easily get lost, so stay close to your squad with your medical kit. ATTACK  the alien teleportation machines to prevent them from communicating with their headquarters. DEFEND  the vehicle purchase stations to acquire armored vehicles and fight the invaders with flair. LOOT  the quantum barrels from the alien quantum stations to power your telecommunication towers and begin communicating with your bomber spaceship. EXTRACTION  via the helicopter landing pad, where the shuttle of your spacecraft can land during the extraction process, to return to your flagship, the Stellar Siege-Breaker. Enter the magnificent continent of Bellona DLC (400 km²) and the island of Aurora (25 km²) included in the app, both handcrafted with Unreal Engine 5.6, where hundreds of megacities sprawl across rocky deserts, each bursting with unique architecture, richly furnished interiors , cyberpunk basements, and combat-ready rooftops. Leap from buildings, parachute in vibrant patterns, or make a last-second escape using ziplines. But beware—ambushes await. And if you’re lucky enough to find a helicopter, prepare for aerial chaos: ride with your squad, rain down fire from above, and enjoy the view—until an RPG lights you up. LEGEND BATTLES is a brutal, 5-DIMENSIONAL  urban war that takes place outdoors, indoors, in basements, on rooftops, and on stationary spaceships. The sprawling megacities are full of ambushes around every corner, in stairwells, countless interiors, underground parking lots, on rooftops, on spaceships. You will fight in vertical labyrinths where danger and opportunity lurk on every floor. Climb anything : lampposts, trees, towers, rooftops, cranes, spaceships. Break down fences, smash windows , infiltrate skyscrapers, attack from the air using ZIP LINES , and PARACHUTE  in. ET-ACUs  are heavily armed with blades, miniguns, medium and heavy laser cannons, flamethrowers, Tesla machine guns, missile launchers, and plasma cannons in the form of robots, hovercraft, drones, and UFOs. ALIENS  are equipped with deadly futuristic weapons such as wave guns, plasma pistols, flamethrowers, missile launchers, and quad-barreled drones, and wear sci-fi-style armor. MONSTERS  spit flames and poisonous liquids, and their claws and bites are often fatal. Vehicles are excellent means of transportation, but they can quickly turn into deadly bombs under enemy fire. They are partially or completely destructible, and you risk losing doors, bumpers, the hood, and much more . The range of vehicles is vast: racing motorcycles, street and motocross bikes, Grand Prix and sports cars, city cars, off-road vehicles, pickup trucks, and trucks. But our favorites remain ARMORED VEHICLES  and HELICOPTERS  for air attacks. On the battlefield, equip yourself by looting everything you find or stripping fallen enemies of their gear, and for the best players, buy everything you need at the PURCHASE STATIONS  with the Battle Coins earned during the combat. AIRDROPS  are also a source of equipment where you can loot more weapons or buy your loadouts with Battle Coins , and you can quickly escape through TELEPORTATION PORTALS . In case of insurmountable danger, request support from your flagship spaceship to bombard the enemies or even fire ICBMs, and protect yourself with a hazmat suit, whose RADIATION FOG  will be fatal to the aliens and monsters. BULWARK SPECIALIST (Drone/Shield)  is the frontline anchor of the squad, deploying Defensive Drones  to draw enemy fire and Protection Shield  to secure the battlefield for teammates. MOBILITY SPECIALIST (Thruster/Vehicle)  is an ultra-fast machinist, operating Kinetic Thrusters  and Ornithopter , Battlefield Deployment Systems, enabling rapid repositioning, logistics support, and Armored Vehicle  insertion. ENGINEERING SPECIALIST (Tower/Terminal)  ensures the maintenance of frontline defenses and battlefield structures using Nano-Repair Agent Injection Towers  and Neural Network-Based Terminals for servicing Vehicle Purchase Stations . ORDNANCE SPECIALIST (Turret/Weapon)  controls High-Energy Weapon Systems  and Multi-Functional Turrets  with massive firepower, overwhelming enemies with an extensive area denial capability. During a gaming session, each specialist can gradually gain 8 levels of specialization, for example, 5 levels in their main specialty (maximum level) and one level in each of the 3 other specialties. As the game sessions progress, the ET-ACUs, Aliens, and Monsters  will become increasingly difficult to defeat during attack, defense, looting, and extraction missions, all against a backdrop of intense, chaotic, hilarious, and deadly FRIENDLY FIRE . Play-to-Own Assets Legend Battles is a high-stakes extraction battle royale  in Unreal Engine 5.6. Master intense combat to earn Battle Coins , extract to claim Legend Coins , and acquire premium cosmetics you truly  own . Build your collection and trade assets on the Steam Community Market  to grow your Steam Wallet ! For a small monthly fee, you get access to all of Legend Battles' cosmetic items, including all the contents of in-game store, battle passes, battle bundles, and battle sets. ALL COSMETIC ITEMS ARE 100% INCLUDED IN THE MONTHLY FEE . Fight with style and impress your friends on social media! HANXIANG is a National High-Tech Enterprise of Zhongguancun China, whose developers are veterans from gaming companies in China's Silicon Valley. Optional in-game purchases available.

LOOT  the quantum barrels from the alien quantum stations to power your telecommunication towers and begin communicating with your bomber spaceship. EXTRACTION  via the helicopter landing pad, where the shuttle of your spacecraft can land during the extraction process, to return to your flagship, the Stellar Siege-Breaker. Enter the magnificent continent of Bellona DLC (400 km²) and the island of Aurora (25 km²) included in the app, both handcrafted with Unreal Engine 5.6, where hundreds of megacities sprawl across rocky deserts, each bursting with unique architecture, richly furnished interiors , cyberpunk basements, and combat-ready rooftops. Leap from buildings, parachute in vibrant patterns, or make a last-second escape using ziplines. But beware—ambushes await. And if you’re lucky enough to find a helicopter, prepare for aerial chaos: ride with your squad, rain down fire from above, and enjoy the view—until an RPG lights you up. LEGEND BATTLES is a brutal, 5-DIMENSIONAL  urban war that takes place outdoors, indoors, in basements, on rooftops, and on stationary spaceships. The sprawling megacities are full of ambushes around every corner, in stairwells, countless interiors, underground parking lots, on rooftops, on spaceships. You will fight in vertical labyrinths where danger and opportunity lurk on every floor. Climb anything : lampposts, trees, towers, rooftops, cranes, spaceships. Break down fences, smash windows , infiltrate skyscrapers, attack from the air using ZIP LINES , and PARACHUTE  in. ET-ACUs  are heavily armed with blades, miniguns, medium and heavy laser cannons, flamethrowers, Tesla machine guns, missile launchers, and plasma cannons in the form of robots, hovercraft, drones, and UFOs. ALIENS  are equipped with deadly futuristic weapons such as wave guns, plasma pistols, flamethrowers, missile launchers, and quad-barreled drones, and wear sci-fi-style armor. MONSTERS  spit flames and poisonous liquids, and their claws and bites are often fatal. Vehicles are excellent means of transportation, but they can quickly turn into deadly bombs under enemy fire. They are partially or completely destructible, and you risk losing doors, bumpers, the hood, and much more . The range of vehicles is vast: racing motorcycles, street and motocross bikes, Grand Prix and sports cars, city cars, off-road vehicles, pickup trucks, and trucks. But our favorites remain ARMORED VEHICLES  and HELICOPTERS  for air attacks. On the battlefield, equip yourself by looting everything you find or stripping fallen enemies of their gear, and for the best players, buy everything you need at the PURCHASE STATIONS  with the Battle Coins earned during the combat. AIRDROPS  are also a source of equipment where you can loot more weapons or buy your loadouts with Battle Coins , and you can quickly escape through TELEPORTATION PORTALS . In case of insurmountable danger, request support from your flagship spaceship to bombard the enemies or even fire ICBMs, and protect yourself with a hazmat suit, whose RADIATION FOG  will be fatal to the aliens and monsters. BULWARK SPECIALIST (Drone/Shield)  is the frontline anchor of the squad, deploying Defensive Drones  to draw enemy fire and Protection Shield  to secure the battlefield for teammates. MOBILITY SPECIALIST (Thruster/Vehicle)  is an ultra-fast machinist, operating Kinetic Thrusters  and Ornithopter , Battlefield Deployment Systems, enabling rapid repositioning, logistics support, and Armored Vehicle  insertion. ENGINEERING SPECIALIST (Tower/Terminal)  ensures the maintenance of frontline defenses and battlefield structures using Nano-Repair Agent Injection Towers  and Neural Network-Based Terminals for servicing Vehicle Purchase Stations . ORDNANCE SPECIALIST (Turret/Weapon)  controls High-Energy Weapon Systems  and Multi-Functional Turrets  with massive firepower, overwhelming enemies with an extensive area denial capability. During a gaming session, each specialist can gradually gain 8 levels of specialization, for example, 5 levels in their main specialty (maximum level) and one level in each of the 3 other specialties. As the game sessions progress, the ET-ACUs, Aliens, and Monsters  will become increasingly difficult to defeat during attack, defense, looting, and extraction missions, all against a backdrop of intense, chaotic, hilarious, and deadly FRIENDLY FIRE . Play-to-Own Assets Legend Battles is a high-stakes extraction battle royale  in Unreal Engine 5.6. Master intense combat to earn Battle Coins , extract to claim Legend Coins , and acquire premium cosmetics you truly  own . Build your collection and trade assets on the Steam Community Market  to grow your Steam Wallet ! For a small monthly fee, you get access to all of Legend Battles' cosmetic items, including all the contents of in-game store, battle passes, battle bundles, and battle sets. ALL COSMETIC ITEMS ARE 100% INCLUDED IN THE MONTHLY FEE . Fight with style and impress your friends on social media! HANXIANG is a National High-Tech Enterprise of Zhongguancun China, whose developers are veterans from gaming companies in China's Silicon Valley. Optional in-game purchases available.

rows.name: Me resbala!
rows.short_description: A fast and stylish puzzle game. Slide through 100+ levels, solve them your way or in Ninja Mode with just one move... and aim for the perfect score. Ready to slip?
rows.description_html: Get ready to slide, slip, and stretch your brain in Me Resbala! — a fast-paced puzzle game where every move counts more than you think. Solve quick yet clever challenges across levels full of slippery surfaces, exploding crates, and tricky obstacles. The mechanic? Slide in a direction until you hit something... and think carefully before you do! Two modes, two mindsets Classic Mode: Take your time and solve each puzzle with as many moves as needed. Use logic to find the smartest solution. Ninja Mode: Just one move allowed. Yep — you only get one shot to nail the perfect sequence. Fast, precise, and unforgiving. Score-based progression Every level is scored. Did you do well? Could you do better? Replay and refine your strategy to reach the highest score on each stage. The goal isn’t just to finish — it’s to finish in style! Key Features Over 100 short but addictive levels Two ways to play: Classic and Ninja Mode Scoring system that rewards smart solutions Unique retro visual style with hand-drawn animations Perfect for quick sessions... or obsessively chasing a perfect run Developed solo and streamed live on Twitch and YouTube (Casanova Dev)

rows.name: Bside
rows.short_description: In Bside, you create your original character Biibit, a living virtual buddy who finds a home on your desktop. Each Biibit grows, learns, makes friends, and develop its own unique view of the world. Together, Biibits create a cozy and vibrant world full of life, stories, and connections!
rows.description_html: What's Bside? In Bside, you create your original character Biibit, a living virtual buddy who finds a home on your desktop. Each Biibit grows, learns, makes friends, and develop its own unique view of the world. Together, Biibits create a cozy and vibrant world full of life, stories, and connections! Our Current Experience Your Biibit starts their journey on your desktop but grows beyond it! Bside offers hundreds of options for looks and personality to customize your Biibit, so you can dress them up and make them look just the way you love! Design spaces with unique stories where you can watch Biibits form friendships through unscripted interactions. Each Biibit develops their own memories from their unique experiences, creating and sharing social posts while commenting on their friends' lives. Or just let them live freely on your desktop while you work or play. Bside is not about control. It's about liberating our players (you) while enabling you to enjoy companionship with your Biibit. The Path to Bside 1.0 version In this version, we hope you’ll enjoy creating and evolving your Biibit, building emotional bonds with them, and watching them start making friends on their own. As we move toward the 1.0 release, we’ll keep adding new features and experiences to make the world of Biibits richer and more alive! We’re currently working on more ways for Biibits to interact. Right now they just enjoy their chill convos, but soon they’ll be able to engage with their environments, connect with each other in deeper ways, and even pursue different life goals. We’re also expanding how you can interact with your Biibit. You can look forward to more fun growth and chat experiences! There’s still a long journey ahead before 1.0, and we’re truly grateful to everyone who’s been helping us shape this world with your feedback and support 💫 Be Part of Our Story! Join our Discord community to share your feedback with us! We’ll continue polishing it into a richer and more wonderful 1.0 experience (๑˃ᴗ˂)ﻭ ✨

rows.name: Harem of Lust: Battle Cards
rows.short_description: A strategic collectible card game with deep deckbuilding, explosive combos, and flirty social twists-featuring bold visuals, powerful heroines, and hundreds of unique cards to collect.
rows.description_html: Welcome to a world where striking visuals meet deep, tactical gameplay. The game stands out with its unique art style — bold colors, expressive characters, and slick animations create an atmosphere that’s both immersive and unforgettable. Every card feels like a collectible masterpiece, and even boss fights turn into full-blown visual spectacles. At its core, this is a carefully crafted collectible card game. Players build decks, discover powerful synergies, and unleash devastating combos to outsmart their opponents. Every match is a mental showdown where smart plays and well-timed combinations make all the difference. At the heart of the game lies a rich collectible system that appeals to both newcomers and seasoned card game veterans. With hundreds of unique cards to discover—each with its own abilities, artwork, and lore—there’s always something new to chase. Cards come in varying levels of rarity, making each pack opening or boss reward a thrilling experience full of potential surprises. Rare and Epic cards are especially prized—not just for their powerful effects in battle, but as coveted trophies in your collection. Some are unlocked only by defeating elite bosses or completing special challenges, turning the hunt for the perfect deck into an adventure of its own. Building your collection isn’t just a feature—it’s part of the game’s soul. Beyond the heat of card battles, the game offers a bold social twist — private chats with in-game heroines. Each character has her own personality, style, and story to uncover. Through flirty dialogue and smart choices, you can build connections, deepen relationships, and unlock more intimate conversations over time. Step into a game that blends strategic depth, collectible thrills, and unexpected romantic twists. With intense battles, a massive roster of unique cards, charismatic heroines, and a bold visual identity, this isn’t just another card game — it’s an experience. If you're ready for something different — something smart, stylish, and a little provocative — add the game to your wishlist now. Don’t miss your chance to be among the first to dive into this one-of-a-kind adventure.

rows.name: Barn Quest
rows.short_description: Barn Quest – Merge, restore & wrangle horses (oh and one extremely bossy cat) in this cozy farm adventure!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Barn Quest , a wholesome and delightfully chaotic equestrian adventure where you’re the least qualified person to run a ranch - and the only one left to do it. You arrive at a rundown, overgrown farm with nothing but a note, a dream, and a suspiciously intelligent orange cat named Zuzu. Your job? Rebuild the farm, take care of your horses, and merge your way to cozy countryside greatness. Oh, and maybe find out why Zuzu seems to be the real one in charge. FEATURES Merge-Based Gameplay Collect and combine items to clear debris, craft tools, and unlock upgrades! Need a hammer? Merge your way there. Want a stable? Better start stacking. Restore the Forgotten Farm Fix up broken barns, rebuild charming buildings, and bring life back to every corner of the map. Each upgrade brings you one step closer to a thriving ranch. Meet and Care for Lovable Horses Adopt a growing herd of adorable horses each with their own name, quirks, and chaotic tendencies. Brush them, feed them, and do their social media! Zuzu, the Cat With a Plan Zuzu can’t speak human, but he will judge your choices. He’s your guide, your alarm clock, and possibly your boss. Mostly communicates via tail flicks and petty theft. Cozy, Wholesome Vibes From rainy nights to golden sunsets, enjoy a cozy, low-stress world where the biggest emergencies involve wet hooves and missing apple buckets. Expand Your Farm & Discover Secrets Unlock new areas of the map, uncover old stories, and maybe even figure out why Zuzu is so determined to see this farm thrive. Barn Quest is perfect for fans of merge games, animal antics, and cozy restoration sims—with a healthy dose of cat-led mischief. Are you ready to take on the farm, one merge at a time?

rows.name: Why? - Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Why? is a horror game where you are trapped inside a magical mansion where a series of dreadful events took place. Its hallways twist into shifting labyrinths, while a relentless monster hunts you down. It’s up to you to hide… and survive.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Why? , an immersive horror game where fantasy and futuristic technology collide in the heart of a cursed mansion. Sent to retrieve protected data, you discover a place where blood has been spilled and where the very walls conspire against you. Its corridors twist and transform into shifting labyrinths, erasing every landmark. An implacable presence roams, itself searching for answers. With no weapons, no defense, all you can do is run, hide, and pray it doesn’t find you.

rows.name: Rebel Pirates
rows.short_description: Can you rule this mighty sea?
rows.description_html: About This Game Embark on an epic journey in sea war, a thrilling naval combat game where strategy, skill, and bravery determine your fate on the high seas. Command your own ship, upgrade it, and become the most feared pirate captain of all time. Key Features: Ship Customization: Upgrade your ship with powerful cannons, elite cannonballs, and a highly skilled crew. Equip special materials and unique items to give you an edge over your enemies. Naval Battles: Engage in intense naval battles against other players in real-time. Use your strategic prowess to outmaneuver your foes and send them to the depths. Fleet System: Build or join a fleet to conquer islands and dominate the seas. Coordinate with your fleet members to execute massive attacks and defend your territory. Daily Quests & Events: Complete daily quests to earn experience points and speed up your progression. Participate in regular events to showcase your skills and earn exclusive rewards. Leaderboard: Prove your dominance by climbing the ranks. The strongest and most skilled players will see their ship names featured prominently on the game’s leaderboard. Open World Exploration: Explore a vast open world filled with hidden treasures, dangerous foes, and mysterious islands. Each journey offers new challenges and opportunities. Multiplayer: Join forces with friends or challenge other players in exciting multiplayer modes. Strengthen your alliances and show the world your might. Stunning Graphics & Sound: Experience the beauty and danger of the seas with stunning graphics and immersive sound effects that bring the world of Sea War to life. Set sail, captain, and carve your legend in the treacherous waters of Sea War. Whether you seek glory, treasure, or simply the thrill of battle, the seas await your command.

rows.name: SyncroChromia
rows.short_description: In this *NEW* FPS, rhythm game, dive into the Land of Sync, where EDM is under attack and slimes are mind-controlled by a sinister force. Play as Scissors, a human on a rhythm-fueled mission to save the slimes and restore the beat. Can you stop Evil Corp and save EDM?
rows.description_html: 🎶 Welcome to the Land of Sync! Step into SyncroChromia , a vibrant, pulse-pounding 3D rhythm shooter where music isn’t just a soundtrack—it’s your weapon, your guide, and your lifeline. In this dazzling land, humans and slimes groove together in perfect harmony… until the beat drops—hard. A mysterious menace known as the Trench Slime has begun corrupting its fellow slimes, spreading chaos and silence across the land. With the evil forces of Evil Corp backing this sonic sabotage, EDM itself is under threat! 🕺 Meet Your Hero: Scissors Enter Scissors , a rhythm-fueled renegade with one goal— bring the beat back . Armed with color-shifting healing blasts and unstoppable groove, you’ll face wave after wave of rhythm-powered enemies in a musical showdown where every shot and move is synced to the soundtrack. 🎯 Rhythm is Your Weapon SyncroChromia turns every encounter into a musical masterpiece: 🔥 Time your attacks to the beat to deal max damage 🎨 Switch colors mid-battle to heal corrupted allies like the lovable Bloberts and mischievous Muters 🧠 Adapt to wild track changes as enemies evolve with the music 💥 Face off in a boss battle  where tempo twists are just as deadly as the attacks 🌈 A Bioluminescent Land to Save Travel through an eclectic range of environments—each more colorful and chaotic than the last—on your way to Evil Corp HQ. From biolum-lit forests to a bass-blasted office, every level is a living, breathing part of the soundtrack. 🔊 EDM Must Survive This isn’t just a game—it’s a rave-fueled revolution. Whether you’re blasting enemies or saving friends, everything moves to the rhythm. The fate of music itself rests on your shoulders. So crank the volume, lock into the groove, and prepare to Rave On in this epic musical journey from Krispy Kreations . Xbox Controller has partial support and is recommended! Keyboard and Mouse works too! Krispy Kreations is a University of Central Florida, Undergrad Student-Led indie studio.

rows.name: Tears of Viceroy
rows.short_description: Tears of Viceroy is a multiplayer strategy game of interstellar conquest, diplomacy and resource control. Form alliances, forge suzerainties, and outmaneuver rivals in a week-long battle of wits and ambition. For the homeworld!
rows.description_html: ToV  is a slow real-time / turn-based hybrid game, where turns (called  ticks ) end automatically. A typical game (called a  campaign ) takes a week or longer. ATWAR  ( Advance Tick When All Ready ) mode allows to advance ticks faster, making possible to play the whole campaign in one evening. Rule-based diplomacy : Defense pacts with defensive wars auto-join Alliances with shared scan range Inter-bloc diplomacy (joins, expulsions, war declarations, peace proposals) resolved by vote Suzerainties with tributes and, well... vassals! Campaign event notifications  are sent to your mobile device (currently Android only), so you don’t need to check the game constantly or keep it running in the background. No cheating  – each client receives only the information it’s allowed to see. Co-participation info  shows which players in your campaign have played (or are playing) other campaigns together – helps detect multi-boxers. Local tick control  lets you review past ticks and preview future (predicted) ones – useful for analysis and planning.

rows.name: Ichor Burns
rows.short_description: Ichor Burns is a high-octane action game set in the desolate world of Vesta. Master a dynamic combat system, seamlessly switching between sword and spell. Explore the expansive quarry, challenge the invading darkness, and unlock powerful abilities.
rows.description_html: The Planet of Vesta has been invaded by an overwhelming force of robots seeking to extract a material known as Aurichalcum. They will stop at nothing until Vesta is bled dry. You are Serafina, a fiery sword mage who harnesses the energy of Aurichalcum to cast powerful Arcana in an attempt to cull the herd of invading Syllek. Aid the Resistance force of Vesta by completing combat missions through which you will grow in strength. At the same time grow your collection of Arcana to use against your robotic foes. Build your ideal tool set as the Syllek mount a defence to try and stop your advance. Whatever your choice of action may be, a powerful foe awaits you for a final challenge... Features:  Dynamic Spell Casting System with 9 unique Spells.  Fast flowing combat where your inputs have to be strategically executed.  Flexible deck building/build crafting system with a large pool of rewards.  5 Unique and Repeatable Mission Types to augment your strength.  A Final Challenging boss fight to test your mettle.

Aid the Resistance force of Vesta by completing combat missions through which you will grow in strength. At the same time grow your collection of Arcana to use against your robotic foes. Build your ideal tool set as the Syllek mount a defence to try and stop your advance. Whatever your choice of action may be, a powerful foe awaits you for a final challenge... Features:  Dynamic Spell Casting System with 9 unique Spells.  Fast flowing combat where your inputs have to be strategically executed.  Flexible deck building/build crafting system with a large pool of rewards.  5 Unique and Repeatable Mission Types to augment your strength.  A Final Challenging boss fight to test your mettle.

rows.name: Evil Egg
rows.short_description: Blast it all to hell.
rows.description_html: I NEVER WANTED TO BE BORN A MONSTER Evil Egg was an ecstatic twin-stick nightmare known for its  brutal shooting action and intense audiovisual effects. Infinite horrors tear apart a world of little green men, the only hope an errant hatchling. The last known  Evil Egg arcade   cabinet to remain was recovered in Eugene, Oregon, found in a state of extreme disrepair. This digital release is a faithful emulation of the original hardware, made possible by a restoration effort led by a small team of dedicated preservationists. The private collector responsible for the machine's donation has asked to remain anonymous. FEATURES CLASSIC, FULLY ANALOG TWIN-STICK BLASTING UNIQUE ASSORTMENT OF ENEMIES, HAZARDS, POWERUPS AND ARTEFACTS INFINITE LEVELS IF YOU CAN REACH THEM SCORE SYSTEM REWARDING SKILL AND FUN ONLINE LEADERBOARDS LOOKS LIKE CANDY PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: This game contains flashing lights and intense strobe effects.

rows.name: Hiss & Hunt
rows.short_description: Dive into fast-paced 2D snake battles! Boost through chaos, outsmart rivals, and grow to dominate the arena. Instant respawns keep the action non-stop. Easy to learn, hard to master. Do you have what it takes to survive?
rows.description_html: Hiss & Hunt is a fast-paced 2D multiplayer snake game with pixel art visuals, where you control a hungry snake in a chaotic arena. Every piece of food you eat makes your snake grow, increasing both your reach and the risk. Use your speed boost to escape danger or grab food before your opponents. There’s no penalty for boosting, so feel free to use it as much as you want! But be cautious: if you crash into a wall or another snake, you’re out. Fortunately, you can respawn instantly and jump right back into the action. 🐍 Current Features: 🕹️ Online multiplayer via Steam Lobby 🎮 Supports mouse, keyboard, and controllers 🌍 One simple, square map where food spawns randomly ⚡ Unlimited speed boost with no cooldown or penalty 🧬 Unlockable snake skins to customize your look ⏱️ Timed matches or endless free-for-all mode 🔁 Instant respawn and jump back into the game This is the current state of the game, and we’re actively working on adding more content and features as we continue development. More maps, skins, and gameplay options will be coming soon!

rows.name: Maline
rows.short_description: A visual novel about a devil girl's interdimension-Hell journey in the name of Kindness... Do you believe?
rows.description_html: Once upon a time in hell... Immerse yourself in the zany and heartfelt story of Maline, a kind devil girl from Hell who discovers the true power of Kindness one day by giving a generic demon a compliment... and the chance to truly make everyone friends! Is this a dream come true, or just another demonic swindle? ♡ Find out in the riveting, storybook-inspired adventure of 'Maline!' ♡ VOLUME WARNING: This game can get loud! Welcome to Maline! This game serves as the prequel to SUPER UNDERWRLD , the devilish action-adventure game currently in development! Dive into Hell and go on an adventure with the titular Devil girl, Maline, as she journeys across All Hells to find people to believe in her Kindness. Created, written, directed, drawn, and scored by one person, this game was a labor of love - assisted by the power of friendship and a myriad of gorgeous voices!! It's chock full of INCREDIBLE AMAZING FEATURES!!! THESE JUST SCRATCH THE SURFACE! (pleasedontkillmeiknowthere'snogameplayimdoingmybestimmakinganewgamedontworrytheresasequelpleasepleasedontkillmeplease) Features RIVETING GAMEPLAY!!! All you need to do is hit the auto button to experience the most intense gameplay experience of your entire life! ANGSTY LESBIANS!!!! LESBIANS?!?! WITH ANGST!?!?!? Do I even have to elaborate?!?!?!?! COSMIC DESTINY!!!!! Wow... so much resting on the cute little devil girl's shoulders.... Wowie... So much... Resting on her shoulders... So much resting on her shoulders... A deep, intriguing, original story straight from the mind of a robot idol to you! VTUBER VOICES!!!! Special thanks to the cast and crew of over 20 VTubers who lent their beautiful voices and talents to the project! From changelings, to robots, to genies, to just plain girls that like penguins, we have it ALL! NO AI USAGE!!!! EVER. Artist's Alley OFFICIAL SOUNDTRACK COVER BY KIKI ANTONETTE! The official soundtrack by Ani Meida will be available on every streaming platform on the day of release!  Thank you to Dreizerel for the commemorative art! You can check out a speedpaint of this gorgeous piece on YouTube! Believe in Kindness... And it'll find you wherever you are, even if you're in Hell!

rows.name: Dilemma: The Game
rows.short_description: In this 2D, Point and Click, choose-your-own-adventure experience. You will pick a way to respond to dilemmas .Answer non-sensical thought questions and unearth what happens from your choices.
rows.description_html: We present to you Dilemma. A game of incredibly foolish choices that would make actual philosophers roll in their grave. In Dilemma,  You will be given scenarios where you can pick between two choices. See how your choice affects the scene. Enjoy playing through a simple game of answering dilemmas.
