rows.name: Sporting Goods Shop: Prologue
rows.short_description: Run your sporting goods shop in this free prologue version of the game. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, and run little contests to entertain your customers. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.
rows.description_html: [Sporting Goods Shop: Prologue is a free prologue version of Sporting Goods Shop. In this game, you'll have a limited amount of contracts.] This is a first-person simulation game where you step into the role of a sporting goods shop owner. Work alone or with friends to expand your humble shop into a huge sporting goods shop. Co-op Mode and Single Player Share the duties with your friends in co-op mode (for up to 4 players). The more players in the store, the more demanding customers will visit your store. You can also go solo and manage everything in the store. If you change your mind, you can invite your friends anytime. Store Workflow Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products with an in-game computer or with your tablet while walking in the store, unpack the boxes, place the products into your store, and set the prices for your products. Consider the market prices while setting up your product prices in the store for customer satisfaction. Always keep your store clean so as not to lose any customers. Also, be careful with the thieves to avoid some box losses that would cause a leak in your finances. Run some little contests and reward your customers with some gifts. Products Please make sure your customers find all their needs in the store. Always expand your product portfolio and satisfy your customers. Sports equipment and accessories, fitness and gym products, skates, rackets, nutrition and body care products, swimming goggles, golf clubs, boxing gloves, sports clothes and shoes, and more... Be aware of the market prices and purchase more products when they're cheap. Customers Place a sufficient number of checkouts to reduce the waiting time for customers. Scan products and collect payments whether in cash or with card purchases. Don't forget to fulfill the online orders.

rows.name: Bye-Bye Bindings!
rows.short_description: Bye-Bye Bindings! is a stress-relief clicker game where you cut through invisible 'En'—spiritual ties—together with a cute spirit cat. Feeling a little worn out? Put on your favorite BGM and gently reset your mind.
rows.description_html: Bye-Bye Bindings! is a stress-relief clicker game themed around 'En' (縁) — a Japanese cultural concept representing invisible connections or ties between people, objects, and moments. Together with a cute, spirit-like cat companion, you’ll gently cut through various “bindings” one click at a time. Changing expressions and subtle effects with each cut Choose from a wide range of relaxing BGM tracks Unlock hand-drawn jacket illustrations as you progress Whether you're feeling overwhelmed or just need a quiet moment, this game is here to gently accompany you. 🧘‍ Highlights: Completely free to play Simple controls, suitable for anyone Each session takes just 5 minutes — perfect for a quick reset Why not take a moment to “cut a tie” and lighten your heart?

rows.name: The Tavern In the Woods
rows.short_description: 'Tavern in the Woods' is a first person, single-player interactive fiction story that blends mystery, storytelling, and supernatural horror. Players explore and investigate an isolated environment as the narrative slowly unfolds, gradually uncovering the truth behind the eerie emptiness.
rows.description_html: 'Tavern in the Woods' is a single-player, first-person, story-driven mystery. You take on the role of a weary traveler, and your journey has led you down an unfamiliar path through sparse and lonely countryside—a forgotten wilderness. At last, you arrive at an ancient tavern, nestled deep within the encroaching woods. Your heart weighs heavy with doubt—will there be room for you to rest? But as you step inside, you find only silence, an empty place, and a lingering mystery waiting in the shadows. Gameplay: You assume the role of a first-person protagonist, exploring the environment as the story gradually unfolds. This is a work of interactive fiction that immerses you in a haunted landscape. Key Features: Atmosphere: An immersive, medieval-era setting—you arrive at the tavern late at night only to find it deserted. With no horse, no weapons, and only the expectation of a meal and a bed, your evening takes an unsettling turn. No Combat: The game focuses on atmosphere, exploration and narrative. Combat is not required, though you may be witness to it! Investigation: Where has everyone gone? Is a dark supernatural force at work? Uncover the truth through careful exploration. Additional Technical Details: Game Duration:  30 minutes to 1 hour (or 1–2 hours for thorough explorers). No Save Function: Due to the short playtime, saving is not currently implemented. Presently only Keyboard and Mouse Controls are compatible with the game.

rows.name: 家训 Dogma
rows.short_description: 'Dogma': A first-person Chinese horror game where you return to a decaying ancestral home to decipher cryptic family rules. Shift between realms, evade spirits, and collect cursed relics to uncover a millennium-era family tragedy. Choose redemption or destruction at the Yin-Yang threshold.
rows.description_html: 'Dogma' is a first-person Chinese horror game blending rule-based anomalies with Yin-Yang realms. As the sole survivor of a cursed household, you return to the isolated ancestral mansion, following cryptic family precepts to reconstruct memories through four relatives' perspectives, revealing truths buried between dreams and reality. Amidst millennial chaos, a family of four descends into madness. Twenty years later, as the escaped younger brother, you receive your mother's letter summoning you back to the derelict home. Navigating spaces where supernatural phenomena intertwine with fragmented memories, you must uncover mold-covered secrets through stealth, artifact collection, and paranormal chases. Gameplay requires obeying paradoxical family rules while traversing dual realms, solving environmental puzzles, and confronting haunting truths about sacrificial rituals that shattered your bloodline at the turn of the century.

rows.name: Levania
rows.short_description: Open world adventure RPG with multiple classes to choose from, allies to recruit, and a unique turn-based battle system.
rows.description_html: **Setting Expectations ** It's important you know what to expect going in so you can know if you want to give the game a try. So here's the negatives that might turn you away. It still has bugs, sometimes game breaking ones. There's no story yet. It's mechanics are still being refined. Combat balance is being worked on. The explorable area is still relatively small. Slow updates (I'm only one man working on it in my free time) Now, I know it seems all bad and if it's already too much for you then I hope you'll consider giving it a try later on with more updates.  Here's the positives of what you can expect: Choice between 5 races, male and female, and 8 starting classes. Each class can choose from 3 vocations (essentially the true class) at level 10 and 2 specializations at level 60. which makes 24 vocations and 48 specializations. 24 followers to find and join your party. Each class has their own set of skills they can unlock. There's over 400 skills in the game with the minimum a single class having at max level being about 13-14. 11 weapon types. Each weapon type has 20 weapons in it. All upgradable to Tier V. An assortment of armors and accessories. 2 cities, a small town, 6 forests, 5 dungeons, & 7 small replayable dungeons. 5 marked quest from the Adventurers Guild & 5 untracked quests on the map. several more secret areas that I wouldn't consider quests. At least a few hours of gameplay. I'm always open to feedback and glitch/bug reports. It helps me make the game better. I'm active on Discord and can more quickly respond to any questions/comments/bug reports. I hope you enjoy the game.

rows.name: Changelog
rows.short_description: In 2016, a group of ambitious students got together to make the best adventure game ever — but they failed. Discover their story by playing through different builds of their game and reading their development logs.
rows.description_html: Eren Lai dreamed of becoming a game developer. Now though, he is just an Associate Accountant at Formworks LLC. It wasn't always like this, though; Eren once led a promising project as a game design student, but the game never came out. What went so terribly wrong? In Changelog, you'll play increasingly-developed builds of the game Eren made with his friends. You'll read through their chat logs and development diaries to discover secrets about the levels. And you'll unravel the story of how it all came crashing down. Features A searchable keyword system that connects secrets in the builds with hints in the game development wiki Over the course of a 2-3 hour playthrough, players will experience the story of Eren's group and decide for themselves who was to blame An entire game-within-a-game (that's like two games for the price of none!)

rows.name: Four Divine Abidings
rows.short_description: Complete the Path to Liberation in the mindfulness-themed idle/incremental game inspired by Buddhist philosophy. Enjoy a calm, atmospheric hand-painted Journey with strategic depth and multiple layers of progression.
rows.description_html: Complete the Path to Liberation in this mindfulness-themed idle/incremental hand-painted journey inspired by Buddhist philosophy. Cultivate the Four Divine Abidings: Loving-Kindness ( Metta ), Compassion ( Karuna ), Appreciative Joy ( Mudita ), and Equanimity ( Upekkha ) - and apply them in various encounters. Enjoy a calm atmosphere supported by hand-painted art and relaxing music. Freely choose between active and idle playstyles, with fair offline progress upgradeable to up to 52 hours. Your entire journey will be guided by a series of tasks that gradually introduce core concepts. With dedication, you can complete the game through a series of Rebirths, shaped by the Karma Seeds sown in previous incarnations. Discover optional lore and unlock themed Skills, Insights, and Spiritual Tools as you progress along the Path. Sow karma seeds to shape each rebirth and experience the journey in new ways. Each step you make brings you closer towards the ultimate goal of Full Liberation. Game Highlights + Narrated gameplay with dozens of tasks to follow. + The game is content-complete and can be finished. + 202 Milestones to claim, many providing unique permanent buffs. + 32 Skills and Insights to master. + Additional 20 Skills for Rebirth mechanic. + 9 Spiritual Tools introducing new mechanics and game loops. + Full support of both idle and active playstyles. + Many intertwined, evolving layers of strategic progression to keep you engaged through the whole game experience. + Hand-painted art , which many people find beautiful; soon getting its own offline exhibition.

rows.name: ClickShot
rows.short_description: Lock, Load, Click. A slick clicker game where every click pulls the trigger. Earn shells, unlock wild gun cosmetics, and stack permanent multipliers. Simple to play, hard to quit. Lock, load, and click your way to glory.
rows.description_html: Lock, load, click. ClickShot is a trigger-happy clicker where every tap fires your way to cosmetic gun upgrades and massive multipliers. Rack up shells, unlock a growing arsenal, and flex your custom loadout with flashy sights, muzzles, and lasers. Features: 🔫 Click your gun to earn shells and cash in on upgrades 💥 Unlock and equip cosmetics that boost your shell multiplier 🛠 Visit the Workbench to mix ‘n match sights, muzzles, and lasers 💼 Shop for new gear — everything you buy sticks with you permanently 🐢 Lightweight and snappy — perfect for short bursts or long grinds

rows.name: Greed's Grub
rows.short_description: You don’t remember exactly what you did, just that it had to have been real bad, if this was your punishment. Five days of community service in this greasy, rotting excuse for a burger joint. Just five days, and you’re free. That’s all you have to endure.
rows.description_html: Greed's Grub is a first-person horror game where you must craft burgers for nightmarish and goofy customers in a hellish diner, facing terrifying challenges for five days in order to survive. You don’t remember exactly what you did, just that it had to have been real bad , if this was your punishment. Five days of community service in this greasy , rotting excuse for a burger joint . Just five days, and you’re free. That’s all you have to endure. Outlast Your Horrific Customers Serve up burgers to the most weirdest and nastiest customers from the depths of hell. Cook, Cook, Cook. Grill, assemble, and pray for five days straight at a cursed burger joint. Each day is more intense than the last. Beware the Boss from Hell The boss is watching, and failure isn’t an option. rows.name: Banana Loco
rows.short_description: A thrilling tile-based treasure hunt where players uncover banana prizes while dodging traps and explosive surprises. Are you ready to go bananas? 🍌💥
rows.description_html: BANANA TREASURE HUNT! Dive into a wild and unpredictable treasure hunt where bananas are the ultimate prize! In this thrilling tile-based adventure, players navigate a grid of mystery, uncovering hidden banana treasures while dodging sneaky traps and explosive surprises. Strategy, luck, and a touch of madness are your best allies in this race to become the ultimate treasure hunter. Are you ready to go bananas? 🍌💥 Banana Loco is a single player game where players try to look for banana treasures within tiles. Players can use power-ups to help them navigate the map tiles. With the use of strategy and tile memorization, players can achieve high scores. Depending on the level, the quest for multiple treasures will be given to the treasure hunters. FEATURES The game includes a treasure hunt within a set of tiles. Use power-ups to gain an advantage. Use them wisely because they're limited. Achieve high scores by collecting many banana treasures! Tile Exploration : Players reveal tiles on the map to uncover treasures or hidden surprises. Levels: Reach more difficult levels by earning treasure scores Banana Treasures : Collect valuable banana treasures to win the round. Card Power-ups : Use power-ups for your advantage to easily find the treasures. Traps : Watch out for traps among hidden tiles that can hinder your progress. Medals : Earn medals by achieving certain high scores.

rows.name: Unbound
rows.short_description: Help Mox break out from his unjust inprisonment. Navigate through a hazardous, futuristic city and outrun your pursuer to reach an off-world colony in this 2D precision-platformer!
rows.description_html: Notice This game was made for educational purposes at The Game Assembly in Malmö. The game is completely free and will remain so forever. About the Game As a wrongfully imprisoned monkey, you break out. Navigate through a hazardous, futuristic city to escape your pursuer and reach an off-world colony. Unbound is a 2D precision-platformer game originally made in 13 weeks by Primal Crowd , 13 students at The Game Assembly in Malmö. Features Precise Movement: Jump, Climb and Dash your way through 3 tricky levels filled with handcrafted precision-platforming challenges. You're Being Chased: The prison guard you escaped from just can't let you go! Outrun your pursuer and escape the planet. Retro Sci-Fi Aesthetic: Take in the views or just vibe. From an underground prison, to a dystopian city and a high-tech spaceport there's a little bit of everything to look at. Go Bananas: Want more challenge? Every level is filled with optional even trickier trials to overcome. Be rewarded with bananas for your skill. Can you collect them all...? See The Result Of Your Effort: The game keeps track of your time, bananas collected and death count. After each run of the game you'll see these displayed and the time be compared to your personal best. Enable the build-in speedrun timer to help you set a new best time. Credits Primal Crowd Programming Abraham Alberto Philip Eriksson Christian Le Elias Ronefors Ylver Blum Buer Graphics Dante Norling Eklöf Oliver Andersson Morgan Wildmark Emil Nilsson Animation Rebecca Kornemalm Theo Hübner Sallis Level Design Erik Gatewood Alvin Berthet  Special Thanks Alice Myhrman Sounds Sound effects provided by Soundsnap, Abraham Alberto and Oliver Andersson. Original Music by Abraham Alberto and Oliver Andersson. Voice acting by Philip Eriksson and Theo Hübner Sallis. Technologies Made in TGE The Game Engine by The Game Assembly Made using FMOD Studio by Firelight Technologies Pty Ltd.

rows.name: Off The Grid
rows.short_description: Welcome to Off The Grid, the next-gen free to play Battle Royale from visionary director Neill Blomkamp. Set in a near-future world where contestants are cybernetically augmented and dropped into televised bloodsport. Death is temporary, but fame is forever.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Off The Grid, the next evolution of the shooter genre from visionary director Neill Blomkamp (District 9, Elysium). Set in a near-future world where contestants are cybernetically augmented and dropped into a televised bloodsport where death is temporary, but fame is forever. In Off The Grid, YOU are a modular death machine. Switch your cyberlimbs at any time, and adapt your playstyle on the fly. Loot the body parts of those that have perished around you, and assemble your dream loadout. With more than 15 limbs available to loot, steal or drop in with, the possibilities for mayhem are endless. Off The Grid takes movement to the next level with a dexterous aerial movement system driven by advanced jetpacks. With strong utilization of the verticality of the maps players are able to both enter and exit fights rapidly, rewarding aggression and a fast-paced gameplay. Drop onto Teardrop Island, a living, breathing paradise built with cutting-edge technologies. Every corner of the map is designed to deliver a truly cinematic experience, setting the stage for an ambitious 60-hour narrative campaign coming later this year. Finetune weaponry to fit your play style: with thousands of combinations there is a loadout for any kind of killer. Tune your guns to perfection with a wide variety of cosmetics and attachments, or lean heavy into Teardrop Island’s latest cyberlimbs in order to dominate the battlefield. Call in your customized loadout at any time and make the battlefield your playground. Extract high-value loot off the island amidst a brutal battle for survival. Adapt, outsmart and work your way closer to victory. Off The Grid isn’t just about being the last one standing, it’s about looting and extracting the most valuable gear before becoming the next casualty. Every item you extract or earn can be traded on the in-game marketplace. We've build a truly open game economy, whether you're snagging that weapon you’ve been coveting, or flipping unused gear, every deal is driven by real supply and demand. List, trade and build up your perfect loadout. When Regen technology is invented, it's bought out exclusively by a consortium of billion-dollar gaming companies to stage a Real Battle Royale. It's a Super Bowl-style televised bloodbath where everyday people are augmented with cyberlimbs and dropped onto an abandoned island to fight to the death.

rows.name: Dream on
rows.short_description: Dream On is a very short, atmospheric walking simulator (5-10 minutes) about making a wish. Walk through a symbolic dreamscape, explore your thoughts and feelings, and make a quiet, meaningful choice at the end of the journey.
rows.description_html: Dream On is a short first-person walking simulator focused on introspection and atmosphere. You’ll embark on a meditative journey through a symbolic dreamscape, exploring surreal environments that reflect the inner world of fears, hopes, and desires. Features: A brief experience — the game can be completed in about 5-10 minutes. Linear narrative with symbolic visuals and ambient storytelling. Immersive sound design — no dialogue or text, just music and sound to guide your experience. Simple controls — walk, look around, and interact with key objects. A meaningful choice at the end — what will you wish for? Dream On is not about challenges or puzzles. It's a quiet space to reflect, feel, and simply be . Perfect for players looking for a short emotional escape or a peaceful moment before sleep.

rows.name: Train Driver 2
rows.short_description: Polish railway simulator emphasizing multiplayer and realism. Become a train driver, operating faithfully recreated trains, or a dispatcher, managing traffic and signalling equipment at your post. Cooperate online, build stations in the editor, and join railway enthusiasts!
rows.description_html: Experience Polish railways like never before! Welcome to Train Driver 2, a unique Polish railway simulator created by enthusiasts for enthusiasts, which will transport you right into the heart of the dynamic world of railways. Designed with online multiplayer gameplay in mind, Train Driver 2 lets you take on one of two key roles: a Train Driver operating the train, or a Dispatcher managing complex traffic at stations and posts. Feel true cooperation, where the dispatcher's actions directly impact the driver's work, and smooth traffic flow depends on your coordination.   The simulator emphasizes high realism, offering faithfully recreated Polish rolling stock (electric and diesel locomotives, EMUs/DMUs), realistic, multi-kilometer routes, and detailed railway procedures. Immerse yourself in the depth of the simulation thanks to the recreation of specialized traffic control systems, such as SWDR, relay interlocking panels, and computer-based systems. Drive various trains – from passenger and fast trains, through expresses, to heavy freight consists, and even perform shunting operations.   Not ready for online challenges? Practice your skills in offline mode . Want to leave your mark on the game world? Use the scenery editor to create your own stations – fictional or based on reality – and share them with the entire community.   Train Driver 2 is more than just a game – it's a vibrant community of enthusiasts, a platform for learning about railways, and a chance to virtually experience the work of a railway professional. Join us and start your railway adventure!

rows.name: RuJuWi
rows.short_description: Run, Jump, Win! Build your own levels, share them and play the levels other players created!
rows.description_html: Run, Jump, Win! Build your own levels, share them and play the levels the other players created! RuJuWi is a fun little platform game that lets you create your own levels, play them as the little slime Puya and share them with others via the Workshop. Use blocks and platforms to create the base structure of your level, fill it with power-ups, enemies and various objects. You can even use mechanisms, allowing you to make logical circuits to move platforms, create blocks or open doors! Finally, add some decorations in the background to really personalize your levels! This game contains: Dozens of Blocks and Platforms to shape your world as you want: from the classic plains to the frozen heights, a fiery volcano and modern buildings! Pickups to help Puya through her adventure: more health, more jumps, invincibility time and keys to open doors. Powerups that make Puya stronger by allowing her to dash, fly, climb walls, drill and even more! Whether to help her mobility or to defeat enemies, powerups are essentials! Of course, Enemies are here too! They walk, run, dash, fly, even explode, but most of all, they want you gone! Mechanisms to make your level a little more 'brainy'. There's everything you need: buttons, switches, targets, timers, doors, teleporters, fans... And even logical gates to link them up! Some Objects will also help Puya during her adventures: boulders and boxes to climb higher, geysers to make her fly, bumpers and shooters to send her in every direction. However, be careful to not end up on some pikes, it could be... deadly. You can also change the rules of your levels, by adding water and lava flooding the level, make it night time, reducing the field of vision of Puya, end even change gravity! Make whatever YOU want and play whatever YOU want!

rows.name: Drift Legends 2
rows.short_description: Arcade drifting with 50+ dream cars, from JDM icons to American Muscle. Master the art of the drift in a huge career, then dominate the competition in cross-platform online battles. Your legend begins now—no high-end PC required.
rows.description_html: Arcade drift physics • 50+ legendary cars • Story campaign • Visual customization • Online PvP & co-op • Cross-platform competitions • Daily & weekly events with prizes • Weekly leaderboards • Controller & Steam Deck support • Low-spec friendly Drift Legends 2 is an arcade drifting game built for pure style, collection and competition. Start your journey from rookie to elite  in a full story campaign , collect 50+ beautifully detailed cars  — from JDM icons  to American muscle  and European legends  — and dominate in online PvP  and co-op  events. Show your identity with visual customization  (paints, liveries, wheels, tires, license plates), climb weekly leaderboards , and win cosmetics and premium cars . The game features controller support , is optimized for Steam Deck , and runs great on everyday PCs . Key Features Arcade drift physics — smooth, responsive and satisfying slides. 50+ legendary cars — JDM classics, raw muscle and timeless European machines. [b] Story campaign (beginners→elite)  — prove yourself and unlock new chapters. Online PvP & co-op — ranked duels, team challenges and casual rooms. Cross-platform competitions — play with friends across platforms. Daily & weekly events with prizes — chase new goals every day. Weekly leaderboards— compete for top spots and exclusive rewards. Visual customization only — paints, liveries, wheels, tires, license plates (no performance tuning, no pay-to-win). Controller support & Steam Deck optimization — pick up and drift anywhere. Low-spec friendly — designed to run smoothly on typical office PCs. Why you’ll love it If you enjoy the style and freedom of Forza Horizon and the high-energy vibe of Need for Speed , this is your drift playground : collect legends, perfect your lines and rule the leaderboards — for free . Note: customization affects visuals only and does not provide gameplay advantages .

Note: customization affects visuals only and does not provide gameplay advantages .

rows.name: Kindergarten of hell
rows.short_description: You are a detective investigating a case that has been forgotten for 5 years. The case involves finding out why everyone disappeared from a daycare.
rows.description_html: Kindergarten of hell: A childlike terror Synopsis : Dive into the heart of horror in Kindergarten of Hell, a horror adventure game where the nightmare takes on childlike allusions. You play a detective, investigating a mysterious disappearance in a seemingly innocent nursery. But behind the pastel walls and seemingly harmless toys lurks a twisted, monstrous reality. Mysterious creatures, from the childhood imagination. Gameplay : Kindergarten of Hell combines exploration, puzzle solving and the course Winding Journey : Navigate through the labyrinthine corridors of the daycare, each more terrifying than the previous. Classrooms transformed into torture chambers, a playground haunted by menacing shadows, and a canteen where the day’s meal is an unspeakable horror await you. Macabre puzzles : Solve twisted puzzles, inspired by children's games, but perverted and morbid. Clues are hidden in unexpected places, and their discovery will not be without danger. Get ready to face your own warped childhood. Atmosphere : The atmosphere of the game is designed to immerse you in a constant discomfort. The graphics, stylized yet horrific, accentuate the contrast between the innocent appearance of the school and the monstrous reality that lurks there. Characters : You will meet unreassuring pets

rows.name: ESA SHIELD
rows.short_description: Join the European Space Agency's SHIELD mission and discover why aliens aren't the biggest threat to us! In this science-based Planetary Protection Simulator, you fight real cosmic hazards. Build, Monitor, Protect! Become Earth's Last Defense.
rows.description_html: ESA SHIELD - Earth's Safety Starts with You! Become head of the European Space Agency's Space Safety Department and protect Earth from real cosmic hazards like Asteroids , Space Debris , and Space Weather . This science-based Planetary Protection Simulator combines tower defense, roguelite, and strategy elements to create a unique gameplay experience grounded in reality. Before you can defend Earth, you need to see the threats coming. Build powerful ground-based monitoring systems to scan the skies for incoming danger—from massive solar storms to fast-moving asteroids. But ground systems alone won’t be enough. Built and sent your satellites into orbit to create a global network of satellites. The more eyes you have in space, the better your chances of survival. Early detection is your best defense. With the right data, you can assess each threat, determine its danger level, and launch the right countermeasures—before it’s too late. Every successful mission makes you stronger. Earn resources, unlock new technologies, and upgrade your systems to stay one step ahead of the next big space threat. ESA SHIELD  is more than a game: It’s a space mission! It is developed as an outreach initiative for the European Space Agency to confront one of the most overlooked challenges in spacecraft: Space Safety. Play the game and support ESA in its mission to keep space safe and Earth protected. ☄️  Encounter Real Space Threats  Face the same dangers ESA deals with today. Coronal mass ejections, asteroid impacts, and space debris. Each threat behaves differently, affecting systems in unique ways, and demands its own monitoring and defense approach. Every decision could be the difference between survival and orbital disaster. 🔬 Research Real Technologies Unlock and implement real-world tech from past missions, current prototypes, and near-future plans. Build your strategy using actual science and engineering: from telescopes to deflection rockets. 🛰️ Build and Customize Satellites Design your own space systems: choose components, mission goals, and orbital paths. Balance cost, stability, and lifetime to create your optimal satellite system. 📡 Monitor the Skies Deploy and upgrade detection systems like telescopes and radar arrays. Expand your coverage, improve precision, and catch incoming threats before they hit. 🚀 Defend Earth and Infrastructure Build and operate space-based defense systems to prevent catastrophic impacts. Launch interceptors, trigger system shutdowns, or send clean-up bots into decaying orbits. 🎯 Make Strategic Decisions Under Pressure Every threat comes with uncertainty. React with limited data, weigh the risks, and choose between bold moves or conservative actions. Your judgment matters. Under a programme of, and funded by, the European Space Agency.

rows.name: FREST
rows.short_description: Unravel a forgotten world. Discover your power. Decide its fate. When Riley stumbles across a mysterious portal in her backyard, she’s transported to Nekojima—a mystical world teetering on the edge of collapse.
rows.description_html: When Riley stumbles across a mysterious portal in her backyard, she’s transported to Nekojima —a mystical world teetering on the edge of collapse. Inhabited by feline-like beings called Cates . Three tyrannical World Lords now rule the once peaceful land. Guided by a strange talking frog named Ben , Riley must fight to restore balance, uncover the truth, and find a way back home. Master your moves and push your limits! Master your moveset and learn new tools to overcome increasingly difficult obstacles. Replay levels against a timer, or go up against new and more challenging areas once you've beaten a level! Reconnect a fractured world. Traverse across three different provinces to free the trapped cates, and build a new home. Uncover hidden pages that slowly reveal the secrets of a world lost to time.

rows.name: Moon Tropica
rows.short_description: Engage in competitive combat, either alongside or against fellow players, as you strive to elevate your character's prowess and amass the most coveted and rare items available within the game world.
rows.description_html: Moon Tropica is a free-to-play, top-down, hack and slash PVP fighter. Team up with, or play against friends using a wide array of powerful weapons in a variety of unique, dynamic maps. BECOME A LEGEND Step into the adventurous, energetic, heart-pounding battle arenas where strategy, skill, and determination are put to the ultimate test. Earn XP progression, complete quests, conquer challenges, and receive rewards all while customizing your fully dynamic character from head-to-toe. POWERFUL ITEMS By any means necessary! Open chests and loot your opponents for a variety of special weapons ranging from boomerangs, bows, elemental staffs, and the ever-so-powerful 'Zuka'. Strategically use objects and dynamic elements from around the map to eliminate your opponents. EXCITING GAME MODES Fend for yourself, eliminate all of the other opponents, and show them who's boss in the ultra fast paced Free-For-All, and 5 Lives game modes. If you're looking for more strategy, team up with friends and dominate the other team in Team Deathmatch and King Of The Hill. VIBRANT COMMUNITY Join the fight and meet other players on the battlefield. Express yourself with a variety of emotes and utilize the  seamless text chat. Whether you want to play solo, or with a group of friends, there is always a new experience that awaits. Disclaimer: Moon Tropica is currently in Early Access. Some advertised features shown in-game or in promotional materials are not yet available in the current build. These elements are presented for visual and illustrative purposes only and will be introduced as development progresses. The following features are coming soon: Item Shop Quests Friends Career Jeet Fest Palm Haven Controller Compatibility Sprays Fireworks Animations Pets We appreciate your support and patience as we continue building the full Moon Tropica experience.

rows.name: Beak Force (Early Access)
rows.short_description: 💥 Waddle into war in Beak Force – a chaotic FPS where you play as a heavily armed penguin! Slide through snowy maps, blast foes with ridiculous weapons, and dominate in wild multiplayer modes like Team Fight and Capture the Flag. It’s fast, it’s funny, it’s frosty – and it’s FREE.
rows.description_html: 🐧 Beakforce – Waddle Into War Beakforce is a fast-paced, first-person shooter where you're not just any soldier—you're a battle-ready penguin armed to the beak. Engage in high-energy, low-temperature warfare across dozens of unique maps, wield a variety of wacky and powerful weapons, and customize your penguin to strike fear (and maybe laughter) into your enemies. Whether you’re flanking through frozen outposts or soaring across snowy stadiums in style, Beakforce is all about wild, chaotic fun—with the precision of a shooter and the personality of a penguin. ❄️ Features: 🧊 Penguin-Powered FPS Combat – Play as a heavily armed penguin in an action-packed shooter with fluid controls and tight gunplay. 🎮 Multiple Game Modes – Classic Team Fight, 2v2, Zombies, and more to come! 🌎 Diverse Maps – Wage war across frosty peaks, icy arenas, sunken ships, and secret arctic bases—each with unique layouts and strategies. 🔫 Weapon Variety – Equip everything from snowball launchers to freeze-ray rifles and more traditional ballistic beak-blasters. 🧢 Full Customization – Dress your penguin in hats, outfits, skins, and accessories. Build your style—and your loadout. 🐧 Waddle With Friends – Squad up with your flock or take on others online in multiplayer madness. Whether you're looking to freeze your enemies in style or just have a good laugh sliding into battle, Beakforce brings the chill... and the thrill.

rows.name: Space ScrubLords
rows.short_description: Grind PvE mode by trying to survive vrs 69 npcs's and defeat meme boss's to lvl your way through 69 tiers of the skill tree, while collecting resources to refine and build out your base so you can Rekt Noobs in PvP mode with powerful upgrades. Compete in 69 day seasons to prove your no scrub!
rows.description_html: GAME IS IN DEVELOPMENT!  DOWNLOAD TO JOIN THE ALPHA TEST!  JOIN THE DISCORD TO FOLLOW PROGRESS, MAKE SUGGESTIONS, AND SUBMIT BUG REPORTS! Are you a Scrub?  Do you need to git gud ?  Do you find yourself constantly getting rekt by enemies?  Have you always wished you could have a toxic bot follow you everywhere and talk trash letting you know how bad you suck?  Noice!   Space Scrublords is for you!  In this fast paced Indie Action Arcade Hybrid meme of a game, you'll balance your time between PvE and PvP modes, trying to survive bullet hell like farming runs to collect coins you'll use to climb your way through a 69 tier Skill Tree ,  gather resources to refine and use them to  build your space base , oh... and... you'll die... a lot. Select a combination of Main (dps or tank) and Sub (special: hook, emp, bomb) roles to access different stats and abilities within the games Skill Tree progression, and queue up for a a fast paced run through various game modes. - PvE mode : fight 69 Npcs as they lvl up, outscale, and overwhelm you, to collect coins, prestige points, and resources you'll need to git stronk, build your base, and participate in PvP modes.  Choose game modes like: Arcade : where you'll try to make your way to defeat 9 meme inspired boss's and earn 69 prestige points each run. Perpetual : where you can test how stronk you are, and hone your mechanical skills to see how long you can last before the NPC's stats outscale your's and you git rekt.  Maybe with enough practice, you'll grow some hands. Quest : where you'll complete challenges to try and rank in the seasons leaderboards. - PvP mode : think you got the skillz?  wanna rekt some noobs?  ready to pwn your enemies and collect their tears so you can meme on them with a stack of their death badges proving you've killed them more times than you've ever touched grass?  Well... go farm up enough rss in PvE mode first, to spam your abilities faster than a script kiddie with an auto clicker, then queue up in fast paced PvP matches and work with your team to destroy the enemy and prove who the scrubs really are.  If you get rekt, go back to PvE mode and train them hands to hone your kiting skillz and skillshot accuracy.  Or grind rss to upgrade your base and unlock powerful upgrades. - Base Builder :  Collect asteroids to gather resources in every PvE run, so you can refine them into materials to build out a custom space station base, where you'll upgrade machines to craft improved ammo, gun power ups, and more to git stronk!

Aboard one of these vessels, a single android has traveled alone through the cosmos for twenty long years. At last, it arrives on an uncharted planet—but what awaits it there is unknown... rows.name: The Communist Manifesto ~ A Visual Novel
rows.short_description: The visual novel adaptation of The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. Experience the Manifesto in a conversational style for the first time and fully customize your reading.
rows.description_html: The visual novel adaptation of The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. Experience the Manifesto in a conversational style and choose your own topics to focus on. Choose whether to ask Engels for footnotes. Unlock the ending after reading Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Get more detail about the vocabulary used in the glossary and track your completion of the glossary to unlock extra features. Unlock extra features including music, introductions, postscript, backgrounds, and the image gallery. Choose what music to play from the soundtrack using the Music Select menu. Unlock 19th century paintings related to locations and events of the Manifesto and its authors to display as backgrounds during your reading. Customize your reading experience further by turning off choice menus, music changes, and animations. Unlock and view images of the authors, drawings of them, and sketches by Engels.

rows.name: MineSweeper Rush
rows.short_description: MineSweeper Rush brings a fresh twist to classic Minesweeper with a growing minefield and fast row clearance. Every second counts as you race to beat your high score and climb the leaderboards.
rows.description_html: Introduction MineSweeper Rush is a new 2D casual game that follows classic Minesweeper rules and adds new features for a fast-paced, competitive experience. The minefield grows upward continuously. When you hit a mine, the game does not end immediately—instead, two new rows are quickly added. Clearing a row happens when you mark all the mines in it. If there are fewer than four rows, four new rows appear along with bonus points. As your score increases, the game speeds up. This racing element means every second counts and makes the challenge even tougher. You can choose from three modes: Easy, Normal, and Hard, or change the board size and the number of mines using shortcut keys. Your high score is recorded on one of five leaderboards so you can compare your speed and accuracy with other players. Gameplay Right-clicking a block puts a question mark on it. A block gets a flag only when it is confirmed to have a mine. You can mark a block by clicking the number next to it, and the game will automatically place flags based on the situation. Four different drag modes help you clear mines faster and score more points in less time. An AI system keeps the game fair. If no safe move exists, clicking a mine will not cause a penalty. Features A built-in tutorial shows you how to play quickly, while the help menu provides clear pictures and step-by-step instructions on rules and strategies. Background music and sound effects build excitement and help you focus during the race. Six different skins are available to reduce eye strain during long, fast-paced sessions. The game window can be resized to perfectly match the board size and your screen resolution. A hidden cheat mode displays solvable blocks and automatically clears mines, making it easier to learn quick strategies. Various number display styles help you see the game state clearly, so you can plan your moves rapidly.

Various number display styles help you see the game state clearly, so you can plan your moves rapidly.
rows.reviews_html: “It's all cheap and cheerful, especially that midi music, but it's a free Minesweeper variant. I'm quite charmed by it. Feels like a freeware game I might have got off a cover disc with cheery RPS fanzine PC Gamer in the late 90s.” Rock Paper Shotgun

rows.name: Dependency Psychological Test
rows.short_description: A narrative-driven point-and-click game that explores dependent personality through interactive psychological testing. Make choices, build relationships, and discover how your behavior shapes your mental assessment.
rows.description_html: Dependency Psychological Test is a narrative-driven point-and-click game that blends everyday storytelling with interactive psychological testing. Rooted in the field of psychometrics, the game invites players to explore the concept of dependency through branching dialogue, subtle choices, and relationship-building. In a cozy, life-like setting, you'll interact with family members, friends, and neighbors. Through meaningful conversations and small yet impactful decisions, you’ll uncover how you respond to emotional, social, and practical challenges—on your own, or by relying on others. Do you trust yourself, or do you seek help when things get tough? Your choices shape not only the story but also your personal psychological report at the end of the game, offering insights into your dependence levels and self-confidence. Whether you’re a fan of introspective games, narrative exploration, or simply curious about yourself, Dependency Psychological Test offers a calm, reflective gameplay experience with multiple outcomes based on how you engage with the world.

rows.short_description: Buttonbox is a simple 2D game made with Python where you press buttons to activate machines and trigger drum sounds. Created using Pygame, it's designed for fun, learning, and inspiration.
rows.description_html: Buttonbox features an intuitive, one-button control interface that lets players interact with mechanical devices and sound-producing drums. In this Python-based 2D game, players solve small challenges by activating various components within the stage. Currently, the game includes two handcrafted levels designed to showcase creative use of simple controls and interactivity.

rows.name: The Journey East and West
rows.short_description: This game was made for my NMU CS120 Winter 2025 semester final project. It is a text-based game where you use number inputs to control the game through the console. Open JDK no longer needs to be installed and added to your systems PATH do not be alarmed when a Command Prompt window opens.
rows.description_html: You are a claim jumper, you must make your way back to Missouri for another chance to receive a claim in Oregon. This game was made for my NMU CS120 Winter 2025 semester final project. It is a text-based game similar to games like The Oregon Trail, where you use number inputs in order to make decisions that control the game played through the console. You will have to deal with random events with success based off of random chance and manage resources because there has to be some fail state or the game would be boring. Open JDK no longer needs to be installed and added to your systems PATH. Do not be alarmed when a Command Prompt window opens, that is the game.

rows.name: Dillo's Dilemma
rows.short_description: Play as Dillo, a clever armadillo with pinball contraptions, in this thrilling 3D physics collectathon! Roll through vivid, expansive worlds, conquer dynamic puzzles, and smash the Rat King’s mighty forts. Rally your brave firefly friends to overcome challenges and save the day!
rows.description_html: Step into the role of Dillo, the ingenious armadillo with pinball expertise, in this dynamic 3D physics collectathon! Master mind-bending pinball structures and fast-paced movement as you roll through vibrant, sprawling worlds filled with intricate challenges. With every agile flip, bounce, and roll, unleash your creative strategies to overcome movement puzzles and destroy Rat King's forts. Rally your firefly friends scattered across diverse environments and prove that clever mechanics and bold determination can light up even the darkest corners of the world. Will your pinball prowess and quick wits save the day? Roll Fast, Think Smart – Save the Fireflies! In Dillo’s Dilemma , you play as Dillo, a clever armadillo who mastered the art of rolling into a high-speed pinball to navigate the world! Use your shell not just for defense, but for movement, puzzles, and offense! Master the World of Pinball Movement Traverse the environment with lightning-fast momentum using handcrafted pinball contraptions. Build and chain your own machines to create wild traversal paths and reach new achievements! Explore Two Vast Worlds and a Vibrant Hub Discover two different worlds – each packed with secrets, challenges, and hidden fireflies. Dive into mini-levels scattered across the overworld and return to your cozy home to prepare your next move. Save Your Firefly Friends from the Rat King The Rat King’s minions have taken over your homeland. Pinpoint their forts across the land, plan your route, and launch strategic assaults to rescue your captured friends! Game Features Momentum-based movement through rolling and bouncing physics. Build and ride through pinball contraptions of your own making. Two expansive worlds with layered mini-levels and a central Hub area. Overworld forts to scout, plan, infiltrate, and destroy in your mission to save fireflies. A colorful, stylized world full of secrets, shortcuts, and surprises. Test your skills and complete your collection by finding all the hidden fireflies.

rows.name: Guild Hall Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Build your guild. Shape your story. In Guild Hall Simulator, you don't slay dragons — you send others to do it. Manage gold, assign quests, upgrade your hall, and wrangle rowdy adventurers who drink too much. Will your guild rise to fame...or collapse under a mountain of paperwork (and slimes)?
rows.description_html: Ready your guild. Shape your destiny. Guild Hall Simulator: Prologue gives you an early chance to step into the role of a guild master — build your guild, manage heroes, and guide your hall to legendary fame! Don't forget to wishlist the full game to continue your journey and build the greatest adventuring guild the world has ever seen. Guild Management Design and build your perfect guild hall: • Place crafting stations, taverns, research labs, and training grounds. • Optimize your layout to empower your adventurers and boost quest success. • Unlock adventurers' hidden potential by matching the right hero to the right quest — from humble G rank missions to elite SSS ranked challenges. Economy Management Start your journey from zero fame and no gold : • Set item prices and manage your inventory. • Grow your guild’s economy carefully — even when pressure rises. • Balance risk and reward: will you prioritize fame, fortune, or survival? The Adventure Continues! This Prologue is just the beginning. Wishlist Guild Hall Simulator to experience the full game, where your choices matter: • Rebuild your guild from rubble in an abandoned town. • Gather materials through mining, farming, and logging. • Craft rare weapons, forge armor, and brew powerful potions. • Train weaker adventurers to meet quest requirements. • Defend your guild and town against monster attacks. • Automate your operations to run a thriving guild hall — even while adventurers eat, drink, and celebrate! Will your guild rise as the last beacon of hope - or collapse under the weight of ambition? The choice is yours, Guild Master.

rows.name: Granvir: Zero Front
rows.short_description: Granvir: Zero Front is a 3rd person action roguelite mech-builder with co-op multiplayer. Experience the prelude to Granvir as the resistance response to the Millennium Company invasion. Pilot your Granvir, manage your campaign between battles to find the best equipment, and stay in the fight.
rows.description_html: Experience The Full Game Out Now! About the Game Granvir: Zero Front is a third person shooter action roguelite featuring mech building. Experience the prelude to the Millennium Horizon campaign in Granvir as the first resistance response to the Millenium Company invasion. Players battle through a route of their choice reaching extraction and completing side objectives at the cost of valuable resources. Between battles, players can swap out parts for upgrades found on the battlefield and manage their campaign by taking on loans to afford ammunition, aiding the locals for support in battle and more. Equip devastating melee weapons such as swords, rocket spears and pile bunkers. Wield powerful long range guns like cannons, machine guns, flamethrowers and rocket pods. Mix and match armaments to suit your play style. Mix torsos, legs, armatures and special modules to customize your Granvir. Defeating enemy ace pilots unlocks their unique parts. Complete any campaign in single-player or multiplayer co-op with up to 10 Granvir pilots at a time. Share parts and resources utilizing the squad depot in rest areas as you plan your next moves. No campaign is the same as you manage time, resources and your route to each objective. Each zone impacts what services and resources are available. Use down time between missions to refit and upgrade your Granvir to prevail.

rows.name: Path of Master 大師之路
rows.short_description: Path of Master is a roguelike‑inspired casual monster‑grinding game.You can continuously upgrade your skills to slay hordes of monsters and strive to survive.
rows.description_html: Path of Master is built with Unreal Engine 5. The gameplay blends survival, Musou, and bullet‑hell elements. We’ve removed the usual roguelike pause‑to‑select‑skill mechanic and now upgrade skills on the fly by picking up skill cubes at the right moment. Your weapon has two interchangeable attack modes; using a special attack sacrifices your normal attack. After surviving the first four stages, Hell Island unlocks—granting massive gold but far tougher challenges. Survive ten minutes there to earn a powerful hidden perk.

rows.name: Blade & Soul NEO
rows.short_description: Relive an iconic tale with Blade & Soul NEO. Fully remastered where players reconnect with the original spirit of the free-to-play, open-world MMORPG. Experience a richer visually enhanced experience set in a world of Wuxia mythology where fast-paced combat collides with the stunning visual beauty.
rows.description_html: The Story Embark on a treacherous adventure as you track down the villains who killed your master. Uncover hidden secrets as you meet dozens of complex characters. Develop your skills and reveal your true potential as you become a master in your own right. The World Immerse yourself in the dense forests, breathtaking vistas, expansive deserts, and savage wildlands of the Earthen Realm. Freely explore alluring regions, meet friends in bustling villages, and delve into dark corners where dangerous foes lie in wait. Infinite Windwalk With no stamina bar explore the far reaches of the Earthen Realm with unprecedented freedom. Scale walls, soar over mountains, and run on water in style with new custom Windwalk animations. Martial Arts Enjoy Blade & Soul's iconic action-based combat with upgraded animation and graphics. Switch seamlessly between Classic and 'B&S' combat modes as you spar with powerful opponents. The new skill extraction system allows for an unprecedented amount of customization as you master the unique skills of your class. Dungeons Powerful opponents threaten the balance. To defeat them you must master your skills, learn their attack strategies, and work closely with your allies. With each victory, you'll earn powerful weapons, valuable accessories, and unique portraits. Explore dungeons solo or use the robust party matching system to team up with up to 5 other players.

rows.name: There Will Be Light
rows.short_description: There Will Be Light is a top-down puzzle adventure in a gloomy but cozy environment. To progress, you have to solve tricky logic puzzles, while defending yourself against enemies. Dive into this cozy but challenging puzzle adventure as you solve riddles and fight your way back to the light.
rows.description_html: Descend into a dreamlike journey through the subconscious, where foggy thoughts cloud the path forward. Solve atmospheric puzzles to bring clarity and light back into a fractured mind. Explore surreal landscapes in this introspective and emotional puzzle game about healing and self-discovery. The story is about a person and their fears and negative subconscious thoughts that inhabit them. As you progress, you dive deep into the subconscious to fight those foggy thoughts and regain confidence in yourself. Perhaps in the end, your view of yourself, the world, and all the problems you deal with might be a little more optimistic. Can anything really go wrong?

rows.name: My Desktop Sister
rows.short_description: My Desktop Sister is a computer desktop companion. Experience the love and kindness from My Desktop Sister.
rows.description_html: Meet My Desktop Sister , an interactive Virtual desktop companion with a tsundere twist! She’s not just a cute anime girl sitting on your screen—she reacts to your actions, remembers past interactions, and has a personality all her own. Whether she’s teasing you, giving you quests, or demanding attention, she’ll make sure you never feel alone at your desk. Features: Interactive Desktop Companion – She lives right on your screen, constantly moving, reacting, and even commenting on your activities as you go about your day. She’s more than just an icon—she’s an engaging, dynamic character that interacts with you in real-time, adding a layer of personality and charm to your desktop experience. Dynamic Mood System – Her personality evolves based on how you treat her, shifting between a variety of moods such as Happy, Annoyed, Playful, or even Sad. The way you interact with her directly influences her reactions, creating a truly personalized experience where your actions shape her behavior. Fully Voiced Dialogue – Immerse yourself in her world with tsundere-style voice lines that bring her to life! And that’s just the beginning—expect even more voice lines and character development in future updates, as her personality and interactions continue to grow. Gift & Inventory System – Show your affection by giving her gifts and watch her adorable, sometimes humorous reactions. Each gift unlocks new ways to interact and build a deeper connection with her, making the experience more rewarding and fun. Quests & Daily Interactions – Take on daily tasks and complete unique quests to earn rewards and unlock special dialogue events. As you progress, you'll discover hidden moments and surprises that make each interaction feel fresh and exciting, all while strengthening your bond with your desktop companion. Whether you’re looking for a productivity companion, an interactive VTuber-style friend, or just a fun, tsundere-infused desktop experience— My Desktop Sister is here to stay (whether she admits she likes you or not).

rows.name: Treasure Hunters: Prologue
rows.short_description: Treasure Hunters: Prologue is a free intense CO-OP treasure-hunting game set in mysterious dungeons filled with puzzles, platforms, and deadly creatures where your goal is to find and steal the most valuable treasures.
rows.description_html: Every dungeon you step into presents its own set of challenges. To stand a chance against the odds, your equipment selection is key. Choose wisely, for your survival depends on it. Set off on exciting adventures through randomly generated dungeons. Each trip brings fresh surprises. Seek the most valuable hidden treasures and overcome different challenges while wandering through twisting paths and mysterious rooms with your friends. As one of the few talented treasure hunters out there, your only duty is to find and steal the most valuable treasures in various dungeons alongside your gang. But keep that in mind not all loot is worth the haul. Heavy, cheap finds could slow you down, choose 'em wisely. And sell them to acquire new equipment for raiding larger and more perilous dungeons, or purchasing cosmetics to customize your character. These dungeons are too dangerous and complicated to raid alone. Form your gang to overcome the creatures that you will encounter and solve the puzzles that require cooperation. Within ominous depths of these ancient dungeons, fraught with twisting passages and hidden traps, lie in wait for an array of perilous creatures, each more fearsome than the last, their eyes gleaming with malevolence and hunger, so do your utmost to stay alive against these formidable odds!

rows.name: Coded Black
rows.short_description: A narrative-driven social justice game exploring the suppressed histories of anti-Blackness in the US and UK. Confront racial injustice and discover moments of Black resilience and humanity through storytelling and historical evidence.
rows.description_html: Coded Black is a bold, narrative-driven experience that immerses players in the hidden and haunting histories of anti-Blackness in the US and UK. This is an experience designed to be difficult – mentally and emotionally. Drawing from primary sources, historical records and scholarly analysis, Coded Black offers a journey through past atrocities and moments of triumph. Explore two distinct, atmospheric scenes  – a plantation and a modern 20th-century city – each filled with real historical documents and audio visual storytelling. With a structure that surfaces different content in each run, Coded Black is a narrative crafted for both personal reflection and educational engagement. Amidst the darkness, Coded Black also shines. Players can find glowing “balls of light” that reveal stories of Black achievement, resilience, and humanity – offering powerful moments of reflection and hope. Blurring the lines between game and museum exhibit, this is an experience about witnessing, understanding and feeling the weight of history through an interactive lens. _ This game is free to play and designed to be used as both an interactive exhibit and a teaching tool. A companion website provides expanded resources, bibliographies, and theoretical materials not included in the game itself. For information about the game, its creators and sources, visit codedblack.info.

rows.name: Desktop Garden
rows.short_description: Type and watch your garden grow! Every keystroke and mouse click lets your plants grow. Decorate your screen, or store them away to keep your screen clear. Place stickers on your plants and give them a name! Can you collect all types of plants?
rows.description_html: Type, grow, and decorate – let your plants thrive while you work! Every keystroke helps a plant grow! You can write, code, or just chat and this peaceful desktop overlay will reward you by growing your own plants during your everyday routine. Start with a tiny sprout that grows as you type and turn it into a wonderful plant. When your screen gets crowded, move your plants to a foldable plant shelf, where they continue growing quietly in the background. Over time, you'll discover a variety of plant types! Decorate your desktop with your favorite green companions and build your own little digital garden. Place stickers on your plants and give them names :) And if you're the productive type, track how much you've typed with a gentle growth-based progress system – watch your focus bloom alongside your plants. Features Plants grow with every keystroke Move grown plants into a collapsible shelf to clear your screen Discover a variety of plants Place stickers on plants and give them a name Keep growing plants even when they're in storage Decorate your desktop with your favorite green friends Track your typing activity through plant growth

rows.name: Bakery Cafe Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Start bake, build, and grow your dream bakery cafe with prologue now! Create delicious pastries, design your space, and serve customers. Play solo or with friends in online co-op to expand your business and experience the excitement of running a bustling cafe!
rows.description_html: Experience the first few hours of “Bakery Cafe Simulator” solo or with up to 4 players online. In this prologue you'll find 10 recipes to cook for your customers, including various coffee recipes and a few pastries such as cookies and cakes. Thirty or so customization elements for your store will also be available, allowing you to let your imagination run wild as you personalize your store. About the game mechanics Build and furnish your café according to your desires. Place tables for customers, decorate and organize your kitchen to be productive. rows.name: Quantum Dogfight
rows.short_description: Quantum Dogfight is a 2-player guessing strategy game where players must correctly locate all of their opponent's planes on a hexagonal grid. Inspired by the principles of quantum mechanics, Quantum Dogfght is a fun and interactive way to learn about superposition and measurement collapse.
rows.description_html: Superposition Quantum Dogfight is a guessing strategy game centered around the quantum mechanical principle of superposition.  At the beginning of each game both players place their planes in two distinct locations, as shown below. Guessing Locations The core gameplay of Quantum Dogfight is turn-based guessing of each player's plane locations. While in superposition, both locations of a plane can be 'attacked', with the goal of successfully attacking all locations of either locations.   Measurement Collapse While attacking your opponent's hex tiles is the way to win, players must also monitor their own board and strategically choose when to invoke a 'measurement collapse'.  This action begins a measurement like shown below, which probabilistically chooses one of the two superposition locations to be final location of the plane.  Players will want to utilize measurement collapses to confuse their opponent, but be warned, just like in quantum machanics you can't control probability! Learning Quantum Mechanics Quantum Dogfight was designed with young STEM-oriented students in mind, providing a fun and interactive way to learn about elements of quantum mechanics.  Found within Quantum Dogfight is a learning module which helps students understand how principles of quantum mechanics are woven into the mechanics of the game. Ways to Play Quantum Dogfight v1.0.0 features two ways for players to enjoy the game.      Local - Players take turns sharing a single computer    Online - Players can connect from two computers over the internet

rows.name: The Others
rows.short_description: A first-person multiplayer survival game where humans must escape and mannequins hunt—who's real, and who will replace you?
rows.description_html: Overview 'The Others' is a multiplayer first-person survival game set in a mysterious factory. Players awaken with no memory, only to find themselves trapped in a facility where mannequins roam—not as lifeless props, but as deadly beings trying to become real humans. Some players are real humans who must cooperate and escape , while others are mannequins in disguise , hunting the rest while hiding their true identity. Who can you trust? Will you escape... or be replaced? Design The Others blends psychological tension, survival, and horror into an asymmetric multiplayer experience. Each round is a battle of trust and betrayal, as mannequins grow stronger and more dangerous over time. Players must explore the dark, confined factory to find weapons, unlock escape routes, and stay alert. A single mistake can turn a potential ally into a predator. Key Features : First-person multiplayer survival with psychological mind games Two distinct roles: Humans (escape) vs Mannequins (hunt) Eerie atmosphere set in a closed mannequin factory Procedurally randomized exits, item spawns, and events for each round Role-based voice chat system with restricted communication Mannequins evolve and grow stronger as the game progresses Dead players enter Observer Mode to watch the rest of the game unfold

Inside, obstacles await you in the form of pitch darkness, the unknown, and opponents who were once your friends. To win, you'll need to memorize your moves, mark your route in your guild book, and try to anticipate the actions of other treasure hunters. Find or steal the key and open the hidden chest... or become another lost soul in the labyrinth. Game Features Turn-based multiplayer for 2-4 players. Competitive elements. Randomly generated labyrinth. Limited visibility. Pixel graphics and a guild atmosphere.

rows.name: Godzilla x Kong: Titan Chasers
rows.short_description: Hunt, capture, and command the monsters of the Monsterverse. Build your base, recruit elite Titan Chasers, and lead squads into tactical turn-based battles. Expand your territory in a shared online world, forge alliances, and face colossal threats like Godzilla, Kong, and Skullcrawlers.
rows.description_html: This world never belong to us. It always belonged to them. It is a time of monsters! Join the Titan Chasers - elite explorers, mercenaries and thrill-seekers - and step onto the shores of the Siren Isles, an untamed new ecosystem forged by the Rise of the Titans. Battle for survival and control on the edge of civilisation. Face epic monsters like the Mother Longlegs, Rock Critters and the deadly Skullcrawlers. Witness the fury of Godzilla and Kong, and join the fight against colossal predators. The Monsterverse comes to life in Godzilla x Kong: Titan Chasers; a 4X MMO strategy game where you will take your place among legends! Explore a stunning 3D map featuring multiple biomes. Defeat classic and brand new superspecies, rescue survivors, and seek out the resources you need to survive against the forces of nature - and rival Chaser factions. Recruit elite Chasers to lead your forces, each offering their own set of unique skills to turn the tide of battle. Use powerful Monarch tech to hunt, capture and study the Superspecies of the Sirens. Rank up and learn how to unleash their ferocity in battle! Embark on thrilling expeditions and test the mettle of your squads in strategic, turn-based RPG combat. Delve into the dark secrets of the Sirens in the main story campaign, or fight as your favourite Superspecies in the monster vs monster campaign! Forge powerful alliances, expand your territory, and secure critical landmarks with your friends. Bring your forces together to join the fight against monster swarms and gigantic beasts. Turn an abandoned, overgrown outpost into a formidable stronghold. Build up your forces and level up your tech to become a power player within this new frontier. Titan Chasers, get ready to stand face-to-toe with Godzilla, Kong, and your favourite creatures of the Monsterverse!

rows.name: The Honours Project
rows.short_description: The Honours Project is an autobiographical walking simulator. Enjoy a narrative experience, adventuring through dream-like levels, solving an occasional puzzle and listening to the dark and sometimes comical dialogue that acts as a commentary about being a student and game development.
rows.description_html: The Honours Project is an autobiographical walking simulator about a moment where I was struggling to come up with an idea for my University project in 2024. You are tasked with helping, by inspiring me with music. Enjoy a narrative experience by adventuring through dream-like levels, solving an occasional puzzle and listening to the dark and sometimes comical dialogue that acts as a commentary about being a student and game development. Move along at your own pace, enjoy the audio experience in a fully 3D soundscape. Find notes that explore extra lore, and get an extra sense of who I am.  The year was likely the toughest I have ever faced, and I wanted to depict these moments as an audiovisual experience with light puzzle mechanics and gameplay. The game takes around about 25 to 35 minutes to complete. The aim of this game was to help others who are in education to understand that it is okay not to know, and that the ideas will come. I too wanted to express myself in the only way I know how, and figured this would be the best platform to be able to do so. Voice work done by the talented Josef Boon While the game is completed, I am still relatively new in the world of game development and I expect bugs and issues, which I will hopefully have a chance to iron out. I am also not the best at optimizing due to Audio Design and narrative being my field of expertise. The game was created over the course of 5 months and was submitted as my fourth year University project that focused on how audio and narrative work together to better player experience. This game should work with mouse + keyboard, and an Xbox controller. Controls   WASD to move E to Interact ESC to bring up more options Developers Note This game will forever be free, and hopefully everyone can find their own level of enjoyment. I am forever learning and always open to feedback so please let me know what you think in the reviews!

Help them traverse varied locations, talk to interesting characters, and learn a lesson about teamwork.  FEATURING: Mischievous Fun - Hop, float, and most of all kick your way across 3 distinct locations and 10 different levels. Fight over coins but work together to reach the end! A Humorous Tone - Enjoy plenty of visual novel styled story cutscenes full of cartoonish personality. Unique Controls -  No need for two devices! Squeeze in close and share one keyboard or  one controller. Now get in there and KICK OFF!

rows.name: Quartermaster
rows.short_description: An online PvE co-op action game for up to 4 players. Work together with your team to manage your inventory, complete objectives, and destroy endless waves of ferocious robots.
rows.description_html: Quartermaster is an online co-op FPS with a strong emphasis on inventory management, where you must use a multitude of different weapons and traps to fight tons of dangerous robots. Explore Neuraxis, a massive cyberpunk city, and complete objectives with up to 3 friends. Strategize and keep only the most important items in your inventory. Don’t get backed into a corner with only a Medkit in hand! Communicate with your teammates to get through objectives. To get through this city alive, you’ll need to have good teamwork. Leave no robot behind! Watch out for the hordes of enemies chasing you. You never know what could be right around the corner…

rows.name: Arcane Assault
rows.short_description: A magic themed VR tower defense game. Face off against hordes of monsters as they descend upon you in waves. Place towers, cast spells, make quick getaways, and unleash total destruction to clear your path of all that comes against you!
rows.description_html: In a time of distress, with many monsters roaming about, one wizard must make their way across the land to assault these creatures with their arcane power, defending themselves from hordes of enemies along the way. Using your map, place down towers to spawn them into the world around you and destroy your foes. But, should things get too hairy, do it yourself by casting spells and unleashing the full power of your ultimate crystals. Features: - Eight unique towers - Seven unique enemies - Three castable spells - Three ultimate abilities - Three main levels - An endless mode

rows.name: Markus's Miasma
rows.short_description: Explore a fog-choked, twisted version of UCSC in this 2D puzzle horror game, where cryptic clues and buried memories reveal the disturbing truth behind one man's obsession...
rows.description_html: Welcome to UCSC—well, kind of. This isn’t the sunny college campus you remember. In this 2D puzzle horror game, you're dropped into a fog-drenched, twisted version of UC Santa Cruz where nothing feels quite right. Familiar landmarks are warped, the silence is heavy, and the mist hides more than just bad weather. You’ll explore eerie paths and unsettling buildings as you piece together the story behind Markus —a guy with a past so dark, it’s bleeding into reality. Solve creepy puzzles, uncover buried memories, and try not to get too lost in the fog (literally and emotionally).  Key Features: 🧩 Puzzle-Based Exploration : Navigate through haunted versions of labs, libraries, and forest trails. Solve logic puzzles to unlock new areas and piece together fragments of Markus’s mind. 🕯️ Atmospheric Horror : Inspired by Silent Hill and Mad Father , this game focuses on slow-building dread, psychological unease, and eerie sound design—not some cheap jump scares. 🗺️ A Twisted UCSC Campus : Iconic locations like the Quarry Plaza and Porter Meadow are reimagined in a surreal nightmare. Expect familiar spaces, distorted by guilt and memory. 📖 Narrative-Driven Gameplay : Dive into a branching, emotionally charged story with themes of trauma, regret, and identity. Your choices affect how much of Markus’s truth you uncover. 🧠 Estimated Playtime: 1–2 hours Inspired by spooky favorites like Mad Father and the chilling vibes of Silent Hill , this game mixes emotional storytelling with mind-bending mystery. It’s not about cheap scares—it’s about slowly realizing that something’s really wrong here... On a side note...all characters, locations, and events in this game are entirely fictional. While the setting draws inspiration from the real UC Santa Cruz campus, this is not a reflection of the actual university. Any resemblance to real people—living or dead—is purely coincidental. But the Markus irl is pretty rad 😎  So grab your flashlight, steady your nerves, and get ready to uncover the secrets hidden in the fog... Welcome (back?) to UCSC. You might not leave the same.

rows.name: Colony 19
rows.short_description: Colony 19 is a VR horror climbing game. Immerse yourself in a harrowing struggle for freedom as you crawl your way out of a dystopian megastructure.
rows.description_html: Having finally escaped your white room, you find yourself in an overwhelming and unfamiliar world hidden from you all your life. Piece together the true reality kept from you and people like you whilst locked away. This game is a VR climber game where you must physically climb out of the concrete and metal hell that towered over your head all your life. Explore a monolithic environment and ascend through an unforgiving megastructure that is COLONY 19.
