rows.name: Brainrot's HAMSTER GAME
rows.short_description: a silly free endless runner depicting the 1:1 experience of a hamster
rows.description_html: Introducing a new type of endless runner...          ...the ( very real ) endless struggle hamsters experience on a day-to-day basis. Jump from platform to platform, nimbly avoiding lava as you try to survive as long as possible to reach a new high score! A surprising amount of depth is found in its simple mechanics, making it a game all about mastery. Learn the tech, become the hamster, and reach the top of the leaderboards! It's a singleplayer game, but it's a very social game too. Compete against your friends and family , flaunt your scores, and share tips as you go. Features Take your shot at the DAILY HAMSTERDLE —a new gauntlet generated every day. Here, you compete against players across the globe for the top spot of the day, however you only get  3 attempts  so make sure they count! Complete ACHIEVEMENTS to unlock   silly  SKINS  and colorful  PALETTES  to mix up the gameplay and impress your friends who don't even know how to unlock them. (More skins coming soon...) Personal Note from the Creator Apologies if this is cheesy or pretentious but hey this is my game I do what I want... This game has taught me what it means to create. The value of art, I feel, comes when you can feel the presence of a soul within. When you create art, you impart your identity into it simply by virtue of you creating it, meaning in effect, it becomes an extension of yourself. Therefore, to reach down and express yourself to the fullest extent into your creation you must also understand yourself to know what there is to express. For me this has meant working on my habits, my connections, my worldview, and everything I can possibly do to be happy, because only by thoroughly enjoying the creation process will that joy be reflected on the other side. This has been my first big project I've ever released and I think it does feel authentically myself, but I definitely ain't stopping here. No art is perfect because no one can be perfect — all we can we do is strive to create bigger and better things by continuously trying to be bigger and better ourselves. I urge you to create something, to experience the pain, the embarrassment, and the deep sense of fulfillment that comes from dedicating your entire self to something and ascribing your identity to it for all the world to see. I've definitely felt like I've come out the other side a better person. I've worked with such beautiful people to be here, especially my good friend Kenneth who did all the art, music, and more, and I feel by going through this difficult self-reflective journey together, we've really gotten to know a deeper side of one another. Without him and everyone whose supported me, I could not accomplish anything close to this, so thanks guys :D and with all that said... I genuinely hope playing this game brings some value to your life.        -Ethan

rows.name: Snake 贪吃蛇
rows.short_description: The classic and pure Snake game.
rows.description_html: The classic and pure Snake game. 'Hello World!' in the game development field It's given to everyone for free. This is a simple game in which you control a white snake to eat the red square. Be careful not to bump into yourself or the boundary! If you fail or fill the entire game area, the game will restart. Use WASD, the arrow keys or the cross keys on the handle to control the movement. The Shift key on the keyboard and the southbound button on the controller are used to accelerate movement.

rows.name: Prism
rows.short_description: A mish-mash of a maze and a platformer within both 2D and 3D!
rows.description_html: Play as Prio and go through different levels and get to the end! Experience two dimensions as you jump through platforms or navigate through mazes. From the open-space 3D world to a classic-style 2D world, you'll face different levels throughout the game. Play in 3D Go through different levels with unique challenges and multiple ways of overcoming. Experience the two worlds meet Play in 2D as you encounter special levels that progress after beating the unique minigame. Or just play classic, fully in 2D Tone down the game and play in one dimension less. Or play infinitely to your hearts desire Pick your adventure, play longer and see how far you can go! Complete levels and experience a different gameplay based on the mode you pick. Don't die though or else you'll be back at the start!  Play a new set of levels that change with each playthrough. Get to the end to claim victory! Who knows what you'll find there...

rows.name: STARDOM RIICHI MAHJONG
rows.short_description: An unexpected twist at a TV audition thrusts the hero into showbiz as an “actress,” starting a life like no other. Face dazzling rivals across the mahjong table, and in the vibrant Urban Mainstray, where conflicts are settled by mahjong, rise as the Stardom of Mahjong!
rows.description_html: 【Classic 13-Tile Riichi Mahjong – Fast-Paced and Thrilling Matches】 Whether you're aiming for the top in ranked battles or just looking for some casual fun, Stardom Mahjong has you covered. Enjoy lightning-fast matchmaking—get into a game within seconds—and invite your friends to play together for a truly exciting mahjong experience! 【Immersive Exploration: Showbiz Secrets × R18 Forbidden Fantasies】 The protagonist (player) encounters an unexpected accident during a TV drama audition and, by a twist of fate, enters the entertainment industry disguised as a woman. From that moment, a completely different life unfolds. Soon after, the mysterious girl Kyoka rises to stardom with a drama hit, taking the showbiz world by storm and igniting an unprecedented frenzy. Yet behind the glamorous stage lies exclusive R18 adult content . Step into Fantasies , where you gradually unlock scenes of temptation and passion, and experience the most forbidden, most heated secrets of the entertainment world. 【Gorgeous Girls × Famous Japanese Voice Actors】 From sweet and innocent cuties to energetic girls and commanding big sisters, each heroine comes with her own unique charm! In Stardom Mahjong, you'll bond with these dazzling beauties as you climb your way to the top of the industry. With an all-star cast of renowned Japanese voice actors, the game delivers both visual and auditory delight! 【Variety of Modes to Explore】 Mahjong is just the beginning! Spin the reels in the entertainment lounge’s idol-themed slot machines, manage your own shop in free-roam mode, and discover countless unique gameplay experiences. Dive into the world of Stardom Mahjong now, and let your skills pave the way to stardom!

rows.name: NoFlash
rows.short_description: VALORANT flash-dodging trainer with dot-clicking mini-game. Two modes: ① Practice (customize flashes/targets) ② Time Attack (score under limit). Master flashes while boosting aim!
rows.description_html: This is a flash-dodging training game specifically designed for VALORANT , featuring nearly all in-game flash effects. It innovatively combines a dot-clicking mechanic, challenging players to precisely hit targets while swiftly avoiding sudden flashes. This dual-tasking gameplay enhances reaction speed and multitasking skills, making it an effective training tool for players.

rows.name: Sereno
rows.short_description: Sereno is a free relaxing puzzle played on a 4x4 board. A player uses arrow keys to move all the tiles in one of 4 directions. Sometimes a pair of tiles will combine into a new one. Listen to immersive smooth jazz music, lean back, unwind, and give yourself a break you deserve.
rows.description_html: Sereno is a classic puzzle with the simple goal of creating a tile with a purple drink out of tiles with glasses, bottles and ices of various colors. Move all your tiles around the board with the arrow keys. When two tiles of the same color and with the same picture touch, they merge into a new one with the same picture but of the next color of the rainbow. If tiles with a bottle and ices of the same color touch they merge into a tile with a drink of the same color. Features: Soft relaxing music that enables player to unwind, rest, and recharge. Classic tile mechanics: press an arrow to move all the tiles in the direction of the arrow. Simple intuitive rules: it takes less than a minute to master the rules, but the strategic challenges are limitless. Smooth design: clean and satisfying visuals for an enjoyable puzzle experience. Sereno is perfect for quick relaxing sessions.

rows.name: DuoQ
rows.short_description: Squad up with Tala, a mysterious (and flirty!) player you meet in the lobby of a fictional FPS game. Use your real-life voice to talk with Tala over comms, solve puzzles, and outwit enemies. By the end, you’ll answer the most important question: Is she into you?
rows.description_html: A 2-Player Game, Played Entirely in Singleplayer DuoQ is an e-dating sim about romancing another person in an online game . Play alongside Tala, a mysterious stranger met in the fictional FPS game To the Heart . With Tala at your side, you'll solve co-op challenges, learn about her IRL life, and answer the question: is she into you? Features Talk with Tala using your real voice, with open ended conversations, a rich narrative to uncover, and plenty of flirting to do! Overcome multiplayer-like challenges and puzzles, fully playable in single player Discover collectibles, secrets, and multiple distinct endings ...So is this a Multiplayer Game? Nope! DuoQ uses voice recognition to track your conversation with Tala, allowing for real time conversations and history. Tala isn't a real person, but using these new technologies, we can tell a new kind of story through the structure of a multiplayer game. Plus, nothing in DuoQ is AI Generated. We use machine learning to advance the conversation, but we don't use AI to generate voice lines, art, or the story itself. This is a handcrafted game and a labor of love from our team - enjoy!

rows.name: Dual Shadows
rows.short_description: The city of Pulsanh is left in the dark after its power source escapes. Navigate the city, confront the Absent, and stop the beasts from causing more chaos.
rows.description_html: Ancient magic. Futuristic tech. A synthetic weapon caught in between. Dual Shadows is a combat-focused action game set in Pulsanh, a neon-drenched city powered by the imprisoned energy of two divine beings: the Phoenix and the Dragon. You play as Linh, a synthetic lifeform forged by the tech conglomerate Harmoni —spliced from fragments of the beasts she’s sent to destroy. DUAL COMBAT SYSTEM Swap freely between: Melee Form aggressive, close-range combat Ranged Form precision-based spellcasting Each form builds energy to use Linh’s abilities, rewarding fluid switching and adaptive play. How you engage with each enemy is up to you! YOU DECIDE Absorb or Release: After defeating a boss, make a critical choice: Absorb: Take enemy spirit for yourself and unlock order-aligned abilities. Release: Free enemy spirit and unlock chaos-aligned abilities. Each choice alters dialogue, unlocks new abilities, and reshapes your story. MULTI-PHASE BOSS ENCOUNTERS Each borough culminates in a unique boss battle: The Phoenix wields embers, fire fields, and a resurrection mechanic. The Dragon strikes with torrents of water, closes distance with sudden dashes, and conjures towering hands of crashing waves. Bosses evolve mid-fight with layered mechanics that test your mastery of both forms. Fail to react in time, and you’ll meet your end. STRATEGIC BUILDCRAFTING Choose from four core abilities that shape your combat style. Each core modifies how your Q and E abilities behave—creating synergy between your chosen form and your Order/Chaos alignment. Alt – A fixed mobility skill for repositioning and evasion. Q / E – Offensive and utility abilities unlocked through narrative progression and Absorb/Release choices. Your build evolves as you progress—encouraging experimentation, alignment mastery, and flexible playstyles. A DENSE, CHOICE DRIVEN WORLD Two boroughs: Phoenix District and Dragon District, each with unique terrain, hazards, and enemy types Replayable encounters with branching outcomes based on Absorb/Release ratios and borough order Flat, linear level design focused on forward momentum and environmental storytelling Dual Shadows blends a gritty cyberpunk setting with mythic undertones drawn from Southeast Asian legend. From barricaded streets and brutalist towers to flickering signage and sacred arenas, the city of Pulsanh reflects a world where divine power has been caged, commodified—and now confronts what it helped create.
rows.about_html: Ancient magic. Futuristic tech. A synthetic weapon caught in between. Dual Shadows is a combat-focused action game set in Pulsanh, a neon-drenched city powered by the imprisoned energy of two divine beings: the Phoenix and the Dragon. You play as Linh, a synthetic lifeform forged by the tech conglomerate Harmoni —spliced from fragments of the beasts she’s sent to destroy. DUAL COMBAT SYSTEM Swap freely between: Melee Form aggressive, close-range combat Ranged Form precision-based spellcasting Each form builds energy to use Linh’s abilities, rewarding fluid switching and adaptive play. How you engage with each enemy is up to you! YOU DECIDE Absorb or Release: After defeating a boss, make a critical choice: Absorb: Take enemy spirit for yourself and unlock order-aligned abilities. Release: Free enemy spirit and unlock chaos-aligned abilities. Each choice alters dialogue, unlocks new abilities, and reshapes your story. MULTI-PHASE BOSS ENCOUNTERS Each borough culminates in a unique boss battle: The Phoenix wields embers, fire fields, and a resurrection mechanic. The Dragon strikes with torrents of water, closes distance with sudden dashes, and conjures towering hands of crashing waves. Bosses evolve mid-fight with layered mechanics that test your mastery of both forms. Fail to react in time, and you’ll meet your end. STRATEGIC BUILDCRAFTING Choose from four core abilities that shape your combat style. Each core modifies how your Q and E abilities behave—creating synergy between your chosen form and your Order/Chaos alignment. Alt – A fixed mobility skill for repositioning and evasion. Q / E – Offensive and utility abilities unlocked through narrative progression and Absorb/Release choices. rows.name: Pet Hero vs Zombie
rows.short_description: The zombie apocalypse has begun! Choose your animal hero – a cat with a pistol, a crocodile with a bazooka, or a chicken with a revolver! Survive endless zombie waves, collect coins, upgrade weapons, and unlock new heroes. How long can you last?
rows.description_html: The zombie apocalypse is here! 🧟‍♂️🐾 Choose your animal warrior – a brave cat with a pistol, a mighty crocodile with a bazooka, or a daring chicken with a revolver! More heroes await to be unlocked. Face endless hordes of zombies, fight for survival, and collect golden coins to upgrade your weapons and unlock new characters and maps. Every battle is a test of skill and endurance – how long can you survive? 🔥 Game Features: ✅ Unique animal heroes, each with their own powerful weapon ✅ Fast-paced action-packed gameplay ✅ Multiple maps to explore and conquer ✅ Endless waves of zombies – the challenge never ends! 🎮 Controls & Goal: Move your hero with simple and intuitive controls, aim, and shoot your way through endless zombie waves. Your mission? Survive as long as possible, eliminate zombies, and collect coins for upgrades. 🐾 Join the battle now! The world needs a hero – and that hero is YOU!

rows.name: Living Nightmares - False Familiar
rows.short_description: Carl Williams, a 15-year-old boy, finds himself alone at home one unsettling night. What begins as a quiet evening soon spirals into something far stranger. Shadows shift, silence speaks, and someone—or something—seems to know him better than he knows himself.
rows.description_html: An episodic psychological horror experience based on fragmented memories and twisted perception. You’re looking at the first chapter of the Living Nightmares series — standalone stories that follow people grappling with distorted realities, fractured identities, and unsettling truths they were never meant to uncover. False Familiar After a strange event leaves you disoriented, you begin to question the memories you thought were real. A familiar face keeps reappearing — but something about them is deeply wrong. You're not sure if you’re being haunted… or if your mind is turning against you. A first-person psychological horror game focused on atmosphere and story-driven progression. Explore your environment, uncover clues, and piece together the reality — if it exists. Key Features A disturbing narrative driven by exploration and subtle choices. Use a phone to receive texts and check messages, uncovering clues through unsettling conversations. Authentic analog horror presentation. Visions, messages, and hallucinations that blur the line between truth and delusion. Minimal HUD, fully immersive experience. Built for short, intense play sessions.

rows.name: Operation: Surface Takeover
rows.short_description: A pixelated 2.5D RTS meets tower defense as you battle mutated ants in a short campaign. Build walls, place turrets, and hold the line to reclaim Earth's surface in this tactical fight for survival where placement of everything matters.
rows.description_html: Take back the Earth in a high-stakes action RTS where humanity fights for survival. Battle swarms of giant, radiation-mutated bugs as you reclaim the surface with advanced technology, tactical turret placement, and strategic defenses. Every decision counts as you push back the infestation and fight to restore what was lost. In this game, you have access to turrets that can be placed on any ground tile—design your base however you want. Your mission: defend headquarters at all costs. Enemies will come in waves from spawners, each with different methods of attack, so stay vigilant. Be careful—they can even destroy the structures you’ve placed. With a 10-level campaign and an endless mode to truly test your skills… the question is, can you handle it?

rows.name: Nightmare Visions Chapter 1
rows.short_description: You investigate a secluded rural home of an old friend that's gone missing, abandoned under mysterious circumstances. You begin to uncover a haunting trail left behind by a man consumed by paranoia, isolation, and something far more disturbing.
rows.description_html: Nightmare Visions: Chapter 1 is not a traditional horror game. There are no save files. No skip buttons. This is a narrative horror experience , not a survival challenge. You’re not here to escape. You’re here to witness. Developed entirely by one person , not a team, in 1 Month as a Challenge. If you're expecting a AAA horror game, you’re in the wrong place. If you're ready for something different , press play. Chapter One introduces the beginning of the Nightmare Visions anthology . Each chapter explores a new character, a new setting, and a new psychological thread woven into the same unnerving universe. Story This is not a game of combat or escape. It is a slow-burning descent into an atmosphere of unease, where story and tension unfold through exploration and observation. Every object, every symbol, and every shadowed corner tells a part of a larger, unsettling truth. Game Features: -First Person Walking Simulator -VHS Effects -Puzzles and Cryptic Messages Total Playtime: 20-30 Minutes Future: Chapter One is available now for free. Chapter Two is currently in development.

rows.name: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance
rows.short_description: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance expands the Blue Protocol universe with a vibrant MMORPG experience. Create your own hero, team up for strategic raids, or simply relax and have fun with friends fishing, crafting, and endless exploration. Adventure awaits!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Regnus! Begin your MMORPG adventure in an anime-styled fantasy world! Explore the Open World Magna is a vast land full of wonder: mine rare crystals, gather mystical herbs and mushrooms, or stumble into sudden monster stampedes! Between battles, lose yourself in breathtaking vistas. Be Whoever You Wanna Be Tank with unbreakable shields, heal with radiant spells, or unleash skillful moves to deal great damage—then swap styles anytime! And combat roles are just the start! In Star Resonance, you can also express yourself with deep customization and various outfits that make you a star in town! Rally, Raid, and Reap Your Rewards Assemble multiplayer parties to topple bosses with attack patterns that are easy to learn but still demand teamwork. Keep looting and make yourself—and your guild—legendary. We Are in This Together Fish at riversides, dance at the town's fair, set off fireworks at night, or even meme in guild chat—remember to have fun with friends, because Regnus shines brightest when shared.

rows.short_description: Stack, swipe, and wave your way through a fast-paced puzzle challenge powered by intuitive hand-tracking controls.
rows.description_html: GeTrix is a modern reinvention of the classic block-falling game, powered by intuitive gesture controls, where a camera tracks your hands. Whether you're stacking solo or waving your way through the challenge mode, GeTrix delivers a fresh and futuristic twist to a timeless favorite. ✋ How It Works – Gesture Controls Play using just your hand and a webcam: ☝️ Index finger – Move block left 🤙 Pinky finger – Move block right 🤚Palm  – Rotate block 🖕 Middle finger – Drop block faster Prefer traditional controls? Use your keyboard to play classic-style too! To use it, just use the arrow keys in order to play.

rows.name: Mandatory Fun
rows.short_description: You play as a young man conscripted into the Finnish military. Your actions shape how things turn out — for you, and for those around you. This is a story-rich experience with elements of drama, comedy, and romance… if you can call it that.
rows.description_html: You play as a young man conscripted into the Finnish military. In Finland, service is mandatory — and you don’t know how it’s going to play out. You’ll have to get used to a new setting and new rules. Your actions shape how things turn out — for you, and for those around you. This is a story-rich experience with elements of drama , comedy , and romance … if you can call it that. This is Part One of a multi-part story. It is a standalone release, and future parts will be released separately. Stay tuned for updates. Estimated playtime: around 1 hour Available for Windows

rows.name: Split Times
rows.short_description: Use your wits and savvy to save the city of Split from unreasonable housing prices! Find the best deals, evade angry sports fans, survive your part-time job and vanquish your inner demons in this short but intense experience.
rows.description_html: Synopsis You have been personally selected by the mayor to save the city of Split from unreasonable housing prices! Over the course of the following year, and on a tight budget, you'll have to use all the tools at your disposition to buy as many houses in the name of the city as you can so that they may be rented for cheap. That being said, there are a lot of people who would rather you fail in your mission... And besides, grandma ain't gonna visit herself, right? Gameplay The game is mostly played with the mouse, but it also uses the keyboard a little. Most of the game is reading the local newspaper and using your knowledge to find the best deals on a map. Once there, you will have to gauge if the price is too high, low, or if you want to try and haggle with the owner of the property. Manage your turns well and you will be victorious! There are also RIVETING bossfights to break the pace by testing your skills on the keyboard through challenges, or testing your wits with mind boggling questions and choices. What to expect A short, simple game made as a hobby. Nothing very ambitious, but made with a lot of heart. The game isn't too long, one play-through takes somewhere between 15 and 30 min. That being said, it is unlikely you will beat the game on your first try. The game is filled with jokes and memes. Even though the game is singleplayer, it is also a very enjoyable experience with friends. Sharing the joke is always a good time. A fun, satirical take on life in the Balkans. Try to spot the references and just have a good time overall.

rows.short_description: Bonki is trapped with BONK in your screen! Click or type to start the bonk war. Customize characters, unlock costumes, and enjoy virtual keyboard SFX while you play, create, or work. Your chaotic screen companion awaits!
rows.description_html: Bonki is trapped in your screen with the legendary meme character, BONK! There’s no way out for them, the only thing they can do is bonk each other. rows.name: Topzerah
rows.short_description: A funny 2D bossfight game. While running, jumping and shooting, defeat 10 unique bosses, progress in the game and make your very own bossfights using the in-game boss creator!
rows.description_html: 'Hey, I wonder if there's any fun 2D bossfight game with a cartoonish design.'  Well, there it is! This amazing game has 10 bosses with unique mechanics, a boss creator that lets you turn any image from your computer into a bossfight (don't make me regret it) and a really funny design! By the way, it was made by a single person, because I know you wouldn't play it if it was made by some random big company. Hope you like it :)

rows.short_description: Sectoris Sky is constantly evolving. New content, features, and optimizations will be added regularly.
rows.description_html: Sectoris Sky is currently in alpha development. The game is playable, but some planned features and content are not yet available. Many updates will be released over time to expand and enrich the experience. Sectoris Sky takes you on a journey through a fantastical world suspended in the skies. Explore sectors made up of floating islands, filled with mysteries, resources, and formidable enemies. Develop your character by allocating your experience points into various stats such as health, stamina, and more, to create your own unique playstyle. Battle creatures to gather resources and unlock blueprints, then craft your own equipment. Every crafted item has randomized stats, making each piece of loot and every creation truly unique. In Sectoris Sky , the path to power lies through exploration, combat, and crafting. Become the master of the skies! Sectoris Sky is constantly evolving. New content, features, and optimizations will be added regularly.

rows.name: Prime World: Classic
rows.short_description: Prime World Classic is a game recreated by fans of the original Prime World. The product is under development. The game combines two genres at once - RPG and MOBA. Control the castle, collect the strongest builds for your heroes and win on the battlefields!
rows.description_html: The Prime World Classic Community welcomes you! Prime World is a free online RPG/MOBA game with a unique universe, combining tactical session-based battles, castle management, and heroes. We’ve come together to recreate your favorite game in a refreshed form! Choose one of two castle designs upon registration; Select and create deadly talent combinations; Multiple game modes; Make friends; Free access to all previously existing hero skins; Hero rankings; Achieve victories on the battlefields of Praia. An incredible variety of talents and skins allows everyone to create a unique character tailored to their playstyle! As the server evolves, new castle development and combat features await you.

rows.short_description: Collect all the coins before time runs out! Dodge traps, defeat enemies, and master each world with your skills.
rows.description_html: SpeedCoins is a frantic 2D platformer that combines action, exploration, and time control. Run, jump, and fight through worlds full of danger, hidden messages, and strange creatures. Master time to your advantage... and make sure you're faster than the coins if you want to survive! You’ll shape your own destiny, change your skin along the way, but never lose sight of your goal. This is SpeedCoins! Explore. Discover the messages from someone special as you journey through unknown worlds. Explore the moon, the desert, and even the depths of hell! Fight. Dodge, shoot, and use your powers to battle anything that stands in your way. Solve. Complete unique puzzles and unlock hidden secrets in every world. Features: Discover the secrets of each character and their story. Jump, teleport, shoot, and dodge! Customize your character as you like. Play without an internet connection. Controller support. Achievements with in-game rewards. Over 50 non-linear levels. Test your skills; fight bosses, diverse enemies... and even time itself! Unique minigames inside the shop. Complete unique puzzles.

Assemble your deck, master elemental synergies, and face unpredictable challenges!
rows.description_html: With pixel-art aesthetics and dark fantasy vibes, every run presents new foes, relics, and spells to discover. Adapt your strategy, make crucial decisions, and shape your destiny with every card drawn. Will you master the arcane arts and conquer the ever-changing world of Arcanard? Key Features:  🔥 Roguelike deck-building – Experiment with endless card combinations and unique playstyles.  ⚡ 9 elemental powers – Build strategies around Fire, Ice, Electro, and more. 📜 Procedurally generated adventure – No two runs are ever the same.  🎨 Pixel-art aesthetic – Immersive fantasy visuals with a dark, mysterious atmosphere.  ⚔️ Turn-based tactical combat – Outsmart enemies with careful planning. Prepare for a thrilling, ever-evolving adventure where every decision matters. Will you rise as the ultimate elemental master?

rows.short_description: Quetzal is the ultimate Card Battle game based on Aztec mythology. Fight in fast-paced duels with powerful Creatures and Spells, upgrade cards and upgrade your base to get more rewards, play online or offline and collect all the cards to build the best deck!
rows.description_html: Aztec Mythology Quetzal is a fast-paced, richly stylized indie card battle game that breathes new life into ancient Aztec mythology. Command the might of legendary gods, fearsome beasts, and arcane rituals in intense turn-based duels brimming with strategic depth and tactical choices. Strategic Card Combat Master a unique combat system where every turn matters. Build your deck, balance your resources, and unleash devastating combos as you fight to bring your opponent’s Life Points to zero. Make use of powerful Creatures, Spells and Counters to forge your own unique playstyle. Upgrade. Expand. Conquer. Empower your cards and grow your strength. Upgrade your base to unlock new features, earn valuable loot, and access new game modes as you rise through the ranks of a forgotten empire. Play Anywhere, Anytime Quetzal can be played offline but also has online features that enhance the experience. Originally crafted for mobile and now refined for PC, Quetzal delivers smooth, optimized gameplay across platforms.

rows.name: 涩涩发抖
rows.short_description: A horror puzzle exploration game After breaking the lipstick, your wife began to beat you up Explore the house, collect props, avoid the wife who is in a strange state, and finally escape from this white nightmare
rows.description_html: A horror puzzle exploration game [Story] One day, your girlfriend Marin got in touch with you and told you that she was being pestered by a strange person who claimed to be a new tenant recruited by the landlord. Not long after moving in, he began to renovate the house and always did some outrageous things intentionally or unintentionally. Marin told you that she has contacted the landlord, but the landlord has not replied to the message yet. And she can't find a new place to live in the short term, so she hopes you will come over first... What's worse, your wife's condition is deteriorating. If you run away directly, it might lead to consequences you don't want to see. [Feature] ·Your wife's condition will directly affect your efficiency in exploring the map. Through interesting interactions, awaken her memory and help her resist strange states · Some interactive sound effects are voiced by mouth · A rendering style similar to that of horror comics · Playing for a long time might make you afraid of frying pans [Hint] In the game, you need to pay attention to the interaction prompts. They usually tell you what items you need to interact with to advance the process

rows.name: Phantom Grid
rows.short_description: Phantom Grid is a fast-paced action arcade stealth game where you take the role of an assassin and take out designated targets. Complete levels to gain high scores and try to beat your old times as you dash, grab, and throw your way through security.
rows.description_html: Phantom Grid is a fast-paced action arcade stealth game where you take the role of an assassin and take out designated targets in a dystopian cyberpunk future, blending quick reflexes and strategic movement in a world ruled by surveillance and corruption. Complete levels to gain high scores and try to beat your old times as you dash, grab, and throw your way through security.

rows.name: Memoria Altera
rows.short_description: Wake up in a dark, futuristic lab with no memories of who you are or why you're there. Explore the lab with your fellow amnesiac Lenny as you complete puzzles to unlock more of the facility and regain more memories of your past. Will you like who you turn out to be?
rows.description_html: Memoria Altera is a narrative-driven puzzle game where you wake up on the floor suffering from amnesia. You must explore the futuristic lab you woke up in to recover your memories with the aid of a fellow amnesiac who is just as confused as you are. Venture deeper into the lab and unravel the secrets of who you were before losing your memories! Key Features: 4+ rooms to explore 7+ puzzles to solve 4+ cutscenes to experience A lot of story rich dialogue to read 1 really cool follower to love

rows.name: Fishing Time
rows.short_description: Fishing Time Is a chill fishing game where you collect rare fish. Every 2 hours, you can catch a fish, which is added to your Steam inventory. There are +140 different fish and 6 different rarity levels! Relax, cast your line, and complete your collection!
rows.description_html: Catch up to +140 different fish with unique colors, shapes and designs, collect trash, and trade it for coins. Every 2 hours, your next fishing attempt is guaranteed to grant a fish, which is added to your Steam inventory. You can either release the fish in-game for coins or sell it on the Steam Marketplace. Fish for trash and exchange the trash for coins, or simply earn coins by freeing fish from your collection, use those coins to buy tons of cosmetics and make your ship look amazing! Just enjoy the chill music, cast your line, and grow your collection!

rows.name: CATpillAr
rows.short_description: “CATpillAr” is a horror-themed VR mini-game that requires you to collect big, juicy, hairy, creepy caterpillars crawling around an empty hospital. In VR, you can grab harmless giant caterpillars by the neck and throw them inside the bucket. Replay and see how many you can collect!
rows.description_html: Step into an abandoned hospital, where giant, hairy, wriggling caterpillars crawl through the eerie hallways. In this horror-themed VR mini-game, your mission is simple—but unsettling: grab them by the neck and toss them into the bucket. 🦠 Immersive Horror Atmosphere – Experience the unsettling silence of the empty hospital as you track these grotesque creatures, each movement sending shivers down your spine. 🐛 Unique Gameplay Mechanics – Reach out in VR to physically grab the caterpillars , feel them squirm in your grip, and aim carefully before throwing them into the bucket. 🔄 Replayability & Challenge – How many can you collect before time runs out? Test your reflexes, beat your own record, and embrace the creepy thrill of the hunt! Do you dare to face the crawling horrors? Grab. Throw. Survive.  CATpillar Score： normal- 1 green-5

rows.name: Blood & Bananas
rows.short_description: Enter the world of corporate politics, in this cold war grand strategy, become a monopoly of resources, buy the market, build an army, drop a nuke or hire a spy as you conspire against your peers and leaders. Become the greatest power via trade or war, in blood & bananas
rows.description_html: Blood & Bananas is a grand strategy game with a focus in economics during the cold war, a capitalism simulator where every country or company has their own goals and where you as the player is only a part of the world. Be a warlord by staging a mutiny or a benevolent ruler who focuses on diplomacy over war or the exact opposite, build the perfect army with different weapons, tanks and planes. Be a country and increase your state power with money to kick out the companies or be a company who puppets countries with good business so you can make money and buy the market provinces of a country, launch new products and change their prices to gain more money or gain more demand in a province, build factories and offices to expand your influence across North America, you could also hire mercenaries and take it by force. Build infrastructure to have more buildings which will improve economy. Use buildings to harvest/mine/extract different resources, monopolize them and mark them up when entities have no choice but to buy them from you. Either you start as a person and work yourself up via the career tree and buy seats to become more powerful than your liege and coup them or play as any entity on the map (tribes not suggested). You can do all at once if you so please.

rows.name: Asphyxiation
rows.short_description: Asphyxiation is an atmospheric horror game where you need to escape the facility before you go insane and run out of air.
rows.description_html: Sent to a remote space facility for inspection. You've been left for dead as you find that the facility has been abandoned by all human life. With the air not fit for breathing if not for your oxygen tank, you must find your way out of the facility before you Asphyxiate, all the while, shaking the feeling that you're being watched. Get lost in a procedurally generated facility looking for the exit Search for air canisters to avoid asphyxiating Go crazy as you witness things not as they are meant to be If you see it, pretend you don't, but do not approach Now featuring revolutionary ball technology!

rows.name: Deserter: Prologue
rows.short_description: Deserter: Prologue is a free stealth-RPG game. Use stealth, cunning, and thieving skills to escape from a military camp in the heart of a dystopian war.
rows.description_html: The prologue to Deserter is a free, standalone chapter that introduces you to the bleak world of the main story. You are John Holden, a soldier broken by endless bloodshed and lies — witness to something that can’t be unseen. With no way back, there’s only one option left: escape. Time is short. Each night is a chance to prepare, but every misstep brings you closer to death on the front lines. Evade the night patrols, steal supplies, craft tools, and strike secret deals with fellow soldiers. Can you make it out unnoticed? Or will you vanish in someone else’s war? Key Features: A unique blend of stealth and RPG genres Stealth, deception, thievery, and careful planning instead of direct combat Atmospheric, detail-rich locations set on the front lines and inside a military camp Multiple escape routes with distinct challenges and consequences A grim dystopia filled with satire and dark humor

rows.name: Stocks
rows.short_description: A collector simulator and clicker where you earn rare items just by staying in the game. Collect stylized company “stocks,” track their value, join seasonal updates, and profit!
rows.description_html: Stocks is a collector’s simulator where simply being in the game can earn you a rare “stock”. Sounds simple? That’s because it is. Just stay online, collect unique items, and watch their value grow. Seasons change — old items stop dropping and become rare, while new ones appear every new season. And it’s all in your inventory. This isn’t just a clicker. It’s the game version of “sit and farm profit,” fully integrated with the Steam economy. You’ll receive in-game items — stylized “stocks” from various fictional companies — and you can either flex your collection or trade it on the market. And yes, you heard it right: just stay in the game and get drops.

rows.name: Contraindication
rows.short_description: Your end is my beginning. A short psychological visual novel with exploration and puzzle elements... it already lays shattered.
rows.description_html: Your end is my beginning. Reimah has nothing to live for but her research, and today is the day she reaps the rewards of her labor.  Little does she know that she will be her first test subject. A short visual novel with exploration and puzzle elements.  Story gets dark at times. Features:  - 20-30 minutes of playtime  - Stylized art with 14 CGs  - A story someone died for  - Turning a light switch off and on Made in 11 days for the RPGMaker 2025 Gamejam. A separate artbook is available if you want to see behind the scenes.  (20 pgs long)

rows.name: Idle Dangers
rows.short_description: In a world where dark forces threaten to consume all, a magical continent is under siege by monstrous invaders. As a hero in this dark fantasy realm, you must rise to the challenge. Strengthen your skills, and lead your team through endless battles to protect the world from destruction.
rows.description_html: In a world where dark forces threaten to consume all, a magical continent is under siege by monstrous invaders. As a hero in this dark fantasy realm, you must rise to the challenge. Strengthen your skills, recruit powerful allies, and lead your team through endless battles to protect the world from destruction. The fate of the realm lies in your hands—prepare for a journey filled with epic dungeons, intense PVP, and towering world bosses. Will you conquer the darkness or be consumed by it? Game Features: [Core Combat System] Idle questing: No need to grind or spend excessively. Play at your own pace while progressing through levels. [Character System] Hero progression and skill enhancement. A wide variety of heroes and skills to mix and match. [Equipment System] Strengthen your gear for explosive power. Collect resources, upgrade equipment, and boost combat strength. [Treasure Chest System] A wealth of resources is waiting for you. Unlock mysterious treasure chests to claim a massive amount of rewards. [Dungeon System] World Bosses and PvP duels. Take on various dungeons and face powerful bosses to earn generous rewards. [Guild System] Join forces and build greatness together. Team up with guildmates to conquer challenges and achieve glory. Embark on your dark fantasy adventure now—defeat, conquer, and rise to the top!

rows.name: Night Patrol Rules
rows.short_description: Virtual group - PLAVE doujin game, set against the backdrop of winter school ghost stories. Experience the Night Patrol Rules of the Seven Mysteries through the eyes of all five band members, uncovering the unsettling truth hidden behind the mystery through your investigation and choices.
rows.description_html: English patch preparation in progress, not yet online. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Main Story A ghost story is spreading across campus. The school has forbidden students from entering or leaving after 7 p.m. But rumor has it that— If someone turns on the lights floor by floor in an empty teaching building, they’ll hear the circuit breaker snap. When the lights that went out begin to flicker again, don’t move. That’s when the “Never-Seen Patroller” appears and takes away any student who dares to linger. To uncover the truth behind this chilling mystery, five members of the school’s band club sneak into the First Arts Building… Disclaimer This is a fan-made game inspired by the virtual boy band PLAVE. It is completely free to play, with no in-game purchases or paid content, and was created solely for entertainment. The main characters are the five members of PLAVE: Nam Yejun (Yejun), Han Noah (Noah), Chae Bonggu (Bamby), Do Eunho (Eunho), and Yu Hamin (Hamin). All other characters are original NPCs designed for this story. Character rights belong to VLAST. All assets used in this game are either self-produced or legally purchased. Apart from the characters and certain references, the world setting and storyline are entirely original and fictional, with a thorough introduction in game. Players unfamiliar with PLAVE are welcome to enjoy it as a standalone school mystery game with mild horror elements. This game focuses on storytelling and includes no romance elements or character ships. Character portrayals reflect the creator’s personal interpretation and may differ from your own view of the band members. All names, places, groups, and legends are fictional and bear no relation to real individuals or entities. Content Warning This game focuses on school mystery and light horror, featuring text-based investigation gameplay. It contains limited depictions of gore and violence. Flashing lights and quick scene transitions are present. If you experience dizziness, nausea, visual discomfort, eye/facial twitching, please stop playing immediately. Recommended for ages 16 and up. Players under 18 or sensitive to horror content should proceed with caution. Lower system performance may cause lag or minor bugs during gameplay. Gameplay You won’t play from a fixed perspective. The story unfolds through the alternating perspectives of five band members, involving branching choices and investigations. Collecting specific items allows you to unlock related keywords in the SeongHwi Archive. You can reach multiple endings based on your choices.   Presentation The game features 2.5D character illustrations and limited animation. The Prologue chapter is now available, with an estimated playtime of 4-6 hours, and contains no direct horror visuals. Headphones are recommended for the best experience. 【Staff】 Producer: Tempestad Game Engine: GameCreator Program: Tempestad Script: Tempestad Copy proofreading: Quanju Foski Scene concept: Michellenaya Scene original painting: Michellenaya, みくる, Tempestad (processed drawing) Character&CG original artwork: TempestadPV Animation: Tempestad UI Art: Maot Logo Design: Dfr Music/Commercial Music Library: MIKIILO, Crow Producer/Envato Market Sound source: Freesound，耳聆网

rows.name: Final War: Frozen Defense
rows.short_description: Strategy Tower Defense, RTS Battles on the World Map
rows.description_html: In a chaotic Middle-earth, war’s shadow looms over the land, people retreat into castles. A powerful dark sorcerer has opened the Gates of Hell, summoning a demonic legion. The balance of magic is crumbling, ancient walls trembling under the infernal onslaught. Knights! Draw your swords, defend the castle together! -A New Height in Puzzle Tower Defense More than a battle of defense and attack, it’s a clash of courage and strategy. Heroes and towers fuse seamlessly, offering fresh tactical combos and a thrilling combat experience, micro-control RTS hero, strategize like a master, and then embrace the thrill of heroism. -Expand Territory, build Roads Expand Territory, then build Roads, road cards help you controlling the enemy’s path to the castle. Tip: Within your tower's range, the longer the enemy's path, the higher your chances of success. -Free RTS Battles on the World Map On a world map, unleash RTS (Real-Time Strategy) battles, leveraging the unique terrain features of each vast region for strategic layouts. Seize resources, engage in real-time combat with countless players, and dominate the battlefield! -Unite with Players Worldwide A 3D planetary map hosts players across the globe. Unleash your social savvy, form alliances, grow stronger, and conquer the planet together!

rows.name: Beastopia
rows.short_description: A strategy game that combines resource management and auction mechanics, where players compete for financial dominance in the Animal Kingdom through clever investments and bidding.
rows.description_html: Step into an animal kingdom where wits and strategy collide. The king’s financial advisor is about to retire, and the great animal houses are mobilizing — through auctions and investments, they’ll battle for the throne of wealth. Only one can rise to power and become the kingdom’s next financial mastermind! This is a strategy game that combines resource management and auction mechanics. You’ll take on the role of uniquely styled animal characters, collecting valuable items from the forest and bidding for them at the grand royal auction. With clever combinations, sharp judgment, and flexible financial tactics, you must outwit your opponents in high-stakes auctions to earn the most wealth and claim your place as the kingdom’s financial advisor. Key Features: 🦊 Strategic Auction Gameplay – Time your bids, read your rivals, and craft your auction strategy to gain the upper hand in turn-based bidding battles. 👑 Single & Multiplayer Modes – Whether facing off against cunning AI or challenging your friends, the game delivers tense, strategic showdowns every round. Enter this vibrant yet power-hungry animal world and prove your financial savvy to claim the glory that’s rightfully yours!

rows.name: FLICK SOLITAIRE
rows.short_description: Level up your chill time with Flick Solitaire. Forget boring card decks – we’re teaming up with real indie artists to design every card, bringing you gorgeous, original artwork. Build your ultimate card collection as you flick through Patience, Pyramid, and Spider. De-stress with a good FLICK!
rows.description_html: Flick Solitaire flips classic card games with chill vibes to keep your mind happy. Every game is a colourful art trip where you discover and build decks, designed by real-world (fierce as FLICK) indie artists! Play Flick is solitaire in full slay mode. Play classic games like Klondike, Spider, and Pyramid, powered by jaw-dropping indie art from real artists, killer animations, and a vibe that hits every single time. Whether you’ve got 3 minutes or 3 hours, it’s pure solo bliss—just you, the cards, and zero distractions. Collect From Ugly Medieval Cats to fire-breathing dragons, Flick’s decks are loaded with personality. We’ve partnered with legends like Cyanide & Happiness (Explosm), Kennys’ GIFS, and a whole squad of indie creators, each bringing their signature style to the table. Open packs, score new cards, and discover which artists you’ll unlock next. With over 60 creators and new designs rolling out each month, your game is as unique as your vibe. Chill   Flick’s all about chill vibes and zero pressure. No timers, no “last person standing” nonsense — just you, the cards, and a smooth rhythm that lets your brain hit the reset button. Whether you're melting away stress or winding down for the night, Flick is your perfect escape. rows.name: Nora and Frank
rows.short_description: Blast through hordes of vicious mutants and science-gone-wrong experiments to save your goblin friends in a stylish retro-magic post-apocalypse. An auto-shooter where builds are made of baseball cards and candy. What? Yeah, we’re confused too!
rows.description_html: Magic meets retro high-tech in Nora and Frank , a stylish and unsettling post-apocalyptic world where nothing is quite what it seems — and every mimic is out to get you. UNLIKELY ALLIES & COUNTLESS ENEMIES Join Nora, a goblin engineer, and her new companion Frank — a mimic suitcase — as they fight through endless hordes of enemies to rescue her friends and family from a mysterious villain. Test your reflexes in this chaotic and charming auto-shooter! HOUSEWITCHES? BANDIT GEESE? Welcome to a world where 1950s Americana, fantasy tropes, comic-book absurdity, and post-apocalyptic decay boil together into one strange, beautiful mess. Behind the humor and chaos lies a dark past — and maybe some answers, if you dare to look. COLLECT DEADLY BASEBALL CARDS Earn tokens and trade them for powerful (and bizarre) baseball cards that define your build. Stack devastating combos, juggle risk and reward, and keep your goblin gut full with snacks and soda. Heroes need carbs, after all. ONE RUN IS NEVER ENOUGH Mix and match levels, cards, and snacks to create a unique run every time. Break the game, melt your brain, or pull off something glorious. Celebrate the chaos — or hit retry when it all goes horribly wrong.

rows.name: Room For One!
rows.short_description: Race your friends to the last available hotel room in this online platforming racing game. Speed and skill are all you need to make sure you're the one coming out on top!
rows.description_html: There's only Room For One! The most popular ( and only ) hotel in town is quickly filling up and you need a place to stay bad. By the time you get there, the front desk is still packed with potential patrons but only one available room left . Looks like you're out of luck...or are you? Room For One! is an online multiplayer game where up to 6 players compete in a cut-throat race within deadly environments. Choose from up to 3 classes each with their own ability to get an edge in the race, and use items found along the way to help you and hinder others! Features: Online multiplayer for 2-6 players Competitive races within a unique locale 3 classes with special abilities Items to help yourself or sabotage others

rows.name: Sub Terra
rows.short_description: Sub Terra is a first person psychological horror game set deep underground. As a maintenance worker, your job is to fix a broken water line at the end of tunnel 04-R. Enter the tunnel, repair the pipe, and get out.
rows.description_html: Sub Terra is a single-player first person psychological horror game inspired by The Backrooms. As a maintenance worker, you've spent your whole life venturing deep underground to repair pipes, gas lines, you name it. Utilities that we take for granted. On a day like any other, you enter the manhole and descend the depths to replace a water line at the end of tunnel 04-R . The job is straightforward. The directions are clear. But your repair doesn't go quite as planned. Immersive Experience: Realistic graphics and spatialized audio create a truly immersive experience guaranteed to make you feel like you're really 50 feet under. Unravel a Mystery: Piece together hints and clues to learn the tragic story of what's been buried underground. Keep an Eye Out: You know the tunnels like the back of your hand, but you're not the only thing down there. Locations: Your job may be down a manhole, but you'll discover much more than just maintenance tunnels. Warning: Sub Terra contains loud noises, flashing lights and material that may be disturbing to some individuals.

rows.name: Project: Mortuus Astrum Playable Teaser
rows.short_description: A first-person cosmic horror short experience set in a hallway-style map, where you uncover the secrets of an abandoned facility while being stalked by a mysterious entity
rows.description_html: Project Mortuus Astrum is a short first-person cosmic horror experience set in a decaying, labyrinthine facility. You awaken alone, disoriented, and pursued by an unseen entity. Explore claustrophobic corridors and abandoned rooms as you uncover environmental clues and solve spatial puzzles to unlock new areas. The game features a hallway-style map design focused on tension and atmosphere, with dynamic audio cues and visual storytelling. There is no combat—your only tools are observation, memory, and movement. The entity stalking you reacts to sound, forcing you to adapt your exploration strategy. The experience lasts approximately 10-15 minutes. Will you escape the facility… or become part of its forgotten history?

rows.name: Bouncemasters
rows.short_description: Launch a penguin across the globe! Whack, bounce, and soar through crazy obstacles in this fun physics-based arcade game, inspired by the legendary YetiSports! Escape the North Pole and find love - or just keep failing hilariously.
rows.description_html: Picture this: you're a penguin. Life at the North Pole? Freezing. Dull. Zero prospects (especially with the ladies). Time to break free! Find some actual fun, like in good old YetiSports! Your tools? A best bear buddy... and a bat. What could go wrong? From scorching deserts to a moose butt - this ain't your average penguin vacation. Bounce off bewildered seals, become a snowball of doom, hitch a ride on a whale, and surf on giant mushrooms. Successfully navigate a lake? Bonus points! Moose-back riding? Definitely a thing. Impale yourself on a pine tree? Probably. All for love. Failure is an option! Because.. You. Will. Always. Fail. Hilariously. You'll get eaten by piranhas, become a moose's new hat, get stuck in a tree, and possibly abducted by a creepy green dude. But hey, at least you'll fail in style. The real question is: how far can you get before you fail spectacularly? Who needs fish when you have rocket-powered frying pans and the freakin' Infinity Gauntlet? Pick your bat - from humble frying pan to the Eiffel Tower, a trusty club, or the ultimate power glove. Boost your launch power, flight, bounce, and max speed. Prepare for penguin-launching mayhem! In your quest for better life you'll even reach the freakin' space. So yeah, we say this game IS about space! It's beautiful. (And a great place to launch a penguin.) Your bear buddy's skills and your epic bat collection will get you there. Think you're the ultimate penguin launcher? Prove it. Endless replayability, global leaderboards - compete with friends and foes. Brag about your distance, your style, your collection of ludicrous bats. Dominate the leaderboards. Become a legend. Or at least, a slightly less unsuccessful penguin launcher.

rows.name: Acki Nacki - Popit Game
rows.short_description: Play Acki Nacki - Popit Game — a massively multiplayer roguelike card game. Сlimb a tower of Blocks. Use game-breaking Popits to defeat other players. Chain strategic combos to boost your score and sabotage your rivals on the live leaderboard.
rows.description_html: Gameplay Overview Calculate, maneuver, and outplay others using your deck. Pair it with tactically deployed Popits. And don't forget to count. How it works: Play card combos to match or beat each Block’s score and climb upward. Score enough points to lift the Block higher. Think. Count. Adapt. If you fail — you fall. But you’re not alone. Meet the Popits Popits are unique user-generated cards that transform your deck. Use different Popits to trigger, abburate, mutate, distort, corrupt, or invert effects. Boost your score with Block Keepers Block Managers distribute rewards Acki Nacki is a combinatorial genius Attack your enemies with Malicious Block Producers Protect your progress with the help of Block Producers Some appear once and vanish. Others stay with you until your final breath in the game. Core Mechanic: Overdraft Score enough on every block. But do not score too much. If you need X and you score much more than X you pay an overdraft fee with your in-game money. Go far over the target and the game will punish you. This game isn’t about scoring the most. It’s about scoring above and as close to the target as possible. Calculate carefully, using your wits — and your calculator — to claim your reward and not get wasted. Multiplayer System: Other players can attack you — and you can attack them. This is a live, asynchronous multiplayer battlefield. Cross paths with others — sometimes gently, sometimes head-on. The leaderboard breathes. Your rank can rise, fall, or shift — even when you’re offline. Every card counts. Pick your Popits in the Popit Shop. Because Popit Game isn’t just played — it’s lived. Every session writes a new story.

rows.name: Paper Depths
rows.short_description: In a retro-futuristic office run by machines, help Florence complete the work across looping tasks. Solve puzzles, navigate bureaucracy, and manage your time wisely in this solo isometric adventure.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the office, Florence . Everyone else has been fired, now it's just you… and the tireless mechanical workers serving the company and its shareholders. Your task? Fetch more documents. Always more. The robots follow orders well, but some files remain lost in the chaos of this decaying earlys 1900's bureaucracy. Dive into piles of paperwork, unravel office secrets, and navigate the absurd demands of a system gone mad. The machines can obey. But can you , a human, meet the standard?

Race to the goal of each stage while posing fabulously! Collect colorful orbs  to grow your Beetle Ball gadget! And use your ball's power to squash your foes! THE BREAKDOWN Gameplay inspired by a mashup of Katamari , Monkey Ball , and Pizza Tower with a Kamen Rider inspired protagonist A vibrant and explosive art style inspired by anime and PS2 era games 10 blood-pumping levels with 3 different aesthetics 3 time ranks to collect in each level - can you get the fastest time? The game was created from scratch within a ~10 week period.

rows.name: PIG
rows.short_description: In a final bid to cheat death, you challenge The Alleyman to a high-stakes dice game where every roll could be your last.
rows.description_html: In a final bid to cheat death, you challenge The Alleyman to a high-stakes dice game where every roll could be your last.  Though the game is simple... what The Alleyman offers isn’t: more time. Beat him, and attain extra life—lose, and he takes what time you have left.  And you? You’re dying anyway, frail body ravaged by an incurable disease.  A single die. A single choice: Will you take the deal? ⌛ GAME FEATURES ⌛ PIG: The Game was made for the O2A2 VN Jam 2025, a micro Visual Novel Jam with strict asset limitations and a 1000 word limit.   3 core conclusions.  Approximately 1,000 words.   Original illustrations.  Original Soundtrack.   The Alleyman plays against you. PIG contains mature themes and is intended for an older audience. Player discretion is advised for visual and written descriptions of gambling, death, and disease.

rows.name: Master of Piece: Prologue
rows.short_description: In this Free version of Master of Piece, build your deck of mercenaries, find powerful synergies between various traits and relics to fight against outlaws, fanatics, and cultists, and uncover the secrets of the Dragon Orb.
rows.description_html: 《Master of Piece: Prologue》is a free prologue version of 《Master of Piece》, a deck-building roguelike game inspired from board games, offering simple yet deeply strategic gameplay. Recruit an expedition team of mercenaries, and embark on a journey to uncover the secrets of a world shrouded in dark mist. Wishlist the full version  to play the complete Mercenary-deckbuilding Game! The full game is scheduled to release in November 2025, as Early Access. Optimize your strategies, Deploy your mercenaries, and fight the battles to achieve victory. Strengthening and combining mercenaries’ unique traits are essential to creating powerful synergies and combinations, which will increase your chances of completing this perilous journey. Combat Deploy one mercenary unit per round to the battlefield and engage in combat. Once combat begins, mercenaries act in order based on their speed. Devise your best next move, given your current situation. With simple controls and a straightforward system, anyone can easily fathom the basic mechanics of the game. However, mastering and optimizing the variable combinations of mercenary traits, relics, and commander’s abilities will demand a deep and complex understanding. Easy learning, but deep, challenging gameplay at the same time! Strategic Combinations Build your team of mercenaries, not cards. Mercenary units can be enhanced and modified in various ways along the journey, offering new strategic combinations every time you play. Explore different journeys with 140+ mercenaries and traits, 80+ relics, and 400+ card events. Discover diverse combinations, build support facilities in campsites, make the ultimate expedition team of your dream. Every new game you play will be perceived differently from the previous experience, with diverse events and randomly generated paths & enemies. 120+ types of mercenaries, 80+ types of relics, 14+ types of building events, and 400+ card events will contribute to creating an infinitely replayable game. The Purpose of the Prologue Version Since launching the demo in March, over 10,000 players have downloaded our game, and many have provided valuable feedback to various parts of the game. Thanks to all the feedback we’ve received since the demo’s release, we’ve been able to improve many aspects of the game. We’re truly grateful for the opportunity to communicate with our players and see the game make progress because of it. rows.name: Scope Battle Royale
rows.short_description: Scope, a fast-paced 100-player battle royale where memory wiped warriors fight for survival on a remote island. Dropped into a stylized world with no powers, only skill, strategy, and will-power.
rows.description_html: Scope is a high-stakes, 100-player battle royale where survival means everything and freedom is the ultimate prize. Set on a remote island deep in the ocean, players take on the roles of memory-wiped warriors trapped in high-tech robotic suits. Each has been kidnapped, trained, and forced to fight in a ruthless tournament where only one can rise. Dropped from a transport plane into a sprawling, ever-shrinking battlefield, players must explore dense mountain forests to open grassy plains—scavenging for weapons, supplies, and the upper hand. With no special abilities to rely on, only strategy, reflexes, and raw skill will separate the victor from the fallen. Stylized visuals, intense solo or squad action, and a mysterious backstory lurking beneath the surface make Scope more than just a fight—it's a test of who you are when everything else has been stripped away.

rows.name: Lootimals
rows.short_description: Lootimals is a chill idle pet collection game where you hatch surprise eggs every 30 minutes. Discover uniquely named creatures across rarity tiers, unlock backgrounds and egg skins, complete collections, and trade in extras for missing pets. No combat, no pressure — just pure collecting bliss.
rows.description_html: Lootimals - Collect. Hatch. Complete. Repeat. Welcome to Lootimals — the ultimate idle pet collection game where every 30 minutes could bring you your next favorite critter! Whether you're grinding for that legendary Cuburtle or just trying to finish your Moolox set, there's always something worth hatching. How it Works Drops Every 30 Minutes – watch the loot roll in. Hatch Unique Creatures – Each drop is a surprise egg containing a randomly rolled Lootimal with its own name, style, and rarity. Hatch eggs for new egg skins, click away to unlock new ingame backgrounds, all while collecting new pets for your collection. Rarity Tiers – From adorable commons to legendary beasts, the thrill of the chase is real. Achievements Galore – Completionists rejoice we've got you covered. No battles. No pay-to-win. Just you, your Lootimals, and the slow grind of fate. Lootimals is the chill companion you didn’t know you needed. Features: 30-minute drop cycles (even while minimized!) Currently 5 different Lootimals with 6 rarity tiers. Real-time rarity-based hatching Full collection tracker Collect Lootimals - Convert Into Tickets - Use Tickets On Missing Lootimals! If you love idle games, collectibles, and the satisfaction of seeing your pet library fill out, Lootimals is for you. rows.name: The Last Guild
rows.short_description: A classic RPG full of combat and regions to explore, focused on collecting resources to create magical items and defeating monsters. You are the last defense of this kingdom, hire adventurers to help you on your journey.
rows.description_html: The Last Guild is a classic third-person RPG with turn-based combat! Powerful beings are rising, and the Kingdom is counting on the last guild to exterminate the forces of darkness. Do you have what it takes to restore order to the world? Choose your adventurers to help restore peace and order to the Kingdom! The Last Guild blends classic RPG heritage with other innovative mechanics, creating an RPG experience like no other! The game will feature several adventures as if it had a GM narrating classic RPG campaigns, from which the player will benefit from new content. The combats are intense and turn-based. Develop your strategies to defeat dozens of unique enemies and deadly bosses. If you defeat them, you will obtain special rewards! You can build up their characters by acquiring EXP and enabling their skills and equipping them with powerful items! Explore the region in search of resources for item creation. Guild quests are essential to obtain many resources!

rows.name: Shards of the library
rows.short_description: A simulation puzzle game where everyday life and mystery intertwine on a farm as you uncover secrets beyond the books.
rows.description_html: Game Title: Shards of the Library Playtime: Approximately 1–2 hours (You can continue playing freely after finishing the main quests) 🧩 Gameplay Shards of the Library is a story-driven simulation and puzzle game with farming elements and mysterious events that unfold within a strange library. Players can: Explore a small open-world village with seasonal changes and a day/night cycle Complete 90+ quests involving farming, cooking, potion crafting, and toolmaking Interact with 40+ unique NPCs and engage in systems like music performance, painting, and writing Enter procedurally generated forests and caves Build relationships, discover secrets, and collect artifacts The game also features fishing, monster encounters, item crafting (70+), farming crops (15+ types), skill learning (50+), and more. Even after completing the main quests, players can continue enjoying daily farm life at their own pace. 📖 Game Story One day, the protagonist receives a letter from their grandfather, asking them to take care of his farm while he goes on an unexpected journey. After arriving and settling into a quiet rural life, the protagonist visits the town library—only to discover that something strange is happening through the books they borrow. In a world where ordinary life and mystery are intertwined, players will gradually uncover hidden truths. 🛠 Developer's Note This game is a solo-developed project created as part of a graduation portfolio, using skills learned from CSE360 and CSE412 courses. It was inspired by titles such as Stardew Valley , Mabinogi , and Princess Maker . All systems listed above are already implemented and playable. Future updates may include polish, bug fixes, and small expansions based on player feedback. We appreciate your understanding as development continues during Early Access. 🎥 Distribution & Streaming Notice If you share or stream this game, please include the game title or a Steam link in your video description. Unauthorized redistribution is not supported, and we are not responsible for any issues caused by it.

rows.name: Biophobia
rows.short_description: A woman is violated by a man. In a final act of rebellion to preserve her humanity, she takes control and opens her stomach. Unable to finish what she started she waits for you, and asks you not to look away.
rows.description_html: Biophobia is an experimental art game that intertwines dissection and gardening mechanics to explore themes of trauma, death and agency. The body becomes a site of decay and creation. You are invited to confront discomfort. Features: Unique Gameplay : Combines a visceral yet delicate dissection with nurturing gardening mechanics. Artistic Body Horror : Experience unsettling yet compassionate depictions of the human form. No gore, but hauntingly beautiful. Sandbox Creation: Choose from a variety of seeds. Shape your own floral expression. Experimental Aesthetic : A blend of surreal visuals and symbolic design, challenging traditional game conventions. Short, Impactful Experience: Designed to be completed in ~20 minutes. Cultural references Inspired by the character  Ophelia from Shakespeare’s Hamlet, Clemente Susini’s wax figure the Anatomical Venus , and Fuyuko Matsui’s painting  Keeping Up the Pureness , Biophobia reimagines historical depictions of women’s bodies through a modern feminist lens. Without text or dialogue, the game speaks through symbolic interaction, haunting visuals, and atmospheric sound. Biophobia is a game intended for players who appreciate experimental design, symbolic storytelling, and confronting mature themes in an artistic setting. Some audiences may find the content of this game unsettling. Viewer discretion is advised.

rows.name: RISE FROM RUIN
rows.short_description: RISE FROM RUIN is a third-person, character-action game where you take control of a massive, unstoppable monster, the BEAST. Run, Jump, charge, smash, and destroy your way through he invading forces to defend the city. Are you strong enough to defend your city from the hordes?
rows.description_html: RISE FROM RUIN is a third-person, character-action game in which you take control of a massive, unstoppable monster, the BEAST. They aim to defend a vast, icy city from relentless, chaotic, hostile forces. The game offers bombastic gameplay and immense battles in which your sheer power is tested against ever-growing enemy forces.  Once a beacon of civilization, the city teeters on the brink of ruin as an overwhelming army of chaos crashes against its walls. Battle through the different sectors of this massive city. Learn the story of the city through the poems. This battle is not just for survival but a clash between order and chaos. Empowered by ancient forces, the BEAST wields fantastical abilities that reflect this duality, some channeling the controlled might of the city, while others embrace the raw, untamed destruction of the invading horde. As waves of enemies surge forward, the city’s fate rests on the BEAST’s ability to harness its immense power, to adapt and endure. RISE FROM RUIN delivers a power fantasy that places you at the center of this epic struggle. Do you have what it takes to defend civilization?

rows.name: 挂机三国-无限升级
rows.short_description: Three Kingdoms card development auto chess lineup with battle mode.
rows.description_html: Hello everyone, this is a card development competitive game that I developed independently A game with multiple heroes and equipments based on the Three Kingdoms theme, integrating elements of strategy, placement, leisure, cultivation, competition, etc. The battle mode is similar to that of auto chess, and unique skills are designed for each general and counselor. Equipment is classified by rarity using the classic gray, green, blue, purple, orange, and red colors, with red being the best and having the most attributes. Each general can be equipped with different types of soldiers, which have a restraining relationship with each other. Reasonable configuration will bring obvious benefits in battle. Carefully designed exclusive weapons for some generals and counselors (to obtain stronger skills and effects), such as Guan Yu's Green Dragon Crescent Blade, Zhang Fei's Zhangba Snake Spear, Cao Cao's Yitian Sword, etc. Tips: During the game, you will randomly meet some other players and defeat them to obtain resources. The color of generals and counselors only represents the strength of their skills and has nothing to do with numerical growth. Resting troops will provide combat bonuses based on their level star rating. Resources prioritize troops and equipment. Daily tasks must be completed. The [?] button in the game has corresponding instructions. If you encounter any questions you don't understand, please add my QQ 375776626 for consultation I have quit my job and am working on games at home full-time. It is inevitable that the games may have some shortcomings. I hope you will be tolerant and encourage me. If you like this game, please give more suggestions and opinions in the comment section, and I will organize and improve it.

rows.name: FickleFlame
rows.short_description: We invite you to experience our immersive, story-driven Platformer about a candle trying to save it's candle world.
rows.description_html: FICKLE FLAME We invite you to experience our immersive, story-driven Platformer about a candle trying to save it's candle world.  Play as the candle brother or candle sister. Explore, meet interesting characters, fight enemies. All to attempt to clear the candle world of the threatening fog and return it to its former happiness.   INTRODUCTORY BIOME This Game covers an introductory biome, in which the player becomes familiar with the moody Waxland. It is completely free and ment to receive the players feedback as well as their interest in a continuation of the full story of this game.   STORY SNIPPET (NON SPOILER) You find yourself in a world of living candles. Where life is simple. Old and young candles spend their day enlightening each others habitats. As it is a candles duty to bring light to its world, for as long and bright as it can! ... One day, however, a gray fog befell this happy candle world. The air became heavy and dusty. To survive in these conditions the candles started to burn their lifeforms away quicker when exposed to this unwelcome fog of death. ...   WHO IS DEVELOPING FICKLE FLAME? We are a group of Indie Game Developers from Poland and Germany. Currently consisting of 3 people, an Artist, Coder and Sound Designer.  SirPine  - the Artist. Introduced the project and re-awoken it from its slumber. He drives the project while creating unique and unpolished art that just has the right edge to it. In every of its creations.  Dezt  - the Coder. Plugging every asset and bit of gamelogic in its right spots. Happy to combine the precise world of code and creative world of art. Kuba  - the Sound Designer. Laying all creations into a melodic tune. He brings the final recipe to cook a masterpiece and immerse the player into the feel of the game. Developing in our free time and trying our best to deliver the immersive, moody and story driven Platformer that we aim for.  No publisher behind it. The Game will initially support the english, polish and german languages.
