rows.name: Slap 'em UP!
rows.short_description: Get in on the casual party card game where every hand is a chance to roast your friends! Slap them down with the higher cards, blast them with mocking stickers, or drop emotes they won’t forget. Dress to impress and make your way to the crown. Who’s the real king now?
rows.description_html: Get in on the casual party card game where every hand is a chance to roast your friends! Slap them down with the higher cards, blast them with mocking stickers, or drop emotes they won’t forget. Dress to impress and make your way to the crown. Who’s the real king now? Easy rules, anyone can play, instant fun! A well-known classic card game, with simple rules you can understand in just a few minutes. Just play your cards at the right moment, and you could be the winner! Let loose with emojis & hilarious stickers! Mock your opponents with funny cutscenes during epic moments — whether it’s a win or a surprise comeback. Crush them with hilarious emojis or throw in a cheeky sticker to seal the deal! Play in various modes, either with random players or your group of friends. Enjoy both global matchmaking and private rooms for fun with up to 4 friends. Perfect for both serious players and those looking to chill with friends. Make it yours, make it epic. Customize cards, characters, and effects to create your own iconic look. Every match feels fresh when it's in your style.

rows.short_description: War Grid Hero is a turn-based card battle game developed by an independent creator. In the game, players must deploy cards to occupy zones, earning points to defeat their opponents.
rows.description_html: War Grid Hero is a turn-based card battle game developed by an independent creator. In the game, players must deploy cards to occupy zones, earning points to defeat their opponents. The game features three main modes。 Online Mode Engage in battles against other players. Host a match or search for an online match as a guest. Currently, 1v1 battles and a basic mode are supported. Guide Mode Learn the game mechanics and familiarize yourself with card characteristics. Intuitive equipment system allowing various different builds Devilish puzzles, left everywhere by the cunning Doc Scratch A NewGame+ mode to test your skills while enjoying a different game experience.

From swift assassins to elemental sorceresses—pick your perfect battle companion. Rich Skill Combos Unlock over 20 active and passive skills. Bullet storms, traps, area explosions… freely combine them to create your ultimate soul-reaping arsenal! Pixel Art Beauty Retro pixel graphics blended with detailed lighting effects. rows.name: SimShock2025
rows.short_description: SimShock2025 is a free, bilingual (EN/ES) hemodynamic shock simulator. Treat cardiogenic, hemorrhagic, and septic shock using real drugs and interventions. Written in PureBasic, available for Mac and Windows. Apple-signed and notarized.
rows.description_html: SimShock2025 is a shock simulation game. This is a game based on hemodynamic simulation of shock. It is based on real pathophysiology, but with numerous liberties to make it playable and fun. There are 3 disease modes: Hypertensive cardiogenic shock, Hemorrhagic shock and Distributive shock. They are initiated by pressing their respective buttons: Heart Failure, Hemorrhage, and Shock. There are 9 therapeutic buttons: Dopamine, Furosemide, Nitroglycerin,  Saline (0.9% saline solution), Amiodarone, Propranolol, Desfibrillator, Transfuse and Antibiotics The player can start the simulation by clicking on the Heart Failure, Hemorrhage, or Distributive Shock buttons. Then, using the therapeutic buttons, the goal is to stabilize and cure the patient. During gameplay, cardiac arrest events may occur, requiring immediate defibrillation. In cases of hemorrhage, transfusions are necessary to achieve recovery. In septic shock, you will need to prescribe the correct antibiotics to treat the infection. If you find it complicated, you can call the ICU, which, depending on the patient's age and bed availability, will take them away... or maybe not. There are several additional controls available: Turn the vital signs monitor on or off. Display a background image on the monitor (right-click on the vital signs monitor). Reset the game using the green button on the ECG and respiratory monitor. Switch between different doctors and mute the heartbeat sound by clicking on the doctor image. Adjust simulation speed with a slider available only on Macintosh. (This feature could not be programmed for Windows.) The game is available in both English and Spanish: You can switch languages manually by pressing the specific language button inside the game. The game was written in PureBasic on Apple Macintosh, and compiled for Mac and Windows. This game is signed and notarized by Apple, so it should open without any security warnings. The software is free.

rows.name: BurnerSphere
rows.short_description: BurnerSphere is an immersive social VR experience where players explore VR documentary content filmed at Burning Man. Navigate iconic art installations, engage with interactive workshops, and connect with friends or meet new ones to go on adventures. Experience Burner Culture like never before!
rows.description_html: Get ready to dive into the digital dust of BurnerSphere! Created by BRCvr in collaboration with Burning Man Project, this isn’t your typical VR experience—it's a fully immersive, interactive documentary that lets YOU explore Black Rock City and its vibrant communities from anywhere in the world! Team up with friends, discover iconic art installations, join interactive workshops, and connect with others in real-time. With stunning 360° and 180° videos, detailed virtual environments, and endless opportunities for spontaneous social interaction, BurnerSphere captures the spirit of Burning Man and inspires creativity and community year-round. Ready to burn bright? Let’s go! Set up account at our website and link that account with 6 digit code.

rows.name: The Mountain And The Moron
rows.short_description: The Mountain and The Moron is a 3D Rage Platformer about a Uncle who is down on his luck, and watches a podcast telling him to 'Climb a mountain to become Enlightened'.

Located near the city of Uncleville, Mount Onkle, a previous attraction for the city. After years of neglect, the mountain's platforms are falling apart, making the mountain very dangerous. It has yet to claim a life, so don't be the first! You play as Uncle Dagobert, a local Uncle with no climbing experience. You will try and fail to reach the top of the mountain. You are 'assisted' by other strange characters who watch and record you trying to reach the top! --FEATURES -- 2 challenging levels Plenty of game modifiers that change up you experience in fun and unique ways Ragdolls! Secret codes that add fun Easter eggs to the game Difficult platforming in risky spots A built in timer! This game was made a student project :) -RasberryPi

rows.name: The Falling Star
rows.short_description: The Falling Star is a first-person exploration and narrative-driven walking simulator. Following the mother's last wish, the girl embarks on a journey in a dream to uncover the story of her missing aunt’s past.
rows.description_html: The Falling Star is a short, atmospheric first-person narrative adventure set in a fragmented dreamscape. You play as a young girl, journeying through a surreal memory world shaped by grief, love, and unanswered questions. After your mother’s passing, you follow her final wish—to uncover the truth behind your missing Aunt Jiang, and in doing so, begin to understand the family stories left unspoken. A Short, Emotional Journey Designed to be completed in around 20–30 minutes , The Falling Star offers a focused, emotionally resonant experience. Perfect for players who enjoy introspective storytelling and atmospheric exploration. Explore a Dreamlike World Wander through beautifully crafted environments that blur the line between memory and imagination. From quiet bedrooms to abandoned factories and the remains of a once-bustling town, each area reflects pieces of the past waiting to be pieced together. Solve Environmental Puzzles Uncover clues hidden in the world—handwritten notes, old objects, and family relics. Light puzzle-solving is used to guide your journey and encourage thoughtful exploration. A Story Told Through Objects Instead of lengthy cutscenes, the narrative unfolds through environmental storytelling . Examine everyday items and listen to the protagonist’s inner thoughts as she reflects on her family’s history. A Meditative Soundscape Accompanied by original gentle music and ambient sound design, the experience invites players to slow down, feel, and remember. If you appreciate narrative-driven games like What Remains of Edith Finch , Gone Home , or To the Moon , The Falling Star offers a similarly heartfelt tale in a compact and accessible format. No combat. No time limits. Just you, your memories, and the stars. Chase the star, while you still can.

rows.name: Electoral Carnage
rows.short_description: Electoral Carnage is an absurd 2D fighting game featuring America's most famous (and infamous) politicians. If you don't download it you hate America. Also JFK can assassinate himself. What more do you need to know?
rows.description_html: Electoral Carnage is a 2D fighting game featuring American Presidents. The game has an emphasis on comedy, movement, and easy to learn, hard to master gameplay. Blood, Guts, Supers From the historical, to the offensive, to the intentionally stupid, every fighter has been blessed with an absurd, balls to the walls super move that will have you and all your friends laughing. Since every super one-shots your opponent, Electoral Carnage is a game about getting your super and landing it first, leading to lightning fast gameplay and quick salty rematches. Movement Mania As lifelong fighting game fans, we've pulled inspiration from fighting games across genres to give each character unique and deeply expressive movement. Dash dance with Obama, air-assault with Teddy Roosevelt, and wavedash with JFK! The American (Fighting Game) Dream Our game has no combos. Instead, after landing a hit, you'll be thrust back into neutral, reemphasizing your movement and giving your one-shot supers even more impact. The unique gameplay loop allows for a fighting game that aims to bridge the gap between competitive and casual players; allowing the sweats to grind out stylish movement tech, but inevitably letting the noobs win a game or two with a lucky super.

rows.description_html: Price of Obsession is a game created by a single developer, where you control a character who, after wanting to make changes in their life, meets new people and shapes both their lives and their own. The game is inspired by adult visual novels and some of the best choice-based story games.

Learn how to cook pizza and make great pizzas. Box your pizzas and serve them to tables. Cook and serve new pizza varieties as you earn money. You should prepare your pizzas quickly and put them in the oven. Get the missing ingredients. Fill your refrigerators.

rows.name: Bloodquest From HELL
rows.short_description: Bloodquest From Hell is a first person exploration game made in Unreal Engine. You play as a humble fry cook, who must journey through a mysterious portal in order to keep your job.
rows.description_html: Underpaid and overworked—hell might be better than the burger joint. Bloodquest From Hell is a first-person exploration puzzle game set in a grotesque dimension of meat, fire, and minimum wage. Developed as a senior project at Ringling College of Art and Design’s Game Art department, the game blends surreal puzzles with an aesthetic inspired by 1980s horror and fantasy films. You play as a fry cook teetering on the edge of unemployment. When a mysterious portal opens behind the grill, your only shot at keeping your job is to step through—and get cooking. Key Features: First-Person Exploration: Navigate a grotesque otherworld filled with meat corridors, and strange denizens. Puzzle-Focused Gameplay: Solve bizarre environmental puzzles to gather infernal ingredients and unlock new areas of this nightmare. Interactive Narrative: Make deals and trade with the inhabitants of hell—some friendly, some… less so. Retro 1980s Aesthetic: Inspired by the visual flair of 1980s and cult classics. The portal's open, the fryer’s cold, and hell is hungry. Time to clock in.

rows.name: Living Pipes
rows.short_description: A narrative-driven first-person puzzle game set in the dystopian future of 2080. Take on the role of a maintenance worker investigating strange malfunctions in a crumbling apartment building, where nothing is as it seems.
rows.description_html: Hired to fix a building, paid too much to ask why. In Living Pipes , a first-person narrative mystery game created as a senior project at Ringling College of Art and Design, you are sent to a remote building under mysterious circumstances. What starts as a routine repair job quickly unravels into something far more unsettling. Explore, repair, and uncover the truth. Navigate dimly lit corridors and strange, decaying rooms using your scanning and repair tools to restore broken infrastructure—fix electrical systems, seal pipe leaks, and reconnect disrupted networks. But as your tasks progress, the environment becomes increasingly unnatural, and you're forced to question the real reason you're here. Key Features: First-Person Exploration : Immersive atmospheric environments powered by Unreal Engine 5. Narrative Mystery : Piece together the story through found documents, audio logs, and environmental storytelling. Puzzle Mechanics : Use diagnostic tools to identify faults and solve spatial and logic-based puzzles tied to the building’s systems. Unsettling Progression : As you dig deeper, the building—and whatever controls it—begins to resist your presence. Will you finish the job… or find out what really lives behind the walls?

rows.short_description: A psychological horror game that centers on exploration, puzzle-solving, and terrifying entity encounters
rows.description_html: Dreamlocked is a 3D psychological horror game where you and up to three others descend into surreal, procedurally generated dream layers filled with fear, puzzles, and unknown entities. Each session features randomized objectives, unpredictable monster behaviors, and unsettling environments that evolve as you progress. Features include: Procedurally generated levels with recurring and random threats Solo or 4-player online co-op gameplay Adaptive AI entities that stalk, hunt, and react dynamically Puzzle-solving and exploration Resource-based inventory and survival mechanics Your goal is to descend, administer the antidote, and escape alive if you can.

rows.name: Decaying Memories
rows.short_description: Spot the difference in the 3 given photos and survive for six minutes! Take too long to spot enough discrepancies and you lose to the fear meter!
rows.description_html: You are presented with 3 photos, if all three are the exact same move on and press the next button. If Any image has a discrepancy, meaning something is different about it compared to the others, press the burn button and burn it. This process is then repeated until the ingame clock has reached 6:00. You can't take too long however because you constantly have a meter that rises, if it fills completely you lose, but if you guess correctly when spotting the difference in the photos, your meter goes down. If you're having a hard time seeing something in a photo, the magnifying glass allows you to zoom in and out.

rows.name: Hack Back
rows.short_description: Breach networks, plant malware, steal secrets, and outsmart digital defenses in a real-time strategy campaign that teaches cybersecurity through immersive, hands-on gameplay—no experience or skills needed!
rows.description_html: Hack Back is a real-time strategy game that teaches offensive and defensive cybersecurity concepts through intuitive, hands-on gameplay. No textbooks, no terminals, and no prior experience required—just jump in and start hacking. As you command your team through an engaging campaign, you’ll infiltrate networks, deploy malware, defend infrastructure, and outsmart corporate adversaries in a battle for digital dominance. Learn by doing as you uncover the story of a rogue hacker who turns against the very megacorp they once served. Each mission introduces real-world cyber principles—like DDoS attacks, intrusion detection, and lateral movement—presented in a way that's approachable, fast-paced, and fun. Key Features: Simple Cybersecurity Learning : Grasp complex concepts through gameplay—no coding or tech skills required. RTS Meets Cyber Warfare : Generate resources, launch attacks, build defenses, and adapt in real-time. Story-Driven Campaign : Follow the journey of a hacker-turned-hero across 8 immersive missions. Unique Units & Abilities : Deploy hackers, engineers, and defenders—each with special powers. Multiplayer Skirmishes (future) : Test your skills against other players in head-to-head cyber battles. Pixel Art Visuals & UI : Enjoy the simple beauty of GameBoy era art. Whether you're a gamer curious about cybersecurity or a cyber pro looking for a relatable world, Hack Back offers a fresh, strategic spin on what it means to learn, play, and win.

rows.name: Zerowake GATES
rows.short_description: Enter a battlefield where madness and desire collide. Pair Espers and Guides for powerful synergy, and join Han Gaon as he uncovers the meteor’s secret and fights to survive a world under alien invasion.
rows.description_html: [ Characters ] Park Mujin/Esper 'What am I, your d*mn puppet? Sit when you say sit, go when you say go?' Alpha energy commands the room and you. Once he marks you, it’s game over: obsession begins Beast-like instincts, especially scent #ObsessiveTop #SizeDifference #DarkTop ------ Seong Yebin/Esper 'The military’s looking for a way to end the Creature crisis. I believe you’re the key.' Control freak Strategic brilliance Smiles when he's about to destroy you #BeautifulTop #SchemingTop #PshycoTop ------ Han Gaon/Guide “Even if it hurts me… I can’t just ignore someone suffering right in front of me.” Mature beyond his years Brilliant, but chooses silence over action Carries the exhaustion of someone who's seen too much #SmartUke #Reserved #NarrativeTwist [ STORY ] When I finally opened my eyes after seven years, something was straddling my body… moving against me. Han Gaon wakes with a shard of meteorite buried deep in his chest. The world he knew is long gone. Now, monstrous alien creatures called 'Creatures' fill the skies, the land, and his vision. Among the infected, only a rare few are born with the ability to suppress the creatures’ power and unleash supernatural strength. They’re called the Awakened. The battlefield belongs to the 'Espers'— men with power, driven by madness. And the only ones who can calm that storm… are the 'Guides'. Men who wield power. And men who know how to handle it. In a world where bonds are forged through submission, desire, protection, and obsession, survival depends on one thing— needing each other completely. ------ Meteorites fired by alien Creatures to invade Earth pierced the atmosphere and crashed across the globe. From the Gates opened by the impact, parasitic monsters poured out relentlessly. Due to the Creatures seeking Earth's life force, almost all of Korea has been devastated. The survivors scattered across the country, forming new survival orders through factions like the Awakened guilds New Tiger, Daybreak Dragon, and Taeul, military organizations such as the 710 Commando, the S.E.M.A Research Institute, and those who belong nowhere—the Wanderers. Why did I gain these powers…? The truth of this chaotic world lies hidden within the shard embedded in my chest! [ Game Description ] Draw cards at random to build your own deck and join the battle. Each Esper card is paired with a Guide card. When you include a connected couple in your deck, they unleash even greater power. In a battlefield where madness and pleasure collide, you must fight alien creatures and find the most effective pairings to survive. Between battles, a dangerous and provocative story unfolds— centered on the protagonist Han Gaon, and the tangled fates of Espers and Guides. Uncover the secret behind the meteor fragment in his chest and fight to save a world in ruins. [ Game Features ] Battle System & Survival Strategy Deploy Espers and Guides into battle for every fight Your choices determine each action—plan your attacks wisely Use couple synergy to form optimal strategies and survive to the end Deep Worldbuilding & Rich Story Enter a deadly universe of madness, obsession, pleasure, and longing Between battles, unlock the captivating story of Han Gaon and the Espers Take on story missions to uncover the alien invasion hidden within the fragments Diverse Characters & Strategic Deckbuilding Build your deck with random card draws Pair Esper and Guide cards to strengthen couple synergy Activate couple bonuses and special skills to claim victory in battle

rows.name: RedMoon : IDLE RPG
rows.short_description: 『RedMoon : IDLE RPG』 is a medieval fantasy idle RPG featuring an adorable hero growing under a crimson moon. Enjoy automatic battles, defeat bosses, collect resources, and upgrade equipment, all enhanced by charming 2D pixel graphics.
rows.description_html: 『RedMoon : IDLE RPG』 is an idle RPG featuring the adventures of a hero growing stronger with the mystical power of the red moon. Players can experience endless growth and exciting progression as they defeat a variety of charming monsters and powerful bosses. Grow stronger even while idle! Embark on an enchanting journey accompanied by adorable monsters crafted with captivating 2D pixel art, and enjoy relaxed yet deeply satisfying gameplay. ✅ Easy Idle Gameplay & Boss System Your character continuously grows and battles automatically without requiring complex controls. Defeat waves of monsters to summon formidable field bosses, then conquer them to progress to higher stages filled with valuable resources and generous rewards! ✅ Collect and Enhance Diverse Equipment & Skills Gather various pieces of equipment and unique skills as you progress through stages. Strengthen and customize your hero to enjoy the rewarding sensation of constant growth and empowerment. ✅ Exciting Raids & Dungeon Challenges Beyond regular stage adventures, exciting raids and challenging dungeons await you, filled with special equipment and rare rewards. Engage in strategic battles against powerful foes, accelerate your hero's growth, and experience deeper, thrilling gameplay!

rows.name: DETRA
rows.short_description: DETRA is a story-rich supernatural horror game where you follow the story of Vir and Druxy, a scientist couple who delve into an abandoned laboratory, in search of a cure for an illness that Druxy has got. Follow along as the trip ends up revealing more about their relationship than was intended.
rows.description_html: Vir and Druxy. Druxy and Vir. Vir would do anything for the woman that he loved. And Druxy knew that. Vir and Druxy go on an expedition to explore an abandoned laboratory, in search for a cure to treat a mystery illness that Druxy has come down with. It becomes Vir’s responsibility to explore the eerie floors of the building and complete his goal of saving the one that he loves. Little does he know, Druxy has another plan up her sleeve. FEATURES Compelling storytelling and characters: The story of DETRA spans four in-game days, with intriguing twists and turns. Stealth mechanics and difficulty: Switch between first-person and third-person cameras as you avoid glaring security cameras, explore the four different levels and complete your mission to save Druxy. Atmospheric graphics: Enjoy a dark 3D atmosphere and beautiful 2D graphics. CONTROLS The controls can be changed in the game, but these are the defaults. Movement: WASD Interact: E Run: Left Shift Sneak: Ctrl Camera Swap: G – Default FOV: 90 Default sens: 2

rows.name: Cards of Fortune
rows.short_description: A co-op rogue-like where strategy and chaos meet ! Battle monsters and gods in a magical universe, upgrade your deck, and survive hellish rooms in this tactical multiplayer bullet hell.
rows.description_html: Cards of Fortune is a cooperative multiplayer game blending rogue-like , deckbuilding , bullet hell , and real-time strategy . Play as a cartomancer and venture into an ancient world filled with magicians, dragons, and forgotten deities. Room by room, you’ll face hordes of enemies or take part in unpredictable events. Each victory rewards you with a new spell card, strengthening your magical arsenal with more than 30 unique spells . Sharpen your tactics— mana and health management are key to survival. Every 10 rooms , a terrifying boss blocks your path. Fight alongside your allies all the way to the final battle against the divine forces of chaos . Designed for cooperation, Cards of Fortune offers high replayability thanks to the wide variety of enemies (40+), room configurations, and custom challenges. It’s perfect for fun and strategic gaming sessions with friends. ✦ Platforms : Windows, Linux ✦ Languages : French, English ✦ Cooperative Multiplayer ✦ Art direction inspired by Final Fantasy and Undertale

rows.short_description: Chill out with a third-person, physics-based golf game set to relaxing LoFi music.  Explore dreamy, atmospheric maps with the freedom to find your own path. Will you risk a tricky shortcut or play it safe? Every shot counts, complete each course before running out of strokes!
rows.description_html: LoFi Golf is a chill, third-person, physics-based golf game set to relaxing LoFi music. Your goal is to complete five maps using the limited number of shots available. Choose your preferred difficulty level, explore atmospheric maps, and build your strategy to succeed! Improve your skills in Training Mode. Once you complete a map, progress to the next one. Enjoy highly interactive environments full of creative paths and surprises!

rows.name: Tails of the North
rows.short_description: Explore northern lands and it's inhabitants as a young cat. Begin unraveling the mystery of a spirit's disappearance.
rows.description_html: Tails of the North  is a third person story-focused adventure and exploration game. You're a young cat, a survivor from a cat colony ravaged by unstable forces of nature, and you've been given a task to find out what happened. After escaping your shattered home, you found yourself following a pair of ravens who carry the symbol of Hovialis on their feathers. Offering your help, you begin to uncover the truth to why the natural order is out of balance. Create your cat! Choose from plenty of fur colors, eye colors, and ear and tail shapes to give your cat an unique look, and follow the adventure of a main character [b]you[/b] want to see! Explore the world! Walk around the beautiful, northern landscape, scale the tall mountainside, or climb up an ancient tree to see everything  - the choice is yours! Meet quirky characters! Along with a buddy of your choosing, you can meet up to 6 unique characters all over the world! You can talk with them to get to know them better, and some may even have a quest for you. Talk to them at different moments of the story to read dialogue you might otherwise miss! Learn new skills! With the help of a mentor, you can learn to use your paws for more than just walking; you can break branches and stones! Clean up the temple site, and find mysteries hidden beneath the rubble.

A robot and a raccoon embark on a short adventure that they can only make it through together. Solve puzzles and navigate a post-human world to reveal a wordless story of disregard and abandonment. Key Features: Co-op - Two-player, local cooperative gameplay Puzzles - Use each character's unique abilities to solve puzzles Exploration - Discover lush environments while you travel into an abandoned city Meaningful Play - Consider the impact of play in a subtle cautionary tale about climate change

rows.name: Subspace Reticulum
rows.short_description: Blow up bots beyond the stars. AI Driven 2D Spaceship Warfare
rows.description_html: Subspace Reticulum is a work-in-progress, proof-of-concept research project that channels the chaotic 2D spaceship combat of Subspace Continuum into an offline, AI-driven experience. Born from a deep love for the classic multiplayer mayhem, this preview offers a bold glimpse into a much larger vision—an alternative Subspace universe powered by revolutionary AI. This project attempts to immortalize the feeling  Continuum  once provided, in a timeless experience, always available without the need for servers or an internet connection. Blast through a handcrafted map that pays homage to iconic Subspace base warfare, with every chokepoint, corridor, and open stretch built for heart-pounding dogfights. Enhanced with vibrant particle effects, this nostalgic yet modern battlefield sets the stage for intense, tactical deathmatches that test your reflexes and cunning. As a research project, Subspace Reticulum is an effort to push the boundaries of AI in gaming. Its Transformer based neural network drives NPCs that don’t just fight—they adapt, strategize, and behave with an almost human flair. These dynamic opponents create unpredictable, replayable encounters, making every match feel fresh and alive. This is just the beginning, a teaser of a grander experience yet to come. Whether you’re a Subspace veteran with a nostalgic craving, or a newcomer hungry for innovation, Subspace Reticulum invites you to dive into this early preview. Strap in, take the helm, and experience the future of AI-driven combat—a thrilling taste of a galaxy-spanning adventure still in the making! The current preview is just the start, and I’m hard at work expanding this proof-of-concept into a richer, more dynamic experience. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s on the horizon: • New Ship Types: Get ready to pilot a variety of ships, each with unique handling characteristics. Stay tuned as I continue to evolve Subspace Reticulum, building toward the ultimate AI-driven Subspace experience! rows.name: Prima Materia XXV
rows.short_description: Stylizovaná lokální mlátička z temné fantasy Prahy. Prima Materia propojuje surové souboje s alchymií, chaosem a módou. Zahraj si za 3D nasnímané ikony české rapové a fashion scény.
rows.description_html: A local multiplayer brawler from the streets of Prague Prima Materia is an experimental 3D fighting game created as part of the Fashion Week 2025 Tobias Equipment showcase. A stylistically uncompromising brawler with a unique aesthetic — reminiscent of classic fighters like Mortal Kombat , but reimagined through the lens of fashion and alchemy. The game features characters based on real icons of the Czech rap and fashion scenes, captured through 3D scanning and transformed into avatars of chaos within a dark fantasy version of Prague. Each fighter is a vessel of destruction — and a victim of it. ⸻ ✦ LEGENDARY LORE According to legend, a secret group of alchemists once operated beneath the cobbled streets of Prague. They uncovered the mystery of Prima Materia — the primal chaotic substance from which all matter is born. Realizing its immense power, the alchemists split the substance into several relics, each containing a fragment of chaos. These relics held transformative powers — from reshaping bodies to defying death — and ultimately ignited a war. Now, the streets of Prague have become blood-soaked arenas, where the fight for power, identity, and survival continues. ⸻ ✦ GAME FEATURES • Local multiplayer for 2 players • Fast and brutal combat in the spirit of classic fighters • Real-time 3D scans of real-life personalities • Stylized environments inspired by gothic Prague ⸻ Chaos is the cause… and the consequence. Enter the arena. And restore the order.

rows.name: Parallel
rows.short_description: Parallel is a stealth-based survival horror sci-fi game where you must unravel the mysteries of what happened on a local space station. Can discover the experiments that took place here and live to tell the tale?
rows.description_html: PARALLEL Parallel is a linear survival horror game developed by a group of Algonquin Students. The game has a strong emphasis on stealth and evasion. Intended for fans of Sci-fi and Horror, Parallel will take advantage of Unreal Engine 5 to create an immersive experience that will get your heart pumping. STORY You are an engineer responding to a fellow corporate space station distress signal. Once you land, you are immediately familiar with how dire the situation truly is. Explore deeper into the station discovering the remains of its crew and the experiments that led to their untimely demise. Can you contain the experiments gone wrong or will you succumb to the same fate as your fallen comrades? GAMEPLAY As you explore the station, you discover a machine that aids you change the fabric of reality. Using this newfound power, you continue to explore the station, phasing through materials and bypassing obstacles throughout the station. While exploring the space station, you will encounter varied and numerous encounters with the monsters that roam the halls and malfunctioning security defences that view you as a target. Along the way, you will find other inventions left by the crew that can be used to distract the monster or even interfere with both the creatures and the security system.  The monster's keen hearing and poor eyesight leave opportunities to exploit its blind spots, just don't get caught in the crossfire. Using everyday objects found throughout the room you crawl through, you can use its greatest strength against it. FEATURES With a plethora of accessibility settings, the game is playable by a wide variety of players. Colorblind modes, independent audio controllers, different methods to play the game, and forgiving save allow for a tailor-made experience for every gamer out there. FUTURE The game is actively being developed with plans to release a VR port soon, all feedback to help mould the game into something we will all be proud of is always appreciated.

rows.name: Mantle
rows.short_description: Alert! It’s time to rise to the occasion. Every nut and bolt is fitted. Every high-tech gadget is primed. Step forth, Mantle, and become the greatest superhero robot ever…hopefully. Face off against good and evil and discover who the true villain of your story is.
rows.description_html: Mantle is a 2D first-person narrative superhero simulation game with turn-based puzzle-like combat. Face off against a wide host of heroes and villains! Witness headlines in the news that respond to your actions as a superhero robot in a proud and egotistical world . Behold, as the pressure and expectations of being a hero... Can lead to a place no one ever expected .          Minigames that dictate the power of your high-tech gadgetry and skills to defend yourself Careful decision-making in turn-based strategy combat – Kill , or Capture ? Mercy , or Safety ? Interact with a desktop to drive the game’s story through news outlets and emails Colorful, interactable comic-book sequences Hybric Energy, a source of energy whose origin is unknown to the masses. Its incredibly versatility has led to the rapid development and prosperity of the city, Amourtia. A proud city that celebrates its heroes and sneers at its villains. That is not to say that Amourtia lives “above the clouds.” Every day, there are those who seek to prove themselves as one of the great. It is a city of dreams and ego. Opportunities can come from anywhere for those with ambition. But sometimes, the pressure of always winning can be too much. Become the Superhero Robot As Mantle, you control all the machinery. You decide the best course of action, and you manipulate your gadgetry to achieve the desired outcome. Experience a plethora of minigame-challenges through various gadgets that rely on your skill in order to do what needs to be done. Are you up to the task? Experience the Hero's Dilemma: Where do you stand?

rows.name: Ye Guild Clerk!
rows.short_description: The local Adventurer's Guild is hiring!... Not for adventurers, but for guild clerks! You play an important role in handing out quests, gold, and equipment as your actions shape the stories of these animal adventurers for better, or for worse..!
rows.description_html: Ye Guild Clerk! is a short 2.5D, interactive narrative game, where you play as a newly hired guild clerk in a world full of cute animal adventurers! Perfect for players who love character-driven stories, cute animals, and cozy medieval fantasy worlds. Features Meet a cast of cute animal adventurers, each with their own stories and quirks! Have 5 days to prove you're a good fit for the role! .. or suffer the consequences and get fired... As a guild clerk, you'll hand out quests, rewards and equipment!...  But be wary: Your choices matter , each action you take shapes the outcomes and stories for each adventurer you run into... for better or for worse! Over 40+ individual endings between all of the adventurers you can meet! Decorate your clerk booth with various customizations and decorations!  Select from 3 different music tracks to listen to! Controls: Point & Click Controls - Drag, Select, & Camera Movement WASD/Arrow Keys - Camera Movement Click/Space - Continue Dialogue ESC - Pause/Settings Menu Please Note: There is no current way to save your progress . It is highly recommended to play in one sitting. The average playthrough can take from 35 - 50 minutes.

rows.name: Sky Die
rows.short_description: Sky Die is a 2D brawl that drops two-to-four players from tall heights, quickly approaching the bottom. Will you be the first to reach the finish line? Or will you succumb to traps scattered around the skies?
rows.description_html: Sky Die is a 2D brawl that drops two-to-four players from tall heights, quickly approaching the bottom. Will you be the first to reach the finish line? Or will you succumb to traps scattered around the skies? There are three different stages to choose from: Factory: Saw blades and pistons decorate this mechanical arena. Dodge them all and try not to get squished! Ocean: Plunge into the depths of the ocean where schools of fish call home. Look out, though! They’re not here to make (more) friends. Jungle: This green landscape is home to various traps, including viscous monkeys. Did you steal their bananas or something? Each “sky-dier” is equipped with a unique ability to secure their spot in the skies. Here’s your lineup: Robot: This mecha menace can project a force field that blocks the next hit taken. Nothing gets past this machine. Diver: The diver is no stranger to the seas. During one of their travels, they found a pet! The diver can launch an opponent-seeking squid that disables the opponent’s abilities. Explorer: The explorer and his bird are inseparable. This character can transform into a nimble bird to traverse around traps with ease. Lizard: This lizard isn’t any ordinary lizard, but instead one of the lightning variety. The lizard sends out a bolt of lightning that can briefly stun opponents. On top of their abilities, each character has a dash that can be charged and released to quickly escape peril… or send your friends towards it! Powerups can also be found in these dangerous skies: Slow Down: Opponents’ move speed becomes slower for a short period of time. Switcheroo: Opponents disappear and reappear in randomly swapped positions. Shocked: Opponents cannot use any actions for a short period of time. Safe Zones: Safe zones appear that opponents must remain in until they expire. If they are too late, they will become stunned. Well, what are you waiting for? Grab your controller, invite your friends, and be the last one falling!

rows.name: Terrors to Unveil - Intrusion
rows.short_description: David Hopster, a 15-year-old high school student, has just been left home alone for the weekend while his parents head out of town. At first, everything seemed normal. He had no idea how quickly things would spiral.
rows.description_html: Terrors to Unveil is a series-based psychological horror game that immerses players in disturbing stories, each one unraveling the terrifying stories of those who lived to tell their experiences. This is the first episode in the series: Episode 1:  Terrors to Unveil - Intrusion David Hopster, a 15-year-old high school student, has just been left home alone for the weekend while his parents head out of town. At first, everything seemed normal. He spent the day enjoying his freedom. But by nightfall, strange things started happening. The Gameplay This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration, and conversation mechanics. Key Features Atmospheric environment and photo-realistic graphics. 2 Endings VHS film aesthetic. Interact with NPCs. Player voice activity.

rows.name: Bound in Time
rows.short_description: A two player, co-op horde shooter with a sci-fi, futuristic twist – play as two heroes, a cyborg and a samurai, working together to defend worlds across space and time from invasions of creatures. As levels are explored, upgrade each character’s abilities in order to take on enemies and a boss!
rows.description_html: Controller Needed Player 1 can use a Mouse and Keyboard but player 2 must use a controller to be able to play. Player 2 can only control menus when they're selecting Hexes or Upgrading About the Game Bound in Time is a two player, co-op horde shooter with a sci-fi, futuristic twist – play as two flashy heroes with a number of abilities, a cyborg and a samurai, working together to defend worlds across space and time from invasions of creatures and monsters. As levels are explored and cleared, upgrade each character’s abilities in order to take on harder enemies and bosses! Join together in a local coop where one of you will play as Lux the high fire power cyborg and Hikari the highly mobile Samurai. You will have a number of cooperative actions to help you through such as medkits to heal each other, revive the other in their time of need and use your abilities to kill and stun enemies when your partner needs it. Take on hordes of creatures which different features such as spitting acid and holding the player down. 3 levels to complete, take on waves of the horde in the old ruins, fight through a burning village on the fire plant and make it to the castle to take on Egon the evil Knight and save time from falling under his control.

rows.name: Samurai's path
rows.short_description: Idle gacha collection game set in a dojo. Train through skill-based minigames, collect and fuse hundreds of unique blades tradeable on the market. Follow your own path and become a Samurai.
rows.description_html: You’ve just arrived in town. The soft spring air lifts the cherry blossoms around you, and for the first time in a long while, you feel you’re fighting for something honorable. As you step inside your temple, it’s time to train and prepare for what lies ahead. Samurai’s Path is an experimental game that evolves alongside its community. Your journey begins with the following: Train with Mini-Games Every few hours, you’ll receive new missions. Embark on small training challenges and earn a Katana Box for each successful completion. Grow Your Katana Collection Discover Katanas inside boxes and expand your collection: from Common and Rare to Epic and Legendary blades. All Katanas can be traded and collected through the Steam Market . First set of Seasonal Katanas F our honoring Amaterasu , and four dedicated to Susanoo, will not be dropping after the season two releases. Only available as drop in Limited Boxes Amaterasu and Susanoo In the ancient tales, Amaterasu , the radiant goddess of the sun, embodies honor, clarity, and creation, her light guiding every true samurai’s path. Susanoo , her tempestuous brother, commands storms and chaos, testing the strength of all who seek mastery. Their eternal balance between order and fury shapes the soul of every blade forged in Samurai’s Path , whether it shines with divine grace or strikes with untamed power. Special Katana Boxes Vanilla Box The original boxes of Samurai’s Path . Contain Katanas following standard drop rates. Common Katana 70% Rare Katana 27% Epic Katana 3% Limited Box Available only during the first weeks after launch. This limited-edition box offers a higher chance of Epic Katanas and a slight chance to obtain one of the eight Legendary.  Common Katana 27% Rare Katana 60% Epic Katana 10% Legendary Katana (Amaterasu or Susanoo collection) 3% Forge More Katanas Combine three Katanas to forge a new Katana Box. Using rarer Katanas increases your odds of receiving a Limited Box . Limited Box: +5% for each common Katana used +10% for each rare Katana used Vanilla Box: The remaining percentage is related to this box. Example: Forging by using tone common katana (+5%) and two rare katanas (+10% X2). Total rate: 75% Vanilla Box and 25% Limited Box Letter System From time to time, you’ll receive letters from your family or townsfolk. These messages reveal hints of future content and allow you to accumulate wealth and resources for the next stage in the evolution of the game. Founder’s Quest Available only until the next major update , the Founder’s Quest rewards Seals for each completed mission. Obtain the Expanded Book to unlock access to a unique Legendary Katana that hides true power (which will never drop again in the game) and gain exclusive perks. What’s Next Samurai’s Path will continue to evolve with the guidance of its community. Here’s a glimpse of what’s coming in Season 2 : New Legendary Katanas A revamped Letter System featuring hidden easter eggs that unlock limited-edition Legendary blades. The Merchant : Buy Katanas that refresh daily and sell your own for fluctuating coin values. The Gambling House : Test your luck in games of cards, dice, and bluffing while waiting for your next mission. These updates mark the next step in the evolution of Samurai’s Path , introducing character progression and customization that will shape your destiny as a true warrior.

Limited Box: +5% for each common Katana used +10% for each rare Katana used Vanilla Box: The remaining percentage is related to this box. Example: Forging by using tone common katana (+5%) and two rare katanas (+10% X2). These messages reveal hints of future content and allow you to accumulate wealth and resources for the next stage in the evolution of the game. Founder’s Quest Available only until the next major update , the Founder’s Quest rewards Seals for each completed mission. Obtain the Expanded Book to unlock access to a unique Legendary Katana that hides true power (which will never drop again in the game) and gain exclusive perks. What’s Next Samurai’s Path will continue to evolve with the guidance of its community. Here’s a glimpse of what’s coming in Season 2 : New Legendary Katanas A revamped Letter System featuring hidden easter eggs that unlock limited-edition Legendary blades. The Merchant : Buy Katanas that refresh daily and sell your own for fluctuating coin values. The Gambling House : Test your luck in games of cards, dice, and bluffing while waiting for your next mission. These updates mark the next step in the evolution of Samurai’s Path , introducing character progression and customization that will shape your destiny as a true warrior.

rows.name: OiiAi Cat
rows.short_description: A chaotic virtual desktop cat that spins when you type, screams 'OiiAi,' tracks your word count, and rewards your keyboard fury with meme-powered madness.
rows.description_html: OiiAi Cat is a free, fun, and meme-fueled virtual desktop pet that brings chaos and charm to your everyday typing! Whether you're working, studying, or just smashing your keyboard for fun, OiiAi Cat reacts in real-time — spinning wildly, making its iconic 'OiiAi' sounds, and counting every word you type. This is more than a meme — it's a quirky productivity companion with unlockables, achievements, and ridiculous visual flair (coming soon). --------------------------------------------- ✨ Key Features Real-Time Typing Reaction The cat spins whenever you type. Stop typing? It stops spinning. Simple, satisfying, and hilarious. Meme Sound Madness Enjoy the chaotic 'OiiAi' meme audio that plays while typing — you can even unlock alternate sound packs. Typing Word Counter Tracks how many words you’ve typed while the cat is active. Think of it as your productivity (or chaos) score. --------------------------------------------- Whether you want to boost your productivity with a fun twist or just watch a cat spin out of control while yelling “OiiAi!”, this virtual desktop companion is the purr-fect sidekick. And yes — it’s totally free. --------------------------------------------- Get ready to type. Get ready to spin. Get ready for OiiAi Cat . Follow Ethel the oiia cat on Instagram: @oiiacat_ethel

rows.name: Thank You for Your Time
rows.short_description: In a surreal audition purgatory, how long will you wait to be chosen?
rows.description_html: Welcome to the definitive surreal audition purgatory experience! The outside world is a cold, harsh place. That's why you came here. The cavern provides you with a minimum of shelter and  - more importantly -  the hope that you will one day be chosen to receive a place by the enormous fire hidden away in the dark depths below . To be chosen, you will have to impress the inscrutable hooded figures that rule this place, but that is much easier said than done. Nobody has ever seen the Hoods react to an audition before - positively or negatively, or at all, and their Shadow servants never give anything away either. And yet, there's always a chance . So long as you can outwait your competition . Thank You for Your Time  is a visual novella that I made with Ren’Py as a solo dev. It’s a surreal parable where  you make choices as a violinist stuck in an audition purgatory and ultimately answer a difficult question​: how long will you wait for your once-in-a-lifetime opportunity?  The player will have to decide the answer that's right for themselves. I hope this game will be cathartic for anyone who has had to go for an audition or a job interview, or who has just felt stuck - so, most people.  Play duration is about 40 minutes to an hour. The game features a final choice that leads to two different endings, as well as a few smaller choices along the way that also impact the story. All of the images in this game are AI generated. The story and narrative design are my own. This is a passion project that cost me nothing to create. It should cost you nothing to play. That said - the best ways to support me are to share this game with someone who might like it or to review it!  I want to grow as a game designer and storyteller, so it would be invaluable to know what worked for you and what didn't. Created by Alex Laney with Ren'Py  Game Tester / Best Girl: Lena Böse

rows.name: AcroChallenge
rows.short_description: AcroChallenge is a fun and creative word game where you compete against others to make the best phrase that fits a 3 to 7 letter acronym generated by the server.  Race against the clock to create the best phrase.
rows.description_html: AcroChallenge is a simple, yet fun and creative word game where you compete against others to make the best phrase that fits a 3 to 7 letter acronym (ie. 'ABCG') generated by the server.  Race against the clock to create the best phrase (ie. 'Already Been Chewed Gum').  Impress your friends with your wit and intellect, or just entertain them with stupid and funny phrases. You choose how to play - against bots, with Stream friends or make new friends.  If you want simple - one click will get you into a random game.  Or you can create your own game - play against just bots or with only Steam friends (coming soon).  Make it more challenging by including per-round 'Topics' that can be set by the server, game winner, or game creator.  Once in a game you can chat with other players as well.  But don't worry, you can 'mute' them if you don't like what they have to say.

rows.name: All Aboard! The Twilight Train
rows.short_description: All Aboard! The Twilight Train is a first-person narrative-adventure set on an interdimensional train. Explore the train, talk to the passengers, drink carrot juice, and help fellow passengers make it to their destination off this weird train.
rows.description_html: It’s Not Easy to Stay on Track All Aboard! The Twilight Train is a 10-15 minute (give or take a few dozen hours of watching Steamboat Willie on loop) adventure game that takes place on an interdimensional train. You wake up on the train with no memories of who you are or what you are doing on this train. Explore!  Explore each of the nooks and crannies of this 1950s-inspired luxury train (but between dimensions). Talk to each of the passengers, and find secret activities! Narrative!  Enjoy All Aboard! The Twilight Trains' blend of humorous and emotional storytelling. Spend time with such characters as the wacky Conductor, the kooky Bartender, and the quirky Attendant (who are definitely not the same character in a different hat). Along the way, you will learn the emotional story of the Felinis Family as you help them find their lost son, Ruckus. TRASHKETBALL!   Experience the high-octane thrill of our innovative mini-game, “TRASHKETBALL!” The goal is to throw trash into a trash bin and get the high-score (disclaimer: All Aboard! The Twilight Train does not record your score for throwing trash in a trash bin)

rows.name: 呼~/huuu
rows.short_description: Huuu~ is a healing interactive narrative game where players become a breeze, using breath to guide and comfort the protagonist. Drifting through the four seasons, they join in a quiet journey of reflection, emotion, and inner healing.
rows.description_html: 'Huuu~' is a 30-minute healing experience. During the days of recovery from illness, the protagonist begins to communicate with the wind. Guided by the breeze, they embark on a journey through the memories of the four seasons—healing old wounds and awakening the courage to reconcile with themselves. Blending natural aesthetics with adventure and puzzle-solving, the game introduces a unique form of natural interaction: breathing . Players take on the role of a breeze in Hoo~ , accompanying and aiding the protagonist on their journey. The wind has shape and emotion—every breath resonates with the game world. In the game, players control the character’s actions and environmental changes through the intensity and rhythm of their breath. Breathing directly influences the world’s dynamics: a gentle, long breath sets feathers dancing through the air; a steady, short puff pushes the character forward; and a warm exhale can awaken slumbering plants and spirits.

rows.name: Elysian Siege
rows.short_description: Stand in Keziah’s footsteps and heed the Divine Order. Jump your way through, reclaim your goddess’s temple, obliterate enemies, and find the Tear of Creation in this beautiful platformer game!
rows.description_html: Take on the role of Keziah! A newly ascended Enforcer whose duty is to carry out the will of her goddess, Anthea. In this action-fantasy platformer, you'll face deadly enemies and avoid dangerous traps as you delve into a divine temple to fulfill your sacred mission. ● Agile gameplay focused on movement and quick reactions ● A short yet satisfying traversal experience ● Challenging achievements for seasoned adventurers! Jump on enemies or dash through them with a deadly attack to defeat them. Bounce on walls, climb vines, and glide as you venture deeper into the temple, dodging threats with precision. Death is a lesson rather than something to fear — while inside the temple, you'll rise again by Anthea’s power until your task is complete. The temple spirits await your arrival. Save them from the evil corrupting your sacred land! Keziah’s mission is only just beginning… Are you ready to fulfill the divine will?

rows.name: Tiris
rows.short_description: Infiltrate in Tiris Cathedral and recover your beloved's soul in this medieval, lowdark fantasy Top-Down Shooter. Deal with hordes of enemies, solve the puzzles that block your path, and free your loved one and the people from the tyranny of the Necromancer and his commanders.
rows.description_html: Enter the darkness. Fight for his soul. In a world ravaged by the Emerald Plague, death is not the end... it’s only the beginning of corruption. In Tiris, you embody Liria, an alchemist and sorceress determined to defy death itself to save her beloved Narcis, turned into an abomination in the service of a dark Necromancer. Face hordes of infected, solve ancient puzzles, and unravel the cursed secrets of a disgraced cathedral. Isometric Twin-Stick Shooter Combine reflexes and strategy in a fast-paced, intense combat system with cover and shooting mechanics. Use alchemy, magic, and arcane weapons to face increasingly deadly enemies. Explore, Solve, and Survive Between battles, you'll face clearly designed yet profound puzzles that will test your wits in areas filled with traps, secrets, and hidden artifacts. A dark, melancholic and stylized world Discover a unique artistic universe: characters of heroic proportions with stylized textures, soft ambient lighting and decadent settings covered in fog and vegetation. A story of love, death, and redemption Immerse yourself in a tragic and heroic narrative: after the loss of Narcis, Liria embarks on an odyssey through the catacombs and cursed halls of a corrupted cathedral. Her mission: to gather the fragments of her beloved's soul and confront the monster they have turned him into. All while the corruption spreads and the Necromancer prepares his rise to immortality. Player Objective in the Demo Traverse three key areas of the Tiris Cathedral complex. Face the Necromancer and his hordes to win back your beloved. Can you restore his soul... or will you fall like so many others?

rows.name: Inside the Crow´s Nest
rows.short_description: Inside the Crow's Nest is a game inspired by classic survival horror. Explore an ancient monastery, face the terrors hidden within its corridors, and search for a way to escape. Will you survive... or be hunted?
rows.description_html: Inside the Crow 's Nest is a Survival Horror game inspired by old-school genre classics. You play as the Hunter, who awakens in a cell marked with strange symbols, trapped in a cult-infested monastery. To escape, you must survive horrifying cultists, uncover dark secrets, and solve intricate puzzles that block your escape. Nostalgic Survival Horror Feel: Experience tense, atmospheric gameplay with fixed camera angles and tank controls - an homage to the pioneers of the genre. Challenging, Rewarding Puzzles Collect clues, decipher their meaning, and use them to navigate and unlock new areas of the cursed monastery. Relentless Cultists and Monstrous Horrors Face off against twisted followers of The Forgotten One—inhuman abominations warped by devotion to their dark god. A Mystery Waiting to Be Uncovered Delve deep into the monastery’s haunted halls and piece together the chilling history of its inhabitants and their eldritch faith. Will the Hunter escape, or become the next sacrifice?

rows.name: Solitude
rows.short_description: A survival shooter with story elements where you explore a hostile alien world after crash-landing your spaceship. Complete quests and gather the resources needed to escape.
rows.description_html: Produced by Jerboa Interactive A downloadable game for Windows. Solitude was developed by four students over the course of 1.5 years as part of a school project at Humboldt-Gymnasium Potsdam. After crash-landing on a hostile alien world, you must explore, survive, and gather the parts needed to repair your damaged spaceship. Face dangerous environments, hostile machines, and mysterious structures as you fight to escape the planet. Guided (and occasionally insulted) by your ship’s sarcastic AI — “Try not to die again this time, would you?” — you’ll traverse the desert in search of whatever scrap, tech, or ancient alien junk might help get your ship flight-ready. Expect challenges, surprises, and the kind of tough love only a malfunctioning assistant can offer. 'Unbelievable what these four young developers have created in such a short time alongside their final two years of High school. Graphics, atmosphere, gameplay, and mechanics are all on point and provide a solid half hour of fun leading up to an epic finale. A debut title that will hopefully be followed by more projects.' - T. Bauer, Supervisor Seminarkurs GameDevelopment Humboldt-Gymnasium Potsdam

rows.name: Satori | 悟り
rows.short_description: SATORI | 悟り is a game that focuses on feelings of sadness and restlessness. In SATORI | 悟り the player immerses himself in a dream world to go on a inner journey of meditation. Are you ready to begin your journey within?
rows.description_html: Playing Satori | 悟り,  the player loses himself in a dream world to take an inner journey of meditation. The game is based on feelings of sadness and restlessness . These are conveyed through the detailed construction of an iconic world. The gameplay , presented in first-person perspective , features a series of puzzles based on sound effects, space, music, and video . The setting, music, and interaction is made to create a complete and coherent experience, in which the player must find his way around, seeking calm and clarity to find the right path. The story, lyrical and sometimes domestic, is told by pictures and impressions, as much through video, imagery and gameplay. At the same time, the player gets to create his own meditative experience, as the narrative is never intrusive and does not take over immersion. Satori | 悟り  can be played in many ways: the thoughtful and reflective player can shape his own interpretive path, investigating his truth and constructing his own meaning. At the same time, the player who cannot clearly find his path can rely on the clues provided by the creators to help him carry out his meditation path. ⠀ The duration of the game is variable, ranging from 30 to 60 min. To play this game it's recommended to use headphones or good quality speakers because many of the game's puzzles requires you to listen carefully to the music and game effects . ⠀ Are you ready to begin your journey within? ARTISTIC STATEMENT My name is Francesco. When I was about ten years old, my father was bedridden by a chronic illness. This wore down the marriage with my mother, who eventually filed for divorce. So, I remained motionless, watching my father's frustration and my mother's difficulties in rebuilding her life, locking myself in a solitude that I populated with art, literature, movies and especially video games. The exploration of these worlds and their meanings thus stimulated my imagination, which nevertheless always seemed to sketch blurred and imprecise worlds, less clear than a dream. So, I tried to sharpen those images through a path of meditation. I had my first meditation experiences several years ago. Approaching the method of transcendental meditation, I chose the word “satori” as my mantra. At first my choice was guided by a desire to cancel the distance between reality and the world revealed to me during meditative experiences. I used to interpret the idea of enlightenment in this way. But as my meditative path continued, I realised I should have faced my past directly. At this point, my personal life experience became a central point to my meditation, and the world that came out was increasingly dark, lonely and difficult. My name is Matteo. We met when we were about ten years old and shared difficulties and uncertainties, but above all we built together a world of fantasy and art, giving shape to our ghosts. I started studying the literature and the arts that allowed me to delve into the relationship between meaning and its representation. With this approach, I worked on Satori | 悟り , contributing to the development of imagery, graphic design, and the audio compartment. In this development, I tried to express my personal experience and the one shared with Francesco by integrating it with his.

We met when we were about ten years old and shared difficulties and uncertainties, but above all we built together a world of fantasy and art, giving shape to our ghosts. I started studying the literature and the arts that allowed me to delve into the relationship between meaning and its representation. With this approach, I worked on Satori | 悟り , contributing to the development of imagery, graphic design, and the audio compartment. In this development, I tried to express my personal experience and the one shared with Francesco by integrating it with his.

rows.name: Hardly Workin'
rows.short_description: Balance your work and fun in this goofy and chaotic office simulator! Avoid falling asleep on the job by slacking off in the goofiest ways possible. Just don't get caught by your boss Karen!
rows.description_html: Hardly Workin' is a chaotic office sim where you play as Buddy Inepta, a supreme slacker. Your goal? Slack off just  enough to stay awake, dodge your boss, and manage to finish all your work before 5:00 PM. Silly Meter Your Silly Meter keeps you awake. If it hits zero, you'll doze off and get fired! Stay silly to stay employed. Silly Tasks Toss paper, fish into other cubicles, or cook a pizza! Your cubicle is your oyster-explore it and find fun ways to get silly! Evil Karen Boss lady Karen is always  on patrol. Get caught slacking three times and you'll be promoted to customer >:( Work Tasks Finish your work tasks on the computer before 5:00 PM or you're toast! Done early? A clock out button becomes available from your desktop once you're ready to call it a day. Coworker Chit-Chat Coworkers will drop by with questions! Answer correctly and get a big boost to your Silly Meter. Hints are scattered around your cubicle, so keep your eyes peeled!

rows.name: Space Ace
rows.short_description: Space Ace is a 2D top-down shooter that focuses on upgrading your ship to fight through levels of Bosses and smaller enemies. Play with keyboard + mouse or Xbox controller.
rows.description_html: Space Ace is a game in which you control a spaceship and fight through levels of enemies in a 2D top-down shooter set in space. Kill enemies, collect resources, and upgrade your ship to face the hordes of unique enemies and boss-level monsters.  FEATURES Try out different character classes such as the Fighter, Scout, and Tank. Cater the difficulty to your skill level with Easy, Medium, and Hard game modes. Upgrade your ship with 35 unique upgrades. Find special power-up abilities within the game to help you survive. Switch between controlling your character with either keyboard + mouse or Xbox controller. Track your in-game accomplishments with historical data on enemies killed, purchased upgrades, completed runs, and more. Save your runs to return to them later with the in-game save system.

rows.name: Skull8
rows.short_description: A 12-minute hunt for eight lost relics in a procedurally generated labyrinth. Think Minesweeper meets dark fantasy, with leaderboards for the brave.
rows.description_html: Skull8 is a small retro-inspired fantasy experiment. Traverse a procedurally generated labyrinth in search of eight mythical relics. Every screen hides traps, secrets, and subtle clues for the observant. Procedurally generated labyrinth full of mysteries Eight relics of forgotten power Custom 12×12 Char Set text-graphics Online leaderboards for competitive explorers <<Skull8 began as a way to introduce my 8-year-old son to programming. We started in BASIC on the Amstrad CPC, but soon ran into the limits of that old machine. So I ported the project to PC, expanded it, and now, it has found its way onto Steam.>>

rows.name: Fishing Friends 3D
rows.short_description: Bait your hooks and go fishing with friends. Customise your fishing rods for optimal performance to catch giant and legendary fish. Chat in-game with fellow anglers and win competitions and tournaments together. Tight lines!
rows.description_html: Fishing Friends 3D lets you fish your way — whether you’re looking to unwind or crave the thrill of competition. Cast your line and leave your worries behind. Drift through peaceful waters and build your ultimate fish album, discovering new species and legendary trophy fish like the elusive Shadowfin. Prefer a faster pace? Jump into Speed Fishing Contests, battle for the top spot in King-of-the-Spot matches with your fishing club, and compete in 3-day club tournaments for big prizes. Don’t overthink it. Just fish — at your own speed, in stunning 3D worlds full of stories and surprises. 🎣 KEY FEATURES Realistic 3D Environments – Watch fish swim in lifelike waters. What you see is what you catch! True-to-Life Fishing Mechanics – Perfect your timing and technique with authentic angling gameplay. 🔧 UPGRADE & CUSTOMIZE YOUR GEAR Level Up your fishing rods and customise for performance – Earn Rod Skill points after every catch and finetune your rods on Distance, Max Weight, Reel Speed, Accuracy, Cast Speed, Control, and Power. Charge the Reel-in Booster to win your fight even against the strongest fish! Catch Legendary Fish – Do you have what it takes to reel in legendary fish like Shadowfin? 🌎 EXPLORE BEAUTIFUL PINE CREEK Pine Creek (First Location) – A hidden gem in the Rocky Mountains, teeming with Bluegill, Crappies, Perch, Smallmouth Bass, Walleyes, Muskies, and multiple trout species. Legendary Fish Await – Land “Shadowfin” the legendary perch, “Prismflip” the legendary rainbow trout, “Bloop” the legendary Bluegill, “Bottomfeeder Bob” the legendary lake trout, “Mudslide” the legendary Brown Trout, “Shivers” the legendary crappie, and “Tugger” the legendary Smallmouth Bass. Freedom to Roam – Cast from anywhere along the shore and discover secret hotspots. New Locations Coming Soon – Stay tuned for fresh fisheries and exotic destinations to test your angling skill. 🏆 COMPETE & WIN REWARDS Target Fish Challenges – Hone your gear setups to conquer unique challenges. Join 3-Day Tournaments – Battle rival clubs and reel in your biggest catches to earn top spots. Speed Fishing Competitions: A new competitions starts every hour. The top 3 anglers win prizes and glory! COMING SOON: Get ready for King-of-the-Spot events! 👥 SOCIAL FISHING CLUBS Create or Join Clubs – Form your own fishing club or team up with friends in existing groups. Plan your next fishing trips in your exclusive club chat. * Collaborate & Climb – Tackle club tournaments and work together to rise on the leaderboards. 📖 MEET ZAC & PHIL: QUESTS & ADVENTURE * Meet Angler Zac – Learn the basics of fishing through gripping quests and challenges that reward you with super rare bait. * Team Up with Phil – Join a treasure hunter and explorer searching for the lost fortunes of a mysterious mountain expedition. 💰 FISH DEALS FOR EXTRA CASH * Complete Fish Deals – Sell your catches to in-game vendors and earn currency. * Upgrade Your Setup – Use your cash to buy better rods, reels, lures, and more from the shop. 🚀 MORE FEATURES ON THE HORIZON * King-of-the-Spot Competitions – Claim and defend prime fishing locations against rivals. * Go big game fishing in Isla Vela in the Caribbean. This vast new fishing location is coming soon! DOWNLOAD AND PLAY “FISHING FRIENDS 3D” NOW FOR FREE!

rows.name: Mountain's Secret
rows.short_description: This is the sequel to Mountain's Memory. Mountain's Secret is an adventure game where you must escape from mysterious ruins while evading enigmatic dolls. Uncover the secrets left unresolved in the previous story, and reveal the true nature of the mountain.
rows.description_html: It is recommended to play the previous game, 'Mountain's Memory,' before playing this one. ─Synopsis─ While camping, you witnessed a bizarre scene. Feeling threatened, you decided to return home immediately but ended up in an accident. When you regained consciousness, you found yourself confined in a desolate ruin deep in the forest. You must now start exploring in hopes of escaping the ruin… Game Overview This game is a horror adventure where players aim to escape from ruins while being pursued by eerie dolls. Is the doll annoying? Then kick it away! Note: The title screen is always displayed in English to enhance the atmosphere, regardless of the language setting. Note: While this game is an escape game, it does not contain puzzles. Note :When you left-click on 'STORY' on the title screen, you can view the summary of the previous game. Guidelines for streaming Users are allowed to create videos or live streams of this game as long as the following conditions are met. Monetization is also permitted. ─Conditions─ Include the store page URL in the video description. Include the phrase 'Mountain's Secret' in the title. Disclaimer The developer is not responsible for any troubles arising from streaming or gameplay. Game Information Estimated completion time: 30 minutes Number of endings: 2

rows.name: Super-B
rows.short_description: Super-B is a free-to-play multiplayer game with AAA 3D graphics, where players become toy characters in a brick-built world. It features 12+ game modes at launch, offering fast-paced action and social interaction.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Super-B, a colorful social playground! Meet friends, decorate your own space, and dive into exciting games—just like hanging out at a theme park full of fun surprises! 01. Social Activities Decorate your room with furniture and create your own personal space. Invite friends over, share quick co-op activities, or just have fun messing around with emotes. Stay connected by sending notes, writing guestbook messages, and even gifting items to friends. 02. Match-Based Games Take on a wide variety of fast-paced game modes in real time: Battle Royale Team Deathmatch Capture the Flag Bomb Defusal Obstacle Races Hide & Seek Random Weapon Challenge …and many more to come through future updates! 03. Character Customization Express your creativity with over 1,000 parts and items.  Mix and match outfits, hairstyles, hats, pets, and emotes to create a character that’s truly one of a kind. 04. Endless Fun Customize your own space, hang out with friends, or climb the rankings in competitive matches. Whether cooperating or competing, every play session brings fresh new experiences.

rows.name: Underground: Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Underground is a first-person horror-puzzle game where you explore a mysterious subway system, solve deadly puzzles, and escape the creatures lurking in the dark. Will the train take you home—or deeper into the nightmare?
rows.description_html: Environmental Puzzles Use notes, clues, and observations to solve puzzles. Sometimes the answer is right in front of you — and sometimes it’s hidden in the shadows. About the Game Underground is a first-person horror adventure where you wake up lost, with no memory of how you got here — and no idea where 'home' is. As you explore a strange and seemingly abandoned subway system, you begin to uncover notes, clues, and puzzles that guide you from station to station. But you're not alone down there. Survive encounters with terrifying entities that stalk the tunnels. Make decisions that affect your survival, and solve increasingly complex puzzles that block your escape. Each station presents a unique challenge — from tracking down the right medication for a patient under time pressure, to escaping a deadly chase after choosing the wrong item. Key Features: A story-driven single-player horror experience Multiple underground stations , each with its own set of puzzles, atmosphere, and secrets Checkpoints between stations so progress isn’t lost A mix of stealth, puzzle-solving, and decision-based gameplay Dynamic horror elements that react to your choices Minimal UI for full immersion

rows.name: The Wind and the Wisp
rows.short_description: A 3D adventure game about blowing into the microphone. Join the Wind, a non-corporeal petal breeze, and the Wisp, a little white ghost with a red ribbon, on their journey to repair a mysterious broken garden.
rows.description_html: The Wind and The Wisp is an adventure game about two best friends. One who has passed away and awoken as a ghost in a mysterious broken garden. And one who is still alive and misses their friend dearly.  Through the combination of traditional input methods and the power of your breath, control both characters and join them on their journey through grief as they bridge the divide and bring life and structure back to the broken garden together. The Wind and the Wisp is a story about love and loss, and seeks to build a sense of connection in the wake of loneliness. Features A lovable little ghost character, the Wisp!  Blow into the microphone to trigger Wind and interact with the world and the Wisp! Solve puzzles by blowing into the microphone and activating unique flower mechanics. A beautiful world to explore with hidden interactions!
