rows.name: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude
rows.short_description: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler with 6 unique races, robust combat, a grand saga spanning a continent full of unique dungeons, a classless skill system, and an extensive guild management system to master as you uncover the world of Dragaea!
rows.description_html: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude contains the first two dungeons and boss fights of the game. All progress carries over to the main game. Beyond the jagged seas lies the the land of Dragaea, you arrived on it's shores called by a mysterious force in a dream to discover it's secrets and become a legend in your own right. Legends of Dragaea is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler, where you form parties of heroes and plumb mysterious dungeons in search of glory, wealth, and loot. Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is inspired by classic JRPGs distilling down the essence to it's roots as an idle dungeon crawler. Discover unique locations, visit the Adventurer's Guild and tear quests from the quest board advancing through the tiered ranking system reaping greater rewards. Encounter dangerous enemies that will test your might, and confront calamitous bosses. As your heroes fell enemies, your knowledge of monsters grow filling the Beastiary with valuable knowledge making all your heroes more effective in combat! Fight in massive 9-man boss raids utilizing your powerful roster of heroes for glory and loot! Build your own guild from the ground up, unlock guild upgrades, customize your heroes and guild banner from a wide variety of emblems or your own custom images. Your success as a guild translates into greater services as you build out the town unlocking more options for your guild like expeditions and a large roster, better resources to exploit, growing from a small village to a bustling city. Choose from 22 combat and utility skills for a robust free-form and classless skill system including melee, ranged, and magic characters allowing you to specialize your heroes any way you wish. Augment your team with over 25+ abilities like Bonk, Fissure, and Life Steal, using any 5 abilities in any combination you choose. As you explore Dragaea you will be able to recruit new party members to aid you in your journey forming multiple teams of 3 to explore dungeons and tackle challenges becoming the finest adventuring guild in all the land. You can even unlock expeditions that allow your parties to adventure while the game is off! The land of Dragaea is a place filled mystery, intrigue, and precious treasure. Collect and upgrade over 200+ pieces of weapons, armor, accessories, items, and other consumables to augment your party's prowess. No two pieces of equipment are the same with different rarities and stats affecting the possibilities. Found a favorite axe or staff? Upgrade it to it's max potential and give your adventurers the finest tools to do the job. A full featured inventory system and shop system lets you manage your collections effortlessly.

Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is inspired by classic JRPGs distilling down the essence to it's roots as an idle dungeon crawler. Discover unique locations, visit the Adventurer's Guild and tear quests from the quest board advancing through the tiered ranking system reaping greater rewards. Encounter dangerous enemies that will test your might, and confront calamitous bosses. As your heroes fell enemies, your knowledge of monsters grow filling the Beastiary with valuable knowledge making all your heroes more effective in combat! Fight in massive 9-man boss raids utilizing your powerful roster of heroes for glory and loot! Build your own guild from the ground up, unlock guild upgrades, customize your heroes and guild banner from a wide variety of emblems or your own custom images. rows.name: SolCycle
rows.short_description: Enter the 3D sci-fi world of SolCycle! Play as a robot cat archaeologist, explore a post-human community rebuilt by plant-fueled robots, and barter with the locals in card-based gameplay! Learn to navigate the citizens’ requests while under the spell of a time-loop. Don’t forget to watch the clock!
rows.description_html: Explore the world of SolCycle as renowned archaeologist and professor PRIV-8! After being laid off due to budget cuts, you decide to travel in search of a mysterious new artifact but find yourself trapped in a time-loop instead! Now you must learn to navigate the locals’ bartering culture using trade-based mechanics whilst still keeping your goal in mind. Who knows what that artifact could do for you when you finally get it…it’ll just have to be worth the trouble! In this solarpunk post-human world, plant-powered robots now worship the soil, creating civilization and structure that values trade above monetization! Meet inhabitants of this community, such as a priestess of the religious order, a shady merchant, and a well-revered mailman. Learn to navigate each segfault, the phenomenon known to reset your time-loop, and come back stronger and more knowledgeable each time! Features: Three animal-themed characters to interact and trade with. Cast of small fruit-themed beings called roros to play with. Unique location themes with original music!

rows.name: Where's That Clown?!
rows.short_description: Where's that Clown is a frantic top down arcade game where you must keep impatient kids entertained throughout chaotic birthday party venues. Dash around, dodging toddlers and parents as you try to get the highest score!
rows.description_html: MAKE KIDS LAUGH! Where's that Clown is a frantic top down arcade game where you've got to keep impatient kids entertained throughout chaotic birthday party venues. Throughout hectic, fast-paced rounds, you can bring randomly-spawning comedic props -- whoopie cushions, juggling pins, pies, and more -- to groups of partygoing children who eagerly await a good laugh. WATCH OUT FOR MOM AND DAD! While bouncing between groups of partygoers, you might run into mom and dad. The angry parents want to make sure they're getting every penny's worth from your services! Bump into them and you'll have to suffer a mean scolding... USE EXCITING PERKS! Bring some exciting new toys to the party with the  TRAMPOLINE  and CLOWN CAR , which take your party entertaining skills to the next level! Leap over mom and dad to avoid their stern talking-to's, or steamroll through the party to get to impatient crowds quicker.

rows.name: Doorway 2
rows.short_description: A fast-paced parkour game where you leap, slide, and crawl through intense obstacle courses—solo or online. Beat the clock. Dodge the bosses. Respawn, retry, and keep moving.
rows.description_html: Fall fast. Get up faster. Doorway 2 is a high-speed parkour platformer built for momentum, precision, and competition. Jump, slide, and crawl through chaotic, ever-changing obstacle rooms in a surreal world. Run solo or compete with others in multiplayer—every second counts. Miss a jump? No sweat. You’ll respawn at the start of the last room you entered. No full resets, just fast retries that keep you in the flow. With unique boss arenas, time-based challenges, and movement-focused design, Doorway 2 is all about pushing your limits without ever hitting pause. Features: Parkour-Driven Movement – Leap gaps, slide under hazards, and crawl through tight spots in tightly designed obstacle maps. Room-Based Respawns – Fall, fail, restart in the previous room and keep your run going. No full resets. Single and Multiplayer Modes – Run solo or race your friends online for the best time. Distinct Boss Encounters – Avoid deadly bosses that disrupt movement mid-run, each tied to unique map mechanics. Speed-Focused Design – Timer-based gameplay and online leaderboards challenge you to master every corner. Stylized Worlds – Dive into a series of surreal, atmospheric environments, each with its own visual identity and flow.

rows.name: Space Station: Beyond
rows.short_description: Play as a variety of creatures or characters and try to survive either maintaining or attacking a space station while everything that can go wrong has already gone wrong.
rows.description_html: Welcome! You have just arrived on board a Nanotrasen-operated workplace vessel located in the far re- [Syndicate attack shuttle. Your mission is to raid th-] job is to tend to the hydroponic gardens and supply the kitchen with fresh foods. During your down time you can hang out at the bar, socialize with your crew mates, take a walk through the station parks, visit the Mime's show, or enjoy any of the other many recreational activi- [Inside the armory is an armed nuclear device strong enough to shatte-] the station. Nanotrasen is proud to have you working with us, and promises to ensure your safety and well-being as long as you are here. When you work for Nanotrasen, you're family. Please, enjoy your- [Ensure no survivors.] Work together with your crew to keep the station running, fight Security over wrongful convictions, construct amazing new extensions to your habitat, or just follow the Clown around and heckle him all shift. Welcome to Space Station 14. Work jobs such as: Engineer: Maintain the station's structural and atmospheric integrity, or waste thousands of dollars of materials on a massive ship to take joyrides in! Scientist:  Research the various anomalous activities around the station and harness their power to create new and exciting anomalous activities! Cause more problems than you solve! Security Officer: Arrests trouble-makers, ne'er-do-wells and terrorists alike, ensure no one gets a chance to kill your crew before you do! Doctor: Ensure the crew is kept healthy, prevent deadly outbreaks, and absolutely do not  distribute illegal drugs. Cargo:  Keep track of the station's supplies, ram the delivery shuttle into the station at reckless speeds, sell everything not nailed down before Security finds out! Chef and Bartender:  Keep the crew well-fed! Be the only thing keeping literally everyone from breaking out in a fist fight! Listen to the microwave! Clowns: You're here too for some reason! Threats During your shifts, you may meet any number of a variety of things that will try to do anything from sabotage your station to confuse the hell out of everyone present. Make sure they don't follow through or that it's at least very funny when they do. Nuclear Operative: Sneak into the station to assassinate the holder of the Nuclear Authentication Disk and blow up the station with its nuke. Nuclear. Thief:  An average crew-man with a kleptomaniac streak. Zombie: Brraaaaiiinsss... Traitor: Infiltrate the station and fulfill your goals without ever getting caught. Cultist:  Convert the entire crew to your ideology before loudly summoning your God to consume the stars!

rows.name: Karma Jump
rows.short_description: After taking his own life, Bobi awakens in a shadow realm ruled by the Angel of Darkness. To escape eternal torment, he must complete twisted trials tied to his past sins. Fight for redemption in this dark narrative adventure.
rows.description_html: Karma Jump  is a third-person, narrative-driven adventure game where players journey through haunting dreamscapes shaped by trauma, guilt, and the desperate hope for redemption. After taking his own life, Bobi awakens not to peace — but to a twisted purgatory. Trapped between life and death, he must confront nightmarish echoes of his past. Guided by the enigmatic Angel of Darkness, Bobi must navigate fragmented memories, each realm revealing the weight of a sin he can no longer ignore. Will redemption be earned — or is it already too late? Gameplay Overview: Explore surreal, handcrafted environments tied to Bobi’s psyche and past. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover lost memories, and face emotional challenges. Dialogue-driven choices and hidden secrets influence Bobi’s journey. Key Features: Narrative-Driven Adventure : A deeply emotional story tackling themes of loss, mental health, and forgiveness. Cinematic Third-Person Perspective : Immerse yourself in richly detailed dreamworlds and character-driven storytelling. Distinct Realms : Each realm features a unique visual art style and atmosphere — from decaying childhood homes to symbolic landscapes of grief. Exploration and Discovery : Interact with artifacts, characters, and memories that alter your understanding of Bobi’s past. note: this game depicts self harm and alcohol abuse

rows.name: Syncers
rows.short_description: Syncers - A Multiplayer/PvP, low-poly, space brawler, from the depths of indie space.
rows.description_html: Syncers - Browser. PvP. Warfare. Syncers is coming to Steam.... Welcome to Syncers - A 1-man, low-poly, space brawler from the depths of indie space. No more dopamine-drenched, ad-bloated, battle-pass nightmares. This is BROWSER PVP WARFARE. It's what you've been waiting for, but didn't know existed. Syncers is about getting back to the heart of gaming, straight into the action - Within 60 seconds, players are fighting in the Syncers battle arena.  It's a one man project, and a solo-dev's love letter to old school game design with: No adds  No bloat No BS Just pick your server, pick your team, and FIGHT ! This is RAW BROWSER PVP WARFARE. And it's coming for you...

rows.name: Highway Hopper
rows.short_description: Jump over guardrails, dodge obstacles, and chase the high score – welcome to Highway Hopper!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Highway Hopper! Highway Hopper is a fast-paced 2D pixel art platformer where you jump over guardrails along an endless highway. Dodge cars, signs, airplanes, and buildings, collect points, and beat your high score! With simple controls, stylish retro design, and an engaging flow, every jump is a little thrill. How long can you last?

rows.name: Zoomers Versus Boomers
rows.short_description: Ever wanted to explode your friends as a wheel chair bound old man? Now you can! In Zoomers Versus Boomers, the Zoomers try to avoid getting blown up for as long as possible. Hurl phones at your friends! Run as they converge on your position in a vast tidal wave of old men! Try not to explode!
rows.description_html: Zoomers versus Boomers is a player versus player game with two teams. The Zoomers, and the Boomers. The Zoomers outnumber the Boomers three to one, but each Zoomer that gets defeated becomes a Boomer. The only way for Zoomers win is to stay alive long enough for the clock to hit zero. Boomers, on the other hand, can win by defeating every Zoomer. The Zoomers Zoomers have a choice between three weapons. Prefer the long range? Use the slow firing but heavy hitting tablet. More of a medium range player? The spray of phones has you covered. Prefer to blast the Boomers yourself, close and personal? The fan of phones fits your style perfectly. The Boomers Boomers one goal is to explode a Zoomer. To do that, they've got the ability to sprint and climb walls at frightening speeds. They can also charge their explosion, giving them greater range and damage the longer they hold onto it for. Though if they charge it for too long, they'll explode! Two unique maps Zoomers versus Boomers features two maps, a sprawling city with tall buildings and a metropolis full of speeding buses. Players can vote on the map they want to play on every few rounds.

rows.name: Plantastic
rows.short_description: 🌿 Over 30 plant species 🎩 Unlockable hats & accessories to customize ⏳ Idle game for desktop – runs in the background 🎁 Regular drops, items & collecting fun 🌍 Proceeds go towards real tree planting projects 🪴 Perfect for work, study & relaxing sessions
rows.description_html: Item drop probability*: Common - 85% Uncommon - 11% Rare - 3,5% Epic - 0,5% Legendary - 1 zu 250.000 *Subject to change 🌱 Plantastic – Grow plants. Grow trees. Grow good vibes. 🌿 Welcome to Plantastic , your charming little desktop companion where cute cartoon plants grow while you work – and where your time helps the real world grow greener, too! ✨ What is Plantastic? Plantastic is a minimalist idle game that lives quietly on your screen while you do what you do best: work, study, chill, or click away. The more you interact with your PC, the more your plant grows – from seedling to fully bloomed show-off. 🌼 Features that help you blossom: 🌿 Collect 30+ plant types – from bashful daisies to diva cacti. 🎩 Unlock silly hats and accessories – party hats, sun visors, crowns, and more. 🎁 Get idle drops just by using your PC – no grinding, no pressure. 🧢 Mix & match looks to customize your leafy buddy’s style. 🪴 Relax and grow – no timers, no stress, just pure plant joy. 🌍 Virtual plants. Real trees. You want a cute companion that makes work feel a bit lighter You’d love to support climate-positive actions with no extra effort You enjoy collecting, customizing , and watching things flourish 🌻 Let's grow something beautiful – together. Whether it’s a cactus with a cowboy hat or a lavender wearing shades – Plantastic is about joy, growth, and doing a little good while having fun. 🌱 Care for cute plants. rows.name: Obgoose
rows.short_description: Tired of feeling obtuse in Scrabble? Try Obgoose, a solo, non-competitive word game where you can play at your own pace.
rows.description_html: Do you despise playing scrabble with others? The feeling that everyone knows more words than you? Well, now this time is over. Obgoose is a singleplayer non-competitive scrabble-like game where no one will ever know when you are obtuse. 1. Why am I a goose? Honk! Move by using the arrow keys. 2. My goal? Join letter tiles and form words. 3. What about the points? You score a point, if you are using all letters and build a connected crossword of valid words. 4. The letter tile is in an unreachable position? Push it out of the screen. It will reappear. 5. I got too many bad letters? Push one letter tile into the well. It will punish you by giving two letter tiles back.

rows.name: Cauldron Chaos
rows.short_description: Your master’s gone. You’re in charge. What could go wrong? Brew potions, bottle them up, and desperately try to keep magical customers happy while chaos rains down every other day. Stir fast. Don’t explode. You’ve got 14 days to not burn the place down.
rows.description_html: Your master has left you in charge of his apothecary for two full weeks. Sounds easy enough... until the shop fills with demanding magical customers, your potion recipes pile up, and chaos starts bubbling over. Cauldron Chaos is a top-down, 2.5D potion-making game where you brew, bottle, and sell potions as fast and accurately as possible — all before the day ends. 🧪 What You’ll Do: Follow a queue of potion recipes delivered to you in a fixed order. Pick up ingredients, add them to the cauldron, stir when required, and bottle the final brew. Deliver potions to whichever customer is asking for them — there's no strict order, and no individual timers. Work against the day’s overall time limit to complete as many correct potions as you can before closing. ✨ Core Features: Hands-On Potion Crafting : Simple, satisfying actions like grabbing ingredients, stirring, and bottling bring each potion to life. Flexible Customer Queue : Serve potions based on need — if someone wants the finished brew, they’ll take it, regardless of line order. Time-Based Pressure : You’re racing the clock, not the customers. Efficient brewing and multitasking are key. Chaotic Daily Events : Every other in-game day throws a magical wrench into your routine — reversed controls, ingredient mix-ups, and more. Two-Week Challenge : Survive 14 increasingly wild days and prove you’re ready to run the apothecary for good. Cozy Yet Chaotic Vibes : Enjoy a whimsical magical shop aesthetic, filled with colorful potions, silly mishaps, and charming characters. Can you master the art of potion-making under pressure and keep the shop afloat until your master returns?

Flexible Customer Queue : Serve potions based on need — if someone wants the finished brew, they’ll take it, regardless of line order. Time-Based Pressure : You’re racing the clock, not the customers. Efficient brewing and multitasking are key. Chaotic Daily Events : Every other in-game day throws a magical wrench into your routine — reversed controls, ingredient mix-ups, and more. Two-Week Challenge : Survive 14 increasingly wild days and prove you’re ready to run the apothecary for good. Cozy Yet Chaotic Vibes : Enjoy a whimsical magical shop aesthetic, filled with colorful potions, silly mishaps, and charming characters. Can you master the art of potion-making under pressure and keep the shop afloat until your master returns?

rows.name: Vegetables of Mass Destruction
rows.short_description: An action hack 'n' slash roguelite where you play as a feisty raccoon tasked with saving the farm animals from evil robots by his master, Sensei Cow. Use the destructive power of vegetables and team up with your trusty chicken and pig pals to rescue farm animals and destroy the robot invaders!
rows.description_html: Vegetables of Mass Destruction is an action hack 'n' slash roguelite. You play as a feisty raccoon tasked with saving the farm animals from evil robots by his master, Sensei Cow. Use the destructive power of vegetables and team up with your trusty chicken and pig pals to rescue farm animals and destroy the robot invaders! Choose Your Weapon! From carrots to chilies, there are different vegetables you can choose to fight with. Find them scattered around the farm or harvest them by defeating enemies. Swing Your Weapon! Each weapon has different attributes and play styles. Battle and dodge through waves of enemies to get deeper into the farm, and confront the evil robot factory!  Eat Your Weapon! Each vegetable provides different permanent buffs and healing if you consume them. Strategize and build around which vegetables you find! And Meet New Friends!  After freeing the farm animals in each level, choose one to become a permanent companion, providing unique buffs that alter your gameplay.  Music Used Menu Music: Apple Cider by Zane Little via OpenGameArt Overworld Music: Banjo Love 85 by Fresh_Morning via Pixabay Combat Music: Banjo Picking Solo with Acoustic Guitar Accompaniment by nickpanek620 via Pixabay Boss Music: Cyber Farm by Psychronic via Pixabay

rows.name: Dicey Decisions
rows.short_description: Dicey Decisions is a multiplayer, strategy based board game where you compete against another person through cards, dice, and collecting runes and points. The game ends at round 6, and the person who gets the most wins! But watch out for your exhaustion levels!
rows.description_html: Dicey Decisions is a multiplayer, strategy based board game where you compete against another person through cards, dice, and collecting runes and points. The game ends at round 6, and the person who gets the most wins! But watch out for your exhaustion levels! Dicey Decisions is a game created around the idea of a kid's understanding of the classic game Dungeons and Dragons. The game uses dice as its core resource, used for both movement and card effects, reflecting the use of dice for actions in DnD. Roll and collect dice each round, use those dice to gather more resources and reputation, beat your opponent! Features Multiplayer: Compete against your friend in a 1v1 match to see who can outsmart the other! Utilize the cards in your inventory based off your character, and collect the necessary dice and runes to play them. Cards: Activate card effects to gain reputation to push you closer to victory! Player Abilities: Each player has their own special skill, figure out how to use your skill to gain the upperhand on your rival!

rows.name: The HELL Prologue
rows.short_description: Take up the role of the Hell Governor and embrace the challenge of welcoming souls who perished in major, historically real human disaster. Build your city, manage your resources while defending the chaos from demons who steal and kill your folks....and also that GIANT TITAN lurking around.
rows.description_html: As Hell’s Governor, your task isn’t just building a city —it’s transforming chaos into order in a realm ruled by sin. Here, every decision and every soul counts. In this city builder, you’ll craft an infernal hell city from the remnants of despair, balancing limited resources while harnessing the power of lost souls. Navigate the dark challenges inspired by the seven deadly sins and confront colossal titans that guard the underworld’s secrets. Each mission dives deep into lore and tests your strategic skills, as every failure paves the way for your resurgence. Every cycle through the underworld teaches you something new: past mistakes become future strengths, and each new attempt brings you closer to building a legacy that defies eternal damnation. Focusing on immersive storytelling and dynamic gameplay, The HELL challenges you to reshape a realm where every structure tells a story of sin, suffering, and ultimate redemption. Your dominion spans centuries. Souls arrive from humanity’s most catastrophic moments—from the chilling Fimbulwinter of ancient Nordic legends to the devastating Great Kanto Earthquake of Japan, and disasters ranging from the early 600-700 AD to the 18th century. In this launch, experience seven immersive missions that shape the very fabric of your underworld: Dancing Plates of Kanto, Japan ( 1923 ) [Earthquake] Broken Vein of Krakatoa, Indonesia ( 1883 ) [Volcano Eruption] Witching Hour of Aztec, South America ( 1540 ) [Plague] Stolen Sun of Northern Scandinavia ( 536 ) [Severe Cold] Cracked Lips of Ancient Egypt ( 2200bc ) [Drought] Wet Dream of Ancient Mesopotamia ( 3500bc ) [Flood] Topsy Turvy of __________________ [Time] Each mission is defined by its unique setting and features a formidable Titan and a narrative intricately tied to one of the seven deadly sins . Every map offers a distinct experience and challenge, ensuring no two missions are alike.   Unlike traditional city builders focused solely on population growth , The HELL challenges you to process these souls into Sinners—the essential workforce that fuels your hell city. As souls burst into your environment through the gaping maw of a Titan, they scatter and converge at a monumental structure known as The Purgatoria. Here, the raw, wandering spirits are queued for transformation, eventually forming the backbone of your infernal labor force. And when disaster strikes, feel the earthquake as the screen shakes, immersing you in the raw power of the underworld. Before transformation, all souls are held in a designated area known as The Wait. This space is subdivided into three distinct zones—The Wait: Fire, The Wait: Ice, and the Blood Hall—each influencing the eventual form of the souls as they are processed. Here, every soul patiently awaits its fate, adding depth and strategy to your transformation process. Resource management is key to building a thriving infernal hell city. As Hell’s Governor, you will strategically harness and utilize four primary resources—Blood, Waste, Cries, and Fears—to keep your city functioning and expand your dark domain. These resources are generated through specific buildings, and each serves a unique purpose: Blood: Powers your city, maintaining its infrastructure and ensuring that everything runs smoothly. Waste: The raw material necessary for construction and city development. Cries: Used to nurture the Dreadful Tree, which unlocks new technologies and strategic options to enhance your city’s capabilities. Fears: Required for invoking the power of the Seven Deadly Sins and unlocking new abilities to aid you in managing chaos. Managing these resources effectively is vital for building your hell city, defending your city, and maintaining order in the face of the titanic forces that threaten to tear everything apart. Moreover, you can monitor your resource flow—resources from mining and hauling are stored in your warehouse, making them readily available for construction and other operations. Additionally, souls come in three distinct colors: Blue Souls : These are the calm, obedient souls that satisfy your city's basic needs, patiently waiting to be transformed into Sinners or soldiers. Yellow Souls : These souls are restless and nearly angry, signaling that they are ready to be processed as soon as sufficient space is available. Red Souls : These are volatile and enraged. When fully incensed, they transform into sadists—ruthless entities that will steal resources and eliminate your valuable units. And in moments of desperation, you may also gain random resources by sacrificing available units , such as Sinners or Soldiers. Your hell city is never at rest. Dark forces and unpredictable chaos constantly threaten to unravel your domain. To counter these dangers, you can transform your sinners into specialized defenders—think of them as your infernal guardians. These heroes can protect key buildings, calm unruly energies, and actively fend off emerging threats . Imagine your ordinary souls becoming swift, relentless protectors of your realm, standing as a bulwark against the encroaching darkness. By continually evolving and adapting your defensive strategy, you ensure that your city remains a bastion of order and strength amidst the eternal chaos of Hell. To counter internal chaos, you can transform idle Sinners into specialized units: Sentries : Act as guardians in your buildings to deter resource-stealing Shallow. Sirens : Soothe agitated souls, reducing internal unrest. Stalkers : Hunt and eliminate both Slitters and Shallows that threaten your order. Unlock the full potential of your role as Hell’s Governor by activating unique skills tied to the Seven Deadly Sins in the Pandemonium . Each sin grants you a distinct ability that can dramatically influence your strategy and the fate of your hell city. Additionally, use the advanced Dreadful Tree technology to boost your city's performance and unlock valuable upgrades.   Will you rise above the chaos and forge a legacy in the flames of damnation? Or will the relentless tide of souls and the dark allure of sin overwhelm you? So many souls, the imminent threat of a Titan and a taboo. The HELL welcomes your miserable soul. Amen. ' You Only Live Twice ' - Hell Governor #13580

rows.name: The Dark Quarter
rows.short_description: A companion app necessary for playing the The Dark Quarter board game from Lucky Duck Games. The Dark Quarter is a cooperative adventure game that tells a rich, adult, dynamic story, mixing an app with physical components.
rows.description_html: This application is a digital companion for The Dark Quarter board game from Lucky Duck Games. The Dark Quarter is a cooperative digital hybrid adventure game that tells a rich, dynamic story through a multi-scenario campaign. Players are invited to make critical decisions that will not only affect their characters but also change the course of the narrative itself. Characters are not simply avatars, easily replaceable from one scenario to the next; instead, they are woven into the very fabric of the story. Their destiny and the destiny of New Orleans are inextricably linked. The game is a digital hybrid, mixing physical components with the app. Players move their miniatures around the map, roll dice to perform tests, and scan QR codes printed on cards to use items. The app guides the use of physical components, provides narration, and describes the results of the players’ actions.

rows.name: A Simple job
rows.short_description: 💼 A simple task: Don’t press the red button. Sounds easy? 😏 Featuring an annoying voice, absurd endings, and too many achievements. Free. Pointless. Glorious. 🤡🔴
rows.description_html: 🔴 A Simple Job – A game that slowly drives you insane... for free! 🌀 Welcome to your new dream job! Your task? Super simple: Just don’t press the red button.   Sounds easy, right? 😇 Well... it would be if it weren’t for that annoying voice constantly yapping in your ear. Imagine Clippy from the 2000s had too much coffee, a podcast mic, and zero chill. 🎤😵 Explore the many ridiculous ways this “simple” game can end — there are more endings than you’ll have reasons to distrust that button. 💣 🏆 Features: 🔴 One (suspiciously good-looking) red button that can ruin everything 🧠 Multiple endings, ranging from “meh” to “WHAT JUST HAPPENED?!” 🥇 A small but mighty list of achievements — more coming if people like it! 😵 A narrator voice you’ll regret meeting (and it regrets you too) 💸 100% free (because even we know this got out of hand) So... do you accept the job? 🔕 Don’t press the button. 🔔 Or... maybe do? 👀 (And if you like it, we’ll make it even worse. Promise.) 😈

rows.name: IF WE MAKE IT HOME.
rows.short_description: Snipping. Pruning. Eating. At what point are you no longer human? IF WE MAKE IT HOME. is a short narrative space thriller, about an advanced space suit ensuring survival at all costs. Inspired by 'The Suit', by Scott Base.
rows.description_html: Snipping. Pruning. Eating. At what point are you no longer human? IF WE MAKE IT HOME. is a short narrative space thriller, where you will learn how far an AI suit will go to follow an order. IF WE MAKE IT HOME. is a gripping narrative space thriller that explores the thin line between survival and self-destruction. In this game, you step into the boots of a lone spaceman, stranded on a desolate, windswept planet. Your only companion? An advanced, hyper-intelligent space suit, driven by a single, unbreakable directive: keep you alive at all costs. But survival isn't always as simple as it sounds. The suit will snip away at your weakness, prune your fears, and consume what it must to keep you breathing. But what happens when the cost of survival becomes your very humanity? Swing around with a grapple hook, boost through the air with a jetpack, but at what cost to your energy ? You decide. Every decision burns precious energy, and every action pulls you further from the person you once were. How far will you go to make it home? IF WE MAKE IT HOME. is a video game adaptation of 'The Suit', a comic created by Scott Base as part of his 'Bad Space' collection. Download IF WE MAKE IT HOME. for free on Steam, and dive deeper into Scott Base's mind by exploring the rest of the 'Bad Space' comics online.

rows.name: Collapse Of The Midnight Sun
rows.short_description: 'Collapse Of The Midnight Sun' is a cozy indie game with metroidvania and time loop mechanics that is less than one hour long.
rows.description_html: 'Collapse Of The Midnight Sun' is a cozy indie game with metroidvania and time loop mechanics that is less than one hour long and developed from scratch by a single developer. You'll be exploring an island that used to be a mountain before the city next to it flooded. The human made fusion reaction that lights up the sky as if it was the sun , has started to collapse. You only have a couple of minutes before it does and time resets. During these couple of minutes, you'll explore the island and memorize its locations like  the abandoned train station and tools like  the lantern. Memorizing these will be crucial for solving the puzzles ahead, before the next collapse and the resulting time loop.

rows.name: Gear Combination
rows.short_description: Gear Combination is a puzzle game where you combine gears of different sizes to reach a target rotation speed. Place gears freely and watch them spin together. Multiple quests can be played in any order and replayed. Simple yet strategic. Perfect for gear lovers.
rows.description_html: A Must-Play Puzzle Game for Gear Lovers – Now Enhanced for Steam! The popular mobile puzzle game Gear Combination is now available on Steam, completely powered up with enhanced graphics, smoother controls, and a more immersive experience tailored for PC players. The game begins with a single rotating gear. Your objective is to combine various gears of different sizes and tooth counts to reach the target rotation speed. You can freely place gears anywhere on the field—watching them interlock and spin in perfect synchronization is a deeply satisfying experience, especially for gear enthusiasts. Rotational speeds are expressed using positive values for clockwise rotation and negative values for counterclockwise. While the rules are simple, achieving the right gear ratios and placements requires thoughtful strategy and planning. With multiple quests available, you're free to tackle them in any order. Previously cleared stages can be replayed as many times as you like, allowing you to refine your solutions or just enjoy the mechanics at your own pace. Whether you're a fan of mechanical puzzles or simply looking for a relaxing and engaging way to spend your time, Gear Combination offers a unique gameplay experience that combines creativity, logic, and the mesmerizing motion of gears. Ready to find your perfect gear combination?

rows.name: Elysian Inferno
rows.short_description: Student Game Project - A Hack and Slash Top-Down ARPG, where you must fight your way through Sanctus and Malum, the Realms of the Afterlife. Simultaneously play as the Mage and the Warrior, split from a soul torn between the two worlds, as you fight to relink your soul back together to escape death.
rows.description_html: Savannah College of Art and Design - Student Capstone Game 2025 This is a short game created over 6 months by our team of 5 undergraduate students Featured at GDC 2025 - SCAD Booth Fight your way through Sanctus and Malum , the Realms of the Afterlife. Simultaneously play as the Mage and the Warrior , split from a soul torn between the two worlds, as you attempt to relink your soul back together and escape death. In this Hack and Slash ARPG, you grow stronger as you gain new abilities during your journey, with unique ability sets between the two characters you play as. You must make use of all your abilities to match elements to what enemies are vulnerable to. Features: Puzzle Combat: Match colored elemental attacks to the enemies' stacks of hearts to be able to damage them, requiring the deliberate use of abilities between both the Mage and Warrior. Satisfying Fast-Paced Action: You must be agile and decisive in how you approach combat to effectively cut through the defenders of the afterlife! Two Worlds At Once:  Instantly and seamlessly swap between  Sanctus and Malum , inverse worlds of each other, as you fight the variety of unique enemies within each. Discover hidden combat encounters and upgrades on your journey! Customizable Controls: Every ability can be bound to any key/button on your ability hotbar, and can be rebound to let you play with any control scheme to best fit you! There is also full parity between Mouse and Keyboard and Controller.   (Game plays best with Controller) Adaptive Original Soundtrack: Listen to unique tracks that respond to your gameplay, with music seamlessly blending to different themes between Sanctus and Malum. Will you face your judgement and destroy those that stand in your path to escape the Afterlife, or will your soul be severed and your fate lost forever?

rows.name: Heavy Spoilers RPG: The true identity of the final enemy is the hero's father
rows.short_description: People across the kingdom are vanishing. Young hero Harold Sageblood is ordered by the king to defeat the mastermind behind it all. Joined by the loyal mage Martha Bethraeor, the hero sets out—seeking answers about his missing father and the truth behind the disappearances.
rows.description_html: A smash-hit RPG with over 25 million Let's Play views is finally coming to Steam! A story so moving you’ll be moved to tears even though the characters and dialogue try to spoil the story! Flip your expectations on their head in this narrative-driven RPG! ■Features Story-focused! Even with massive spoilers, the emotional impact hits hard. Unforgettable Characters! Meet the mage Marcia Uragir and the ominous Demon Lord Yu Sha-No-Chiichi, who both have very obvious secrets! An Adventure You Can’t Put Down! You might think you figured everything out, but the emotional journey will keep surprising you. ■STORY People across the kingdom are vanishing without a trace. The young hero, Harold Sageblood, is ordered by the king to find and defeat the mastermind behind the disappearances. Joining the hero is the ever-loyal mage Marsha Betraeor—who promises she’ll definitely never betray Harold. Also, what happened to Harold’s father after he set off on his own journey? Surely there’s no connection to the disappearance of Harold’s father and the man the king claims is responsible? The shocking truth revealed at the climax will leave you speechless! ■Recommended For Players who love story-driven RPGs Those looking for both laughter and tears Fans of unexpected twists and emotional payoffs Anyone curious about a game where spoilers make the journey even better! Embark on this unforgettable adventure today!

rows.name: They Came for More Pasta
rows.short_description: 'When aliens order pasta, only one guy can deliver justice!' You're a food delivery guy in this short, comical graphic adventure, determined to stop the monopoly on Italian cousine imposed by an alien invasion.
rows.description_html: ' When aliens order pasta, only one guy can deliver justice! ' They Came for More Pasta is a short comedic adventure inspired in tone by classic graphic adventures! A mix of absurd humor, puzzles, exploration, dialogue , and an incredible alien obsession with Italian cuisine, seasoned with a healthy dose of sci-fi comedy . The shocking revelation is served: the aliens are here ! But their intentions don't involve lasers, conquest, or abductions. Their sole, irresistible desire is Italian food ! Decades of mysterious UFO sightings ? They weren't preparing for conquest, they weren't analyzing humans. They were just looking for the best recipes on Earth . But now things have gotten serious: they're not just tasting anymore, now they want to manage and control Italian cuisine . You're a simple Italian food delivery guy , forced to work for the fearsome alien company AlienExpress™. But your life, and with it the fate of the entire Nation, changes when the aliens cross the line by deciding to make you work even on World Cup Final day ! The most unlikely of heroes , armed with nothing but carbs and guts, will fight his way through the aliens to defeat their saucy plan and deliver justice once and for all! A graphic adventure with a modern , controller-friendly approach. A short but intense story divided into 3 parts, rich in humor , Italian pop culture references , and, above all, Italian food ! Get ready to laugh , think outside the box (and the kitchen), and face the most important delivery of your life. Whether you're a fan of classic point-and-click graphic adventures or just looking for a relaxing experience with an original story, prepare your keyboard, controller, and forks: the aliens are waiting, and they're very hungry. Warning : This game may contain Pineapple Pizza . Multiple-choice dialogues : Talk to a cast of unforgettable characters, including eccentric humans, alien pizza chefs, and space bureaucrats. Discover extraterrestrial secrets and how to stop the alien invasion. Environmental Puzzles : Test your wit with puzzles and enigmas. Use objects in creative and unexpected ways and overcome the environmental challenges you'll encounter along your path. Exploration : From the uncontrolled traffic of Italian streets to alien spaceship technology, navigating interstellar bureaucratic corridors, offices, and galactic call centers. Inventory System : Collect items, use them at the right time and place, or give them to someone who knows best how to use them to progress in the adventure. Comic and Original Story : Immerse yourself in a plot that unfolds through cutscenes, quotes, memorable characters, and a continuous series of increasingly absurd situations caused by the encounter (or clash) between Italian and alien culture. Duration : A short, concentrated adventure (like tomato sauce), lasting about 1 hour, ideal for a pasta-and-pixel weekend or a fun and fulfilling game session.

rows.name: Mega Dimension Ripper 9000
rows.short_description: Twin-stick shooter roguelite with environment-merging levels! With 1-4 players, survive for two minutes in each level while waves of relentless enemies are sent to attack you! Combine powerful upgrades and earn your freedom in this wacky interdimensional gauntlet!
rows.description_html: Twin-stick shooter roguelite with environment-merging levels! Play with 1-4 players in this wacky interdimensional gauntlet! Features 1–4 Player Co-op Roguelite (Play locally or online with Steam Remote Play Together) Single Player: Use Mouse & Keyboard or Controller Co-op: Controllers Required Multiple Difficulty Options (Try Your Best at 'Mega') Endless Waves of Diverse Enemy Types Discover Powerful Upgrade Combinations Seamlessly Merge Into New Environments Mid-Level Setting In this 1-4 player, couch co-op, roguelite party game, you play as combatants being teleported against their will into a life-threatening arena by the scary, yet charismatic, 'General'. With his prototyped teleportation technology malfunctioning, he sends wacky and unlikely environments from across the multiverse to merge onto the arena as the levels progress.  ​ Gameplay Experience fast progression, permanent powerups, and procedurally generated levels commonly found in the roguelike genre. Rather than exploring larger areas in longer levels, you must instead survive with your team in a small top-down arena. This arena will shift and glitch between environments for two minutes while waves of enemies are sent by the 'General' to test you. It’s life or death, and freedom is waiting for you at the end! How to Use Controllers Other Than Xbox Connect your desired controllers to the device Find Mega Dimension Ripper 9000 in your Steam library Click on the 'Manage' button on the right side of your screen Select 'Properties' Select the 'Controller' tab on the new window Click the dropdown on the right side of the new window Select 'Enable Steam Input' or 'Use Default Settings' You can now close out of that window and play the game with various controller type * Some controllers may need to be plugged into the system How to Use Steam Remote Play Together From the Friends tab When in game, press Shift + Tab to open steam overlay Open the 'Friends' tab at the bottom of the screen Right click on friend you want to invite Select 'Remote Play Together' From the Remote Play Together tab When in game, press Shift + Tab to open steam overlay Open the 'Remote Play Together' tab at the bottom of the screen Select Invite a Friend Select up to 3 friends you would like to invite Select 'Confirm'

rows.name: Skull Hotel
rows.short_description: Skull Hotel is a horror game where you clean hotel rooms while creatures hide, waiting to kill you.
rows.description_html: Immersive Horror Experience Experience realistic graphics and a chilling horror soundscape that intensifies as you progress. Every detail is designed to keep you on edge. Unpredictable Danger With a variety of original horror mechanics and dozens of hiding spots, you never know where the next threat will come from. Each playthrough is unique, making every cleaning shift a new experience. Easy to Learn, Hard to Master Skull Hotel is easy to pick up and play and can be finished in under 10 minutes, but its psychological horror and unpredictable gameplay make it truly difficult to complete. Expect to die multiple times before finishing the game. Leave Your Mark Survive your shift and sign the guest book at the reception to prove you made it. Will your name be remembered, or will you become just another lost guest?

rows.name: Cave of Gurg
rows.short_description: 'Dark. Silent. Waiting.' This is a text-based, turn-based strategy mini-game that runs on the command line. You play as a hunter exploring a mysterious cave in pursuit of the terrifying, man-eating creature known as the 'Gurg.'
rows.description_html: 'Dark. Silent. Waiting.' This game is a text-based, turn-based strategy mini-game that runs entirely on the command line. The player takes on the role of a hunter, exploring a mysterious cave and attempting to hunt down a terrifying man-eating creature known as the 'Gurg.' In this game, understanding your surroundings through messages that appear after each action is the key to survival and victory. The Cave: The cave consists of several rooms, each assigned a unique number. While the overall structure of the cave is fixed, the room numbers are randomly assigned in each playthrough. In addition to the 'Gurg,' two 'giant bats' lurk somewhere in the cave. Yes, two of them. The Hunter: Armed only with a bow and three arrows, the hunter bravely challenges the Gurg. Victory is achieved by striking the Gurg with an arrow. However, if the hunter is eaten by the Gurg, falls into a pit, or runs out of arrows, the game is over. Play Time: Each play session takes approximately 1 to 10 minutes. Notes: The introductory game guide can be skipped. For details, please check the “option” menu in-game. The application relies on the user's command line environment. There is no audio output.

rows.name: Aesop Rock's Black Hole Superette Experience
rows.short_description: A surreal first-person exploration game where you roam a fictional convenience store, collect hidden audio fragments, and unlock cryptic wisdom. Sample the full Black Hole Superette album, discover hidden easter eggs, and dive into a twisted soundscape of interactive hip-hop absurdity.
rows.description_html: Aesop Rock's Black Hole Superette Experience is a surreal, first-person exploration game set in a fictional convenience store brimming with absurdity, hidden meanings, and sonic treasures. As you wander the aisles in search of audio fragments, you’ll unlock cryptic words of wisdom from Aesop Rock himself. Sample your way through the entire Black Hole Superette album, uncover exclusive content, and dig into a universe packed with deep cuts, easter eggs, and offbeat lore only the most dedicated heads will decode. Welcome to the weirdest corner store you’ve never escaped!

rows.name: Pippa and Your Phantasmal Problem
rows.short_description: Find out who's been messing up your home with this troublesome witch!
rows.description_html: ★ Story Ms Ester's beautiful and neat house has been mysteriously wrecked in the past few weeks and nobody knows why. Patches of dirt on the carpet, things gone missing, and all sorts of mess keeps happening around the house. The police was called to investigate, a priest was invited to bless the house, and a group of ghostbusters was hired (they were so expensive!) and none of them found anything. How useless! If this problem isn't solved by the time Ms Ester returns from her short trip, she'll kick you out. You have to find someone who can help: anyone will do, even this unreliable looking, self-proclaimed witch you just randomly met. ' Pippa is going to save the day! Hehehe~ ' ★ Features Around 15,000 words in total. 3 endings: 1 bad ending and 2 good endings. Choose what to feed Pippa: the food chosen affects Pippa's magical energy, which will influence the story. Cute character art and cute soundtracks. Cute dogs! ★ Credits story, art, programming:  Konayachi soundtrack composer:  Dalton Attig (special thanks to Bristol!) proofreaders:  S.B.Hunter, ebi-hime, Wan-chan misc. programming help:  an anonymous family member sfx:  freesfx, pixabay background art references:  pxhere, minikle tools:  ActionEditor3, guiManipulate other software:  Krita, VSCodium engine:  Ren'Py This VN is made in a month for Spooktober Visual Novel Jam 2024!

rows.name: Revenant: Through The Veil
rows.short_description: When love defies death, the gods take notice. Armed with the Book of the Dead, archaeologist Hossam Sharawi must face ancient gods, survive cursed tombs, and journey through the Egyptian afterlife to bring back the one he lost.
rows.description_html: Hossam Sharawi An archaeologist devastated by the loss of his lover, embarks on a daring quest into forbidden pyramids and ancient temples of Egypt. Armed with the Book of the Dead, he must summon powerful Egyptian gods and face them to navigate the risky journey through the afterlife. To bring back his lost lover, he needs to outwit and overcome these gods, each guarding a different tomb. Some gods are obstacles, seeking to hinder his progress, while others offer aid. Hossam’s ultimate goal is to reach the Field of Reeds, retrieve his lost love, and escape back to the land of the living. EGYPTIAN MYTHOLOGY Inspired by Ancient Egypt’s Book of the Dead, immerse yourself and embark on a journey through the afterlife and encounter the many gods and goddesses in Egyptian mythology. PUZZLES Immerse yourself and explore the atmospheric environments in Revenant. Each level consists of puzzles that need to be completed to further progress through the afterlife. SOULS-LIKE COMBAT Lock onto enemies, dodge their attacks, and utilize the abilities granted to you by the gods to fight your way through the servants of the dead in the afterlife.

rows.name: Narb Fortunii
rows.short_description: Narb Fortunii is a short, story driven adventure. Move through the environment and read the characters dialogue while you enjoy the music. Complete a platforming challenge to reach the final conversation of this whimsical adventure.
rows.description_html: Narb Fortunii is a short, story driven adventure filled with fun dialogue and music. Move through the world and take in the different environments, characters, and sounds as the mystery of why you fell into this world unravels. This linear adventure is not just one dimensional. Use the pause menu for help to continue to a 3D platforming challenge will bring you to the end, or restart you if the menu's music wasn't fully enjoyed. Take off your specs and lock yourself into place, mid-air, to complete the final jumps that will bring you to the end.

rows.name: Hook, Line, and Axe
rows.short_description: Swing into action in this third-person hack-and-slash parkour set in a sci-fi dystopian America. Strike down corruption with your trusty battle axe. Grapple onto enemies and the environment alike. Chain abilities for the ultimate combo of destruction in Hook, Line, and Axe.
rows.description_html: Hook, Line, and Axe is a third person hack-and-slash parkour set in a dystopian America. In this fictional world, nothing is truly as it seems, and a tyrannical government has corrupted far more than anyone suspected. It’s up to you, an Insurrectionist and conspiracy theorist, to put a stop to them once and for all. With nothing more than a battle axe, take the fight to the military at Area 51. Talk about bringing an axe to a gunfight! Upon discovering a high-tech grapple hook inside, you must swing around to traverse this dangerous terrain, find collectibles, unleash a full arsenal of combat abilities at your disposal, and unlock secrets on the most dangerous and unpredictable mission the world has ever seen in  Hook, Line, and Axe . Hook, Line, and Axe currently is a standalone game that serves as a ' Part One ' to the story. There WILL be a Part Two, Sequel, or DLC should the game receive adequate funding or a significant amount of interest. Until then, our small group of developers hopes you enjoy the game in its current capacity! Warning : Game contains some stylized violence and may contain content that is too mature for some users.

rows.name: Nuclear Meltdown
rows.short_description: Nuclear meltdown is a collective video game in which a group of players find themselves having to face an emergency in a nuclear power plant despite not having the technical skills.
rows.description_html: Nuclear Meltdown is a tense, fast-paced cooperative game where a group of ordinary people are thrust into an extraordinary crisis: a nuclear power plant emergency. Trapped inside the control center, players must respond to an escalating catastrophe—without any technical expertise. You play as a visiting delegation touring the facility when, without warning, disaster strikes. A sudden explosion knocks out all communication lines and incapacitates the technical staff. As the security doors seal shut, you're left alone in front of a maze of blinking lights, switches, and warning sirens—none of which you understand. Your only link to the outside world is an outdated data terminal capable of receiving brief text instructions and sending simple YES or NO replies. Guided by minimal communication and your own instincts, you must work together under pressure, interpret cryptic console interfaces, and try to prevent a full-scale nuclear meltdown. Finanziato dall’Unione europea – Next Generation EU

rows.name: Shards of the Banished
rows.short_description: Shards of the Banished is a dark fantasy action-RPG set in a cursed medieval world. A fallen king, a cursed queen, and a power-hungry usurper have plunged the land into ruin. As the exiled heir, you must rise, face powerful foes, and reclaim what is rightfully yours.
rows.description_html: Overview: Shards of the Banished is a soulslike action RPG set in a post-apocalyptic dark fantasy world. You play as a lone warrior cast into a land consumed by glimmering darkness and the ashes of what was once a prosperous realm. Survive brutal encounters, explore ruined landscapes, and harness the mysterious power of crystals to uncover the truth behind your banishment. Key Features: Deep Combat System : Master a stamina-based melee combat system with dodge rolls, parries, and powerful finishers. Character Progression : Unlock new abilities through a detailed skill tree tailored to your combat style. Talismans : Collect and equip a variety of talismans that grant passive bonuses, stat boosts, and special effects. Boss Fights : Face off against 3 deadly bosses, each with unique mechanics and challenges. World Design : Navigate interconnected areas filled with secrets, traps, shortcuts, and hidden lore. Replayability : Multiple builds and playstyles encourage experimentation and repeated playthroughs. Atmospheric World : Experience a haunting soundtrack and environmental storytelling that deepen the immersion.

rows.short_description: Bop the ball. Collect coins. Don’t let it touch the ground! Easy to play. Hard to play well. (This game is deceptively difficult. You've been warned.)
rows.description_html: P lay as a crab trying to keep a ball in the air. Move side to side, bop the ball up, and scoop up gold as they rain down upon you! The longer you keep the bounce going, the more treasure you earn. Relaxing, meditative, replayable, and yet surprisingly difficult. Play alone or with a friend in Coop and competitive mode. 🎮 How to Play Move left and right with the joystick Keep the ball bouncing Collect coins for extra points Miss a bounce? It’s game over! ✨ Features 🦀 Simple joystick controls: just move left or right 🏐 Ball physics: keep it bouncing as long as you can 💰 Coin collection and score chasing 🔁 Easy to pick up and play 🎯 For Players Who: Like casual reflex games Difficult games

rows.name: Stanley Says
rows.short_description: A first-person puzzle horror game set in a defunct children's nursery from 2001. Uncover dark secrets, solve mascot-themed puzzles, and survive the twisted games of Stanley—an animatronic who never stopped playing.
rows.description_html: In 2001, you were taken. And somehow, you survived. Over two decades later, you return to the place that should have stayed buried: Stanley’s World. Once a cheerful drop-off nursery for children—where parents left their kids while they ran errands or went to work—it was abruptly shut down in 2001, just days after a string of mysterious disappearances... and the world changed forever. Now it’s quiet. Empty. Almost. 🕹️ Stanley Says is a first-person puzzle horror game set in the decaying remains of a once-trusted childcare center. Piece together the twisted history of Harvey Lamon , the man behind the madness, and Stanley , the smiling mascot who never really left. 💀 Features: Explore eerie environments dripping with corrupted childhood nostalgia Solve dark puzzles to unlock doors, secrets, and memories long forgotten Follow Stanley’s rules… or face the consequences Uncover disturbing lore through notes, tapes, and objects frozen in time from 2001 “Stanley says… don’t look behind you.” You’re not a kid anymore. But Stanley doesn’t care.

rows.name: Naja Medjai
rows.short_description: Naja Medjai is a family-friendly Souls-lite 3D platformer set in a mythical Ancient Egypt. Play as Rosetta, a Medjai warrior blessed by Apophis and Anubis, as she battles corrupted gods to save humanity.
rows.description_html: Naja Medjai is a family-friendly Souls-lite combat game and 3D platformer set in a stylized, fictional Ancient Egypt. You play as Rosetta , a Medjai warrior chosen by fate and empowered by two ancient gods. With responsive, dodge-based combat and environmental platforming, Naja Medjai offers an accessible gateway into the challenging world of Souls-inspired games. 🎮 Core Gameplay Features ⚔️ Dodge-based melee combat with light/heavy attacks and readable patterns 🐫 Explore 3 distinct biomes : winding canyons, flooded ruins, and scorched settlements 🧠 Challenging boss battles with unique phases and mechanics 🧗 3D platforming across ancient puzzles, vertical spaces, and treacherous terrain 🧭 Semi-open world structure with unlockable areas and nonlinear progression 🕯️ Mythology-inspired narrative featuring gods like Ra, Set, Geb, Apophis, and Anubis 👪 Family-friendly design with accessible challenge and stylized visuals In this mythic reimagining of Ancient Egypt, Rosetta stands as the last hope for humanity. Blessed by Apophis , the serpent god of chaos, and Anubis , guardian of the afterlife, she is tasked with defeating corrupted pantheons. Under the scorching reign of Ra , the gods have abandoned mankind—until Rosetta rises to challenge the divine order. 🌄 The Winding Canyon – Path to Geb A vast, twisting canyon carved by time and turmoil. Navigate winding paths, leap across precarious ledges, and avoid treacherous oil pits that threaten to send you plunging into the depths. Ancient rock golems patrol the area, barraging you with crushing melee strikes and hurling deadly rocks from afar. Beware—the Earth God’s massive head periodically emerges from the canyon walls, unleashing devastating projectile attacks that keep you on edge. This rugged landscape tests your agility and wits before you face Geb’s overwhelming might. 🌍 Geb – The Unmoving Earth Don’t let his size fool you—Geb is anything but slow. This towering god lashes out with crushing melee strikes, hurls chunks of stone from afar, and dives underground to strike from unexpected angles. Adapt quickly, read the rumble beneath your feet, and keep moving—or get buried alive. ⚡ The Flooded City – Path to Set Traverse a tiered city swallowed by water and storm. Lightning elementals lurk in the depths, striking from the shadows as you navigate slippery walkways and crumbling platforms. The air crackles with electric tension, and the storm never ceases—only the swift and sharp survive this tempestuous domain. 🌪️ Set – Warden of Storm and Sand Set is a whirlwind of aggression. He darts across the arena in rapid 3-hit dash chains, unleashes crackling lightning orbs from his core, and summons storm clouds that restore his strength if left unchecked. Stay alert, manage the chaos, and shut down his healing before the desert claims you. 🌴 The Ghost Town – Path to Ra Once a thriving desert settlement, now scorched and silent under an eternal sun. The path to Ra winds through crumbling houses, charred statues, and haunting remnants of lives lost to fire. The oppressive heat radiates from cracked earth, while restless fire elementals flicker through the ruins, igniting bursts of flame that keep you on edge. The shadows grow longer with every step, drawing you deeper into Ra’s fiery domain. ☀️ Ra – Scorched Tyrant of the Sky Ra commands the battlefield with divine precision. He hurls scorching projectiles, sweeps massive arcs of flame, and ignites the ground beneath your feet. Periodically, he vanishes in a flash of light—then reappears across the arena, keeping pressure high and positioning critical. This is a fight of endurance and awareness—misstep once, and the sun god won’t give you a second chance. 🧩 Explore. Fight. Endure. Each boss defeated grants Rosetta new powers , found in ancient relics and godly artefacts . These enhance her strength and unlock new opportunities for traversal and combat. Progression is tied to mastery: learn from failure, adapt, and grow stronger. ✨ A Souls-lite for All Players Naja Medjai offers a gentle entry point into the world of Souls-inspired games. With readable patterns, forgiving checkpoints, and tight controls, it's an ideal challenge for younger players, genre newcomers, or fans looking for a more stylized and mythic experience .

rows.name: Dungeon CompAInions
rows.short_description: In Dungeon CompAInions, choose a class—Mage, Druid, or Ranger—while AI-controlled allies help you survive waves of enemies. Pause to slow the pace at a cost, or push on for higher scores. Earn upgrades after each round as difficulty steadily increases.
rows.description_html: In Dungeon CompAInions , the player can choose one of three playable classes: Mage, Druid, and Ranger. Each character comes equipped with a main attack weapon and two powerful abilities, which must be used strategically and wisely. The two remaining classes not chosen by the player will be controlled by agents trained through Reinforcement Learning and will accompany the player throughout their journey. Together, the player and their AI companions must clear rounds composed of multiple enemy waves. Each round consists of five waves, which are triggered continuously during gameplay—unless the player decides to activate the pause button midway through the round. Pausing the game will damage, potentially even kill, the player. This allows for clearing the remaining enemies and helps with not being overrun by hordes of undead. The player will get score for every initiated wave, stacking up with the number of waves cleared without pausing. Thus, the player should choose wisely between staying safe and pausing the game, or being greedy and trying to clear all enemies without a moment of peace. After completing a round, the player will be presented with three reward options, from which one may be selected. These rewards include upgrades to Attack Damage or Ability Damage, increases in Max Health, reductions in cooldown times, or boosts to movement speed. These upgrades are essential for survival and success. With every subsequent round, the game becomes progressively more challenging. Enemy strength increases, spawn rates accelerate, and wave intervals become shorter—down to a predefined minimum. This creates a dynamic balance between becoming stronger and facing ever-larger groups of enemies, ensuring the player is constantly tested in both strategy and combat efficiency.
rows.about_html: In Dungeon CompAInions , the player can choose one of three playable classes: Mage, Druid, and Ranger. Each character comes equipped with a main attack weapon and two powerful abilities, which must be used strategically and wisely. The two remaining classes not chosen by the player will be controlled by agents trained through Reinforcement Learning and will accompany the player throughout their journey. Together, the player and their AI companions must clear rounds composed of multiple enemy waves. Each round consists of five waves, which are triggered continuously during gameplay—unless the player decides to activate the pause button midway through the round. Pausing the game will damage, potentially even kill, the player. This allows for clearing the remaining enemies and helps with not being overrun by hordes of undead. The player will get score for every initiated wave, stacking up with the number of waves cleared without pausing. rows.name: ROOM FOOTBALL - Shipyard
rows.short_description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.
rows.description_html: The game is a fps, puzzle game, from the first person. In which the game is controlled by the character on the WASD and mouse, you need to shoot  ball in objects and destroy them. Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics. On the map there are objects marked with a red beam going into the sky, the player must find all these objects and destroy them with a soccer ball to complete the game. Objects that need to be found and destroyed are marked with a red beam going into the sky. The player needs to control the camera on the WASD buttons and the mouse, find all the necessary objects on the location and hold down the left mouse button, controlling the force of the blow to the ball, knock them down as quickly as possible, getting points for it. The game has achievements and leaderboards.

rows.name: a pig game: A Pee Wee Premiere
rows.short_description: Join Pee Wee the Polka Dotted Pig - your silent (but determined) ceramic protagonist on a mission to collect toothpicks! Flip, fling, and fly through a kitchen full of cozy characters and curious quests!
rows.description_html: Collect Your Toothpicks! Life’s pretty straightforward when you’re a ceramic toothpick holder. But what’s a pig to do in a brand new kitchen? That'll take the help of some new friends and a couple well-timed acrobatic feats! Gameplay Features Overview Unique Acrobatic Platforming Mechanics Complete Missions, Puzzles, Racing, and Platforming Challenges Features Responsive Tutorials and Visible Input Displays Wholesome and Charming NPC Dialogue Interactions Unlock Exciting New Ways to Traverse the Kitchen! Explore a Beautiful Detailed Kitchen Environment Menu Setting Options, Auto Saving Rich Environmental Audio and Dynamic Music Full Gamepad Controller Support Meet Your New Countertop Companions  This kitchen is full of countertop characters who can't wait to meet the newest arrival! (it's you!) Explore a Culinary World From a Whole New Perspective  As the saying goes, 'The world is your toothpick!'- or that's what this piggy toothpick holder tells us (we'll have to fact check him on it). Flip, Fling, and Fly Your Way to Daring New Heights!  Begin fun and challenging quests as you meet new friends and discover all new ways to explore the kitchen from top to bottom! After all, 'There are toothpicks everywhere for those with eyes to see!' (okay, that one can't be true) About the History and Inspiration Usually music is made for the game. This game was made for the music. This antique pig originates from 1950's Japan, but he more recently became the center of attention among a whole new audience thanks his catchy little jingle written by PineyWoods Corner (for which there is no antidote). Pee Wee's jingle got so popular that it lead to him being placed back into production and is now available at PineyWoodsCorner's shop on Etsy! This all struck me as a fun concept [an antique rejoining the modern age], so I created this game for fun and for a good cause! Now Pee Wee taps his trotters to a brand new game made all about him! Explore the lore! a pig game was inspired by PineyWoods Corner's Pee Wee Polka Dotted Pig!

rows.name: Fourmiworld
rows.short_description: Carve your own path through Fourmiworld - an 'open-world-ant-farm-metroidvania'. Play as an interdimensional urban explorer girl, collect Gamut to unlock new abilities, and discover the sights, plights, & soundbites of a surreal alien dimension.
rows.description_html: 'In times of boredom, there's only one logical thing to do...                                      ...travel to another dimension, recreationally!'                                                      - A. Wandereye (probably) Fourmiworld Fourmiworld is a free game all about exploring a strange world orbiting a dying star. Along the way you'll discover the remains of a lost civilization, encounter bizarre creatures, unlock tools to aid your expedition, and more. If you'd like to support us, consider checking out the Wandereye's Writings DLC . It isn't necessary, but we recommend it if you want the definitive Fourmiworld experience. Should you play? If you enjoy at least 7 of the following points , we think you'll really click with Fourmiworld : Games with destructible environments and secrets to discover.​ Open-world exploration and nonlinear progression. Insects , bugs and Sci-Fi ecosystems. Piecing together the history of a long-gone alien race. Atypical artstyles , collage, girls with flowers for eyes. Growing stronger and gaining abilities to better navigate your environment. Games that don't hold your hand and just let you figure things out. Atmospheric , ambient music that adapts to where you are. Personalized experiences, seeing things other players will not see. The word 'Frondosity' invokes a certain joy in you. Inspirations These games inspired us a lot during development. We think you should give the game a try if you enjoy at least two of these: Metroid - Game-altering upgrades & lonesome alien atmosphere. Terraria - Digging anywhere & obtaining resources to get new abilities. Hylics - Surrealistic stylization & unconventional vibe. Yume Nikki - Exploring exactly how you want to & seeing weird/cool/scary things. Starseed Pilgrim - Lack of hand-holding & tile interaction aspects.

rows.name: Mitos.is: OG
rows.short_description: Absorb, split, survive—the 2016 cell-devouring classic is back! Battle in Free-for-All, Random Teams, Guild War & Tournaments. Reach level 59, open unlimited accounts, and dominate the arena in Mitos.is: The Game OG.
rows.description_html: The 2016 cell-devouring classic is back—tighter, faster, and hungrier than ever! Relive the golden age of Mitos.is with the OG edition: a faithful remake of the original release, polished for today’s rigs but true to the gameplay that stole your spare time. Spawn as a single cell in a ruthless micro-universe, absorb the tiny, evade the titans, split for lightning strikes, and weaponize viruses in a heartbeat. Every second is a fight for survival—and total domination. Key Features at Launch Core Game Modes Free for All – Pure chaos: every cell for itself. Random Teams – Instant alliances, on-the-fly tactics. Guild War – Squad up and battle guild-versus-guild for bragging rights. Tournaments – Elimination events where only one champion walks away. Level Cap 69 Climb the OG progression ladder, unlock power-ups, and flex your max-level prowess. Unlimited Accounts No restrictions—create as many profiles as you want to test new builds and playstyles. Ultra-Responsive Netcode Revamped networking, global servers, and in-game settings to crush lag before it crushes you. Gear & Custom Skins Earn cellular gear, craft unique loadouts, and stand out in the arena. Guilds & Social Tools Global chat, friends lists, and streamlined guild management for coordinated attacks and legendary rivalries. How to Thrive Absorb smaller cells to bulk up. Evade anything bigger—unless you’re setting an ambush. Split & Conquer: divide for speed bursts or surprise strikes. Deploy Viruses as cover, traps, or living projectiles. Expel Mass to dodge danger, feed allies, or pull off daring maneuvers. Whether you’re a nostalgia-driven veteran or a first-time explorer of the micro-cosmos, Mitos.is: The Game OG delivers that raw PvP adrenaline you remember—now with modern quality-of-life tweaks and sturdier servers.

rows.name: Ball Space
rows.short_description: A single player 3D puzzle platformer set in low earth orbit. Roll, jump, and float around in space as a ball collecting records, coins, and new friends. Listen to the records you collect and uncover forgotten secrets. Gravity changes from area to area so be prepared for some unusual challenges.
rows.description_html: Roll around in space in this 3D puzzle platformer. Use gravity to fling yourself to new heights and uncover the  very serious secrets of the universe. Orbit around the planetoids and collect playable records or just hang out with the game's inhabitants and listen to music.
rows.about_html: Roll around in space in this 3D puzzle platformer. Use gravity to fling yourself to new heights and uncover the  very serious secrets of the universe. Orbit around the planetoids and collect playable records or just hang out with the game's inhabitants and listen to music.

rows.name: The River
rows.short_description: A short story point-and-click visual novel about the afterlife.
rows.description_html: You wake up in the void, with no memory other than the deep sense that something horrible has happened to you in life that has left you in limbo. Can you find your way back to the living to make things right? Should you? Welcome to my first visual novel / game project, The River. I actually made something! This is my very first attempt at making a game, as well as my first second earnest attempt at a cohesive, stand-alone narrative. I set off to create all of the visual assets, sound effects, and music myself, and scripting/tying it all together with Adventure Game Studio. Estimated play time: 30-50 minutes. Playing with good Audio / Headphones is highly recommended. Content Warning: Contains mature subject matter (discussion of death and dying, written descriptions of violence) Game Features: Unique, (mostly) monochrome style visuals Digital hand-drawn backgrounds Unique soundtrack and dynamic music score for each of the game's 12 scenes Nearly 2000 frames of sprite animation Visual Novel styled story, including dialog and character portraits

rows.name: Seven Hearts
rows.short_description: Seven Hearts is a vibrant strategy RPG where you assemble a team from over 250 unique heroes across seven classes. The game features real-time tactical combat, powerful tanks with special abilities, and deep team-building mechanics. Engage in various modes, including PvP arenas and guild raids.
rows.description_html: Boisterous Battle! Seven Hearts! Asgard’s defenses have fallen! They need your help! Lead your team of heroes to defend against the Undeads, once and for all! *Upon your first login after purchase, you will receive 250 Diamonds, 1,000,000 GOLD, and 300 AP for free. # Take Your PIck! There are over 250 heroes to choose from! Build your own team of heroes from 7 different classes: Warrior, Rogue, Archer, Defender, Wizard, Golem, and Warlord. # Need Back Up! Support the team with the right tank, each empowered with special abilities! Clear the old Sanctuary towers of Asgard to unlock the Ancient Protectors and add their mighty powers to your deck! # Gear Up, Team! We Have a World to Save! Optimize your deck by finding & upgrading the right weapons and gears for your heroes. You can strategize and build multiple decks for special types of enemies! Choose your tank wisely! Each tank brings a unique set of skills to the battle field! # Who’s in Charge Over Here? Compete against other players and their decks in online PVP arenas! Fortify your defenses and towers strategically against other players! Siege and destroy their towers & defenses! Make allies and team up with your friends to fight off the raid bosses! # Ready Your Tank! 9 different gameplay modes from Single Play, PVP Arenas, Sanctuary, Guild Raids and many more! Find your favorite mode!
