rows.name: Lizards VS Humans
rows.short_description: A multiplayer FPS Sci-Fi game set in an alternate reality where reptilian beings battle humans for control of Earth. Features unique species-specific abilities, diverse weapon systems, and tactical gameplay.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the war-torn universe of Lizards Vs Humans , a fast-paced, class-based sci-fi multiplayer FPS where ancient alien warriors and elite space marines battle across the stars for supremacy. Choose your side in an epic conflict spanning frozen moons, abandoned stations, blazing deserts, and futuristic cities built in craters and valleys. Will you stand with humanity, defending its last colonies in high-tech power armor? Or embrace the primal fury of the Lizard People, reptilian warriors wielding plasma-edged blades and biotech weaponry? This is not just war. This is extinction or evolution.

rows.name: Free Lottery
rows.short_description: Free Lotto​​ is an idle placement game requiring zero operation. It automatically triggers ​​lottery ticket drops​​ at intervals, where low-tier tickets can be synthesized into higher-tier ones, and vice versa via ​​lossless decomposition​​—ensuring no resource waste.
rows.description_html: Free Lotto​ ​ is an idle placement game where you can literally do nothing. At regular intervals, the game automatically triggers a ​ ​lottery ticket drop​ ​, rewarding players with random-tier tickets. Lower-tier tickets can be synthesized into higher-tier ones, while higher-tier tickets can also be ​ ​decomposed back into lower-tier tickets without any loss​ ​—ensuring zero resource waste during conversion.

rows.name: Gravebound
rows.short_description: Survive as long as you can through the waves of magic guardians, level up to heighten your own magical abilities, and unlock game changing weapon upgrades and new arenas as you explore Dark Willow Crypt! Will you escape, or are you bound for the grave...
rows.description_html: Welcome to Dark Willow Crypt Explore the remote grounds of Dark Willow Crypt in search of legendary magical secrets from the mages laid to rest there. But the dead do not give up their secrets freely... With rogue-like, survivor style game-play, face the graveyard's increasingly challenging guardians while enhancing your own magical abilities through both the artifacts you find and the experience you gain. Game-play Features First-Person arena shooter combat with Survivor-genre inspired mechanics Rogue-like leveling system with a variety of player and weapon upgrades for diverse build crafting A handcrafted magical world with varied arenas to provide unique combat challenges and distinct enemy encounters Optional Endless-Mode to push player builds to their absolute limit

rows.name: Heist.exe
rows.short_description: A sci-fi stealth game in which you must infiltrate digital facilities, steal back the possessions within, and escape without being seen. These 'networks' contain switches that can alter your path or stop guards from seeing you. Activate them on your own or with the stolen possession!
rows.description_html: Infiltrate the depths of cyberspace on a life-or-death mission to reclaim stolen valuables. Stealth around robotic guards, manipulate the surrounding environment, and retrieve your client's prized possession to ultimately escape the network. But once you snag it, the sinister NETBots will shotgun the self-destruction of their own network—all in an attempt to permanently wipe you from existence! Get in, get out, and take back what's NOT rightfully theirs.   Features Play as Agent Tehsi, a professional spy who's fast on her feet and adept with machinery! You can activate terminals to open and close walls or create walkways to new heights, which also keep you safe from the sights of guards. Find a possession at the end of the level , then traverse back through it in a different way! Use the very item you've retrieved by putting it on buttons that also open walls or shrink blocks. Avoid the robotic guards   and sentries surveying the area. They'll stop at nothing to capture you and keep the possession from your grasp! Be prepared to escape the network shutdown! After reclaiming the possession, an escape sequence triggers and demands that you escape before time's up. What's more, certain terminals deactivate, making escape even harder! Each room has its own camera angle(s) , allowing for simple yet effective observation of each challenge. Enjoy two full levels of accessible and exciting gameplay ! At least one additional level will be released with the full version of the game.

rows.name: CyclingArcadeRaceSimulator
rows.short_description: CyclingArcadeRaceSimulator is a fun cycling simulation for ANT+ FEC devices. Opponents automatically adapt to your performance. Experience action-packed races on Formula 1 tracks, in the mountains, or in the desert!
rows.description_html: CyclingArcadeRaceSimulator for ANT+ FEC Devices A challenging and entertaining cycling simulation for ambitious riders. This game is all about having fun on your bike – just hop on and ride! Opponents automatically adjust to your fitness level (FTP), ensuring you're always challenged at the right intensity. Whether you're racing on a Formula 1 circuit, climbing steep mountain roads, or battling through a scorching desert – there's something here for every type of rider. Features: Support for ANT+ FEC compatible smart trainers Dynamic opponent difficulty based on your fitness A variety of tracks with unique challenges Focus on fun, accessibility, and long-term motivation

rows.name: Rail Gunner
rows.short_description: A sci-fi rail shooter for PC, PCVR and Mac. Defend your train against AI controlled robots which run, fly, rocket and roll in pursuit. Enemies are fully destructible and physically simulated. A variety of weapons and power-ups to unlock.
rows.description_html: A sci-fi rail shooter for PC, PCVR and Mac   ( also available free on iOS & Android ) Defend your train against waves of AI-controlled robots that run, fly, rocket and roll in pursuit. Fully destructible enemies – Voxels + physical simulation makes for infinite variation in the carnage you unleash. Neural-network AI – Damaged bots limp, crawl or skid to keep the hunt alive. Unlockable weapons & power-ups - Rail guns, plasma weapons, lasers, missiles and a variety of powerups to fuel the destruction. Optional VR  - Immerse yourself in the chase. Unique integrated zooming allows you to make that distant sharp shot while keeping a gunsight on the enemies at your heels. Two game modes  • Chase – survive endless pursuit, holding out for the next supply carriage while pushing for the highest score.  • Node Assault – fight through the defenders and destroy the enemy brain-train to continue your progress towards new weapons and powerups. Single-player only. Play the core endless gameplay loop for free. One optional DLC unlocks complete progression, allowing all weapons and power-ups to be earned through play.

Unique integrated zooming allows you to make that distant sharp shot while keeping a gunsight on the enemies at your heels. Two game modes  • Chase – survive endless pursuit, holding out for the next supply carriage while pushing for the highest score.  • Node Assault – fight through the defenders and destroy the enemy brain-train to continue your progress towards new weapons and powerups. Single-player only. Play the core endless gameplay loop for free. One optional DLC unlocks complete progression, allowing all weapons and power-ups to be earned through play.

rows.name: CyberArena
rows.short_description: Fast-paced 2D arena shooter where you control a combat mech and fight endless waves of deadly robots. Inspired by Vampire Survivors and Hotline Miami, with roguelike elements, upgrade choices, and stylish pixel art.
rows.description_html: Dive into a neon mech arena brawl! This is a fast-paced 2D top-down action game where you pilot a combat mech and fight off waves of hostile robots. Every battle is a test of survival, reflexes, and smart upgrade choices. The game blends elements of arena shooter , roguelike , and survivor-style gameplay, inspired by hits like Vampire Survivors and Hotline Miami . Each run is unique — collect upgrades, build your mech, and fight through the chaos. ⚙️ Upgrade your mech : choose powerful enhancements after each wave. 🤖 Face enemy hordes : from light drones to heavy war machines. 💥 Intense action : fast, brutal, and unforgiving. 🧱 Pixel art visuals : stylish retro graphics with a neon twist. 🎮 Simple controls : easy to pick up, hard to master. Only the quickest will survive. Can you make it to the end?

rows.name: Everranger
rows.short_description: This is a moderately challenging single-player 2D puzzle game with approximately 100 levels. You control your piece to evade or capture other pieces, ultimately reaching the target point. Different pieces follow distinct movement logic. You must deduce these patterns through exploration.
rows.description_html: This is a moderately challenging single-player minimalist 2D puzzle game with approximately 100 levels. In the game, you control your piece (an hourglass) to evade or capture other pieces according to game mechanics, ultimately reaching the target point. Different pieces follow distinct movement logic that isn't explicitly revealed - you must deduce these patterns through exploration and observation. Most levels are grouped in series of 10. Within each series, difficulty gradually increases: earlier levels serve as tutorials for core mechanics, while later levels present greater challenges that may require extended problem-solving. Although appearing turn-based (with enemy pieces reacting after your moves before awaiting your next action), the game actually operates in real-time. Each piece enters a cooldown period after moving, creating dynamic puzzle scenarios where enemy pieces might execute multiple moves in response to your actions. While the compact game allows free selection of any level (no progression locks), sequential play is recommended for optimal experience progression.

rows.name: Fracctal TCG
rows.short_description: Fracctal TCG distills the thrill of monster collecting into a one-versus-one card game built for quick, tactical showdowns.
rows.description_html: Fuse Pokémon-style creatures with Hearthstone-inspired combat in this fast, strategic card battler. Build 30-card elemental decks, level your cards mid-match, and climb the ranked ladder through Solo quests, PvP duels, automated tournaments, and seasonal events. About This Game Fracctal TCG distills the thrill of monster collecting into a one-versus-one card game built for quick, tactical showdowns. Choose from eight elemental teams —like Fire, Ice, Plant, Rock, Psychic, Electric, and more. Master mono-element decks or blend types for clever combos. Hearthstone-like resource curve. Both players start at 2 mana and gain +1 per turn (max 10), keeping matches brisk without runaway snowballing. 30-card decks, 20 HP, fairy hero powers. Every draw matters; teched counters and tempo swings decide the match in under ten minutes. Card evolution. Let a creature survive three of your turns and it morphs into a stronger form—protect it or pay the price. Hero powers (Fairy skills). Fire blasts damage, Plant heals, Rock builds armor, Psychic forces discards, and more—one use per turn, so timing is everything. Level-up progression. Win games, complete daily quests, and earn currency to enhance your favorite cards or unlock fresh archetypes. Solo & PvP content. Tutorial Mode that teaches core mechanics. Practice and level up your skills in Solo Mode. Ranked PvP Ladder with seasonal resets and cosmetic rewards. Automated & Custom Tournaments Compete in daily or weekly automated tournaments for in-game currency, rare cards, or cosmetic rewards. Bracketed matchmaking and prize distribution handled seamlessly by our backend. Whether you love crunchy card math or flashy creature battles, Fracctal TCG offers depth for veterans and an inviting tutorial for newcomers. Key Features Element-based deck-building (8 teams, hundreds of cards) Evolving minions that transform mid-battle Fairy hero power system —eight play-styles right out of the box Adventure, Solo, Ranked, and Custom play modes Daily, weekly, & guild challenges with generous progression Seasonal expansions that add new mechanics without power-creep Cross-platform with iOS, macOS, Android, and PC

rows.name: Rebound Rush
rows.short_description: Duel your friends in a life-sized pinball arena in a high-tension one-on-one sport! Parry a constantly accelerating ball and launch it into your opponent’s goal to win the match. But watch out — the commentator might have a trick or two to spice things up... Good luck!
rows.description_html: Rebound Rush Rebound Rush is a fast paced sport game where you duel your friends in a life size pinball arena. Conquer the crowd and terrain by avoiding and using obstacles to your advantage and score in your oponnent's nest! Be careful though, the commentator might hinder you by moving the net or throwing items to make the match more spicy! Watch out for boomboxes and use them to keep your opponent on the edge! Heads up! Rebound Rush is a two-player-only experience—whether you're battling it out in couch PvP or via Steam Remote Play, you'll need a friend to duel (after all, what's life without a few broken friendships over video games?). No buddy nearby? Go outside and make one—we believe in you. Good luck!

rows.name: Pudding Fantasy: Tales of Go and Magic
rows.short_description: A Go RPG where you can naturally learn Go while having fun! ♪ The legendary staff 'Honin Rod' sealed away the Demon King. But the seal broke due to the staff's deterioration. The resurrected Demon King brought forth monsters called 'Gomono,' throwing the kingdom into chaos.
rows.description_html: Story The legendary staff 'Honin Rod' that sealed away the Demon King. However, due to the deterioration of the staff, the seal that lasted for many years has been broken. The Demon King has been resurrected, and monsters known as 'Gomono' have appeared, plunging the kingdom into chaos. Yet, the king is indifferent to the suffering of his people! As long as he can eat his beloved pudding, he's satisfied and shows no intention of dealing with the Demon King or the Gomono. But then, all the pudding in the kingdom was stolen by the Demon King! The king, who didn't care about the people's suffering, is now furious because he can't eat his favorite pudding. He orders a search for the descendant of the Hero of Light who once sealed away the Demon King. However, since he announced a reward for defeating the Demon King, countless people claiming to be descendants of the Hero of Light swarm the kingdom. He promises to pay a reward to whoever defeats the Demon King first. The protagonist, Buchi, faces a financial crisis because his father's pudding factory had its ingredients stolen by the Demon King. To save his family's finances (albeit reluctantly), he sets out on a journey to defeat the Demon King. What's Go? You may have heard the name, but don’t really know what it is, and it sounds difficult. This game is just for you! The long-awaited Go Fantasy RPG is here! Adorable and colorful characters. Stunning graphical effects. Dress-up items. Battles with monsters. All the essential elements of a fantasy RPG are packed into this game. While enjoying the game, you will naturally learn how to play Go in this long-awaited masterpiece. This is the first part of a two-chapter series. In Chapter 1, you will learn the rules and basics, while the upcoming Chapter 2 (the final chapter) will provide more advanced tactics and lessons on the 19x19 board. This series aims to teach you everything you need to know about Go, from knowing nothing to becoming a player. The policy has been changed, and the game is now designed to teach everything from Chapter One through to the final chapter. With this single title, you’ll master the rules of Go and fundamental techniques! Regarding Streaming Streaming is allowed! Feel free to share your gameplay!

rows.name: Paths of the Visionaries
rows.short_description: Grab your notebook, trust your gut, or throw a punch—whatever works. This love letter to classic 2D JRPGs throws high schoolers, detectives, and street toughs into a tangled web of conspiracies, lurking horrors, and uncertain paths. Every shadow hides a secret—reveal them or be lost to the void.
rows.description_html: In the quiet town of Edinborough, a trio of high school boys get wise to unnatural beasts oozing out of a facility tucked away in the mountains. Across town, a hard-nosed gumshoe and a cocky street tough chase the story of some poor soul who got too close to the truth. As their paths twist, the deeper they dig, the darker the mystery becomes. Through thick woods, quiet waters, grimy streets, abandoned shafts, every path leads to more trouble than they bargained for. Key Features: A rip-roarin’ 15+ hours of mystery, mayhem, and monsters Fast-paced turn-based brawls See trouble coming a mile away—no surprise encounters, you’ll spot those goons before they spot you. Classic 16-bit style and soundtrack straight outta the past—Taking cues from the golden age of RPGs.

rows.name: Asteroid Forward
rows.short_description: Asteroid Forward is a spin-off video game from the Asteroid series for PC and mobile devices. Battle your way through space in this vertical side-scrolling action arcade game!
rows.description_html: Asteroid Forward is a spin-off video game from the Asteroid series, and it’s a vertical-scrolling action arcade game for PC and mobile devices. FIGHT FEARSOME ENEMIES The Z9 Galaxy is home to many planets under attack. Power yourself up with the many POWER-UPS scattered throughout the environment and fight your way to victory! Free all the planets in the available levels and replay them to collect additional resources. ENDLESS FUN In Exploration Mode, you can keep playing even after completing the main campaign levels, constantly moving forward and encountering all kinds of enemies and bosses—some of which you may not have faced before! Try to beat your high score and earn new rewards! TAKE ON THE FEARSOME BLACK HOLE RAIDS - COMING SOON AFTER LAUNCH Special battles against brand-new bosses await you in Asteroid Forward! Fight solo or team up with a friend in online multiplayer mode to earn incredible rewards. CUSTOMIZE YOUR SPACESHIP By playing the various available game modes, you can earn Flact and Aquanium Gems—resources you can use in the Shop to buy new ship styles or other useful items. Find the style that suits you best! SEASONS AND EVENTS Asteroid Forward constantly brings you new content and events to enjoy, thanks to the Forward Pass seasons—available in a free version with 7 useful rewards, or a Premium version (purchasable with Aquanium Gems)! The Premium Forward Pass includes 2 themed ship styles, Flact, and Aquanium Gems, with a total of 30 levels. Complete daily missions to level up and finish the current season’s Forward Pass. A new Pass arrives every two months. Each month also brings new playable events with rewards such as exclusive ship styles and other useful resources. Log in regularly to discover what’s new! POWER UP In addition to the POWER-UPS you'll find throughout the stages, you can also upgrade your spaceship's stats—such as health, damage dealt to enemies, and more—by spending Flact, which you earn simply by playing the game in various modes and opening Astronaut Crates. Make your way through the universe in Asteroid Forward!

rows.name: GodsArena Online
rows.short_description: GodsArena is a dream game created by our small independent team inspired by classic MMORPGs. Four playable classes, a wide variety of pets, dungeons, maps, and of course — fierce rivals!
rows.description_html: GodsArena is a dream project brought to life by our small independent team, inspired by the golden age of classic MMORPGs. Our mission was to recapture the spirit of true MMORPG gameplay, while adapting it to the pace of modern players who may not have 10+ hours a day to spare. So, what is GodsArena ? At its core, it features four unique classes — Mage, Warrior, Champion, and Priest — each with their own distinctive playstyle, abilities, and strengths. All classes are carefully balanced for thrilling PvP battles and efficient monster hunting across the open world. But your hero won’t be alone. Pets play a crucial role in battle — choose from dozens of companions, each with unique traits and skills. Pets grow stronger, level up, and learn new abilities, often turning the tide of combat. For collectors, there’s the option to own multiple pets and work toward a full collection. Mounts are also at your disposal — not just for faster travel across the expansive world, but also for enhancing your character’s stats. Mounts can be upgraded and equipped with special gear that directly boosts your performance in combat. The world of GodsArena is inspired by ancient Greece and divided into two warring factions: Athens and Sparta. When creating a character, you’ll choose your allegiance and engage in an ongoing struggle for dominance and resources through large-scale PvP events. PvE enthusiasts will find a rich variety of instances and dungeons, offering both solo and group content with powerful bosses and valuable loot. Crafting and economic systems provide opportunities to gather resources, create useful items, and trade them on the in-game marketplace. For players who love character progression, GodsArena offers an extensive enhancement system. Unlike many other games, your gear doesn’t become obsolete as you level up — it can be upgraded and improved without losing any prior investment. You can also level up your skills, pets, mounts, and core attributes, making every character truly one of a kind. GodsArena is constantly evolving, and even now offers: • Over 50 maps for PvP and PvE battles • Dozens of dungeons • A wide range of events and seasonal content Join us and become part of the legend in the world of GodsArena !

rows.name: Keep 'Em Out!
rows.short_description: A single-player wave-based zombie survival FPS where you shoot, barricade, and upgrade to survive increasingly intense undead assaults using weapons, perks, and strategic defense.
rows.description_html: Keep 'Em Out is a fast-paced, wave-based zombie shooter where survival depends on skill, strategy, and the right perks. Barricade doors, blast through hordes of the undead, and earn powerful upgrades through a unique card selection system. After certain rounds, choose from randomized perk cards that permanently enhance your abilities — increase weapon damage, boost fire rate, regenerate health, or even defy death itself. Every choice matters. Build your loadout, hold your ground, and keep 'em out before they tear through your defenses. Can you survive the night?

rows.short_description: Wizard’s Gambit — A 2D strategy card game where four magical factions battle for dominance through tactical card placement, faction powers, and evolving decks.
rows.description_html: Wizard's Gambit — a Magical Clash of Strategy and Power Step into the mystical world of Wizard’s Gambit , a fast-paced 2D strategy card game where magic, wit, and cunning decide the victor. Choose your faction, and test your skills in a duel of strategy and luck. Whether you’re a fan of card battlers or simply love fantasy worlds, Wizard’s Gambit offers an accessible yet competitive experience. In this first build, the game introduces single-player mode , faction selection , and a full deck of magical cards , giving you a solid foundation to explore the world of spellcasting and tactical play. Each match challenges you to think ahead, combine abilities, and outmaneuver your opponent to claim victory. Key Features 🎴 2D Fantasy Card Battles – Simple to learn, tough to master. 🧙 Faction Selection – Pick from four unique magical schools. 📖 Full Deck of Cards – Unlock diverse spells and characters. ☁️ Unity Cloud Save – Keep your progress across sessions. 🧩 Strategic Gameplay – Every card you play shapes the board.

rows.name: Tag! You're Dead
rows.short_description: Tag! You're Dead is a fast-paced side-scroller based on the FOUND TV film demo_n. Run, jump, and dodge through glitchy horror as a demonic force hunts you. It’s you vs. the darkness in this addictive, high-score chase. How long can you survive?
rows.description_html: Tag! You're Dead is a fast-paced, side-scrolling horror arcade game where every second you survive makes the game harder. Inspired by the FOUND TV film demo_n , this one-button nightmare drops you into a glitch-ridden world full of collapsing platforms, demonic traps, and sudden jump scares. You tap, dash, and jump to stay alive as the screen speeds up and the pressure builds. The farther you get, the faster it goes—and the more twisted the game becomes. At first, it seems simple: dodge obstacles, survive the demons, and climb the leaderboard. But very quickly, you'll find yourself in a state of full-panic reflexes as the speed increases, the visuals distort, and the enemies become relentless. It’s brutal, fast, and addictively fun —a game that dares you to try “just one more run” even after your 20th crash. There are no checkpoints. No second chances. Just your instincts and a steadily unraveling nightmare trying to catch you. What Makes It Unique: One-button twitch gameplay Creepy found footage horror aesthetic Demons that get faster and smarter the longer you last Retro glitch visuals and VHS-style effects Original horror soundtrack that builds with intensity Tag! You're Dead is perfect for fans of Geometry Dash , Flappy Bird , or anyone who wants a creepy, high-score arcade challenge that feels different every time. How far can you go before the shadows catch you?

rows.name: cLocked In
rows.short_description: Step into the boots of a rookie city police guard in a sprawling fantasy metropolis. Uphold the law, take on escalating missions, and rise through the ranks from parking tickets to deadly confrontations. Customize your gear, explore the city, and maybe lose your paycheck at the local casino.
rows.description_html: Description: Step into the boots of a rookie officer in cLocked In , a fast-paced open-world police simulator set in a vibrant, low-poly, fantasy city where humans, orcs, elves, and goblins coexist—and crime never sleeps. You're the newest recruit on the force, starting small but dreaming big. From writing parking tickets in quiet suburbs to breaking up dangerous drug rings and surviving magical shootouts, your rise through the ranks begins now. Explore Four Unique Districts: Hannara – Human-dominated suburban streets with minor infractions and neighborhood disputes. Morgatelis – Glittering skyscrapers housing wealthy elves and goblins—and the white-collar crimes they commit. DelDedria – A gritty, dangerous zone home to orcs and humans, where gang violence and illegal deals run rampant. Colezaria – An industrial wasteland policed with grit, where orc laborers and criminal rings clash in the factories. Gameplay & Features: 🛡️ Tier-Based Crime Response Tier 1 (Low-Risk) : Chase down fleeing suspects such as graffiti artists, write parking tickets, and detain petty criminals using handcuffs. Tier 2 (Medium-Risk) : Use your trusty baton to break up street fights, control vandalism, and disarm and detain drug dealers. Tier 3 (High-Risk) : Gear up with a pistol and deploy a futuristic shield to face magical shootouts, bomb threats, and organized bank robberies. 🎖️ Level Up Your Officer Earn XP and credits by resolving crimes correctly—non-lethal takedowns and appropriate force earn bigger rewards. Level up to take on more dangerous assignments, access higher crime tiers, and unlock perks and cosmetics. 🚓 Customize Your Loadout Spend your hard-earned credits on: Weapon camos for your pistol and baton New police vehicles including high-speed cars and bikes Weapon upgrades such as ranged and melee damage output as well as magazine size 🎰 Live the Off-Duty Life Take a break from justice and explore city life: Hit the casino and try your luck at four unique table games using the credits you earn in game Socialize with NPCs, explore district cultures 🔓 Master Your Role Climb from rookie patrol to elite enforcer. With every promotion (level up), you'll unlock access to new camos, special achievements to unlock vehicles, and the trust of your precinct to handle the city's darkest corners. What are you waiting for? Serve by the book to bring justice your way. The city awaits, Officer.

rows.name: Hollowing
rows.short_description: Play as a student who is alone outside. He is constantly under academic and social pressure. As anxiety and loneliness accumulated, he began to notice something unusual. In this inescapable fear, he must find the answer... or be consumed by it.
rows.description_html: 《Hollowing》 is a first person perspective pixel style psychological horror game that focuses on immersive experiences of narrative exploration and eerie atmosphere. You will play the role of an international student studying alone in a foreign country, attending classes on campus during the day and returning to a dim and silent apartment at night, repeating a meaningless life day after day. In this closed and lonely environment, time gradually becomes blurred, and reality and illusion begin to intersect. The shadow outside the window is getting closer and closer, and the whispers at night are becoming clearer. Is something approaching or is your mind collapsing? The main gameplay of the game is first person interactive exploration, which unlocks the character's inner world and story clues through walking, observing, and interacting with objects. The game is mainly driven by the plot, with a strong narrative progression as the main axis, advancing day by day, feeling the character's psychological state gradually collapsing, bringing you a psychologically terrifying experience The inspiration for the story comes from the loneliness and cultural barriers experienced by real international students. The game has no combat system and focuses on psychological stress and environmental narrative. This will be a journey about anxiety, loneliness, and the breakdown of self-awareness. What exactly are you facing? A real monster? Or is it just a projection of your inner self? flee? Or face it? This gradually distorted daily routine is waiting for you to uncover the truth. This is my first game，please enjoy.

rows.name: District Zero
rows.short_description: Shoot your way through an alien takeover. Using your flashlight to see through the darkness and fight the aliens to make your way off the ship.
rows.description_html: District Zero is a horror FPS game, in which you shoot your way through aliens that have taken over your spaceship, in which you must escape. Keep yourself alive for long enough and you might just escape the aliens clutches through the escape pod. Using your Helmet to gain information about your health. Keeping yourself alive using stations, and blowing through enemies. And listen to announcements over tips to help you escape. But watch out as the deep clutches of space may get to you.

rows.short_description: Your adorable waifu lives on your taskbar, always by your side as you work, browse, or game. Customize her look with cute accessories and enjoy her calming presence throughout your day.
rows.description_html: you’re never alone your loyal waifu is always by your side, right on your taskbar. She’s your cute, animated sidekick who cheers you on, reacts to your clicks, and grows stronger the more time you spend together. While you work, browse, or game, unlock cute accessories like hats, ears, and other fun add-ons. Customize her look, enjoy charming interactions, and let her keep you company as you conquer the day one idle tap at a time. Yui is your sweet digital companion who lives right on your taskbar. Always by your side, she brings charm and cheer to your day. Yui keeps things simple give her a little click and she rewards you with a cute, satisfying bounce, adding a bit of fun to your daily routine. Yui  Your Gentle Desktop Companion While you go about your daily routine, Yui quietly watches over you from the corner of your screen. Whenever you need a little motivation, a peaceful distraction, or just a gentle smile, Yui is always there your serene and beautiful waifu in the digital world.

rows.name: Weapon Case
rows.short_description: A top-down roguelite shooter where you command a ship and survive endless waves of sea monsters. Manually aim your main weapon, auto-fire the rest, and upgrade to stay afloat, or sink trying.
rows.description_html: Survive the Swarm at Sea. Take the fight to the open ocean in this fast-paced top-down roguelite shooter where you pilot everything from a humble raft to a full-blown battleship. Battle relentless hordes of mutant sea creatures, upgrade your firepower, and see how long you can stay afloat in this nautical twist on the auto-shooter genre. Choose your ship. Pick your weapon. Aim. Survive. In this 2D top-down arena shooter, you’ll start each run by selecting your vessel and a primary weapon, which you manually aim with the mouse. As the ocean gets deadlier by the second, you’ll gather upgrades, unlock new ship weapons that auto-fire at nearby threats, and build an unstoppable floating fortress, or sink trying. Key Features Battle waves of aggressive sea creatures in real-time combat Unlock and pilot unique ships, from makeshift rafts to war-ready battleships Manually aim your starter weapon for precision, while new weapons auto-fire Upgrade your arsenal and combine weapons for devastating synergies Roguelite progression: No two runs are the same Face off against elite enemies and monstrous bosses from the deep

rows.name: Farm Manager
rows.short_description: Create and manage your own farm. Strategize, expand, plant, grow and harvest the lands and breed prize-worthy animals in this immersive farm management game. Farm Manager is among the most realistic of the strategy genre - so prove yourself and beat your friends and other real life managers.
rows.description_html: Become a CEO and Build Your Farming Empire Today! Start an exciting journey as the ultimate Farm Manager! Strategize, expand, grow the lands and breed prize-worthy animals in this immersive farm management game. Whether you dream of running a small business or ruling a global industrial empire, you create your adventure yourself. Prove yourself and beat your friends and other real life managers to top the leaderboards by creating the most successful empire. Key Features Fields Worldwide: Choose from over 22 million real-world fields across the globe - all based on actual geographic data. Acquire new farms anywhere and expand your empire! Realistic Agriculture Data: Farm Manager leverages real-world inspired data, including pH levels, soil types, contamination classifications and regional agricultural trends. Real-world weather conditions update every hour. Realistic Tractor Models: Indulge yourself in vehicle models similar to John Deere, New Holland, Case, Fendt, Ferguson, MAN and CLAAS. Equip your machines with implements to complete essential tasks such as plowing, fertilizing, seeding, and irrigating. Diverse Crops: Choose from a growing variety of seeds to plant and manage — each with its own characteristics, needs, and market value. Keep Farm Animals: Care for your animals by keeping them well-fed and content. Improve their quality through smart breeding and proper management. Dynamic Marketplace: Experience realistic economic scenarios and market fluctuations. Stay on top of supply and demand to buy seed and sell crops at the perfect time! Customizable Tractors: Upgrade your machines to suit your style and enhance performance. Global Connections: Track your farms live in each city on the interactive map. Achievements & Rewards: Earn valuable rewards as you grow your business and prove your skills as a top-tier farm manager! You can optimize details, earn a perfect harvest and acquire the best equipment, but only you, the manager and farmer, can become the CEO of an empire of fields, animals and crops and utilize your complicated strategy to be the new tycoon boss of bio and hay today. 📈 Whether you're creating a specialized trade or creating a multinational supply chain, this Farm Manager tycoon lets you take control of every detail. The immersive graphics, engaging gameplay, and realistic mechanics make this the ultimate farming simulator for fans of strategy games. Why Choose Farm Manager? From strategic decisions to hands-on management, this game offers unparalleled depth for those who love logistics, data, animals and city-building games. Build your empire and prove you’re the ultimate manager tycoon! 🚀 Download this Farm Manager tycoon now and start your journey toward farmer greatness!

rows.name: Dungeon Raid: Zero Floor
rows.short_description: Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.
rows.description_html: Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger. SPECIAL FEATURES - A unique progression system. Find the door to the next floor and use the key to proceed. But be careful! Just one wrong decision could lead you to death. Choose your next card that will make you one step closer to victory! - Instinct-based roguelike. Make decisions at every turn. Find useful cards and combine objects found in the chests and bought at the shop to power up your character. But beware the traps and dangerous enemies! -There's always one more try. You'll never feel fully prepared deep down the dungeon. The game is created for replay. Every new playthrough is unique and will feel fresh even to the most experienced players. Use your instincts and your character's unique abilities to fend off the dangerous creatures that lurk deep under the earth. - Fully compatible with all gamepads, including Steam Deck. - Stylish 2D pixel art. HERE'S A TASTE OF WHAT YOU GET IN THE GAME - 6 unlockable heroes. Each with unique passive abilities and spells that allow you to change your game style with every playthrough. - Lots of colourful and detailed cards and items to unlock. - More than 10 unique bosses, each requiring a special approach to defeat. - If the game feels too challenging, you can use card upgrades to make your playthrough an easier experience.

And try not to die... from hunger. SPECIAL FEATURES - A unique progression system. Find the door to the next floor and use the key to proceed. But be careful! Just one wrong decision could lead you to death. Choose your next card that will make you one step closer to victory! - Instinct-based roguelike. Make decisions at every turn. Find useful cards and combine objects found in the chests and bought at the shop to power up your character. But beware the traps and dangerous enemies! -There's always one more try. You'll never feel fully prepared deep down the dungeon. The game is created for replay. Every new playthrough is unique and will feel fresh even to the most experienced players. Use your instincts and your character's unique abilities to fend off the dangerous creatures that lurk deep under the earth. - Fully compatible with all gamepads, including Steam Deck. - Stylish 2D pixel art. HERE'S A TASTE OF WHAT YOU GET IN THE GAME - 6 unlockable heroes. Each with unique passive abilities and spells that allow you to change your game style with every playthrough. - Lots of colourful and detailed cards and items to unlock. - More than 10 unique bosses, each requiring a special approach to defeat. - If the game feels too challenging, you can use card upgrades to make your playthrough an easier experience.

rows.name: Virtual City Playground®: Build Your Metropolis
rows.short_description: Relaxing city builder where you grow a vibrant metropolis, produce goods, manage transit and build iconic landmarks at your own pace.
rows.description_html: Create your perfect metropolis! Looking for a city builder that's fun, friendly and stress-free? Welcome to Virtual City Playground®. No complex traffic systems or steep learning curves — just relaxing, satisfying city building at your own pace. Key Features • Build and Expand Grow your small town into a thriving metropolis. Construct stylish residential districts and productive industrial zones with ease. • Enjoy Smooth Progression Manufacture goods, deliver them to shopping malls and steadily grow your city's economy through a simple, rewarding gameplay loop. • Create Efficient Transit Set up convenient transport routes that move citizens to parks, cinemas, stadiums and more. • Keep Your City Thriving Plant trees, recycle waste, upgrade buildings and unlock hospitals and fire stations to keep your city healthy and safe. • Construct Epic Landmarks Reach for the skies with unique structures like the Eco Skyscraper, Ice Castle, Airport, Casino, Hangar and even a Shuttle Launch Pad. • Celebrate Your Citizens Host vibrant public events to keep your residents happy and your city full of life. While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings. You can play this game whether you’re offline or online. ______________________________ Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish.

rows.name: Sherlock: Hidden Object & Match-3 Mystery
rows.short_description: Explore familiar stories with Sherlock Holmes! Solve mysteries, find hidden objects, and play match-3 puzzles to restore classic tales. Join clans, take part in events, and uncover secrets across hundreds of detailed levels — the magnifying glass is in your hands!
rows.description_html: Your favorite books are falling apart — and only Sherlock can save them. Dive into a world where classic stories twist into chaos. In Sherlock: Hidden Object & Match-3 Mystery, someone — or something — is tampering with the endings of legendary novels. Heroes are missing. Villains take control. Team up with Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson to uncover what’s behind these literary mysteries and restore the truth. Explore intricately crafted storybook settings, solve logic-based challenges, and uncover hidden clues as you move through distorted narratives. Choose your playstyle: search richly detailed scenes in hidden object mode, or relax with thoughtful match-3 gameplay — both seamlessly woven into the unfolding mystery. Key Features • Challenge yourself with special conditions: night scenes, mirrored objects, time-limited puzzles, and more • Travel through the grand central Library: each book unlocks a new case inspired by the world's greatest literature • Immerse yourself in hand-painted scenes: inspired by vintage illustrations and timeless art styles • Play your way: switch between hidden object scenes and match-3 puzzles • Experience regular live events: seasonal content, unique rewards, and limited-time challenges While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings. You can play this game whether you’re offline or online. ______________________________ Game available in: English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Spanish (Latin America).

rows.name: Before the End
rows.short_description: Before the End is a grid-based puzzle game that follows the dinosaurs during the time just before their extinction. Interact with the environment and manipulate strange quantum powers to progress through the natural world. What can you achieve in the time before the end?
rows.description_html: Before the End is a 2D top-down grid-based puzzle game taking place during prehistoric times. In each level, the player must reach the goal to pass time and move ever closer towards the anticipated extinction of the dinosaurs. Within each level, you will utilize strange quantum powers to manipulate natural objects by swapping them amongst each other. You will also find yourself less alone as you play, recruiting an expanding cast of dinosaur friends to help you manipulate the environment in new and layered ways. Explore an expansive world by progressing through 70 increasingly difficult levels spread through a variety of natural environments. Witness what lies ahead and determine what you can accomplish in the time before the end? This game was originally created by Jodi Foster as an undergraduate Honors Thesis at the University of Florida.

rows.name: Line Hopper
rows.short_description: In this unique game, you get to see what a two-dimensional world composed of multicolored lines looks like from the perspective of the main character, Linus. Whereas you and I see our 3D world as a series of 2D images, Linus sees his 2D world in one dimension: as a single vertical line!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Line Hopper! In this unique game (the first 1st-person 2D platformer ever created), you get to see what a two-dimensional world composed of multicolored lines looks like from the perspective of the main character, Linus. Whereas you and I see our 3D world as a series of 2D images, Linus sees his 2D world in one dimension: as a single vertical line! Piecing together what is going on from his vantage point is challenging at first, but once you've gotten used to it, you'll be surprised how much you are able to see! Black and purple lines represent every-day obstacles that you can walk on, jump off of, and slide against. Red lines are enemies, and the goal of each level is to reach the green line. When you reach a yellow line, you get to see the full level from a 2D perspective for as long as you remain in contact with it; otherwise, you and Linus are on your own! Comes with a tool to create your own levels! (A multiplayer mode for this game is currently under development.)

rows.name: Die. Respawn. Repeat.
rows.short_description: A fast-paced, minimalist bullet hell where dying makes you stronger. Originally made for a game jam, now polished and released as a free standalone.
rows.description_html: You’re a circle. Everything else wants you gone. But every time you die, you leave something behind — a glowing shield, a permanent upgrade, a memory of failure turned into a tool for survival. Die. Upgrade. Try again. In this neon-lit bullet hell, every death creates a persistent upgrade that stays on the battlefield — blocking bullets, shaping new strategies, and gradually turning chaos into rhythm. This is a small, free game I made during a game jam. I liked the vibe, so I decided to polish it up and share it here on Steam. It’s short, weird, and (hopefully) satisfying. No microtransactions, no fluff — just you, the shapes, and the bullets.

rows.name: Lost Island
rows.short_description: You arrive on a deserted island. Will you be able to rebuild your boat to return home and uncover the island's secret ?
rows.description_html: Lost Island is an RPG Maker MV game where you end up stranded on a deserted island by accident. Your goal is to find a way back home! Explore the island, interact with various objects and animals, and use the items in your inventory. You might even discover some secrets. Estimated playtime: 15 to 30 minutes.

rows.name: flowloop&
rows.short_description: flowloop& is a minimalistic anti-gravity racer where you try and stay on the track for as long as you can. Every day you can play on three new procedurally generated levels where you race around in 3D-space.
rows.description_html: flowloop& is a minimalistic anti-gravity racer where you try and stay on the track for as long as you can. Every day you can play on three new procedurally generated levels where you race around in 3D-space. The game is intended for those moments where you have a short 5 - 20 min break and just want to get your mind off whatever you are currently doing. Keyboard controls: Turn with A-D Boost with ↑ decelerate with ↓ Gamepad controls: Turn with left stick Boost with X decelerate with A Controls can be found and changed in the Settings menu. Use strafing and sharp turns to help you stay on the track longer. Works with a controller and keyboard. If the game stutters then please consider turning down the AA and track details.

rows.name: Bass Harrier
rows.short_description: Bass Harrier is a rhythm-fueled shoot 'em up. This world is powered by the Riddim of the music—enemy spawns, environments, and even the lights shift dynamically to the stage's soundtrack. No need for prior experience—just follow the beat, dodge threats, and fire away!
rows.description_html: New Mixtape mode Available! Preselected arcade runs are now available to play. Can you unlock the secret Forbidden Tape? About the Game Bass Harrier is an electrifying fusion of rhythm and arcade shooting, where the beat controls the battlefield. Even if you've never played a rhythm game or a shmup before, you'll quickly get into the groove! Enemies, environments, and even the lights react to the music, creating a dynamic experience where timing is everything. Instead of memorizing complex patterns, just feel the beat—your movements and attacks sync naturally with the soundtrack. Whether you're dodging waves of enemies or unleashing powerful shots, the music guides you. No prior experience needed—just jump in, follow the rhythm, and let the game pull you into its pulse-pounding world! In the land of Vasta, rhythm is life—and one prince holds the key to keeping the beat alive. With his boundless talent and unwavering spirit, he spreads music, color, and joy to all who listen. But today, the groove is under siege. A band of unscrupulous disruptors has emerged from the shadows, striking at the heart of the kingdom’s rhythm. Their chaos threatens to silence the pulse that drives Vasta, turning harmony into discord. But the prince? He’s not about to let the music die. Armed with his rhythm, courage, and an unstoppable beat, he sets out to reclaim the soul of the land. Every step, every note, every perfectly timed attack sends a message—this groove won’t break. The battle for Vasta isn’t just a fight—it’s a performance. And the stage is set for the most electrifying showdown the world has ever seen. Will the groove prevail? Or will the silence take hold? This summer, prepare to feel the rhythm like never before. Play your way: Dive into Play Album , a classic arcade mode that lets you experience full musical journeys; Explore the Mixtape Mode , where various routes remix your adventure in surprising ways; Or fine-tune your skills in Singletrack , perfect for practicing specific levels. And if you think you’re skilled enough to unlock a secret mixtape route—well, let’s just say, Vasta doesn’t hand out VIP passes easily.

rows.name: A Better Tomorrow
rows.short_description: Rabies shatters a young cop's peaceful life. Confronted by this incurable virus, he must choose: leave the police force or hide his illness to trace his infection source. In this visual novel, witness his fate while uncovering the city's darkest secrets—past and present.
rows.description_html: Rabies erupts without warning, rupturing the young policeman’s placid existence. Condemned by this incurable, lifelong affliction, he confronts an agonizing ultimatum: surrender his badge to reality’s demands, or bury his sickness to hunt the truth behind his infection. This is merely the prologue. When fate beckons him down a path drenched in shadows, his investigation will drag into the light this city’s most sordid secrets—corruption festering through decades, bleeding into the present. Game Features: Razor-sharp pacing: Zero filler; every detail fuels the core mystery. Cinematic sequences: Every frame intensifies the narrative weight. Immersive soundscape: 100+ SFX pull you deeper into the world. Linear destiny: Become fate’s accomplice in his desperate struggle.

rows.name: JustRun
rows.short_description: 'Just Run' is a very simple platform jumping game that only requires movement and jumping to complete the entire process. The key point is a simple jumping adventure, using the props of the scene to interact and reach the end.
rows.description_html: 'Just Run' is a very simple game, with simple movement, simple jumping, simple background, and a 2D platform game composed of many simple elements. You will play a white pattern creature, breaking through the preset map, with only the functions of jumping and moving, and interacting with the derived scene props, avoiding dangerous objects on the scene, picking up points and reaching the destination. When you have collected all the points and come to the point, you will see new changes in the scene and generate new routes. You will once again adventure on the new route. Jumping and moving are the skills you can rely on most. Story You will see the essence of the four seasons on the map, an abstract representation of seasonal changes, and it seems that some scenes and props on the map will change accordingly? The cycle of the four seasons turns, with the end connected to the beginning. Game content Game duration is about 1 hour 4 chapters in total 4 background music

rows.name: Dark December
rows.short_description: Pre-Registration Period: 9th Dec 2025 - until launch Engage in fierce battles and shape your own combat style with unique weapon–skill combinations. Each character has distinct abilities and weapons, and with strategic bonus stat allocation, you can challenge even the most formidable foes.
rows.description_html: Dark December unfolds in the prequel universe of Undecember, set in a turbulent era where remnants of ancient civilizations clash with mythic powers. As the player, you will uncover the forgotten truth of a fallen hero, confronting powerful factions across a battlefield consumed by chaos. Experience an epic tale where myth and destiny intertwine brought to life through immersive storytelling and intense action. Welcome to the world of DarkDecember Master strategic party-based raids, harness class-specific rune systems, and customize your gear through the power of Aether Cores — all to forge a character stronger than ever before. In DarkDecember , weapons are more than just steel. They evolve with your will, becoming a force capable of reshaping the battlefield itself. Immersive Campaign and Growth Strengthen your character through strategic party-based raids, class-specific rune systems, and item customization powered by Aether Cores. In DarkDecember, weapons are more than mere steel they evolve with the player’s will, becoming a force capable of reshaping the tide of battle. Endless Challenges Test your limits in the Corridor of Oblivion and the Dimensional Rift . The Corridor of Oblivion is a place where forgotten memories and present nightmares collide where fallen bosses rise once more, stronger than ever, to challenge you again. In the Dimensional Rift, you must join forces with your allies to fend off waves of enemies seeking to resurrect the sealed Valknut . Stand your ground against the oncoming darkness and protect a crumbling world. The hero who can turn the tide of fate is you.

rows.name: Zombie Ants VR: Definitive Edition
rows.short_description: Zombie Ants VR is a short educational experience that takes the player through the life cycle of Ophiocordyceps, a fungus that manipulates the behavior of insects in order to increase the spread of its spores. This 'zombie fungus' was a large inspiration for the video game series Last of Us!
rows.description_html: Zombie Ants VR is a short (5-10 minute) educational experience that takes the player through the life cycle of Ophiocordyceps, a fungus that manipulates the behavior of insects (in this case ants) in order to increase the spread of its spores. This fungus was a large inspiration for the video game series Last of Us and is often referred to as the 'Zombie Fungus'. The game offers several different control schemes to accommodate all sorts of players from those who have never used VR before to those who want a more interactive experience. There is also a motion sickness option. Educational content of the game is recommended for ages 12+, but may be suitable for younger audiences. Zombie Ants VR was created by a large collaborative effort between researchers, student, and recent-graduates of the University of Central Florida (UCF) biology, game development, and acting departments as well as the University of Utrecht (UU) biology, computer science, and arts departments. It was supported by NSF Career 1941546, made available to Charissa de Bekker, and internal funding form Utrecht University, made available to William C. Beckerson.

rows.name: SaHwa_The Altered Timeline
rows.short_description: SaHwa: Black Tortoise is a third-person action-adventure game created in Unity for portfolio purposes. Set in a fantasy version of Joseon, players fight to protect the land from rising threats. Each character has unique skills and passives. Use them to defeat enemies in this single-player journey.
rows.description_html: ❖ Game Description (English) ❖ A fantasy game set in an alternate history of Joseon Korea. In the depths of desperate prayers, a new deity— the God of Lamentation —was born. But the god turned traitor, plunging Joseon into chaos. As the divine turmoil reached a point beyond salvation, the gods intervened, shifting Joseon into a different timeline— a world that now stands in resistance against the God of Lamentation. Joseon is already being devoured by corruption... Stand with Joseon. rows.name: Laugh Track
rows.short_description: You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever! Choose your scripts, decide what characters to build relationships with, and keep those audience ratings high -- or get cancelled in more ways than one! Welcome to Must See TV.
rows.description_html: Welcome To Your New Job You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever! We're so happy you've chosen permanent employment. Management has infinite faith in your ability to steer our production team towards our mysterious and important endgame. You'll be guiding four teenagers -- Juno, Cat, Daniel, and Remy -- through the trials and travails of high school life. Using our patented 'Ratings(tm)' system, you'll make decisions that keep them entertainingly unhappy! But not too unhappy, or they'll break. But also not too relaxed, or they'll fight back. We can't have that, no! How will we ever reach syndication if the entire project collapses? Game Features A visual novel from the creators of Arcade Spirits, Penny Larceny, and The Shadow Over Cyberspace! Four human teens with Teen Problems!  And one hamster. Can you help them find their way? Eight episodes of wacky shenanigans and soul-crushing real-world drama! You choose the episode order, you choose who to focus on! Relationships, romances, and ratings -- all leading to the ending you desire! Will you fight back against Management, or comply with the job? Classical cartoony visuals and music, to tickle your nostalgia bones! Full text-to-speech support for disability access, using NVDA if available! Just tap the V key to activate before you start a new game. The promise of utter annihilation if you fail in your task! Doesn't that sound like fun? I Would Like To Decline This Opportunity Please You don't want to be part of an eternal cosmic hive mind, yoked to your typewriter, forced to tune sitcom scripts until your continued existence is determined to be redundant and your soul gets re-absorbed into Management? You want out...? There is no out . There is only in . Welcome to Laugh Track. A free game (with optional donation) coming to your PC in early 2026 from Fiction Factory Games, creators of Arcade Spirits, Penny Larceny, and the Shadow Over Cyberspace.

rows.name: Cry Of Monster
rows.short_description: Everything fell apart. People started getting sick… not in a normal way. Now the city is desolate, and the only thing that matters is finding out if your best friend is still alive. You'll have to explore, run, hide, and face the contamination.
rows.description_html: Cry of Monster is a 2D survival horror game with a pixel art style that immerses you in an experience filled with tension, mystery, and gore. You control a young woman in an abandoned city, searching for her best friend who vanished under unsettling circumstances. In this short game (1 hour), you must solve puzzles, execute mechanics, explore environments, and face grotesque monsters. Main Features: Engaging Story: Uncover the truth behind your friend's disappearance through an emotional narrative full of unexpected twists. Survival and Puzzles: Use your wits to solve environmental puzzles and escape deadly traps while managing limited resources to survive. Multiple Gore Deaths: Every mistake can lead to one of many brutal and visually striking deaths. Pixel Art Style: Enjoy retro 2D art that blends nostalgia with an oppressive atmosphere, complemented by a haunting soundtrack and sound effects. Will you find your friend and escape alive, or become prey to the unknown? Warning: This game contains explicit gore content, including graphic violence and bloody deaths, which may not be suitable for all audiences.

rows.name: Dotakawa☆COOKING BATTLE
rows.short_description: Hit 'em with a pan! Grab that ingredient!! Let's Dotakawa☆ COOKING BATTLE!! The goal is to complete more bento boxes than anyone else within the limited time. Gather the ingredients, cook them, and get the bento box ready!
rows.description_html: －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ This game was developed as part of new employee training at Byking Inc. Depending on your PC environment, you may experience some issues or bugs during play. We ask for your kind understanding should you encounter any such issues. This game is made for Local-Play, but online multiplayer is available via Steam Remote Play Together. *This is a competitive game for 1 to 4 players. *Multiplayer mode is only available with controllers. Mouse-and-keyboard is not supported. *A controller is required for each player. The game is made for Local-Play. －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ Your first thought at seeing this game might be, 'Just like a typical cooking game' ...but the real battle lies behind the cooking...and the frying pan behind your back... ■Hectic sabotage action Whacking others with a pan to steal their stuff, or swiping their food while they’re looking the other way. It’s like a battle royale, right in the middle of class! Do whatever it takes to win! There's no right or wrong! All is fair in cook-and-war!! ■Whack them! Before they snitch! If your under-handed actions are seen by other students, they'll rush to tell the teacher. And if you don't stop them...a 'stunning' bolt of justice will strike, costing you precious bento-time! To prevent this we'll need them to forget what they've witnessed... So chase them with your frying pan, and go right for the head! Instant memory-loss! ■Surprisingly deep strategy!? Just whacking others won't help you win the game. You'll have to cook, to steal, to attack, and balance multiple tasks in order to get ahead of the other players. Or...perhaps keeping a low, pacifist profile is also a viable strategy...? The way of the violent pan, or the path of peaceful cooking... To win by force, or by diligent skill... the choice is yours.

rows.name: 今夜无人入眠 No One Sleep Tonight
rows.short_description: No One Sleep Tonight is a game that focuses on the feeling of Night. You will go through multiple midnight scenes and experience different environments and gameplay, explore this world created by street lamp, moonlight, and wind.
rows.description_html: No One Sleeps Tonight is a game consisting of multiple midnight scenes. You will travel through several environments with unique gameplay and styles to experience different nighttime emotions. The game includes dozen unique scenes, each representing a character's experience under the cover of night. You could be a sniper waiting for your target on the battlefield, a child sneaking out of the room at midnight, or a traveler waiting for a bus to come in the rain. In addition to the differences between environments, each scene also has different gameplay and ending conditions. Will you drive a speeding car on a rainy mountain road, or walk quietly down a silent alley in search of your destination? Every choice you make during the night may unlock new items and lead you to the next moonlit space. We hope that each experience will remind you of your own nighttime emotions. And then, have a good NIGHT.

rows.name: 7 Jobs at the Same Time
rows.short_description: A Point and Click work simulator where you juggle 7 jobs to pay your debt. Start by doing simple spreadsheet and progress to more important job like overseeing a nuclear bomb.
rows.description_html: Congrats you just graduated! But now you have pay for your student loan. Time to  get a job . Let's start with something basic : filling out spreadsheets, easy enough But the bills keep coming and one job isn't enough, time to get another one File sorting, sort files to the correct folders, sounds manageable. But 2 jobs is still enough, time to get a third, and maybe even a fourth and fifth one, at this point you might as well get the sixth and seventh job. But since your time is limited, you have to do to them at the same time! Key Features :  Play through 7 days, with each day getting more hectic than the last 7 different jobs for you to juggle Your time is limited, so do your jobs quickly and efficiently! No music! Just the calming sound of a busy office next to a construction site Chat with your employers, receive or send them files, tell them you've finished your job, or alternatively you can send them some very kind words

rows.name: Road Trip to the End of the World
rows.short_description: Road Trip to the End of the World is a visual novel about the death of a friendship. When Andy and her imaginary friend Fishy set off on a road trip to crash their ex-best friend’s wedding, will they know when to hit the brakes?
rows.description_html: Get in, loser, we’re wedding crashing.  Andy Min is having the worst summer: on top of dropping out of med school, she’s been uninvited from her ex-best friend’s wedding. Join her and her imaginary friend Fishy on a cross-country drive to eat burgers, crash a wedding, and perhaps even find closure. Warning: closure sold separately. Features: 1-2 hours of pure road trip chaos A fully original soundtrack Back pain Questionable gas station food Multiple diner burger options An imaginary fish friend who loves you very much ...And a surprise celebrity guest Road Trip to the End of the World is a linear visual novel with point-and-click elements. Enjoy your trip, wherever it may lead you.

rows.short_description: Learn about REAL mushrooms and how to identify them, in this cozy mushroom picking Sim! Also manage your shop and sell them to the local folk.
rows.description_html: This is a cozy mushroom foraging Simulation, that teaches you how to identify 15 different types of mushrooms! You also get to manage your own little Shop, that you inherited from your grandma. Here you may sell all the edible mushrooms you found during the day. And spend that hard earned money on new pages in your mushroom guide, basket upgrades or a lantern to see better in the dark. learn about 15 beginner friendly mushrooms Sell mushrooms to the townsfolk explore a big map inspired by European forests

rows.name: Tanks!
rows.short_description: Bullet-hell top down tank fighting game.
rows.description_html: Get Ready Soldier! You have been approved for the digital tank operator training program. Fight For Your Country! Complete 25 increasingly difficult missions in Campaign mode. Fight a diverse selection of enemy tanks, each with their own gimmicks. From the immobile brown tank, to the invisible white tank, to the deadeye green tank, it won't be an easy task. Face The Brutality Of War! Upgrade your tank in Endless  mode. With rouge-like elements, you'll fight hundreds of tanks, defeat unique bosses, and become more powerful than you can imagine. Or you'll die over, and over, and over again. Enlist Your Friends! Work together in Co-op Campaign ; now with even more brutal levels! And with no extra lives, you'll have to work together to defeat all 25 missions. Or, play competitively and try to get the highest score by destroying the most tanks. Prove You're Worthy! Fight to the death with up to 3 other players  in Last Tank Standing . Be the last player alive at the end of each round to earn points. Set a custom amount of rounds, and at the end, be the one with the highest score to see the other players go BOOM!

rows.name: Ruarua.ru
rows.short_description: Ruarua.ru is a long-term farming project that always accompanies you... It is a simple farming game that can be played anytime and anywhere when you have free time.
rows.description_html: This is a small indie game, created with passion despite the many challenges along the way. It may not have the polish and grandeur of big productions, but I hope it can bring you a moment of lighthearted joy. Ruarua.ru will continue to be updated and improved, striving to offer all explorers a better experience. A long-term farming project that always accompanies you... Ruarua.ru is a long-term farming project that that always accompanies you, It is a simple farming game that can be played anytime and anywhere when you have free time. Here, you can not only make many friends, communicate and play together, but also slowly accumulate resources through playing, and gain a full sense of accomplishment. In Ruarua.ru , you take on the role of an Explorer , embarking on an adventurous journey filled with battles against monsters and the collection of loot cards . You can choose Free Mode , where you actively hunt down monsters to initiate combat, or opt for Explore Mode , where you wait for the next wave of monsters and respond strategically. Of course, there are many other ways to obtain cards as well! Each card has its own unique function — some generate a steady flow of resources, while others enhance your combat skills and performance. As you gather more cards, you can combine lower-tier cards into more powerful higher-tier ones, and equip them to strengthen your abilities. As you grow stronger, you'll gradually unlock access to more dangerous and mysterious places, encounter a variety of NPCs, and uncover more stories and challenges waiting to be revealed. Explorers, let’s set off on this journey together!

rows.name: Kana no Mado
rows.short_description: Learn to read Japanese hiragana and katakana with this calm and focused educational app. Practice kana recognition through sound and visual quizzes. No writing or grammar - just reading practice at your own pace. Ideal for beginners in Japanese.
rows.description_html: Kana no Mado - Plus is here! 🎉 Kana no Mado – Plus is here! Looking to go further with your kana reading? Kana no Mado – Plus adds advanced kana, JLPT vocabulary with kanji and furigana, more quiz options, and full voice audio by a native speaker. A perfect upgrade if you’ve enjoyed the free app! About the Game Kana no Mado – Learn to Read Japanese Kana no Mado (“The Kana Window”) is a calm, distraction-free app that helps you learn to read Japanese kana – the hiragana and katakana characters used in everyday written Japanese. Focused purely on reading, this free version lets you recognize, hear, and read kana using structured lessons and quizzes. No writing, grammar, or distractions – just the reading practice you need to get started. Perfect for beginners and beyond From complete beginners to those who just want to brush up, Kana no Mado makes it easy to learn or review kana reading, your way. Each kana is introduced with sound, supported by examples and reading quizzes you can replay at your own pace. Get used to how kana really look Kana in the real world don’t always look like textbook characters. In Kana no Mado , each character can be displayed in three fonts – a clear print style, a handwritten variant, and a Mincho-style font used in books and signs. What’s included for free LEARN Hiragana – The Basics Learn to read basic hiragana characters with native audio. Katakana – The Basics Learn to read basic katakana characters with native audio. Hiragana Variants & Katakana Variants Practice voiced and combined kana, with instant feedback. PRACTICE Hiragana Quiz – Beginner Drill beginner hiragana at your own pace. Katakana Quiz – Beginner Test beginner katakana with no pressure. Listening Quiz – Kana Train your ear with simple kana sounds. Available in multiple languages English, French, Spanish, German, Simplified Chinese Want to go further? All the core kana content is free. But if you want to practice with real words, track your progress, and unlock new learning and quiz modes, the Kana no Mado Plus DLC has even more to offer.

rows.name: Pirate Go: Bravo
rows.short_description: A turn-based strategy game where classic board game mechanics meet high-seas adventure. Roll the dice, conquer islands, collect treasure, and outwit rivals in your quest to become the ultimate pirate tycoon.
rows.description_html: Pirate Go: Bravo is a thrilling turn-based pirate-themed strategy game inspired by the classic mechanics of Monopoly. Set sail across a vibrant archipelago where every dice roll decides your fate—will you land on a treasure island, a rival's stronghold, or trigger a mysterious event? Build your empire by acquiring islands, collecting tolls, and expanding your maritime domain. Each game is a unique blend of luck and tactics, where your decisions shape your rise as the ultimate pirate tycoon. Face off against other pirates, defend your territory, and seize opportunities to outmaneuver your opponents. Uncover legendary treasures hidden throughout the map by collecting keys and unlocking mysterious chests. Upgrade your fleet, strengthen your economy, and chart your path to domination of the high seas.

rows.name: DOGWALK
rows.short_description: Explore a hand-crafted winter forest as a big adorable dog and a little kid in tow. A short, free, open source project brought to you by Blender Studio.
rows.description_html: Blender Studio's official game project is a short casual interactive story. Play a big, adorable dog traversing through winter woods and help out a little kid decorate a snowman with colorful items hidden in the environment. Explore You are let loose to roam camping grounds, forest paths, idyllic creeks and a frozen pond in this miniature open world. Bound together Guide or drag around your little kid owner that you have in tow. Help each other out, be a menace or be a good boy. Play your way Dive straight in and have the game react to your play-style and choices. There are no fail states. Only player driven moments. A paper craft world Traverse an environment made of real-life paper crafted models, scanned and recreated to be played with. Free for everyone Brought to you by the Blender Studio as the new free and creative commons 'Open Project'. Made with, and available as free and open-source software. The project was used to test and improve both Blender and the Godot Game Engine. Find out more or support our work on the Blender Studio website!

rows.name: DDD - Drone Drop Dash
rows.short_description: A memory-based drone delivery game where every route counts. Rise to the top pilot.
rows.description_html: Drone Drop Dash (DDD) is a fast-paced, memory-based mission game that puts your navigation skills to the test. In a near-future world where drone delivery is a core part of daily logistics, players must memorize flight paths, avoid no-fly zones, and complete high-precision missions under pressure. Inspired by real-world drone challenges such as restricted airspace, collision risks, and strict route planning, DDD delivers a focused gameplay loop built on accuracy, timing, and mental recall. Fly through increasingly complex levels, complete deliveries with efficiency, and avoid costly mistakes. Your goal: Rise through the ranks and become a top-tier drone pilot.  Key Features • Memory-based navigation gameplay • Route optimization and obstacle avoidance • Simple controls, escalating difficulty • Short, skill-focused mission structure • Clean visuals and tight pacing  Drone Drop Dash captures the thrill of precision flight and the tension of real-world delivery scenarios—all in a compact, strategic arcade-style experience.

rows.short_description: “Lots of Cats on an Adventure” is a game where you find hidden cats in comic strips, meow!
rows.description_html: “Lots of Cats on an Adventure” is a game where you find hidden cats in comic strips, meow!   On a peaceful day, humans (a.k.a. cat servants) were abducted by aliens! One brave cat couldn’t just sit back and watch, so they set off on an adventure to gather a crew to rescue their beloved humans…. Find the cats hidden in the beautiful and diverse hand-drawn landscapes, and join the cat friends on their wacky adventure, meow! Find Over 2200 Cats and Special Items! Part 1 (free): 5+1 main landscapes, 5 interactable comic strips, 850+ cats, 250 items Part 2 (DLC): 5+1 main landscapes, 5 interactable comic strips, 850+ cats, 250 items Main Features All comic strips and main landscapes are connected through story progression. Hints can be used once per minute. No penalty for clicking on a spot without a cat. Search freely. Has an original soundtrack, with unique tracks featured in each episode. Another BGM set is also available, so you can choose the one that you like best.
